Introduction
引言
The Register of Historic Parks and Gardens of Special Historic Interest in England (now a component
of the National Heritage List for England) was set up in 1983. It includes designed landscapes of many
types, private and public, which are identified using explicit criteria to possess special interest. To date
over 1650 sites have been included on the Register. Thereby Historic England seeks to increase
awareness of their significance, and to encourage appropriate long-term management. Although
registration is a statutory designation, there are no specific controls for registered parks and gardens
unlike listed buildings or scheduled monuments. However, the National Planning Policy Framework,
gives registered parks and gardens an equal policy status with listed buildings and scheduled
monuments.
英格兰特别历史名胜公园名录(现在是英格兰国家遗产名录的一部分)成立于 1983 年。它包括设计的许多
类型的景观，私人和公共，这是确定使用明确的标准，以拥有特殊的利益。到目前为止，已有超过 1650
个地点被列入登记册。因此，历史悠久的英格兰寻求提高对其重要性的认识，并鼓励适当的长期管理。
虽然注册是一个法定的指定，有没有具体的控制已注册的公园和花园不像列出的建筑物或规定的纪念碑。
然而，国家规划政策框架给予注册公园和花园与列入名录的建筑物和纪念碑同等的政策地位。
This is one of four complementary selection guides which briefly describe the types of designed landscape
included on the Register, and set out selection criteria for designation. This guide covers urban landscapes
ranging from town squares to municipal parks, from private gardens to public walks. The other three guides
treat Rural Landscapes, Institutional Landscapes, and Landscapes of Remembrance. The listing of
buildings in designed landscapes is considered in the Garden and Park Structures selection guide, and the
scheduling of archaeological garden remains, principally but not exclusively earthwork remains, is dealt with
in the Gardens scheduling selection guide.
这是四个补充选择指南之一，简要说明登记册所载的设计景观类型，并列出指定的选择标准。本指南涵盖了
从城镇广场到市政公园，从私人花园到公共步行道的城市景观。其他三本指南分别介绍了乡村景观、机构景
观和纪念景观。在园林和公园结构选择指南中考虑了在设计景观中列出建筑物的问题，在园林规划选择指南
中主要但不完全涉及考古园林遗迹的规划问题。
1 Historical Summary
1 历史概要
1.1 Town and suburban gardens
1.1 市镇及郊区花园
Excavations and survey over the last 20 years at
Roman towns, including Silchester and Wroxeter,
have begun to yield a better understanding of the
nature of the urban experience in the first four
centuries AD. At Wroxeter, for instance,
geophysical survey and air photography has
radically altered how the city is seen; now it is
argued that it was jam-packed with buildings,
rather than a spaciously laid out place with (to use
the modern term) much green space, which was
the traditional perception of the town. Undoubtedly
work in the future, and further technical advances
in investigation, will add new sites and still greater
detail to what is known, and enable better
understanding of the nature of public and private
spaces, and of how such changed over the
Roman centuries.
在过去的 20 年里，对包括锡尔切斯特和劳克斯特
在内的罗马城镇的挖掘和调查，已经开始使人们对
公元前四个世纪城市经验的本质有了更好的理解。
例如，在 Wroxeter，地球物理学勘探和航空摄影已
经从根本上改变了人们对这座城市的看法; 现在有人
认为，这座城市被建筑物挤得水泄不通，而不是一
个拥有大量绿色空间(用现代术语来说)的宽敞布局的
地方，而这正是这座城市的传统观念。毫无疑问，
未来的工作和进一步的调查技术进步，将增加新的
地点和更多已知的细节，使人们能够更好地了解公
共和私人空间的性质，以及这些空间在罗马世纪中
是如何变化的。
Evidence for town gardens during the medieval
period is limited, and derives from documents
including maps and plans, and increasingly from
archaeological excavations. Physical and
cartographic evidence of medieval urban gardens
show that these tended to be narrow but very long.
Modern boundaries often preserve their lines, even
if the plot has been truncated; these plan-elements
contribute considerably
关于中世纪时期城镇花园的证据是有限的，它们来
自包括地图和平面图在内的文献，并且越来越多地
来自考古发掘。中世纪城市花园的物理和地图证据
表明，这些花园往往很窄，但很长。现代的边界往
往保留了它们的线条，即使地块被截断了; 这些规划
元素贡献很大
to the ‘grain’ of historic places. Documents and
archaeology indicate that urban gardens were used
for growing food, for keeping animals, for small-
scale crafts and industries, and for rubbish and
night-soil disposal. It does not appear that ordinary
households had pleasure gardens, although these
were associated with the much larger properties
maintained in towns and especially cities by
aristocrats and leading churchmen. Documentary
evidence shows that in London what we would
today term professional gardeners were attempting
to regulate their
历史地点的“谷物”。文献和考古学表明，城市花
园被用于种植粮食，饲养动物，小型手工业和工业，
以及垃圾和粪便处理。普通家庭似乎没有游乐园，
尽管这些游乐园与城镇，特别是贵族和主要教士在
城市里维持的大得多的财产有关。文件证据表明，
在伦敦，我们今天所说的专业园丁正试图规范他们
的园艺
trade from the thirteenth century, and the
Royal Worshipful Company of Gardeners was
established in 1605 in part to confine
gardening to those with prescribed training,
experience and knowledge.
皇家园丁崇拜公司成立于 1605 年，其部分目的
是将园艺工作局限于那些有规定的培训、经验
和知识的人。
From the mid sixteenth century our knowledge of
gardens increases with the proliferation of
gardening texts and descriptions, printed and
estate maps, and documentation in general.
Together the sources show that, especially in the
suburbs of London and major provincial cities,
pleasure gardens were evolving on the properties
of the well-to-do with features such as walks,
trellised alleys, bowling alleys, mazes,
banqueting houses, and knots and mounts for
looking over the garden wall to the countryside
beyond. Pleasure gardens also appeared in
association with commercial places of
entertainment like inns and brothels.
从 16 世纪中叶开始，我们对园艺的了解随着园艺
文本和描述、印刷品和地图以及一般文献的增加而
增加。资料显示，特别是在伦敦郊区和主要的省级
城市，游乐园是在富人的财产基础上发展起来的，
具有步道、格子小巷、保龄球小巷、迷宫、宴会房
屋以及越过花园围墙眺望远方乡村的绳结和坐骑等
特征。游乐园也与商业娱乐场所如旅馆和妓院联系
在一起。
The number and ambition of urban gardens
increased in the eighteenth century, and
commercially produced town plans like those of
John Rocque are sometimes at a scale sufficient
to show, at least schematically, the layout of the
larger individual gardens. These typically
complemented the fine town houses being
commissioned by those wishing for a stylish urban
base, especially in places of resort where there
was a social season. For the expanding urban
middle classes, gardening was one of the
commercialised leisure activities recommended by
eighteenth-century texts such as Thomas
Fairchild’s The City Gardener (1722). Whether
occupying a medieval burgage or part of a new
development, such gardens normally lay behind
the house and were long, narrow, and typically
defined by tall walls; Joseph Spence and Richard
Horwood’s eighteenth-century London town
garden plans and maps show the popularity of
城市花园的数量和野心在十八世纪增加了，商业生
产的城市规划，如约翰 · 罗克的那些有时规模足以
显示，至少在示意图上，较大的个人花园的布局。
这些典型地补充了那些希望有一个时髦的城市基地
的人们委托建造的精美的城市住宅，特别是在有社
交季节的度假胜地。对于不断扩大的城市中产阶级
来说，园艺是十八世纪托马斯 · 费尔查尔德
(Thomas Fairchild)的《城市园丁》(The City
Gardener，1722)等文本所推荐的商业化休闲活动
之一。无论是占据中世纪的城堡还是新开发项目的
一部分，这样的花园通常位于房子的后面，而且又
长又窄，通常由高墙围起来
< < Contents 2
目录 2
features such as gravel walks, terraces, water
features, mounts, paved areas, lawns, flower beds
and parterres. One garden had a covered way with
vines, another a rectangular fish pond on its
terrace. The concept of variety with the prospect
towards, across and beyond the confining boundary
was of primary importance. Recent studies such as
Todd Longstaffe-Gowan’s The London Town
Garden 1740-1840 (2001) have drawn attention to
the wealth of documentary evidence, and to the
potential interest of such gardens. The garden at
Bourne Hill House, Salisbury (Wiltshire), designed
by Richard Woods in the early 1770s (registered
Grade II), is a good example of provincial, high-
status, late eighteenth-century landscaping. Some
Georgian town gardens, as
例如砾石路、梯田、水景、山、铺砌的地方、草坪、
花坛和花坛。一个花园有一条被藤蔓覆盖的道路，另
一个花园的露台上有一个矩形的鱼塘。多样性的概念
与前景，跨越和超越限制的边界是首要的重要性。最
近的一些研究，如托德•朗斯塔夫-高恩(Todd
Longstaffe-Gowan)的《伦敦城市花园 1740-1840》
(The London Town Garden 1740-1840,2001 年出
版) ，引起了人们对大量文献证据的关注，以及这些
花园的潜在利益。位于索尔兹伯里(威尔特郡)伯恩山
庄(Bourne Hill House)的花园，由理查德•伍兹
(Richard Woods)在 18 世纪 70 年代初设计(注册二
级) ，是 18 世纪晚期地位显赫的省级园林景观的典
范。一些乔治亚州的城镇花园
at the Circus in Bath, have been the subject of
archaeological excavations; features such as
paths, flower beds, and building foundations have
been found sealed beneath later lawns.
在巴斯的马戏团，一直是考古发掘的主题，在后来
的草坪下面发现了一些特征，如小径、花坛和建筑
物的地基。
In the nineteenth century the writings of John
Claudius Loudon and his wife Jane catered for the
burgeoning interest in gardening, not least among
the well-to-do occupying the new terraces and
villas of England’s expanding towns and cities.
Loudon’s Encyclopaedia of Gardening (1822) was
a comprehensive guide and his Gardeners
Magazine was established in 1826. In The
Suburban Gardener (1838) he recommended
symmetrical designs for shared front or rear
gardens. Most garden owners, however, adopted
fairly standardised layouts and, where evidence
survives, decorative achievement is not always
evident. An exceptional example is William Morris’s
garden at the Red House (1860; listed Grade I),
Bexleyheath, south-east London, where the garden
is treated as integral with the house, a series of
exterior ‘rooms’: herb and vegetable gardens, two
compartments full of old-fashioned flowers, and
many fruit trees.
在十九世纪，约翰 · 克劳迪斯 · 劳顿和他的妻子简的
作品迎合了人们对园艺的兴趣，尤其是那些在英格
兰不断扩张的城镇里居住着新梯田和别墅的富人。
劳登的《园艺百科全书》(1822)是一本全面的指南，
他的《园艺家》杂志成立于 1826 年。在《郊区园
丁》(The Suburban Gardener，1838)一书中，他推
荐了对称设计的前后花园。然而，大多数花园主人
采用了相当标准化的布局，并且，在证据存在的地
方，装饰成就并不总是显而易见的。一个例外的例
子是威廉•莫里斯(William Morris)在位于伦敦东南
部贝克斯利希思(Bexleyheath)的红房子(Red
House，1860; listed Grade i)的花园。在这里，花
园被视为与房子不可分割的一部分，有一系列的外
部“房间”: 草药园和蔬菜园，两个装满老式花卉的
隔间，以及许多果树。
Especially characteristic of the late eighteenth
and early nineteenth centuries were substantial
edge of town villas, built by a wide range of
middle-class patrons, for whom the building of
a secluded suburban seat often represented
the acme of social aspiration. Typically these
were set within an acre or two of park-like
尤其具有十八世纪末十九世纪初特点的是城镇
边缘的大量别墅，由广泛的中产阶级赞助人建
造，对他们来说，建造一个僻静的郊区座位往
往代表着社会抱负的极致。一般来说，这些建
筑都设置在公园一两英亩的范围内
grounds, rarely laid out with the assistance of a
professional designer. Most are very simple, with
little beyond an imposing gateway and lawns with
some specimen coniferous trees. Exceptionally,
however, they could be improbably crammed with
incident: whimsical buildings and other structures,
specimen plants, elaborate compartmentation and,
in picturesque examples,
很少在专业设计师的协助下进行布置。大多数都非
常简单，除了一个壮观的大门和一些标本针叶树的
草坪之外，几乎没有什么。然而，在特殊情况下，
它们可能充满了令人难以置信的事件: 异想天开的建
筑物和其他结构，标本植物，精心设计的隔间，以
及，在如画般的例子,
a maze-like combination of winding walks and
dense shrubbery calculated to thwart perceptions
of littleness. Few such gardens have been
maintained since the nineteenth century in line
with their original design principles; intact and
unaltered examples are now rare.
迷宫一样的组合曲折的步行和密集的灌木丛计算，
以挫败感觉渺小。自 19 世纪以来，很少有这样的
花园能够按照它们最初的设计原则得到维护; 完好
无损的例子现在已经很少见了。
In the twentieth century the commissioning of larger
houses, with larger gardens, was less common than
in the Victorian period, although examples can be
found, such as Winterbourne, an Edwardian Arts
and Crafts house and garden at Edgbaston,
Birmingham (registered Grade II). Here, as so often,
an industrialist moved to the urban fringe, or just
beyond, for clean air and privacy. Many properties
which now might be classed as urban were, in fact,
built in the country. An example is Kearnsey Court,
Dover (Kent), built about 1900 for Alfred Leney, a
brewer and drinks manufacturer, the grounds of
which (registered Grade II) were one of Thomas
Mawson’s earliest commissions. Modernist gardens
of the 1930s were perhaps even rarer in the urban
realm than the rural (for a brief summary of such
see the Rural designed landscapes selection
guide); certainly that seems true of survivals.
在二十世纪，与维多利亚时期相比，委托建造带有更
大花园的更大房屋的情况不太常见，尽管可以找到一
些例子，如伯明翰 Edgbaston (注册二级)的爱德华时
代的工艺美术房屋和花园 Winterbourne。在这里，
像往常一样，一个实业家为了清新的空气和隐私而搬
到城市边缘，或者仅仅是远离城市。许多现在可能被
归类为城市的房产实际上都是在这个国家建造的。一
个例子是肯特郡多佛的卡恩西宫(Kearnsey Court) ，
大约 1900 年为酿酒和饮料制造商阿尔弗雷德•雷尼
(Alfred Leney)建造，其理由(注册为二级)是托马斯•
莫森(Thomas Mawson)最早的委托之一。20 世纪 30
年代的现代主义花园在城市地区可能比在乡村地区更
为罕见(关于这一点的简要概述请参阅《乡村设计风
景选择指南》) ; 当然，对于幸存者来说似乎也是如
此。
Especially in the decades either side of 1930,
suburban developments (typified by ‘Metroland’ to
the north-west of London), and council and private
estates, saw the provision of standardised
特别是在 1930 年前后的几十年里，郊区发展(以伦
敦西北部的“大都会城市”为代表)、地方政府和私
人房地产都看到了标准化的规定
– but often generous – plots alongside the
standardised houses. These, and the
landscaping in the streetscape, contribute much
to the character of these areas.
- 但往往慷慨-标准化房屋旁边的地块。这些，以
及街景中的景观美化，对这些地区的特点有很大
的贡献。

1.2 Detached town gardens
1.2 独立的城市花园
In the early nineteenth century landowners began
to let out blocks of plots on the outskirts of
expanding towns and cities to artisans and
members of the skilled working class, such as the
Sheffield cutlers and the Nottingham lace-makers,
to cultivate as ornamental and productive
gardens. The term ‘detached town gardens’ to
describe these was used by J C Loudon, while
elsewhere the relatively high rent which was
charged gave rise to the alternative name of
‘guinea gardens’.
十九世纪早期，土地所有者开始将扩张中的城镇和
城市郊区的土地出租给工匠和熟练工人阶级，如谢
菲尔德的刀匠和诺丁汉的花边制造商，作为装饰性
和生产性的花园种植。J · c · 劳登用“独立的城镇
花园”一词来描述这些建筑，而在其他地方，由于
收取的租金相对较高，因此产生了另一个名称“几
内亚花园”。
Detached town gardens typically had a grid plan
with the equal-sized plots accessed via main
drives, paths and side alleys. Plots were defined
by hedges, walls or boarded fences. They
contained fruit trees, flowers and flowering
shrubs, patches of lawn for sitting out on and
areas for vegetable plots. The silk-weavers of
Middleton (Lancashire) were noted for their
cultivation of auriculas and other florists’ flowers.
Some had miniature knot gardens
独立的城镇花园通常有一个网格计划与相同大小的
地块访问通过主要驱动器，路径和小巷。地块被定
义为树篱，墙壁或木板栅栏。它们包括果树、鲜花
和开花灌木，可供休憩的草坪和可供种植蔬菜的地
块。米德尔顿(兰开夏郡)的丝织工以种植黑木耳和
其他花卉而闻名。有些还有迷你花园
or parterres; one at Birmingham is reported to
have had a fishpond. Many had buildings,
sometimes architecturally characterful, such as
residential cottages (families sometimes spent
nights on site), summerhouses (with fireplaces
or ranges for cooking), privies and glass
houses; if of sufficient architectural or historic
interest these may merit individual listing (see
the Garden and Park Structures selection
guide). While some town gardens do survive,
others have subsequently been built over or
become urban allotments devoted to purely
horticultural production.
或者花坛; 据报道，伯明翰的一个花坛里有一个
鱼塘。许多建筑物，有时建筑特色，如住宅小
屋(家庭有时在现场过夜)、避暑别墅(有壁炉或
炉灶做饭)、厕所和玻璃房屋; 如果有足够的建筑
或历史价值，这些可能值得个别列出(见花园和
公园结构选择指南)。虽然一些城镇花园确实存
在，其他随后被建立或成为纯粹园艺生产的城
市分配。
There are currently five sets of detached
gardens on the Register: Hunger Hill and
Stonepit Coppice Gardens and Gorsey Close
Gardens, Nottingham, Grade II*; Bagthorpe
Gardens, Nottingham, Grade II*; Hill Close
Gardens, Warwick, Grade II*; Westbourne
Road Town Gardens, Birmingham, Grade II;
and Stoney Road Allotments, Coventry,
Grade II* (Fig 1).
目前登记册上有五组独立花园: 诺丁汉的
Hunger Hill 和 Stonepit Coppice Gardens 和
Gorsey Close Gardens，二级 * ; 诺丁汉的

1.3 Allotments
1.3 分配
From the 1760s there were local initiatives to
provide landless rural labourers with the means to
support themselves via rented plots, and
sometimes a cottage and cow. The first Enclosure
Act to allot a portion of land for ‘poor gardens’ (a
total of 8 acres out of 970 enclosed) was that of
1806 for Great Somerford (Wiltshire), while the
Select Vestries Act of 1819 empowered parish
wardens to purchase or lease up to 20 acres
(increased to 50 acres by Act of 1831) to let to the
poor, typically in quarter-acre blocks. By 1834
there were still probably fewer than 20,000 such
plots in the country, although the total had risen to
about 100,000 by the 1840s. Further provision was
encouraged by legislation
从 18 世纪 60 年代开始，地方政府采取主动行动，
通过租用土地，有时甚至租用农舍和奶牛，为无地
的农村劳动者提供维持生计的手段。第一个将一部
分土地分配给“贫穷花园”的圈地法案(970 个圈地
中共有 8 英亩)是 1806 年的大萨默福德(威尔特郡)法
案，而 1819 年的选择修道院法案授权教区管理员购
买或租赁多达 20 英亩(1831 年法案增加到 50 英亩)
的土地，以出租给穷人，通常是四分之一英亩的区
块。到 1834 年，尽管到 19 世纪 40 年代，这种地块
的总数已经上升到大约 100,000 块，但这个国家的
这种地块可能还不到 20,000 块。立法鼓励了进一步
的规定
< < Contents 4
< < 目录 4
such as the General Inclosure Act of 1845 which
specified that commissioners must appropriate
allotments for the labouring poor, and the 1887
Allotments Act which required councils to provide
land for allotments. The 1889 county council
elections were known as the ‘Allotment
Elections’, with candidates standing on their
position on allotment provision. By 1890 there
were just over 440,000 allotments, and more
followed further legislative provision.
例如 1845 年的《一般封闭法》 ，其中规定专员必
须拨款给劳动力贫困者，以及 1887 年的《拨款
法》 ，其中要求理事会提供土地进行拨款。1889
年的县议会选举被称为“分配选举”，候选人站
在他们在分配规定的立场上。到 1890 年，只有
440,000 份拨款，更多的人遵循了进一步的立法规
定。
During the First World War, local government
requisitioned land to increase the number of
allotments to 1.5 million. In the early twentieth
century urban allotments were increasingly acquired
by the ‘respectable classes’, and humorous
postcards reflected the ‘allotment craze’. After a
renewed interest in allotments during the Second
World War (those in London’s Kensington Gardens
and in the moat of the Tower of London were
demonstrations that everyone was ‘doing their bit’ in
the Dig for Victory campaign) the number under
cultivation fell away, to a million in 1950, to 800,000
in 1960, and even fewer in the 1970s. The decline
then slowed as the green movement emerged, and
in many places demand now exceeds supply.
Allotments, that is plots to grow fruit and vegetables
on will generally fall outside the Register definition
of ‘designed landscapes’ (here a distinction being
made with detached town gardens, treated above).
在第一次世界大战期间，当地政府征用土地，以增加
拨款数量到 150 万。在二十世纪早期，城市的土地分
配越来越多地被“受人尊敬的阶层”获得，幽默的明
信片反映了“土地分配热”。在第二次世界大战期间，
人们重新对土地分配产生了兴趣(伦敦肯辛顿花园和
伦敦塔护城河中的土地表明，每个人都在“为胜利而
挖掘”运动中“尽自己的一份力量”) ，耕地数量开

1970 年甚至更少。随着绿色运动的兴起，这种下降
趋势开始放缓，在许多地方，现在需求超过了供给。
分配，也就是种植水果和蔬菜的地块，通常不在“设
计景观”的登记册定义范围之内(这里区分的是独立

1.4 Nurseries 1.5 Town squares
1.4 苗圃系列 1.5 城市广场
Nurseries – enclosed ground for the successive
cultivation of plants and trees – have similarly
been reckoned to fall outside the remit of the
Register, not being designed landscapes as they
are understood. That said, in the absence of any
general national survey (which has yet to
happen) future inclusion may one day occur:
some nursery buildings have already been listed.
Nurseries 是连续种植植物和树木的封闭场地，同
样被认为不属于登记册的范围，不是所理解的设
计景观。尽管如此，在没有任何全国性普查的情
况下(这种普查尚未进行) ，未来有一天可能会被纳
入: 一些托儿所建筑已经被列入名单。
In London, William the Gardener, active at the
Tower of London and elsewhere in the capital in the
1260s and 1270s, supplied a wide range of trees,
fruit bushes, herbs and flowers, presumably from
his own nursery. Medieval ‘impyards’ seem
在伦敦，1260 年代和 1270 年代，活跃在伦敦塔和首

bounded by hedges or small trees, crossed by

statue. There were over 30 squares in London by

1.6 Public walks
1.6 公众步行
In 1612 Northernhay (part of the later Northernhay

extending round the north and north-east sides of
Exeter Castle (Devon), was levelled and laid out by
the city authorities as a public walk with an avenue
of elms and seats for the use of the elderly. This is a
very early example of a public walk, the fashion for
which – to enable social walking, the promenade –
took off in the mid seventeenth century (Fig 3). The
Mall in London was laid out by Charles II in 1660,
and soon after examples began to appear across
England in provincial towns and cities with
aspirations to a polite society, especially in spas and
resorts.
1612 年，北海(后来的北海和鲁日蒙花园的一部分，
登记为二级) ，延伸到埃克塞特城堡(德文郡)的北部
和东北部，被市政当局夷为平地，布置成一条公共步
行道，有榆树林荫道和供老年人使用的座位。这是一
个非常早期的公共步行的例子，这种时尚-使社会步
行，散步-在 17 世纪中期起飞(图 3)。伦敦的购物中
心是查理二世在 1660 年设计的，不久之后，英格兰
各地的乡镇和城市开始出现这样的例子，他们渴望建
立一个文明的社会，特别是在温泉和度假胜地。
Only one walk is currently registered at Grade II*,
Richmond Terrace Walk, Greater London, laid out
about 1700 along high ground to a viewpoint
across the Thames; that has a high grade because
of its early date, and because it was much
celebrated in literature and art. Five other public
walks on the Register are predominantly of the
midto late eighteenth century and registered at
Grade II; others are elements within wider
designated landscapes.
目前只有一条步行道登记在二级 * ，里士满露台步
行道，大伦敦，约 1700 沿着高地横跨泰晤士河的一
个观点，这有一个很高的等级，因为它的早期日期，
并因为它是文学和艺术的很多著名。登记册上的其
他五条公共步行道主要是 18 世纪中后期的，登记为
二级步行道; 其他步行道则是更广阔的景观中的元素。
The appearance of such walks was initially defined
by pedestrian paths, the planting of avenues of
shade-giving trees, and the maintenance of open
space around them although, as towns and cities
grew, development occurred around the walks, and
they became, in effect, linear urban parks. These
were often flanked by fashionable housing laid out
in accordance with covenants specifying where
development could take place. The walk could be
enhanced by paved surfacing materials, railings,
bollards and ornamental lighting columns, and could
incorporate features such as fountains and statues,
as also found in public parks. Walks typically later
passed into public ownership and evolved into
public gardens or thoroughfares, like New Walk
(created 1785) in Leicester (registered Grade II).
这种人行道的外观最初是由人行道、种植遮荫树木的
林荫道和维护周围的开放空间来定义的，尽管随着城
镇和城市的发展，人行道周围发生了发展，实际上它
们成为了线性的城市公园。这些街道的两侧通常是时
髦的住宅区，这些住宅区的布局符合契约规定的发展
可以在哪里进行。步行可以通过铺设路面材料、栏杆、
护柱和装饰性照明柱来加强，并且可以结合喷泉和雕
像等特征，这些特征也可以在公园里找到。步行道通
常后来被公共所有，并发展成公共花园或大道，如新
步行道(创建于 1785 年)在莱斯特(注册二级)。
1.7 Pleasure gardens
1.7 游乐花园
Commercially managed pleasure gardens began
to open in major towns and cities after the
restoration of the monarchy in 1660. Those at
Vauxhall, in Lambeth on the south bank of the
Thames, opened (under the name New Spring
Gardens) in 1661, and Ranelagh, with its great
rotunda echoing the Pantheon in Rome, in 1742
(Grade II-registered as part of the Royal Hospital,
Chelsea). Pleasure gardens’ attractions included
promenading, dancing, fireworks and concerts.
At first the layout was simple with gravel walks,
but later they contained ornamental buildings and
varying landscape features such as Ranelagh’s
canal and Chinese bridge. Entertainment on offer
there included the performance of new music by
Handel and Mozart, but many pleasure gardens
later became distinctly down-market.
1660 年君主制恢复后，商业管理的游乐园开始在
主要城镇开放。位于泰晤士河南岸兰贝斯的沃克
斯豪尔酒店于 1661 年开业(名为“新春花园”) ，
拉内拉酒店于 1742 年开业(二级注册为切尔西皇
家医院的一部分) ，大圆形大厅与罗马的万神殿相
呼应。游乐园的景点包括散步、舞蹈、烟火和音
乐会。起初，这里的布局很简单，只有碎石路，
但后来，它们包含了装饰性建筑和各种景观特色，
比如拉内拉运河和中国大桥。那里提供的娱乐包
括韩德尔和莫扎特的新音乐表演，但许多游乐园
后来明显变成了低端市场。
< < Contents 7
< < 目录 7
The eighteenth century saw large numbers of
provincial towns and cities provided with pleasure
gardens of some sort, often named after the main
London prototypes of Vauxhall, Ranelagh and
Spring Gardens. St James’s Gardens, for instance,
was laid out to the east of the Assembly Rooms at
Bath in 1709 and provided space for recreation
(registered as Parade Gardens, Grade II).
Admission to the gardens was by subscription,
ensuring exclusivity. New gardens continued to be
made, and old ones revived, well into the early
nineteenth century. Town commons were also
traditional places of recreation, until enclosure in the
period 1750-1850 reduced the number of such open
spaces: Quarry Park (registered Grade II), for
instance, Shrewsbury’s main open space, began to
evolve from common ground in 1719 when tree-
lined walks were planted. Both private pleasure
gardens and commons were largely superseded
十八世纪，大量的省级城镇和城市提供了某种类型的
游乐园，常常以沃克斯豪尔，拉内拉和春天花园的主
要伦敦原型命名。例如，圣詹姆斯花园于 1709 年建
在巴斯会议室的东面，并提供了娱乐空间(注册为二
级游行花园)。进入花园是通过订阅，确保排他性。
直到 19 世纪早期，新的花园还在继续建造，旧的花
园也开始复兴。市镇公共空间也是传统的娱乐场所，
直到 1750-1850 年期间的围栏减少了这种开放空间的
数量: 例如，石矿公园(登记为二级) ，什鲁斯伯里的
主要开放空间，开始从公共场地演变到 1719 年，当
时种植了林荫小径。私人游乐园和公共空间在很大程
度上被取代
by public parks from the early Victorian period
and many were built over; a few, however,
remain as some form of open space.
从维多利亚早期的公园和许多被建造; 然而，少数，
作为某种形式的开放空间。
1.8 Public parks and municipal gardens
1.8 公共公园和市政花园
The earliest examples of urban public parks were
the Royal Parks; London’s Hyde Park (registered
Grade I), until then a hunting park, was open to
the public from the 1630s. Such open access,
however, remained exceptional for two hundred
years, and otherwise open places for public
access and recreation were limited to spaces like
commons, urban squares, and walks (Fig 4).
城市公园最早的例子是皇家公园; 伦敦的海德公园
(登记为一级) ，在此之前是一个狩猎公园，从 17 世
纪 30 年代开始对公众开放。然而，这种开放式通
道在 200 年来一直是个例外，否则公共通道和娱乐
的开放空间仅限于公共空间、城市广场和步行道(图
4)。
In the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries
a few more parks opened, and the opening of
Kensington Gardens (registered Grade I)
在十八世纪晚期和十九世纪早期，又开放了几个公园，

Common elements of such parks included
boundary walls, gate lodges, separate carriage
ways and inter-weaving paths, one or more
lakes, grass to play on, ornamental trees to give
instruction and form, rippling water to enliven the

Theorists held there should be elements of

Liverpool’s Birkenhead Park (registered Grade I),
designed by Joseph Paxton and opened in 1847,
was very influential. It contained a grand
entranceway and an innovatory system of
circulation and traffic segregation which divided the
park into different character areas. He created a
variety of landscapes by raising mounds from the
lake spoil, framing views and using dramatic rocky
outcrops to add variety and contrast. The circulation
had a serpentine route for carriages and horse
riders and a separate walk for pedestrians. Paxton’s
Crystal Palace Park in Sydenham, south-east
London (registered Grade II*)
利物浦的伯肯黑德公园(注册一级)由约瑟夫 · 帕克斯

The early designs of Loudon and Paxton,
especially Birkenhead, were being replicated
elsewhere by the mid nineteenth century.
Between 1845 and 1859 park creation
accelerated, local authority activity increased, and
further important promotional legislation was
passed. The 1875 Public Health Act was
particularly important, as it enabled local
authorities to use income from the rates to
develop and maintain public parks, part of a wider
range of mid-Victorian measures to keep the
populace fit, and the working class orderly and
sober. A typical provincial example is Abbey
Park, Leicester (registered Grade II), designed by
William Barron and opened in 1882, where
separate areas demarcated by paths and
shrubberies were given over to different sports
including bowling and tennis. In some parks there
were lakes for bathing, and women were allowed
劳登和帕克斯顿的早期设计，尤其是伯肯黑德的早
期设计，到了 19 世纪中期，在其他地方得到了复
制。从 1845 年到 1859 年，公园建设加速，地方
当局活动增加，进一步重要的促进立法通过。
1875 年的《公共卫生法》特别重要，因为它使地
方当局能够利用税收收入来开发和维护公园，这是
维多利亚时代中期更广泛的保持民众健康和工人阶
级有序和清醒的措施的一部分。一个典型的省级例
子是莱斯特修道院公园(注册二级) ，由威廉 · 巴伦

开的区域被分给不同的运动，包括保龄球和网球。

or villa grounds, and often mature trees, pools
and other pre-exisiting features were

saw fit to celebrate the occasions in this way;
most towns had at least one park by 1900. Now
commonplace were bandstands, lodges,
pavilions and refreshment rooms alongside
shelters, lavatories and drinking fountains which
enabled the use of parks in poor weather and
demonstrated the authorities’ concern for public
health and morality (Fig 6). The political and
social role of parks was codified through by-

避难所、厕所和饮水机，这些设施使人们能够在
恶劣天气下使用公园，显示出当局对公共健康和
道德的关注(图 6)。公园的政治和社会角色通过明
确规定允许活动的法规编纂成法典，并通过当地
名人和捐助者的雕像得到加强。
After the First World War, and to a lesser extent after
the Second, war memorials, gates and other
commemorative features and planting were added to
the majority of parks. Purpose-designed memorial

Park in Wyre, Lancashire, created in the 1920s by
Patrick Abercrombie, and the Walsall

Park creation continued between the two world
wars. Thomas Mawson became one of the the

在两次世界大战之间，公园的创建仍在继续。

1.9 Seaside gardens
1.9 海滨花园
From soon after the emergence of sea-bathing and
seaside resorts in the eighteenth century, gardens
were used to enhance the genteel settings desired
by promoters and visitors alike. Examples include
the Pleasure Gardens in Bournemouth (Dorset;
registered Grade II*), laid out down the sides of the
Bourne Stream from the 1840s, and the Valley
Gardens and South Cliff Gardens in Scarborough
(North Yorkshire; registered Grade II), developed
from the 1860s to enhance the spa-town’s public
facilities. In the later nineteenth century gardens
running alongside elevated sea-edge promenades
became commonplace, typically enlivened with
spectacular summer displays of formal floral
bedding (Fig 8).
从十八世纪海滨浴场和海滨度假村出现后不久，花园
就被用来提高发起人和游客所期望的上流社会的环境。
例子包括伯恩茅斯的游乐园(多塞特; 注册二级 *) ，从
19 世纪 40 年代开始布置在伯恩河两岸，斯卡伯勒的
山谷花园和南悬崖花园(北约克郡; 注册二级) ，从 19
世纪 60 年代开始发展，以改善温泉城的公共设施。
在 19 世纪后期，沿着海边高架步行道的花园变得司
空见惯，典型的是在夏季展示正式的花卉床上用品，
使花园生气勃勃(图 8)。

Registered examples include Princess Gardens,
Torbay (Devon; Grade II) opened in 1894.
注册的例子包括公主花园，托贝(德文郡; 二级)开
放于 1894 年。
The English seaside remained a favoured
destination in the first half of the twentieth century,
and resorts continued to invest in gardens and
landscaping, sometimes of a novel character: the
Venetian Waterways, Great Yarmouth (Norfolk;
Grade II), a series of winding rivers for boating
weaving through rock gardens opened 1926/1928.
The 1930s saw the introduction of modernist and
Art Deco-style pavilions, lidos and designated
bathing stations. Their setting consisted
predominantly of hard landscaping with walks, sun
terraces, balustraded promenades and lawns, with
limited planting, as at the Grade-I listed De La Warr
Pavilion in Bexhill, East Sussex of 1935. Examples

holidays remained popular in the 1950s, and
resorts continued to make and extend gardens,
as with the Lower, Central and Upper Gardens in
Bournemouth (registered Grade II*). From the
1970s, as the package holiday abroad became
affordable, and as local authority spending on
parks began to be reduced, English seaside
gardens often started to fall into gentle decline.
假期在 1950 年代仍然流行，度假胜地继续建造和
扩大花园，如伯恩茅斯的下花园、中花园和上花园
(注册二级 *)。从 20 世纪 70 年代开始，随着人们

1.10 Botanic gardens
1.10 植物园
The collection and curation of plants, primarily for
medicinal applications and later for botanical study,
was well-established in England long before Oxford’s
Botanic Garden (registered Grade I) was established
in 1621. Other early examples include London’s
Chelsea Physic Garden of 1673 (registered Grade I),
while the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew (London
Borough of Richmond on Thames) and Cambridge
University botanic gardens (registered
早在 1621 年牛津植物园(注册为一级植物园)建立之前，
英格兰就已经建立了植物收集和管理系统，主要用于
药用，后来用于植物学研究。其他早期的例子包括
1673 年伦敦的切尔西物理公园(Chelsea Physic
Garden)(注册一级) ，皇家植物园，邱园(Kew)(伦敦里
士满自治区)和剑桥大学植物园(Cambridge University
botanic gardens)(注册一级)

1.11 Landscaping in the public realm:
1.11 公共领域的景观美化:
twentieth century
二十世纪
In the twentieth century designed landscapes
became integral to areas of the public realm
where, in the past, there had been far less
emphasis on design and especially soft
landscaping. Examples include open spaces
(other than formal squares and the like) in towns
and cities, housing estates, and new road
corridors including by-passes with grassy, tree-
lined verges and central reservations.
在二十世纪，设计景观成为公共领域不可或缺的一
部分，在过去，这些领域对设计的重视程度远远低
于对软景观的重视程度。这些例子包括城镇的开放
空间(除了正式的广场之类的)、住宅区和新的道路
走廊，包括有草地、绿树成荫的边缘和中央保留区
的旁道。
Early twentieth-century landscape design of this
type can be found at industrial model villages such
as Port Sunlight (the Wirral; registered Grade II),
where the principal public open spaces of The Dell,
The Diamond, and The Causeway lie within a
garden village laid out in the late nineteenth and
early twentieth century as part of the overall plans of
William Hesketh Lever. Similar examples
二十世纪早期这种类型的景观设计可以在阳光港等工
业示范村找到，在那里，戴尔、钻石和堤道的主要公
共开放空间位于 19 世纪末和 20 世纪初作为 William
Hesketh Lever 总体规划的一部分而布置的花园村庄
内。类似的例子

After the Second World War, leading landscape

the Commemorative Structures listing selection
guide.
在英国。许多地方当局，比如伦敦郡议会，委托这
些庄园的公共领域的现代主义雕塑作品，有时是当
代著名雕塑家的作品。这些公共艺术品的命名在纪
念建筑清单选择指南中进行了讨论。
In the 1960s, especially notable, and successful,
were the seventy-plus private housing estates
designed by Span Development Ltd, a partnership
between the architect Eric Lyons and the developer
Geoffrey Townsend. These aimed to recreate
在 20 世纪 60 年代，由 Span Development Ltd 设计
的 70 多个私人住宅区尤其引人注目和成功。 Span
Development Ltd 是建筑师埃里克•里昂(Eric
Lyons)和开发商杰弗里•汤森(Geoffrey Townsend)
之间的合作伙伴关系。这些项目旨在重建
a ‘village’ character, with houses grouped in
intimate relationships separated by open areas
which were true spaces rather than gaps between
buildings. Private gardens were small and used as
an outdoor room (courtyard/patio), whereas the
designers’ vision was that the front gardens should
be run together without fences. Span estates were
often set in mature parklands,
一种“村庄”的特征，房屋以亲密的关系组合在一
起，被真正的空间而不是建筑物之间的空隙分隔开
来。私人花园很小，用作室外空间(庭院/露台) ，而
设计师的愿景是前面的花园应该一起运行，没有围
栏。跨度房产通常设置在成熟的公园,
as at Highsett, Cambridge (listed Grade II),
where the Danish landscape architect Preben
Jacobsen was commissioned to remodel and
enhance the planting of a Victorian landscape.
在剑桥的 Highsett (列为二级) ，丹麦景观设计师
Preben Jacobsen 被委托改造和加强维多利亚风
景的种植。

2 Criteria for
Registration
注册准则
All sites included on the Register of Parks and Gardens must hold a level of significance
defined as ‘special historic’ interest in a national context. Nine general criteria have been
defined: five relating to date and four to other considerations, which have been used in
assessing candidates for inclusion since the start of the Register in the 1980s.
所有被列入公园和花园登记册的地点必须具有一定的重要性，被定义为在国家背景下的
“特殊历史”利益。确定了九项一般标准: 五项与日期有关，四项与其他考虑因素有关，自
1980 年代登记册开始以来，这些标准一直用于评估列入名单的候选人。
2.1 Date and rarity
2.1 日期和稀有性
The older a designed landscape is, and the
fewer the surviving examples of its kind, the
more likely it is to have special interest. Likely to
be designated are:
一个设计的风景越古老，同类现存的例子越少，
就越有可能引起人们的特殊兴趣。可能被指定的
有:
 Sites formed before 1750 where at
least a significant proportion of the
principal features of the original layout
is still in evidence
“1750 年以前形成的遗址，至少有相当一部分原
始布局的主要特征仍然存在
 Sites laid out between 1750 and 1840
where enough of the layout survives to
reflect the original design
1750 年至 1840 年间的遗址，足够的布局保留下来，
以反映原始设计
 Sites with a main phase of development
post-1840 which are of special interest
and relatively intact, the degree of
required special interest rising as the site
becomes closer in time
「在 1840 年以后主要发展阶段的土地具有特别意义，
而且相对完整，所需特别意义的程度随着土地
日益接近而上升。」
 Particularly careful selection is required
for sites from the period after 1945
“对于 1945 年以后的土地，需要特别仔细的选择。”
 Sites of less than 30 years old are
normally registered only if they are of
outstanding quality and under threat
”建成不足 30 年的土地，一般只有在质素优良及受到
威胁的情况下才会注册
2.2 Further considerations
2.2 进一步考虑
Further considerations which may influence
selection, and may exceptionally be sufficient
by themselves to merit designation, are:
可能影响选择的其他考虑因素，以及在特殊情况
下，这些因素本身可能足以被指定为候选人:
 Sites which were influential in the
development of taste, whether through
reputation or reference in literature
”在品味发展中具有影响力的地点，无论是通过声
誉还是文学参考
 Sites which are early or representative
examples of a style of layout or a type of
site, or the work of a designer (amateur
or professional) of national importance
”是一种布局风格或一种网站类型的早期或具有代表
性的例子，或是具有国家重要性的设计师(业
余或专业人士)的作品
 Sites having an association with significant
persons or historic events
与重要人物或历史事件有联系的场所
 Sites with a strong group value with other
heritage assets
”具有强大群体价值的遗址与其他文物资产

3 Specific
具体点
Considerations
考虑事项
In this section, more specific guidance is given relating to the registration of
urban landscapes, which outlines our approach in assessing candidates for
being added to the National Heritage List for England.
在本节中，我们提供了有关城市景观登记的更为具体的指导，概述了我们评
估被列入英格兰国家遗产名录候选人的方法。
3.1 Documentation
3.1 文献
Whatever its date and type, where a
landscape’s creation or development is
particularly well documented, that will almost
always add to its interest, and can merit
designation at a higher grade.
无论它的日期和类型，哪里的景观的创造或发展
是特别良好的记录，这几乎总是增加其利益，并
可以值得指定在更高的等级。
3.2 Town squares
3.2 城镇广场
Many urban squares were conceived as an
original part of a building development, and the
survival of that architectural context has an
important bearing on registration.
许多城市广场被认为是建筑发展的一个原始部分，
这种建筑背景的生存对注册有着重要的影响。
An early date, especially predating the
proliferation of squares in the nineteenth century,
will strengthen the case for inclusion on the
Register. Very few of the early to mid eighteenth-
century squares retain enough of their layout to
make them registerable, although two exceptions
in London are Grosvenor Square and Berkeley
Square (both registered Grade II). Grosvenor’s
oval-shaped square formed the centrepiece to
the Mayfair part of the Grosvenor Estate and was
laid out in the 1720s, the only one at this time as
a formal ‘wilderness’. Berkeley Square retains its
original layout of a simple oval plan with a
centrepiece building: a pump house
一个早期的日期，特别是早于 19 世纪广场的扩散，
将加强案件列入登记册。十八世纪早期到中期的广
场很少能保留足够的布局使其可以注册，尽管伦敦
的两个例外是格罗夫纳广场和伯克利广场(都是二
级注册)。格罗夫纳的椭圆形方形建筑是格罗夫纳
庄园梅菲尔区的核心部分，建于 18 世纪 20 年代，
是当时唯一一个正式的“荒野”。伯克利广场保
留了原来简单的椭圆形平面布局和一个中心建筑:
泵房
with a chinoiserie tent roof (listed Grade II).
Ornamental buildings such as these and other
listed structures make a significant contribution
to a square’s character and will strengthen
有中式帐篷屋顶(列为二级)。像这样的装饰性建
筑和其他列出的建筑对广场的性质有着重要的贡
献，并将加强
the case for registration. Railings, gates, lamp
standards, statues, drinking fountains, memorials
and ornamental buildings can all be listed in their
own right. For the relevant criteria see the listing
selection guide on Street Furniture.
注册的理由。栏杆，大门，灯标，雕像，饮水机，
纪念碑和装饰性建筑物都可以列出自己的权利。
相关标准见街道家具列表选择指南。
Important registered late eighteenth-century
squares include several in London: Bedford
Square (Grade II*), Brunswick Square
(registered at Grade II together with Coram’s
Fields and Mecklenburgh Square), Cadogan
Place (II), Hans Place (II), Manchester Square,
and Portman Square (II). Bedford Square carries
a higher grade (II*) as it was the focal point for a
new grid of streets, part of the Bedford Estate. It
was the first garden square with an imposed
architectural uniformity and it set the style for
garden squares in London through the late
eighteenth century and early nineteenth century.
十八世纪后期登记的重要广场包括伦敦的几个: 贝
德福德广场(二级 *)、不伦瑞克广场(二级与科拉姆
广场和梅克伦堡广场一起登记)、卡多根广场(二
级)、汉斯广场(二级)、曼彻斯特广场和波特曼广
场(二级)。贝德福德广场具有更高的等级(II *) ，
因为它是一个新的街道网格的焦点，贝德福德庄
园的一部分。它是第一个具有统一建筑风格的花
园广场，在整个 18 世纪末和 19 世纪初，它为伦
敦的花园广场奠定了风格。
The Bedford Estate comprising Bedford,
Bloomsbury and Russell Squares, exemplifies a late
Georgian planned estate with several squares. The
Grosvenor Estate (its Belgravia and Pimlico
Squares registered at Grade II) is a good example
for the early nineteenth century, and the Ladbroke
贝德福德庄园由贝德福德、布鲁姆斯伯里和拉塞尔广
场组成，是后乔治王朝时期规划的几个广场的典范。
格罗夫纳庄园(其 Belgravia 和 Pimlico 广场二级注册)
是 19 世纪早期的一个很好的例子，而拉德布罗克庄
园就是一个很好的例子

Estate (its squares registered at II) for the mid
nineteenth century. Where several squares form
part of a single town planning scheme, and it is
primarily the scheme as a whole that may be of
special historic interest in terms of town planning
and landscape design, then the squares should
be assessed together as one site. They are more
likely to merit higher grades on group value,
providing each individual square registered in
this way retains the majority of its architectural
context and its original layout intact.
十九世纪中期的房地产(其广场登记在 II)。如果几
个广场构成一个城市规划方案的一部分，而且主
要是整个方案在城市规划和景观设计方面可能具
有特殊的历史意义，那么这些广场应该作为一个

获得更高的评分，只要以这种方式注册的每个单
独的广场保持其建筑背景的大部分和原始布局的
完整性。
Specific English Heritage criteria for the
registration of squares were established in 2002
and are still relevant today. For earlier squares,
created before 1800, specific criteria include:
2002 年制定了具体的英国文化遗产广场登记标准，
至今仍然适用。对于 1800 年前建成的早期广场，
具体标准包括:
 The form of the square and its
original architectural context
should be still in evidence
“广场的形式及其原始建筑背景应该仍
然是显而易见的
 Enough of the original landscaping
(paths, planting, statutory, railings),
survives to reflect the original design
“足够的原始景观(道路，种植，法定，栏杆) ，
生存，以反映原始设计
Many more regency squares survive, so criteria
for squares from 1800 to 1830 include:
更多的摄政广场幸存了下来，所以从 1800 年到

 The majority of the original
architectural context and the
original layout should be intact
“大部分原始建筑环境和原始布局应该完
好无损
 The square is of special historic interest
(see below)
广场具有特殊的历史价值(见下文)
There are large numbers of squares from the 1840s
onwards in England. Specific criteria for these are
accordingly more stringent and include:
从 19 世纪 40 年代开始，英格兰就有大量的广场。相
应地，这些标准更加严格，包括:
 The architectural context of the square
should be intact
“广场的建筑环境应该是完整的
 The original layout of the square is intact
”广场的原始布局完好无损
 The landscape design of the square is of
special historic interest in its own right
广场的景观设计本身就具有特殊的历史价值
Special historic interest can be
defined as embracing:
特殊的历史兴趣可以定义为:
 Influential, high quality architecture
or landscaping
“有影响力的、高质量的建筑或景观
 An extensive or innovative planning
scheme of special historic interest
”具有特殊历史意义的广泛或创新的规划方案
 The involvement of a designer
of national importance
”国家重要设计师的参与
 A clear historical association with
persons or events of national importance
”与国家重要人物或事件有明显的历史联系
 Where high quality statuary, garden
buildings and memorials make a
contribution to the landscape
”高质量的雕塑，花园建筑和纪念碑对景观作
出了贡献
 Where later conversions and additions
do not detract but add value
”后来的转换和增加不会减损，反而会增加价值
 Where an original planting scheme
survives, this will add to the historic interest
of the site; a particularly fine scheme might
in itself make a site registerable or might
contribute towards a high grade
“如果一个原始的种植计划得以保留下来，这将增加该
地点的历史价值; 一个特别好的计划本身可能使
一个地点可以注册，或者可能有助于提高地点的
等级
 The existence of surviving documentation
such as designs, plans, planting lists, and
deeds relating to the square’s layout
”现存的文件，例如设计图，计划，种植清单，以及
与广场布局有关的契约
Sites most likely to merit a high grade are those
where the design of the landscape component is
of particular note; those where an early
最有可能获得高评级的遗址是那些景观组成部分
的设计特别值得注意的地方;
(pre-1830) design has survived intact; and
those which represent a major work of a
designer of national importance.
(1830 年以前)设计保存完好，那些代表一个国家
重要设计师的主要作品。
3.3 Public walks
3.3 公共步行
Very few walks survive in anything like their
original state. The criteria for designation require
a good state of preservation of the original
design, including planting, ancillary features, and
the means of boundary delineation. There is not
只有极少数的徒步者能在原始状态下存活下来。设
计的标准要求保持原始设计的良好状态，包括种植，
辅助功能，以及边界划分的手段。这里没有
an expectation that original surfaces (perhaps
cobbles) will necessarily survive. Association with
原始表面(可能是鹅卵石)必然存在的期望

a designer of national significance considerably
strengthens the case for registration, as does a

一个具有国家意义的设计师大大加强了注册的理

碑或街道家具的特殊利益。
3.4 Pleasure gardens

3.5 Public parks and municipal gardens
3.5 公园及市政花园
Municipal parks were systematically reviewed by
English Heritage from 2003, when specific criteria
for designation on the Register were developed.
从 2003 年开始，英国文化遗产局对市政公园进行了
系统的审查，当时制定了登记册上指定的具体标准。
Most of the 225 sites currently designated are
relatively early, with good survival of landscaping,
planting and structures. Three separate date
bands, and sets of criteria, were defined:
目前指定的 225 个地点大部分较早，景观美化、
种植和结构保存良好。三个独立的日期范围和一
套标准被定义为:
For sites with a main phase of development
between 1833 (the date of the Select
Committee on Public Walks) and 1875 (Public
Health Act), specific criteria include:
对于在 1833 年(公众步行专责委员会成立之日)
至 1875 年(公共卫生法)期间进行主要发展阶段
的场地，具体标准包括:
 That enough of the landscaping survives
to reflect the original design
”足够的景观保留下来，以反映原始设计
Sites are likely to merit a high grade when typically
more than one of the following is the case: where
the condition of this primary phase remains good;
where the design is of particular note; and where a
designer of national importance was involved.
Examples include Princes Park, Liverpool (Grade
II*; Fig 11) designed
当下列情况之一以上时，场址可能值得高度评价: 这
一初级阶段的条件仍然良好; 设计特别值得注意; 以
及涉及具有国家重要性的设计者。例子包括利物浦
王子公园(二级; 图 11)设计

由约瑟夫 · 帕克斯顿设计，于 1842 年开业;

For sites with a main phase of development

对于 1875 年至第二次世界大战期间的主要发展阶

 That significant attention was paid to the

”他们非常重视景观美化

Such sites are likely to merit a high grade where
the condition of this phase remains exceptionally
good, where the design is of particular note, or
where the landscape represents a major work by
a designer of national importance. Examples
include Stanley Park, Blackpool (Grade II* )

which was intended to extend visitor facilities in

Opened in 1926, it retains all the principal

putting green and an athletic oval.
如果这一阶段的条件仍然非常好，如果设计特别引

例子包括赤柱公园、黑潭(二级 *) ，由 Thomas

园和区域的游戏，包括推杆果岭和运动椭圆形。
For sites with a main phase of development laid
out post-war but more than 30 years ago,
specific criteria include:
对于战后但 30 多年前规划的主要发展阶段的场地，
具体的标准包括:
 The design is of exceptional note
”这个设计非常引人注目
 And that its key elements
survive essentially intact
而且它的关键元素基本上完好无损
A major obstacle to the inclusion of garden
squares on the Register is that they often
lack prominent design features, and many
have suffered from mid to late twentieth-
century changes through Second World War
bomb damage, the removal of railings in
1941, and more recently from development
and inappropriate landscaping.
将花园广场列入登记册的一个主要障碍是，它
们往往缺乏突出的设计特点，许多广场由于第
二次世界大战的炸弹破坏、1941 年拆除栏杆
以及最近由于开发和不适当的景观美化而在
20 世纪中后期发生了变化。
3.6 Seaside gardens
3.6 海滨花园
The same general designation principles as
for public parks (above) would apply.
Seaside gardens whose creation formed part
a wider enhancement of a resort’s public
realm (say, alongside the provision of a pier)
will gain interest thereby.
适用于公园(上文)的一般指定原则。海滨花园
的创造形成了一个更广泛的增强度假村的公共
领域的一部分(比如说，除了提供一个码头)将
因此获得兴趣。

3.7 Botanic gardens 3.9 Detached town gardens
3.7 植物园 3.9 独立的城镇花园
Most Victorian and earlier botanic gardens are
already registered, several at a high grade.
Early date and the degree of survival of the
early design will be critical factors in
designation assessment, as will the survival of
key buildings, notably conservatories and other
glasshouses. The significance or otherwise of
modern botanic collections will play no part in
assessment, although long-established
specimen trees will add to a site’s interest.
大多数维多利亚时代和早期的植物园都已经注册，
其中几个级别很高。早期设计的日期和存活程度
将是指定评估的关键因素，重要建筑物，特别是
温室和其他温室的存活也是如此。现代植物收藏
的重要性或其他方面将不会在评估中发挥作用，
尽管长期建立的标本树将增加一个网站的兴趣。
3.8 Town and suburban gardens
3.8 市镇及郊区花园
The most likely candidates for registration will be
ambitious gardens attached to grand town houses
of the seventeenth and eighteenth century. The
over-arching criteria set out about above
concerning date bands will apply. Good
documentation, as always, will enhance the case
for designation. More modest town house gardens
may also be worthy of careful consideration for
designation, especially those pre-dating the mid
nineteenth century. Boundary walls (which may
already be covered in the listing as curtilage
structures) may be listable in their own right if of
exceptional age and character (see the Suburban
and Country Houses listing selection guide), as may
individual structures such as summerhouses and
gateways (both typically in end walls) and, in
sloping gardens, ornamental flights of steps.
最有可能的注册候选人是雄心勃勃的花园附属于 17
和 18 世纪的宏伟的联排别墅。上面提到的关于日期
带的总体标准将会适用。良好的文件，一如既往，将
加强指定的理由。更加普通的城市住宅花园也值得仔
细考虑，特别是那些早于 19 世纪中期的。如果有特
殊的年龄和性格，边界墙(可能已经被列为宅邸结构)
可以自行列入清单(参见郊区和乡村住宅清单选择指
南) ，如凉亭和门廊(通常都在边界墙上)以及倾斜花
园中的装饰性台阶也可以列入清单。
An example of a registered urban garden is 100
Cheyne Walk (London Royal Borough of
Kensington and Chelsea; registered Grade II) part
of the seventeenth-century Lindsey House (listed
Grade II*). The garden was redesigned by Edwin
Lutyens with planting by Gertrude Jekyll in 1909,
and has later work by Lady Arabella Lennox-Boyd.
注册的城市花园的一个例子是 100 Cheyne Walk (伦
敦皇家肯辛顿-切尔西区，注册二级) ，它是 17 世纪
的 Lindsey House 的一部分(列为二级 *)。这个花园
由 Edwin Lutyens 重新设计，Gertrude Jekyll 在
1909 年种植，后来由 Arabella Lennox-Boyd 夫人设
计。
Where properties such as those of Edwardian
industrialists, originally lay beyond the town
edge but have later been enveloped by urban
development, these should normally be
assessed as rural rather than urban.
如果像爱德华七世时期实业家的房产最初位于城
镇边缘之外，但后来被城市发展所包围，那么这
些房产通常应被评估为农村而不是城市。
Although once very common, the survival rate of
detached town gardens is poor. A national survey
(Lambert 1994) indicated that very few sites
survive in their original form. The five registered
examples have been included as they retain a
relatively high proportion of their nineteenth-
century character, and some contemporary
buildings. A high grade will typically indicate
虽然曾经非常普遍，独立的城镇花园的存活率是贫
穷的。一项全国性的调查(Lambert 1994)表明，很
少有遗址能以原始形式存活下来。这五个已注册的
例子被包括在内，因为它们保留了相当高的比例，
它们的十九世纪的特征，和一些当代的建筑。一个
高的等级通常意味着
a site which survives especially well, with features
such as boundaries and a range of built
structures. Other than the five registered sites,
known examples survive only as allotments with
hedges and buildings removed. While of local
interest and amenity value, these will not normally
merit inclusion on the Register.
生存状况特别好的场地，具有边界和一系列建筑结
构等特征。除了五个已注册的遗址，已知的例子只
能作为分配的篱笆和建筑物删除。虽然具有本地利
益和美化市容价值，但通常不值得列入登记册。
3.10 Allotments
3.10 编配
The lack of designed elements with allotments
(as opposed to detached town gardens) other
than their boundaries means that designation
would not generally be considered. Many local
authorities have policies on allotments, and
sites with a long history may merit especially
careful management. Others lie in conservation
areas; again, this offers the opportunity for local
management.
缺乏设计元素与分配(相对独立的城镇花园)除了
他们的边界意味着指定将不会被普遍考虑。许多
地方当局都有分配政策，有着悠久历史的场地可
能需要特别小心的管理。还有一些位于保护区，
这也为地方管理提供了机会。
3.11 Nurseries
3.11 苗圃系列
As noted above, nurseries fall outside the remit of
the Register, not being designed landscapes as
there understood. However, upstanding structural
features including walls, gardener’s houses and
sheds, may be eligible for designation as listed
buildings. The selection criteria will generally
如上所述，托儿所不在登记册的管辖范围之内，不
是那里所理解的设计景观。然而，正直的结构特征，
包括墙壁，园丁的房子和棚屋，可能有资格被指定
为列出的建筑物。一般来说，选择标准
be akin to those for walled gardens, given in
the Garden and Park Structures listing
selection guide. A particular factor when
assessing nursery buildings may sometimes be
be historic association, that is where a nursery
was run by well-known nurserymen, or
regularly supplied well-known designers.
类似于那些围墙花园，给出的花园和公园结构列
表选择指南。在评估托儿所建筑时，一个特别的
因素有时可能是历史关联，即托儿所由知名托儿
所经营，或定期提供知名设计师。
< < Contents 22
目录 22
3.12 Sports grounds 3.14 Grading
3.12 运动场 3.14 等级
Some sports grounds and the like have both
cultural and historic significance: the Oval and
Lord’s for cricket, Wembley for football, Aintree,
Cheltenham and Epsom for horse racing,
London’s Blackheath for golf – to offer just a few
examples. All fall outside the remit of the Register
in terms of designation in their own right, although
many registered parks do include sports grounds
within their boundaries. Structures associated
with sports grounds such as stands and pavilions
may be eligible for designation, and guidance on
this is provided in the Sports and Recreation
Buildings listing selection guide.
一些运动场等具有文化和历史双重意义: 椭圆形和
上帝球场代表板球，温布利球场代表足球，切尔滕
纳姆和埃普瑟姆代表赛马，伦敦的 Blackheath 代
表高尔夫——仅举几个例子。所有这些公园都不属
于登记册的管辖范围，尽管许多登记在册的公园都
在其管辖范围内包括运动场。与运动场有关的构筑
物，例如看台和凉亭，可能有资格获得指定，有关
这方面的指引载于《体育及康乐建筑物选择指南》。
3.13 Listing
3.13 上市
Many structures and features found in parks
and other designed landscapes make a
significant contribution to their landscape
character, and their presence may strengthen
the case for registration. Ornamental buildings,
railings and gates, lamp standards, statues,
drinking fountains, memorials, sundials, urns,
bridges over lakes and Pulhamite rockwork can
all be listed in their own right if they possess
intrinsic special interest. Again, see the Garden
and Park Structures listing selection guide.
在公园和其他设计景观中发现的许多结构和特征
对其景观特征做出了重要贡献，它们的存在可以
加强注册的理由。装饰性建筑物、栏杆和大门、
灯具标准、雕像、饮水器、纪念物、日晷、骨灰
瓮、湖上桥梁和普拉米特石制品，如果具有内在
的特殊利益，都可以自行列出。再次，请参阅花
园和公园结构列表的选择指南。
While all registered sites are considered to be of a
sufficiently high level of interest to merit a national
designation, the sites included on the Register are
divided into three grade bands to give added
guidance on their significance. The three grades
are Grade I (of exceptional interest), Grade II* (of
more than special interest) and Grade II (of special
interest, warranting every effort to preserve them).
Having begun by assessing the best-known
designed landscapes, we accordingly have a high
percentage registered in the higher grades, and
over 37 per cent
虽然所有已登记的场址都被认为具有足够高的利益
水平，值得国家指定，但登记册所列场址分为三个
等级，以便就其重要性提供更多指导。这三个级别
分别为一级(具特殊意义)、二级 * (具特殊意义以上)
及二级(具特殊意义，有必要尽力保存)。我们已经开
始评估最著名的景观设计，因此有很高的比例注册
在较高的等级，超过 37%
of all such sites are Grade I or Grade II*; by
way of comparison, only 8 per cent of listed
buildings are designated at these levels.
所有这些地点都是一级或二级 * ; 相比之下，
只有 8% 的列出的建筑被指定在这些级别。

Register of Parks and Gardens Selection Guide
公园及花园登记册选择指南
Summary
摘要
Historic England’s selection guides help to define which historic buildings and sites
are likely to meet the relevant tests for national designation. Four guides, of which
this is one, deal with the types of site included on Historic England’s Register of
Parks and Gardens of Special Historic Interest in England which is a constituent part
of the National Heritage List for England.
英格兰历史建筑的选择指南有助于确定哪些历史建筑和遗址可能符合国家指定的相关测试。
四个指南，其中之一，处理的遗址类型包括在历史英格兰的公园和花园特别历史兴趣的英
格兰登记册，这是一个组成部分的国家遗产清单的英格兰。
Each guide falls into two halves. The first defines the types of site included in
it, before going on to give a brisk overview of how these developed through
time, with notice of the main designers and some of the key sites. The second
half of the guide sets out the particular tests a site has to meet if it is to be
included on the Register. A select bibliography gives suggestions for further
reading.
每个向导分成两部分。首先定义了包含在其中的网站类型，然后在主要设计者和一
些关键网站的注意下，对这些网站是如何随着时间的推移而发展的给出一个简要的
概述。指南的后半部分列出了一个网站如果要被列入注册表，必须要满足的特殊测
试。一个精选的参考书目提供了进一步阅读的建议。
This guide covers institutional designed landscapes, including those around
educational establishments, government and civic buildings, factories and
hospitals.The other three guides treat Rural, and Urban, landscapes, and
Landscapes of Remembrance, that is cemeteries and burial grounds.
这本指南涵盖了机构设计的景观，包括教育机构、政府和市政建筑、工厂和医院周围的景
观。另外三本指南分别介绍了农村和城市的景观，以及墓地和墓地的纪念景观。
First published by English Heritage March 2013.
2013 年 3 月由英国文化遗产出版社首次出版。
This edition published by Historic England December 2017.
本版由英格兰历史出版社 2017 年 12 月出版。

Introduction
引言
The Register of Historic Parks and Gardens
历史公园名录
of Special Historic Interest in England(now
a component of the National Heritage List
for England) was set up in 1983. It includes
designed landscapes of many types, private
and public, which are identified using
explicit criteria to possess special interest.
To date over 1650 sites have been included
on the Register. Thereby Historic England
seeks to increase awareness of their
significance, and to encourage appropriate
long-term management.Although
registration is a statutory designation,there
are no specific controls for registered parks
and gardens unlike listed buildings or
scheduled monuments. However, the
National Planning Policy Framework, gives
registered parks and gardens an equal
policy status with listed buildings and
scheduled monuments.
英格兰特殊历史名胜(现在是英格兰国家遗产名
录的一个组成部分)于 1983 年建立。它包括设
计的许多类型的景观，私人和公共，这是确定
使用明确的标准，以拥有特殊的利益。到目前
为止，已有超过 1650 个地点被列入登记册。
因此，历史悠久的英格兰寻求提高对其重要性
的认识，并鼓励适当的长期管理。虽然注册是
一个法定的指定，有没有具体的控制已注册的
公园和花园不像列出的建筑物或规定的纪念碑。
然而，国家规划政策框架给予注册公园和花园
与列入名录的建筑物和纪念碑同等的政策地位。
This is one of four complementary selection
guides which briefly describe the types of
designed landscape included on the
register, and set out selection criteria for
designation. This guide covers institutional
and to some extent commercial landscapes,
including buildings associated with health
and welfare, places of education, military
and industrial complexes,factories and
offices, and sites associated with public
services such as pumping stations.These
landscapes are often relatively short-lived,
like some of the organisations with which
they are associated. Technological and
medical advances, government policies and
social change can all put institutional
landscapes under pressure, as can
demands to release land for development.
The other three guides treat Rural and
Urban designed landscapes,and
Landscapes of Remembrance. The listing of
buildings in designed landscapes is
considered in the Garden and Park
Structures listing selection guide, and the
scheduling of archaeological garden
remains, principally but not exclusively
earthwork remains, is dealt with in the
Gardens scheduling selection guide.
这是四个补充选择指南之一，简要说明登记册
所包括的设计景观类型，并列出指定的选择标
准。本指南涵盖公共机构及某程度上的商业景
观，包括与健康及福利有关的建筑物、教育场
所、军事及工业综合设施、工厂及办公室，以
及与公共服务有关的地点，例如抽水站。这些
景观通常是相对短暂的，就像一些与之相关的
组织一样。技术和医疗进步、政府政策和社会
变革都会给制度环境带来压力，就像要求释放
土地用于发展一样。另外三本指南分别介绍了
城乡设计风景和纪念风景。设计景观中的建筑
物列表在《园林和公园结构列表选择指南》中
予以考虑，而考古园遗址的列表，主要但不仅
限于土方工程遗址，则在《园林列表选择指
南》中予以处理。
1 Historical
Summary
1 历史概
要
1.1 Landscapes of health and
welfare
1.1 健康与福利景观
Larger, and better-endowed groups of
almshouses were typically arranged
formally, sometimes with substantial and
partly ornamental gardens. Registered
examples include Trinity Hospital, Long
Melford, Suffolk(Grade II), founded
1573,which has an inner courtyard garden
and an outer walled garden, and Lord
Leycester’s Hospital, Warwick(Grade II),
founded 1571,which had a garden(which
survives) divided between an orchard and
cultivated ground,with a viewing terrace
down one side.
规模更大、资金更充足的救济院群体通常被正
式安排，有时有大量的装饰性花园。注册的例
子包括三一医院，朗梅尔福德，萨福克(二级) ，
创建于 1573 年，有一个内院花园和一个外围
花园，莱斯特勋爵医院，沃里克(二级) ，创建
于 1571 年，有一个花园(现存)分为果园和耕地，
一侧有一个观景台。
The late eighteenth and nineteenth
centuries saw the development of a variety
of purpose-built hospitals which included
lunatic asylums,epileptic and ‘mental
deficiency’ colonies,tuberculosis sanatoria
and large-scale isolation hospitals(for the
designation criteria for the buildings
themselves see the Health and
18 世纪末和 19 世纪，出现了各种专门建造的
医院，其中包括精神病院、癫痫病和”精神缺
陷”群体、结核病疗养院和大型隔离医院(关于
建筑物本身的指定标准见《卫生和社会保障
法》)
Welfare Buildings listing selection
guide).These were typically set in a rural
environment for the benefit of the patients,
often within landscaped grounds laid out in
the style of a country house park. Extensive
areas were provided for therapeutic use by
the patients,and also for their recreation
and that of the staff. Views beyond the
estate were believed to be therapeutic, too,
and to lift the spirits.
福利建筑列表选择指南)。这些都是典型的设置
在乡村环境为病人的利益，往往在园林布局的
风格，乡村别墅公园。广泛的区域为患者提供
了治疗用途，也为他们的娱乐和工作人员提供
了娱乐。房产之外的景观也被认为是治疗性的，
并且可以振奋精神。
Prior to the Lunatics Act of 1808 a handful
of purpose-built charitably-funded and
private asylums were erected, but few of
their contemporary landscapes survive in
recognisable form. Of these, The Retreat
Hospital, York, a Quaker charitable asylum
built 1793-7(listed Grade II but not
registered)was a model for future asylums,
with designed grounds for the benefit of
the patients. At
在 1808 年的《疯子法案》之前，一些专门建
造的慈善资助和私人庇护所被建立起来，但它
们当代的景观很少以可辨认的形式保存下来。
其中，位于约克郡的灵修医院是一个贵格会慈
善庇护所，建于 1793 年至 1797 年(列为二级
但未注册) ，是未来庇护所的典范，其设计理由
是为了病人的利益。他说
Brislington House, Bristol(registered Grade
II*),a private asylum of 1804-6, each of the
airing courts – secure yards alongside the
main block where patients could take
exercise- was laid out ornamentally with
paths, lawns, borders and a mount giving
views of the Bath hills.
布里斯托尔的布里斯灵顿府(注册二级 *) ，
1804 年至 1806 年的私人庇护所，每个通风法
院——沿着主要街区的安全院落，病人可以在
那里锻炼——都有装饰性的小径、草坪、边界
和一座可以看到巴斯山的山峰。
The 1808 County Asylums Act permitted
county magistrates to fund new asylums
from the rates and led to the establishment
of 22 purpose-built county asylums.
Springfield Hospital, Wandsworth (Greater
London; registered Grade II), was a notable
early example(1841) of a county asylum
with a designed landscape. Its airing courts
were originally laid out with two on either
side of the building, reflecting the
segregation of male and female patients.
The courts’ external brick walls(intended to
prevent escape) were set in deep ditches, in
the fashion of a sunk fence, as it was
considered of benefit to the patients to
enjoy extensive views beyond the confines
of the asylum. Another 63 asylums were
built between 1845, when the Lunacy Act
made it compulsory for counties to make
public provision for their pauper lunatics,
and 1888, with another 30 or so after that.
Notable examples include St
Mary’s,Stannington, Northumberland(1910-
4), and High Royds, West Yorkshire(1884-8;
see too Figs 1 and 2).Sometimes notable
designers were used to set out grounds.
These included Mr Robert Lloyd, Head
Gardener at Brookwood Asylum(Surrey),
who made a speciality of designing asylum
grounds such as the West Sussex Lunatic
Asylum, at Graylingwell, in 1896-8, and the
internationally-renowned William Goldring
at the Kesteven County Lunatic Asylum,
Rauceby(Lincolnshire) in 1900 and at
Middlesex County Asylum, Napsbury,in
1902-5(all these, except Brookwood,
registered Grade II). Grounds were often
heavily planted with specimen trees, and
sometimes had parkland accommodating
sports facilities, and even a
1808 年的《县庇护法》允许县治安法官从费率中为新的庇护提供资金，并导致建立了 22 个专门
建造的县庇护所。斯普林菲尔德医院，旺兹沃思(大伦敦; 注册二级) ，是一个著名的早期例子

被认为有利于病人在精神病院范围之外享受广阔的视野。从 1845 年到 1888 年，《精神病法》规

从 1950 年代中期开始，现有精神病院的空中
法庭常常通过取消边界而开放，以便为病人提

From the mid 1980s two related
government policies combined to usher in
a large number of hospital and asylum
closures: first that of rationalising the
National Health Service estate, and second
that of ‘care in the community’ as enshrined
in the National Health Service and
Community Care Act (1990). Some sites
were demolished, some converted to
private housing. The degree to which their
grounds were retained varied, but most
were altered or even lost altogether.
从 1980 年代中期开始，两项相关的政府政策
结合在一起，导致大量医院和庇护所关闭: 第一
项是使国家卫生服务机构合理化，第二项是庄
严载入《国家卫生服务和社区护理法》(1990
年)的”社区护理”。一些场所被拆除，一些被
改造成私人住宅。他们的土地被保留的程度各
不相同，但大多数被改变甚至完全丧失。

Many sanatoria – facilities for treating long-
term illnesses, in particular tuberculosis –
had ornamental settings because of the
need to provide grounds to exercise in.
Ventnor’s National Cottage Hospital for
Consumption and Diseases of the
Chest(Isle of Wight; registered Grade II)
opened in 1868 at a time when open-air
treatment for tuberculosis was beginning
to be recognised as effective. The basis for
the layout consisted of ornamental
Measured Walks: as patients improved,
they could walk ever-longer distances.
Additional land was soon acquired,partly to
retain open views to the sea, and partly for
ornamental and productive purposes.
Milk,eggs, vegetables and fruit were
produced, while specimen trees were
planted, some by the royal family. After the
hospital closed in 1964 the grounds re-
opened as Ventnor Botanic Garden.King

许多疗养院——治疗长期疾病的设施，特别是肺结核——都有装饰性的环境，因为需要提供运动
场地。1868 年，文特诺的国家胸部消耗和疾病医院(怀特岛，登记为二级)开业，当时人们开始认
识到露天治疗肺结核的有效性。布局的基础包括装饰性的测量步行: 随着病人的改善，他们可以步
行更长的距离。很快就获得了更多的土地，部分是为了保持对海的开放视野，部分是为了装饰和
生产目的。牛奶、鸡蛋、蔬菜和水果被生产出来，标本树也被种植出来，其中一些是由皇室家族
种植的。1964 年医院关闭后，这片土地重新开放，成为文特诺植物园。爱德华七世国王医院，伊

Sussex), was another tuberculosis sanatorium,opened 1906 as a private facility for the
middle classes. It is set in extensive ornamental gardens (registered Grade II), for which
about 40 planting plans were provided by Gertrude Jekyll: one of her most extensive
commissions. The gardens encouraged a regime of good diet and exercise – walking and
gardening – while its south-facing hillside site offered clear, unpolluted, air. It, too,had
Measured Walks.
苏塞克斯(Sussex)是另一家肺结核疗养院，于 1906 年开业，作为中产阶级的私人疗养院。它设置
在广泛的装饰花园(注册二级) ，其中大约 40 种植计划提供了格特鲁德 Jekyll: 她最广泛的委托之一。
这个花园鼓励良好的饮食和锻炼-步行和园艺-同时它朝南的山坡地带提供了清洁，无污染的空气。
这里也有适量的散步。
Workhouses have much in common with county asylums, often with confined airing courts
and kitchen gardens or farmland,although in the workhouse regime ornamental
landscapes were deliberately absent. Thurgarton Hundred Workhouse(Southwell
Workhouse),(Nottinghamshire, registered Grade II*, a National Trust property) is the best
example
of a workhouse landscape. Opened in 1824, its grounds were divided between enclosed exercise and
service yards(the former laid to grass, later with specimen trees), and productive land where the
inmates grew vegetables and fruit for the workhouse kitchens.
济贫院与郡立精神病院有很多共同之处，通常有封闭的通风庭院、厨房花园或农田，尽管在济贫
院制度下，有意没有装饰性的景观。Thurgarton Hundred 济贫院(Southwell 济贫院) ，
(Nottinghamshire，注册二级 * ，一个国家信托财产)是济贫院景观的最好例子。它于 1824 年开
放，场地分为封闭的运动场和服务场(前者铺设草坪，后来种上标本树) ，以及囚犯为济贫院厨房
种植蔬菜和水果的肥沃土地。
Another social institution was the cottage home orphanage, with ‘village homes’ of a
domestic character set within an ornamental designed estate. Early charitable examples
include the Barnardo’s village homes at Barkingside (London Borough of Redbridge) of
1875onwards, and the Harris Orphanage(now the Harris Knowledge Park, Preston,
Lancashire;registered Grade II), laid out 1884-8 by Preston’s Parks Superintendent. In both
cases the homes were grouped around a ‘village green’.
另一个社会机构是农舍家庭孤儿院，在一个装饰性设计的庄园里设有家庭特色的“乡村住宅”。
早期的慈善例子包括 1875 年以后巴纳多在巴金赛德(伦敦雷德布里奇区)的乡村住宅，以及哈里斯
孤儿院(现在的哈里斯知识公园，普雷斯顿，兰开夏郡; 注册二级) ，由普雷斯顿的公园管理员在
1884 年至 1888 年间规划。在这两个案例中，这些家庭都围绕着一个“绿色村庄”。

A new development of the 1920s and 1930s, was the so-called mental deficiency colony.
Such often comprised dispersed villa buildings scattered through and respecting an older
landscape park,such as for example at Prudhoe, Northumberland,begun about 1914.
20 世纪 20、30 年代的一个新发展，就是所谓的精神缺陷群体。这些建筑通常由分散的别墅建筑
组成，分散在一个古老的景观公园中，例如开始于 1914 年的诺森伯兰的普拉德霍。
1.2 Universities and colleges
1.2 大学和学院
While having much in common with monasteries,the medieval colleges of Oxford and
Cambridge had greater provision for recreation with ball courts, bowling greens and walks
alongside kitchen gardens and orchards. The confines of urban living meant any gardens
were relatively small-scale, especially in Oxford, although where colleges had land
available walks extended outside the walls, as with Worcester(registered Grade II*), Christ
Church(registered Grade I), St.John’s(registered Grade II) and Trinity(registered Grade II)
colleges. Magdalen College(registered Grade I) had notably extensive rural walks, with a
swannery and a menagerie. In Cambridge, where college grounds adjoined each other
along the
虽然与修道院有很多相似之处，但中世纪的牛津大学和剑桥大学提供了更多的娱乐设施，包括球
场、草地滚球场以及沿着厨房花园和果园散步。城市生活的限制意味着任何花园的规模都相对较
小，特别是在牛津，尽管那里的大学有土地可用的步行延伸到墙外，如伍斯特(注册二级 *) ，基
督教会(注册一级) ，圣约翰学院(注册二级)和三一学院(注册二级)。牛津大学莫德林学院(注册为一
年级)有著名的广泛的乡村散步，有一个天鹅园和一个动物园。在剑桥，这里的大学校园彼此毗邻
banks of the Cam, gardens were generally
larger.Mounts to give a view of gardens and

feature of Oxford and Cambridge gardens,

(New College，Oxford)(注册一级)培育了一座

At the Renaissance, college gardens
became more expansive. At All Souls,
Oxford, the years after 1574 saw the
Warden introduce cut hedges,covered
galleries, and intricate knot gardens, the
last apparently based on exemplars in
Thomas Hill’s newly-published The
Gardeners Labyrinth (1577). Some walks
became more formalised,and planting was
recorded along Christ Church’s walks in
1624. The Civil Wars brought disruption to
both places. In Oxford(the centre of the
royalist cause from 1642-6) quadrangles
became parade grounds and defences were
constructed, and in Cambridge(where
Cromwell was MP) orchards and walks were
despoiled. After the Wars some of Oxford’s
defences were appropriated as garden
features, such as Addison’s Walk at
Magdalene,banked above Oxford’s water

瓦德姆学院(注册二年级)私人研究员花园的露台堤坝。
The Restoration saw the widespread introduction of baroque garden features to college
gardens including parterres, fountains, statues and grilles.Clare College,
Cambridge(registered Grade II)has a surviving axial vista linking the college courts east of
the Cam with a bridge and a walk across the Backs to wrought iron gates on Queen’s Road.
In Cambridge again, at Christ’s College (registered Grade II) part of a formal wilderness of
the earlier eighteenth century remains, with a very early outdoor bathing pool overlooked
by a loggia-like summer house and with busts of college luminaries set about the garden.
In general, however, most such gardens were more Dutch in taste than French. At Oxford
the grandest scheme was at Christ Church, with Trinity’s and New College’s gardens also
being extensive and ambitious. The colleges and their gardens were captured in
exceptional detail in the engravings in David Loggan’s Oxonia Illustra of 1675 and
Cantabrigia Illustrata of 1690.
复辟见证了巴洛克园林特征的广泛引入，包括花坛，喷泉，雕像和格栅大学园林。剑桥克莱尔学
院(注册二年级)有一个现存的轴向远景连接学院法院东部的 Cam 与桥梁和步行穿过背面的锻铁大
门在皇后大道。在剑桥，基督学院(注册二级)是十八世纪早期正式荒野的一部分，有一个非常早
期的户外浴池，可以俯瞰到一座凉廊式的避暑别墅，花园里摆放着大学名人的半身像。然而，总
的来说，大多数这样的花园在品味上比法国更荷兰化。在牛津，最宏伟的计划是在基督教堂，三
一学院和新学院的花园也是广阔的和雄心勃勃的。大卫 · 洛根(David Loggan)的《1675 年的
Oxonia Illustra 》和《1690 年的 Cantabrigia Illustrata 》中的雕刻作品非常详细地记录了这些
学院和它们的花园。
Eighteenth-century landscaping in Oxford took the form of lawns and informal groves at
Wadham,Balliol and St. John’s; only Worcester College gained a designed piece of water. In
Cambridge,Lancelot Brown designed the Fellows’ Garden (more commonly known as The
Wilderness) for St. John’s in 1773 on a site across the River Cam from the main college
buildings, and this survives intact(registered Grade II*). Brown’s visionary scheme of 1779
to transform the Backs into a parkland setting was not implemented as the riverside
colleges were reluctant to collaborate,although in the event the formality seen in the Buck
Brother’s engraved view of 1743 was much softened in the early nineteenth century, with
lawns on the college side of the Cam giving way to meadows with grazing cattle beyond.
(See too Figs 4 and 5.)
18 世纪，牛津大学伍斯特学院在 Wadham，Balliol 和 st. John’s 的草坪和非正式的小树林中进行
了园林绿化，只有伍斯特学院获得了一片设计好的水域。在剑桥，兰斯洛特 · 布朗于 1773 年为圣
约翰大学设计了伙伴花园(通常被称为荒野) ，位于河对岸，与主要的大学建筑相隔河流，这座花
园保存完好(注册为二级 *)。布朗在 1779 年提出的将后院改造成公园环境的远见计划没有得到实
施，因为河边的学院不愿意合作，尽管在 19 世纪早期，雄鹿兄弟雕刻的 1743 年景象中的形式被
大大软化了，大学校园一侧的草坪让位于牧场，远处是放牧的牛群。(见图 4 和图 5)
From the 1870s the new women’s colleges at Cambridge – Girton, and Newnham – and in
Oxford St Hugh’s and Lady Margaret Hall, did away with the staircase model for colleges in
favour of an Arts and Crafts country house style,
complemented by manor-house style gardens rather than formal courts, with lawns and extensive
flower beds.
从 19 世纪 70 年代开始，剑桥大学格顿女子学院、纽纳姆女子学院以及牛津大学玛格莉特夫人学
堂都废除了大学的楼梯模式，取而代之的是工艺美术乡村住宅风格，辅之以庄园风格的花园，而
不是正式的庭院，有草坪和大片的花坛。
After the Second World War, universities
第二次世界大战后，大学
continued to influence garden and landscape design in England. Major government
spending on university building projects via the University Grants Committee began in the
1940s and the general introduction of maintenance grants in 1962 led to a huge increase
in student numbers,which more than doubled between then and 1977. An early example
of a university campus landscape of this period is the Vale in Edgbaston at the University
of Birmingham(registered Grade II), laid out in 1959-60 to a design by the landscape
architect Mary Mitchell. As often in public and institutional landscapes of this
period,modern sculpture was introduced at many universities to create strong focal points
in the landscape design. For instance, at Southampton University, which gained full
university status in 1952, a master plan was commissioned from Basil Spence in 1956, with
the main campus expanding in the early 1960s across a former brickyard.Buildings were
set around a park-like low valley and stream, with sculptures by Barbara Hepworth (Fig 6),
Justin Knowles and John Edwards.
继续影响着英国的园林和景观设计。政府通过大学教育资助委员会在大学建设项目上的主要开支
始于 1940 年代，1962 年普遍采用的维修补助金导致学生人数大幅度增加，从那时到 1977 年，
学生人数增加了一倍多。这一时期大学校园景观的一个早期例子是伯明翰大学的 Vale (注册二级) ，
由景观设计师 Mary Mitchell 在 1959-60 年间设计。在这一时期的公共和机构景观中，现代雕塑
被引入许多大学，以创造景观设计中的强大焦点。例如，在 1952 年获得正式大学地位的南安普
敦大学，1956 年由 Basil Spence 委托制定了一项总体规划，主校区在 1960 年代初扩建，穿过一
个以前的砖厂。建筑物围绕着公园一样的低谷和溪流，由芭芭拉 · 赫普沃斯(图 6) ，贾斯汀 · 诺尔
斯和约翰 · 爱德华兹的雕塑。
Later universities experimented with teaching
后来的大学开始尝试教学
spines where arts and social science disciplines could be taught in combined
accommodation.Seven new universities(the so-called Shakespearean Seven) followed:
Sussex, York,East Anglia, Essex, Kent, Warwick and Lancaster.Many of these are effectively
new towns, and now that their landscaping is reaching maturity, their initial design
intentions can be better understood and appreciated. At York(today Heslington West
Campus), the landscape design, as conceptualised by the architects Robert Matthew
Johnson-Marshall and Partners(RMJM), and further developed by their landscape architect
Maurice Lee in the early 1960s, includes ornamental, large-scale tree planting and a lake.
At the University of East Anglia(UEA), the first phase of its dramatic landscape was
completed by Brenda Colvin in 1966, who stated that a ‘broad park-like landscape should
be emphasised throughout’. Her work
艺术和社会科学学科可以在合并宿舍中教授的脊柱。七所新大学(所谓的莎士比亚七大)紧随其后:
苏塞克斯，约克，东 Anglia，埃塞克斯，肯特，沃里克和兰开斯特。其中许多实际上是新城镇，
现在他们的景观已经达到成熟，他们最初的设计意图可以更好地理解和欣赏。在约克(今赫斯灵顿
西校区) ，景观设计，由建筑师罗伯特马修约翰逊-马歇尔和伙伴(RMJM)概念化，并进一步发展由
他们的景观设计师莫里斯李在 20 世纪 60 年代初，包括装饰，大规模植树和湖泊。在东英吉利亚
大学(UEA) ，1966 年布伦达 · 科尔文(Brenda Colvin)完成了该校引人注目的景观的第一阶段，他
说“应该在整个过程中强调广阔的公园式景观”。她的作品
