1.4 Government and civic buildings
1.4 政府及民用建筑物
Although historically the buildings commissioned by and for central and local government
including ministries and town halls, were often designed to impress(see the listing
selection guides on Law and Government Buildings and Culture and Entertainment),
landscaping was generally modest in scale and ambition. Inevitably exceptions can be
found; one example is the spacious formal layout of the Grade II-listed Walthamstow Civic
Centre(1937-43), built on open land on the edge of the expanding outer London suburb.
Some of the new county halls of the 1960s also had key approaches and spaces which
were more than strictly functional. One notable example is Truro County Hall(Cornwall)of
1963-6 with landscaping(included in the Grade II listing) by Geoffrey Jellicoe(1900-96);this
includes an internal courtyard with a Barbara
虽然历史上中央和地方政府委托建造的建筑，包括各部委和市政厅，往往是为了给人留下深刻印
象(见法律和政府建筑以及文化和娱乐的选择指南) ，但景观美化的规模和雄心一般都不大。不可
避免地会有例外; 一个例子是二级保护的沃尔瑟姆斯托市政中心(1937-1943)的宽敞的正式布局，
它建在伦敦郊区扩张区边缘的开阔土地上。20 世纪 60 年代的一些新的市政厅也有关键的入口和
空间，这些空间不仅仅是严格的功能性的。一个值得注意的例子是 1963-1966 年特鲁罗县政府
(康沃尔)与景观(包括在二级清单)杰弗里杰利科(1900-1996 年) ; 这包括一个内部庭院与芭芭拉
Hepworth sculpture. Civic buildings associated with culture and education such as
museums,art galleries and libraries were often, as at York,established within existing
green spaces, and with their own immediate landscaping. A number of post-war libraries
have contemporary designed garden settings. See too the Urban designed landscapes
selection guide for discussion of civic spaces, such as Plymouth’s Grade-II registered Civic
Square of 1957.
Hepworth 雕塑。与文化和教育相关的公民建筑，如博物馆、艺术画廊和图书馆，常常像在约克
一样，建立在现有的绿色空间之内，并有自己的直接景观。许多战后图书馆都有当代设计的花园
环境。参见《城市设计风景选择指南》来讨论城市空间，比如 1957 年普利茅斯二级注册的城市
广场。
1.5 Utilities and public infrastructure
1.5 公用事业和公共基础设施
As ever-more public utilities were provided from the mid nineteenth century
onwards,architecture and setting were sometimes used to impress and reassure. The late
nineteenth-century Papplewick and Bestwood pumping stations in Nottinghamshire,
where the cooling ponds were designed for ornamental effect and surrounded by lawns
and shrubberies, are both registered Grade II. Especially after the Second World War when
public infrastructure projects became larger, the impact they had on the surrounding
countryside, and their setting,received consideration at the design stage.The landscaping
of reservoirs, motorways,power stations and forests, all became the business of landscape
architects. While of considerable interest, for the moment these schemes lie beyond the
scope of the Register.
从 19 世纪中叶开始，越来越多的公共设施被提供，建筑和环境有时被用来给人留下深刻印象和安
心。十九世纪末期，位于 Nottinghamshire 的 Papplewick 和 Bestwood 抽水站都被评为二级。
这两个抽水站的冷却池是为了装饰效果而设计的，周围是草坪和灌木丛。特别是在第二次世界大
战后，公共基础设施项目变得越来越大，它们对周围乡村的影响，以及它们的设置，在设计阶段
得到了考虑。水库、高速公路、发电站和森林的景观美化，都成为了景观设计师的事业。虽然有
相当大的兴趣，但目前这些方案超出了登记册的范围。
1.6 Military complexes
1.6 军事建筑群
From Roman times, military complexes have been carefully laid out, both for functional
reasons, and to reinforce ideals of rank, order and discipline. One highly unusual military
landscape is Repository Woods, Woolwich(London Borough of Greenwich, Registered
Grade II*), which was conceived about 1800 as an ordnance training landscape – moving
heavy guns over difficult ground and across pieces of water, for instance – for the Royal
Military Academy. This was set within picturesque pleasure grounds with walks and
planting which enabled exercises to be shown off to British and foreign dignitaries and to
the public, thereby promoting the strength and prowess of the British Army.
从罗马时代开始，军事建筑群就被精心布置，不仅是出于功能上的原因，也是为了加强军衔、秩
序和纪律的理想。一个非常不寻常的军事景观是仓库伍兹，伍尔维奇(伦敦格林威治区，登记二级
*) ，这是构想约 1800 年作为一个军械训练景观-移动重型枪械在困难的地面和跨越片片水域，例
如，为皇家军事学院。这是设置在风景如画的游乐场内的散步和种植，使演习能够向英国和外国
政要和公众炫耀，从而提高英国军队的实力和威力。
Turning to modern times, with most of the temporary bases during the world wars
aesthetic considerations were at best secondary. More attention was given to outward
appearance of the permanent facilities constructed during the First World War and from
the early 1930s,particularly during the rearmament period from 1935. Concerns about the
impact of air stations on the countryside led to the involvement of the Royal Fine Arts
Commission and the Council for the Preservation of Rural England in the design of airfield
buildings – typically in a modest, neo-Georgian style for the domestic quarters and
Moderne style for the technical buildings – and their layout. Typically domestic buildings
were well-spaced, with modest landscaping and some tree-lined paths and roads.
谈到现代，世界大战期间大多数临时基地的美学考虑充其量只是次要的。人们更加注意第一次世
界大战期间和 1930 年代初期建造的永久性设施的外观，特别是在 1935 年重新武装期间。由于担
心机场对农村的影响，英国皇家美术委员会和保护英格兰农村委员会参与了机场建筑的设计工作，
这些建筑通常采用朴素的新格鲁吉亚风格，技术建筑则采用现代风格。典型的家庭建筑是间距良
好的，有适度的景观和一些绿树成荫的小路和道路。
1.7 Landscapes associated withindustrial and commercial
buildings
1.7 与工商业楼宇相关的景观
Deliberately conceived landscapes associated with industrial sites were rare. Some
eighteenth-and nineteenth-century industrial complexes – such as some of those in
Coalbrookdale,in Shropshire’s Ironbridge Gorge – often had facades and surrounds
intended to draw the admiration of visitors and tourists, and perhaps to mitigate the less
desirable aspects of production.Another example is Quarry Bank Mill, at Styal,Cheshire,
where the Grade II* listed mill of the 1780s and the manager’s house are linked by a
designed landscape. Warmley House(South Gloucestershire; listed Grade II*), built about
1750for William Champion, a Quaker industrialist, had exceptional gardens(registered
Grade II) closely associated with Champion’s early zinc smelting processes, and many
features had a dual purpose,
精心构思的与工业场所相关的景观是罕见的。一些 18 世纪和 19 世纪的工业综合体——例如希罗
普郡铁桥谷的 Coalbrookdale 的一些工业综合体——常常有立面和周围环境，意在吸引游客和游
客的赞赏，也许是为了减轻生产中不那么令人满意的方面。另一个例子是采石场银行磨坊，在
Styal，柴郡，在那里二级 * 上市磨坊的 1780 年代和经理的房子是由一个设计的景观连接。瓦姆
利庄园(南告罗士打郡，列为二级 *) ，建于 1750 年左右，为贵格会实业家威廉•钱皮恩(William
Champion)建造，拥有与钱皮恩早期炼锌工艺密切相关的特殊花园(注册为二级) ，许多功能具有

2 Criteria
forRegistration
2 注册准则
All sites included on the Register of Parks and Gardens must hold a level of
significance defined as ‘special historic’ interest in a national context. Nine general
criteria have been defined: five relating to date and four to other considerations,
which have been used in assessing candidates for inclusion since the start of the
Register in the 1990s.
所有包括在公园和花园登记册中的地点必须具有一定的重要性，在国家背景下被定义为
“特殊的历史”利益。确定了九项一般标准: 五项与日期有关，四项与其他考虑因素有关，
自 1990 年代登记册开始以来，这些标准一直用于评估列入名单的候选人。
2.1 Date and rarity
2.1 日期和稀有性
The older a designed landscape is, and the fewer the surviving examples of its kind, the
more likely it is to have special interest. Likely to be designated are:
一个设计的风景越古老，同类现存的例子越少，就越有可能引起人们的特别兴趣。可能被指定的
有:
Sites  formed before 1750 where at least a significant proportion of the principal features
of the original layout is still in evidence Sites  laid out between 1750 and 1840where
enough of the layout survives to reflect the original design Sites  with a main phase of
development post-1840 which are of special interest and relatively intact, the degree of
required special interest rising as the site becomes closer in time Particularly  careful
selection is required for sites from the period after 1945 Sites  of less than 30 years old are
normally registered only if they are of outstanding quality and under threat
“1750 年以前形成的地点，至少有相当一部分原有布局的主要特征仍然存在”“1750 年至 1840
年间形成的地点，有足够的布局保留下来，以反映原有设计”“1840 年以后主要发展阶段的地点，
具有特殊利益和相对完整性，所需的特殊利益程度随着时间的推移而增加”“对于 1945 年以后
的地点，需要特别仔细的选择”“30 年以下的地点，通常只有在质量优异和受到威胁的情况下才
会登记
2.2 Further considerations
2.2 进一步考虑
Further considerations which may influence selection, and may exceptionally be sufficient
by themselves to merit designation, are:
可能影响选择的其他考虑因素，以及在特殊情况下，这些因素本身可能足以被指定为候选人:
Sites  which were influential in the development of taste, whether through reputation or
reference in literature Sites  which are early or representative examples of a style of layout
or a type of site, or the work of a designer(amateur or professional) of national importance
Sites  having an association with significant persons or historic events Sites  with a strong
group value with other heritage assets
”通过声誉或文学参考对品味发展产生影响的遗址”是布局风格或遗址类型或国家重要设计师(业
余或专业人士)作品的早期或代表性例子的遗址”与重要人物或历史事件有联系的遗址”具有强大
群体价值和其他遗产资产的遗址
3
SpecificConsider
ations
3 个具体考虑
In this section, more specific guidance is given relating to the registration of
institutional landscapes, which outlines our approach in assessing candidates for
being added to the National Heritage List for England.
在本节中，我们提供了有关机构景观登记的
更为具体的指导，概述了我们评估被列入英
格兰国家遗产名录候选人的方法。
3.1 Documentation
3.1 文件
Whatever its date and type, where a
landscape’s creation or development is
particularly well documented, that will
almost always add to its interest, and can
merit designation at a higher grade.
无论它的日期和类型，哪里的景观的创造或发
展是特别良好的记录，这几乎总是增加其利益，
并可以值得指定在更高的等级。
3.2 Group value
3.2 组值
The presence of a main building(such as a
college or factory) is not an essential
prerequisite for designation. However, with
institutional landscapes it would be very
exceptional for an example to meet the
tests of special interest for registration if
the main building has been lost.
主要建筑(如学院或工厂)的存在并不是指定的必
要先决条件。然而，对于机构景观来说，如果
主要建筑已经丢失，那么满足特殊兴趣的注册
测试将是非常特殊的。
3.3 Hard landscaping and
listing
3.3 硬景观美化和挂牌
In cases where a main building is listed, key
hard landscaping features such as
paving,small bridges, pools, canals,
fountains, or covered walk ways may merit
listing either in their own right or as
subsidiary features.Where a landscape
including such features is registered, this
identified special interest will normally
enhance the case for listing.
在列出主要建筑物的情况下，关键的硬景观特
征，如铺路、小桥、游泳池、运河、喷泉或有
盖步行道，可能值得列出自己的权利或作为附
属特征。如果一个景观包括这些功能被注册，
这确定的特殊利益通常会增强的情况下列出。
3.4 Authenticity
3.4 真实性
Institutional landscapes have often evolved,
or been subject to remodelling, restoration
or even recreation. Each case will have to
be judged on its merits. A recreated
landscaping scheme is unlikely to merit
designation, unless through time(and
almost certainly upwards of 30 years)it
becomes of historiographical interest.
机构景观经常发生变化，或受到重塑，修复，
甚至娱乐。每个案件都必须根据案情进行判断。
一个重建的景观规划不太可能值得指定，除非
随着时间的推移(几乎可以肯定超过 30 年)它成
为历史的兴趣。
3.5 Condition and registration
3.5 条件及注册
If a site is in poor condition, it will
nevertheless remain a candidate for
designation where its overall design or
layout remains sufficiently intact.
如果一个地点状况不佳，在其整体设计或布局
保持足够完整的情况下，它仍将是指定的候选
地点。
3.6 Grading
3.6 等级
While all registered sites are considered to
be of a sufficiently high level of interest to
merit a national designation, the sites
included on the Register of Parks and
Gardens are divided into three grade bands
to give added guidance on their
significance. The three grades are Grade I
(of exceptional interest), Grade II*(of more
than special interest) and Grade II(of special
interest, warranting every effort to preserve
them). Having begun by assessing the best-
known designed landscapes, we
accordingly have a high percentage
registered in the higher grades, and over 37
per cent of all such sites are graded in a
Grade I or Grade II* ranking; by way of
comparison, only 8 per cent of listed
buildings are designated at these levels.
虽然所有登记的地点都被认为具有足够高的利益水平，值得国家指定，但列入公园和园林登记册
的地点分为三个等级，以便就其重要性提供更多的指导。这三个级别分别为一级(具特殊意义)、
二级 * (具特殊意义以上)及二级(具特殊意义，有必要尽力保存)。我们首先评估了最著名的景观设
计，因此，登记在较高级别的建筑物所占的百分比很高，其中超过 37% 的用地被评定为一级或二
级 * ; 相比之下，只有 8% 的列入名单的建筑物被评定为这些级别。
3.77 Specific considerations: hospital landscapes
3.77 具体考虑: 医院景观
Supplementary criteria for the registration of hospital landscapes were published in
2001to facilitate a programme of assessments. These stated that to be of sufficient historic
interest to merit registration, hospital landscapes should meet one or more of the
following criteria:
2001 年公布了医院景观注册的补充标准，以促进评估方案。这些规定指出，为了具有足够的历史
价值，值得注册，医院景观应符合以下一项或多项标准:
That  a medical context is reflected in the landscape layout, such as a pioneering or
representative example of a particular type of hospital site. Assessment should be made in
the context of the development of that particular type; Where  the outer areas are no
longer intact, key elements, such as the core,are sufficiently intact to show the original
design, and are of particular importance in design and/or medical terms; The  historic
documentation provides a good knowledge of the site’s importance in medical and
landscape design history
“医疗背景反映在景观布局中，例如某一特定类型医院场地的开创性或代表性例子。评估应结合这
种特殊类型的发展情况进行;”在外部地区不再完整的地方，核心等关键要素完好无损，足以显示
原始设计，在设计和/或医学方面具有特别重要的意义;”历史文献提供了该地点在医学和景观设计
历史上的重要性的良好知识
Specific criteria for asylums require that they should meet one or more of the following
criteria:
精神病院的具体标准要求它们必须满足以下一个或多个标准:
For  asylum or related landscapes laid out before 1845, that at least a proportion of the
original layout is still in evidence, reflecting the key elements of the original design; For 
asylum or related landscapes laid out between 1845 and 1914, that the key elements
survive intact or relatively so; For  asylum or related landscapes laid out after 1914 but over
30 years ago, that they should remain intact or relatively intact
”对于 1845 年以前设计的庇护所或相关景观，至少一部分原始布局仍然存在，反映了原始设计的
关键要素;”对于 1845 年至 1914 年间设计的庇护所或相关景观，关键要素保持完整或相对完整;”
对于 1914 年以后但超过 30 年前设计的庇护所或相关景观，它们应保持完整或相对完整
In all cases there would generally be an expectation that the main hospital or asylum
building remained standing. Where listed, this may increase the likelihood of registration,
or registration at a higher grade.
在所有情况下，人们普遍期望主要的医院或庇护所建筑保持原状。在列出的情况下，这可能会增
加注册的可能性，或者注册级别更高。

Landscapes of
Remembrance
纪念风景画
Register of Parks and Gardens Selection Guide
公园及花园名册选择指南
Summary
摘要
Historic England’s selection guides help to define which historic buildings and sites
are likely to meet the relevant tests for national designation. Four guides, of which
this is one, deal with the types of site included on Historic England’s Register of
Parks and Gardens of Special Historic Interest in England which is a constituent
part of the National Heritage List for England.
英格兰历史建筑的选择指南有助于确定哪些历史建筑和遗址可能符合国家指定的相关测试。
四个指南，其中之一，处理的遗址类型包括在历史英格兰的公园和花园特别历史兴趣的英
格兰登记册，这是一个组成部分的国家遗产清单的英格兰。
Each guide falls into two halves. The first defines the types of site included in it,
before going on to give a brisk overview of how these developed through time,
with notice of the main designers and some of the key sites. The second half of the
guide sets out the particular tests a site has to meet if it is to be included on the
Register. A select bibliography gives suggestions for further reading.
每个向导分成两部分。首先定义了包含在其中的网站类型，然后在主要设计者和一些关键
网站的注意下，对这些网站是如何随着时间的推移而发展的给出一个简要的概述。指南的
后半部分列出了一个网站如果要被列入注册表，必须要满足的特殊测试。一个精选的参考
书目提供了进一步阅读的建议。
This guide covers Landscapes of Remembrance, that is the designed landscapes of
cemeteries and burial grounds of all sorts. The other three guides treat Rural,
Urban,and Institutional landscapes.
这本指南涵盖了纪念景观，即各种墓地和墓地的设计景观。另外三本指南分别介绍了农村、
城市和机构景观。

Introduction
引言
The Register of Historic Parks and Gardens
历史公园名录
of Special Historic Interest in England(now
a component of the National Heritage List
for England) was set up in 1983. It includes
designed landscapes of many types, private
and public, which are identified using
explicit criteria to possess special interest.
To date over 1650 sites have been included
on the Register. Thereby Historic England
seeks to increase awareness of their
significance, and to encourage appropriate
long-term management.Although
registration is a statutory designation,there
are no specific controls for registered parks
and gardens unlike listed buildings or
scheduled monuments. However, the
National Planning Policy Framework, gives
registered parks and gardens an equal
policy status with
英格兰特殊历史名胜(现在是英格兰国家遗产名
录的一个组成部分)于 1983 年建立。它包括设
计的许多类型的景观，私人和公共，这是确定
使用明确的标准，以拥有特殊的利益。到目前
为止，已有超过 1650 个地点被列入登记册。
因此，历史悠久的英格兰寻求提高对其重要性
的认识，并鼓励适当的长期管理。虽然注册是
一个法定的指定，有没有具体的控制已注册的
公园和花园不像列出的建筑物或规定的纪念碑。
然而，国家规划政策框架，给予注册公园和花
园一个平等的政策地位
listed buildings and scheduled monuments.
表列建筑物及列明古迹。
This is one of four complementary selection
guides which briefly describe the types of
designed landscape included on the
Register,and set out selection criteria for
designation. This guide covers burial
grounds and cemeteries of various
different types, as more fully set out at the
head of the Historical Summary. The other
three guides treat Rural, Institutional and
Urban designed landscapes. The last
includes a brief consideration of municipal
parks associated with remembrance. The
listing of buildings in designed landscapes
is considered in the Garden and Park
Structures selection guide, and the
scheduling
这是四个补充选择指南之一，其中简要描述包
括在名册内的设计景观类型，并列出指定的选
择标准。本指南涵盖了各种不同类型的墓地和
墓地，在历史摘要的开头部分有更详细的介绍。
其他三本指南分别介绍了农村、机构和城市设
计的景观。最后一个包括一个与纪念相关的市
政公园的简短考虑。设计景观中的建筑物列表
在花园和公园结构选择指南和时间表中考虑
of archaeological garden remains,
principally but
考古花园遗址，主要是

1 Historical
Summary
1 历史概要
Funerary landscapes can be divided into eight distinct types: churchyards,
葬礼景观可以分为八种不同的类型: 教堂墓地,
non-Anglican burial grounds, cemeteries, crematoria, military cemeteries,
非圣公会墓地，墓地，火葬场，军人墓地,
burial grounds attached to specific institutions, ‘emergency’ mass
附属于特定机构的墓地，“紧急”群体
burial grounds and family mausolea in private grounds.
墓地和私人墓地的家族陵墓。
1.1 Churchyards
1.1 教堂墓地
Churchyards constitute some of our most
sensitive historical open spaces, and a high
proportion have Anglo-Saxon origins.
Many, both rural and urban, occupy clearly-
planned compartments in settlements, and
in the Middle Ages were open spaces used
for a variety of functions,generally without
permanent grave markers until the
seventeenth century or later. Churchyards
are places with natural, as well as man-
made,importance. Many of England’s oldest
yew trees stand in churchyards, although
just why this should be, and their true age,
remains uncertain.Few churchyards appear
to have been laid out as formal designed
landscapes. Occasionally Georgian
ornamental planting – tree-lined paths, for
instance – is evidenced, and Painswick
(Gloucestershire; registered Grade II*; Fig
1) is a rare example where this survives in
dramatic form.
教堂庭院构成了我们最敏感的历史开放空间，
其中很大一部分源自盎格鲁-撒克逊。许多人，
无论是农村的还是城市的，在定居点占据着明
确规划的隔间，在中世纪是用于各种功能的开
放空间，一般直到 17 世纪或以后才有永久的墓
碑。教堂庭院不仅是人造的，也是自然的重要
场所。许多英格兰最古老的紫杉树都矗立在教
堂墓地里，尽管这究竟是为什么，以及它们的
真实年龄，仍然不确定。很少有教堂墓地看起
来像是正式设计的景观。偶尔，乔治亚州的观
赏性种植——例如，林荫小径——可以证明，
而 Painswick (格洛斯特郡; 注册二级 * ; 图 1)是
一个罕见的例子，它以戏剧性的形式幸存下来。
In the mid nineteenth century churchyards
lost their near-monopoly on burial. Some,
especially in towns, were closed, while
others followed the trends set by private
and municipal cemeteries as they gained
elaborate monuments and ornamental,
largely evergreen, planting such as Irish
yews. In line with Victorian piety, ‘God’s
Acre’ was treated with greater reverence,
and appreciated also for its picturesque
qualities and antiquarian interest. In the
second half of the nineteenth century, the
extension of
churchyards constituted a preferred option to the
establishment of a new cemetery. Indeed, in
1867,the Churchyard Consecration Act simplified
the conveyancing procedure for the donation of
land for churchyards. The Act specified that the
donor could retain one sixth of the donated
portion for private usage, and as a consequence
some churchyard extensions include fenced
enclaves.Churchyard extension was
commonplace, partly as
在十九世纪中叶，教堂墓地丧失了对埋葬的近
乎垄断地位。一些公墓，特别是城镇的公墓，
已经关闭，而另一些公墓则追随着私人和市政
公墓的发展趋势，因为这些公墓建造了精美的
纪念碑，种植了爱尔兰紫杉等大部分常绿的装
饰性植物。与维多利亚时代的虔诚相一致，
“上帝的一亩地”受到了更多的尊敬，也因其
风景如画的品质和古文物的趣味而受到赞赏。
在 19 世纪下半叶，教堂墓地的扩建是建立一个
新墓地的首选。事实上，在 1867 年，《教堂
墓地奉献法》简化了为教堂墓地捐赠土地的转
让程序。该法案明确规定，捐赠者可以保留捐
赠部分的六分之一用于私人用途，因此，一些
墓地扩建包括围栏飞地。墓地扩建是司空见惯
的，部分原因是

墓地，它被注册为二级设计景观。

圣乔治花园，伦敦卡姆登区。这个墓地于 1713 年开放，是一种新的英国国教墓地——位于布卢姆斯伯里

a consequence of investment in complex memorials,which used up space in the
churchyard rapidly, and partly because of population growth.
这是投资建造复杂的纪念碑的结果，这些纪念碑迅速占用了墓地的空间，部分原因是人口增长。
As the nineteenth century progressed, some vestries attempted to implement cemetery
management guidance within new churchyard extensions, and parish records and visual
survey can evidence the introduction of a more rational approach to land use. In many
churchyards,the complexity of the Victorian landscape has regrettably disappeared as a
consequence of successive clearance programmes, which have in particular targeted the
levelling of body mounds and removal of kerbsets. Large-scale churchyard re-ordering has
occasionally introduced some landscaping opportunities that in themselves may merit
conservation: for example, the churchyard of St John the Baptist at Knaresborough(North
Yorkshire) was cleared ‘by design’ according to plans produced by the renowned designer
Sylvia Crowe in the early 1970s.
随着十九世纪的进展，一些牧师试图在新的墓地扩建范围内实施墓地管理指导，教区记录和目测
可以证明采用了更合理的土地使用方法。令人遗憾的是，在许多教堂墓地，维多利亚时代景观的
复杂性已经消失，因为连续的清理方案，特别是针对平整尸体堆和清除路边石。大规模的墓地重
新排序偶尔会带来一些美化环境的机会，而这些机会本身可能就值得保护。例如，北约克郡纳尔
斯伯勒的圣若翰洗者墓地是根据著名设计师西尔维娅•克罗(Sylvia Crowe)在 20 世纪 70 年代初
制定的计划“经过设计”清理的。
Figure 3
图 3
Bunhill Fields, London Borough of Islington. One of the capital’s earliest, and historically richest,
nonconformist burial grounds. Interment here was started in 1666,and there are now some 2,000
memorials. Seventy-five tombs, along with the boundary walls, railings and gates, are listed at
Grades II* and II. The whole is registered at Grade I.
伦敦伊斯灵顿区的邦希尔球场。伦敦最早的，历史上最富饶的非墨守成规者墓地之一。这里的葬礼始于
1666 年，现在有大约 2000 个纪念碑。75 座坟墓，以及边界墙、栏杆和大门，被列为二级 * 和二级。整
个墓葬都登记在一级。
1.2 Non-Anglican burial grounds
1.2 非圣公会墓地
After the Reformation a few private Catholic
宗教改革后，一些私人天主教徒
chapels and burial grounds continued to be used for burial by adherents to the Old Faith,
although heavy penalties meant few burial registers were kept. Burial grounds(graveyards
without a principal place of worship) emerged in the later seventeenth century as
deliberately separate enclaves for the burial of the dead from minority faiths such as such
Quakers, Jews and Moravians which did not belong to the Church of England.Early burial
grounds include London’s imposing Bunhill Fields(opened 1656; registered Grade I;Fig 3),
and the Velho Jewish burial ground on Mile End Road, London(opened 1657; registered
Grade II). Early burial grounds tended to be small,functional, urban enclosures in which
landscaping and planting were generally minimal, with plain head-stones modestly
reflecting sepulchral humility. However, as the nineteenth century progressed, these
grounds also became subject to changing demand for formal commemoration.The Old
Baptist Chapel burial ground at Tewkesbury – in use from 1655 – is one example where
nineteenth-century memorials are little different from those in municipal cemeteries.
教堂和墓地继续被旧信仰的信徒用来埋葬，尽管严厉的惩罚意味着几乎没有埋葬记录。墓地(没有
主要宗教场所的墓地)在十七世纪后期出现，作为故意将死者的埋葬地与少数宗教信仰分开，例如
不属于英国国教的贵格会教徒、犹太教徒和摩拉维亚教徒。早期的墓地包括伦敦雄伟的 Bunhill
Fields (开放于 1656 年; 注册一级; 图 3) ，以及伦敦 Mile End 路上的 Velho 犹太墓地(开放于
1657 年; 注册二级)。早期的墓地往往是小型的、功能齐全的城市围场，园林绿化和种植通常很少，
普通的墓碑适度地反映了阴间的谦卑。然而，随着 19 世纪的进展，这些墓地也成为变化的需求
正式纪念。位于蒂克斯伯里的旧浸礼会教堂墓地——从 1655 年开始使用——是 19 世纪纪念碑与
市政公墓中的纪念碑几乎没有什么不同的一个例子。
Figure 4
图 4
Histon Road Cemetery, Cambridge. Although this has lost its chapel, it is included on the Register
at Grade II as the best example of a cemetery designed by J C Loudon(d.1843), the leading
proponent of cemetery improvement. Typical features include the straight paths, neatly-ordered
graves and sombre planting.
剑桥希斯顿公墓。虽然这里已经失去了它的教堂，但是它被列入了二级登记册，作为由 j c 劳登(1843 年
生)设计的墓地的最佳范例，他是改善墓地的主要支持者。典型的特征包括笔直的道路，整齐的坟墓和阴郁
的种植。
1.3 Cemeteries
1.3 坟场
Planned detached cemeteries(as opposed to overflow burial grounds, in confined spaces)
were laid out from the earlier seventeenth century –Exeter’s Bartholomew Yard(registered
Grade II*)of the 1630s is the earliest known – while St George’s Gardens(registered Grade
II*; Fig 2)opened in 1714 as the Anglican burial ground for Bloomsbury, is regarded as the
first deliberately planned Anglican cemetery in England.
17 世纪早期，埃克塞特的 Bartholomew Yard (注册二级 *)是已知最早的墓地，而圣乔治花园(注
册二级 * ; 图 2)于 1714 年开放，作为布鲁姆斯伯里的圣公会墓地，被认为是英国第一个有意规划
的圣公会墓地。
1.3.1 Early private company cemeteries
1.3.1 早期私人公司坟场
What is generally reckoned the first non-
人们普遍认为的第一个非
denominational cemetery in England is The Rosary, Norwich,(registered Grade II*),
founded in 1819. It was to be a cemetery where people were free to be buried with the
religious service of their choice, or none at all. Over the next decade,several further non-
denominational cemeteries were founded by Nonconformists in English towns and cities.
But what in general lay behind the opening of new cemeteries in the last years of the
Georgian epoch in the 1820s and 1830s was the need for more burial space in towns and
cities where much-increased populations overwhelmed the existing churchyards giving
rise to much
英格兰的教派墓地是诺威奇的玫瑰花园(注册二级 *) ，创建于 1819 年。它原本是一个公墓，人们
可以自由选择他们的宗教仪式，或者根本不选择宗教仪式。在接下来的十年里，在英国的城镇和
城市里，一些非教派的人建立了更多的非教派墓地。但总体而言，在 19 世纪 20 年代和 30 年代
格鲁吉亚时代最后几年新墓地开放的背后，是需要在人口大幅增加的城镇建造更多的墓地，这些
地方的人口超过了现有的教堂墓地，从而产生了大量墓地

对健康的恐惧。多愁善感的虔诚和对礼貌的日益强调也起到了一定的作用。
Cemeteries emerged as a new form of arcadian funerary landscape, combining the
incident-dotted circuits of the private park with the religious and didactic monuments of
the churchyard. Père Lachaise Cemetery in Paris (opened 1804) in part influenced J C
Loudon’s On the Laying Out, Planting and Managing of Cemeteries(1843), which promoted
a more regimented approach to cemetery management.Loudon aimed to meet sanitary
requirements from burial space whilst at the same time offering an attractive and
instructive landscape(Fig 4).
墓地作为一种新形式的世外桃源葬礼景观出现了，结合了事件点缀的私人公园环线与教堂墓地的
宗教和说教纪念碑。巴黎拉雪兹神父公墓(1804 年开放)在一定程度上影响了 j · c · 劳登的《公墓
的布局、种植和管理》(1843 年) ，促进了公墓管理更加严格的方法。劳登的目标是满足墓地的卫
生要求，同时提供一个有吸引力和有益的景观(图 4)。
In England the general model was for
在英格兰，一般的模式是为

example, at Kensal Green, London, opened in 1833(registered Grade I; Fig 5). The
Neoclassical character of these early foundations was joined from the later 1830s onwards
by stylistic eclecticism, with the provision of Gothic and

1.3.2 High Victorian and
Edwardian municipal
cemeteries
1.3.2 高维多利亚时代和
爱德华时代的市政公墓
The Public Health Act 1848
created a framework for the
closure of insanitary burial
spaces, and Burial Acts in
1852 and 1853 empowered
vestries to establish new
cemeteries funded through
loans raised against the
rates. The burial boards
which were then created to
administer these new
cemeteries took their cue
from the private
establishments of the
earlier period, in offering
the sale of burial rights in
perpetuity. This degree of
permanency, in addition to
a growing cultural aversion
to disintering bodies in
order to re-use
space in the cemetery, created
a context for the erection of
more elaborate monuments.
Boards generally established
hierarchies of graves which
ranged from the formal and
imposing, situated along the
principal avenues, to public
graves in less prominent areas,
where families were generally
not permitted to erect a
memorial.
1848 年《公共卫生法》为关
闭不卫生的墓地建立了一个框
架，1852 年和 1853 年的《墓
地法》授权牧师通过提高利率
的贷款建立新的墓地。当时为
管理这些新墓地而设立的墓地
委员会是从早期的私人机构那
里得到启示，提供永久性的出
售墓地权利。这种程度的永久
性，加上文化上日益厌恶为了
重新利用墓地的空间而分离尸
体，为树立更精致的纪念碑创
造了条件。委员会通常确定坟
墓的等级，从位于主要道路沿
线的正式和庄严的坟墓，到不
太显眼地区的公共坟墓，在这
些地区，家属一般不被允许竖
立纪念碑。
Early sections were
frequently joined later by
later nineteenth- and
twentieth-century
extensions which can
possess a different
character in terms of layout
and planting.The grander
municipal cemeteries, like
their commercial
inspirations, aimed at an
opulent effect through
imposing gateways, chapels
and planting, but this gave
way during the later
twentieth century to a much
leaner approach to upkeep
which involved the
demolition of disused
buildings, the in-filling of
pathways, and the
abandonment of elaborate
planting schemes,which has
transformed their
appearance.
19 世纪后期和 20 世纪后期的
延伸经常加入早期的部分，这
些部分在布局和种植方面可能
具有不同的特点。宏伟的市政
公墓和它们的商业灵感一样，
旨在通过建造大门、礼拜堂和
种植来达到富丽堂皇的效果，
但在 20 世纪后期，这种做法
让位于一种更精简的维修方法，
其中包括拆除废弃的建筑物，
填平道路，放弃精心设计的种
植方案，这些方案改变了它们
的外观。

the emergence of new and

commemoration.Victorian
excess was deemed by
some to be

as a new ideal, in which the tradition of

不真诚，痴迷于社会地位。现代化的草坪墓地

坟墓的传统，使得维护工作更加容易，特别是
在引进了新的割草设备的地方。通过移除围栏
来划分墓地，进一步简化了维护工作。纪念碑
刻意谦虚，铭文和图像变得更加克制和私密。
While the twentieth century generally saw a
decline in the opulence and ambition of
commemorative design, some modern
funerary landscapes may deserve greater
recognition in the future. There was an
intention to produce landscapes that were
more akin to the domestic garden, with flat
lawns and bright bedding. A new trend in
the late twentieth century was the
woodland, or natural, burial ground. The
first in the UK was opened in 1993 at
Carlisle Cemetery,with the first private one,
the Greenhaven Burial Ground, at
Lilbourne(Nottinghamshire), opening in
1994. By 2012 there were over 200 in the
UK.
虽然二十世纪纪念设计的奢华程度和雄心壮志
普遍下降，但一些现代葬礼景观在未来可能值
得更多的承认。当时的意图是创造出更接近于
家庭花园的风景，有平坦的草坪和明亮的床上
用品。二十世纪后期的一个新趋势是林地，或
者说是天然的墓地。英国第一家墓地于 1993
年在卡莱尔公墓开业，第一家私人墓地是位于
利尔伯恩(诺丁汉郡)的格林黑文墓地，于 1994
年开业。到 2012 年，在英国有超过 200 个。
1.4 Crematoria
1.4 火葬场
Cremation was legalised in 1884, the first
legal cremation took place in 1885, at a
crematorium founded by the Cremation
Society of Great Britain, at Woking(Surrey;
Grade II). An Act of 1902 empowered the
construction of crematoria by local
authorities. Hilary Grainger’s Death
Redesigned records that to 2005, 251
crematoria were built in the UK: 14 to 1914,
6 in the 1920s,34 in the 1930s, and 4 in the
1940s. Between 1950 and 1970 a further
147 were constructed.Golders Green,
opened 1902(London Borough of Barnet;
registered Grade I; Fig 8) is the first
crematorium in England where landscape
design was considered from the outset,
and it had significant influence on
crematorium landscape design in general
right through the first half of the twentieth
century although, as the figures above
show, it was only in the 1930s that
crematoria began to be built in larger
numbers. William Robinson’s God’s Acre
Beautiful(1880) was a key tract, promoting
both cremation, and burial grounds entirely
uncluttered with memorials or tombstones.
The American term ‘gardens of rest’ or
‘gardens of remembrance’ has been in

These were characterised by a relatively formal layout close to the crematorium buildings,
with rose beds, pools, rockeries, shrubberies and walks(mostly influenced by the Arts and
Crafts style), with informality beyond. Although in the early years most ashes were
interred in the ground, there was a gradual move to retain ashes above ground which
promoted the building of columbaria, walls with niches purchased either for a few years or
in perpetuity. A remarkable example of 1901(listed Grade II) remains at Hull
Crematorium(itself also of 1901, and listed Grade II), consisting of an artificial rockery that
was extensively planted with alpines and held up to a thousands urns. After the First
World War colonnades became popular, where small tablets could be placed after ashes
had been scattered in the adjacent gardens.
火葬场附近的建筑物布局相对正式，有玫瑰花床、水池、假山、灌木丛和人行道(大部分受工艺美
术风格影响) ，不拘礼节。虽然早年大部分骨灰都埋在地下，但后来逐渐将骨灰保留在地上，这

括一个人造假山，广泛种植着高山，并有上千个骨灰瓮。第一次世界大战后，柱廊变得流行起来，
在邻近的花园里撒上骨灰后，可以放置小石碑。

There are instances of landscapes for cremated remains that were laid out with no
adjacent crematorium such as Stoke Poges Memorial Garden(1937); registered Grade I(Fig
9). This stands on the meadows immortalised in Thomas Gray’s poem, ‘Elergy Written in a
Country Churchyard’(1751).Within many churchyards,newly landscaped areas have been
created to accommodate cremated remains, and may include formal built and designed
elements such as columbaria. In 2000, over 70 per cent of all deposits were of cremated
bodies.
有些火化遗骸的景观并没有毗邻的火葬场，例如 stokpoges 纪念花园(1937 年) ; 登记为一级(图
9)。这座建筑位于托马斯 · 格雷(Thomas Gray)的诗歌《乡村教堂墓地的哀歌》(Elergy Written
in a Country Churchyard，1751)中永垂不朽的草地上。在许多教堂墓地，新的景观区域已经建
立起来，以容纳火化的遗骸，可能包括正式建造和设计的元素，如骨灰龛。在 2000 年，超过
70% 的沉积物是火化的尸体。
1.5 Military cemeteries
1.5 军人墓地
British military personnel had long been buried where they died; commemoration was
confined to officers, who occasionally received individual memorials. An early military
cemetery was that laid out in Turkey at Scutari hospital during the Crimean War(1854-6).
As the status of soldiers rose in the later nineteenth century, greater attention was paid to
their burial: at home, and across the Empire, distinct military burial grounds were
established. Others were established in South Africa during the Zulu and Boer Wars.
英国军人长期埋葬在他们死去的地方; 纪念活动仅限于军官，他们偶尔会收到个人的纪念。克里
米亚战争(1854-1856)期间，一个早期的军人墓地在土耳其的 Scutari 医院被建立起来。随着士兵
地位在十九世纪后期的提高，人们对他们的埋葬给予了更多的关注: 在国内和整个帝国，都建立
了独特的军事墓地。在祖鲁战争和布尔战争期间，还有一些建在南非。
However, it was not until the First World War that a decision was made not to repatriate
the dead,and that systematic record keeping and care for graves should be introduced. In
1915 the Imperial (Later Commonwealth) War Graves Commission was founded by Major
General Sir Fabian Ware (1869-1949). One of its first tasks was to acquire land abroad, and
to construct cemeteries and memorials to the dead. Prominent architects and artists were
commissioned to design the cemeteries, including Sir Edwin Lutyens, Sir Reginald
Blomfield and Sir Herbert Baker,and Rudyard Kipling was the literary advisor.Gertrude
Jekyll, through Lutyens, briefly advised on planting, and while she recommended that each
gravestone should be shaded by an English rose, generally species native to the
casualties’countries were used, enhancing connections with home. By 1921 the
Commission was responsible for 2,400 cemeteries abroad, and by the mid twentieth
century 2,500. The names of those with no known grave were inscribed on memorials to
然而，直到第一次世界大战才作出不遣返死者的决定，并且应该采用系统的记录和照料坟墓的做
法。1915 年，帝国(后来的英联邦)战争坟墓委员会由少将费边 · 瓦尔爵士(1869-1949)创立。该委
员会的首要任务之一是在国外获得土地，并为死者修建墓地和纪念碑。杰出的建筑师和艺术家被
委托设计公墓，包括埃德温 · 鲁琴斯爵士，雷金纳德 · 布隆菲尔德爵士和赫伯特 · 贝克爵士，以及
拉迪亚德 · 吉卜林是文学顾问。格特鲁德 · 杰基尔(Gertrude Jekyll)通过鲁琴斯(Lutyens)简要介绍
了种植方面的建议，尽管她建议每块墓碑应该用一朵英国玫瑰遮阴，但通常使用的都是死难者所
在国家的本土品种，从而加强了与家乡的联系。到 1921 年，该委员会负责管理海外的 2400 个公
墓，到 20 世纪中叶，这个数字达到了 2500 个。那些没有已知坟墓的人的名字被刻在纪念碑上
the missing.
失踪的人。
For soldiers who died at home of wounds, disease or accident, the Commission created
over 12,000enclaves in the UK. Many are attached to pre-existing civilian cemeteries. Of
the UK sites, 416are large enough(that is, with over 40 graves) to have the Cross of
Sacrifice designed by Blomfield and thirteen(with over 1,000 graves) the altar-like Stone of
Remembrance designed by Lutyens.In general only the larger war cemeteries, such as
Brookwood(Surrey; registered Grade I), and the RAF regional cemeteries at Bath,
Cambridge,
对于那些因伤病或事故死于家中的士兵，该委员会在英国建立了超过 12000 个飞地。许多都附属
于原有的平民墓地。在英国的遗址中，有 416 处足够大(即 40 多个坟墓) ，可以放置由布隆菲尔
德设计的牺牲十字架和 13 处(1000 多个坟墓)由鲁琴斯设计的祭坛状的纪念石,

哈罗盖特、切斯特和牛津的宏伟设计特征与那些在国外创造的有相同之处。
In 2003 a repatriation policy was formalised,and since then service personnel who die
abroad are returned to the UK at the expense of the MoD. To meet the public desire to
commemorate those who have served the country, the National Memorial Arboretum at
Alrewas in Staffordshire was created; planting began in 1997, and it opened in 2001. By
2015 it contained over 300 memorials.
2003 年，一项遣返政策正式确定下来，从那时起，在国外死亡的军人将由国防部出资遣返英国。
为了满足公众纪念那些为国家服务的人的愿望，英国国家纪念植物园在斯塔福德郡的奥尔勒斯建
立，种植始于 1997 年，2001 年开放。到 2015 年，它包含了超过 300 个纪念馆。
Aside from the Commonwealth War Graves Commission(CWGC) cemeteries, there are a
few war cemeteries in England laid out by other countries for their war dead. These
include the German War Cemetery at Cannock Chase(Staffordshire) of 1967, laid out by
the Volksbund Deutsche Kriegsgräberfürsorgung (the German War Graves Commission;
now managed on its behalf by the CWGC) to evoke north German heathland(Fig 10); and
the Brookwood, and Cambridge, American War Cemeteries, created by the American
Battle Monuments Commission, which have severely formal designs. The Cambridge
cemetery, dedicated 1956, has landscape design by Olmsted Brothers of Brookline,
Massachusetts(Fig 11).All three cemeteries are registered at Grade I.The Muslim Burial
Ground at Woking(Surrey) for soldiers of the Indian sub-continent who died of wounds
was completed in 1917(Fig 12); its walls and gateway are listed Grade II. Lastly, the Chattri
Memorial on the Downs near Patcham (East Sussex; listed Grade II), unveiled in
1921,marks the site of the burning ghat(place of cremation) where 53 Hindu and Sikh
soldiers and servants who had died of wounds or disease in Brighton hospitals in 1914-15
were cremated.
除了英联邦战争公墓委员会(CWGC)公墓外，英格兰还有一些其他国家为战争死难者建造的战争公
墓。这些建筑包括 1967 年位于 Cannock Chase (斯塔福德郡)的德国战争公墓，由德国人民银行
(Volksbund Deutsche Kriegsgräberfürsorgung)设计，以唤起人们对北德荒原的回忆(图 10) ;
以及由美国战役纪念碑委员会设计的布鲁克伍德和剑桥美国战争公墓。剑桥公墓，建于 1956 年，
由马萨诸塞州布鲁克林的奥姆斯特德兄弟公司设计(图 11)。所有三个墓地都是一级注册的。位于
沃金(萨里)的穆斯林墓地是印度次大陆死于伤病的士兵的墓地，于 1917 年竣工(图 12) ，墓墙和墓
门被列为二级墓地。最后，1921 年揭幕的位于帕彻姆(Patcham)附近丘陵上的 Chattri 纪念碑标
志着燃烧的 ghat (火葬场所) ，1914-1915 年在布莱顿医院死于伤病的 53 名印度教和锡克教士兵
和仆人在这里被火化。
War memorials in cities, towns and villages often stand within a designed setting,typically
laid out at the time of the memorial’s installation, and intended to complement it. These
range from a kerbed or railed lawn, to much larger and more ambitious enclosures which
serve as memorial parks.
城市、城镇和村庄中的战争纪念碑通常都是设计好的，通常是在纪念碑安装时布置的，目的是为
了补充它。这些建筑从路边的路肩或有栏杆的草坪，到作为纪念公园的更大更雄心勃勃的围墙。
For the listing of war memorials, and the special considerations which apply to those in
CWGC cemeteries, see the Commemorative Structures listing selection guide.
关于战争纪念碑的列表，以及适用于 CWGC 公墓的特殊考虑，请参阅纪念建筑列表选择指南。
1.6 Emergency mass burial grounds
1.6 紧急集体墓地
In towns, from the Middle Ages until the Second World War, epidemics and other massed
death incidents could lead to emergency burial grounds being established. For example,
cholera burial grounds existed across the UK, although in some cases these have been
retained as open spaces where there is little evidence of their past purpose. York’s,
alongside the railway station,is the resting place of 185 victims of the 1832outbreak, while
the emergency cholera burial ground for Selby(North Yorkshire) adjoined the abbey’s
cemetery.
在城镇，从中世纪到第二次世界大战，流行病和其他集体死亡事件可能导致建立紧急埋葬地点。
例如，英国各地都有霍乱埋葬地，尽管在某些情况下，这些地方被保留为开放空间，几乎没有证
据表明它们过去的用途。1832 年霍乱爆发后，185 名受害者在火车站旁边的约克郡安息，塞尔比
(北约克郡)的紧急霍乱埋葬地与修道院的墓地毗邻。
Areas within existing larger cemeteries where massed burials took place are sometimes
demarcated. For example, large-scale losses as a consequence of aerial bombardment in
the Second World War were – when pressure was particularly acute – interred in massed
graves.Monuments that were later erected to the civilian war dead were financed through
specific grants available from the Treasury, and were subject to negotiation on design and
cost. Some have been listed in their own right.
在现有的较大的墓地内进行集体埋葬的区域有时被划分出来。例如，第二次世界大战期间由于空
中轰炸造成的大规模损失在压力特别严重的时候被埋葬在乱葬岗。后来为平民战争死难者建造的
纪念碑是通过财政部的特别拨款资助的，并且需要就设计和成本进行谈判。其中一些已经被列入
自己的名单。
1.7 Institutional burial grounds
1.7 机构墓地
From the mid nineteenth century institutional burial grounds became more common with
the rise of locally-funded facilities such as county asylums and isolation hospitals. The
earliest surviving examples are of the seventeenth century, notably the Royal Hospital
Chelsea,where the burial ground on Royal Hospital Road was in use from the 1690s and
which is included in the Grade II landscape. The former Greenwich Hospital had a
comparable area, but this landscape is not registered in its own right.In the eighteenth
century military establishments such as the naval hospitals at Greenwich, Haslar (Gosport,
Hampshire; registered Grade II) and Devonport(Plymouth, Devon), gained burial grounds,
as did prisons. Other than the Haslar Royal Naval Cemetery, very few such funerary
landscapes have been registered hitherto.
从 19 世纪中叶开始，随着县精神病院和隔离医院等地方资助设施的兴起，机构墓地变得越来越
普遍。现存最早的例子是 17 世纪，特别是切尔西皇家医院，皇家医院路上的墓地从 17 世纪 90
年代开始使用，被列入二级景观。以前的格林威治医院也有类似的面积，但是这种景观本身并没
有注册。在十八世纪的军事设施中，如格林威治的海军医院 Haslar (戈壁波特，汉普郡; 注册二
级)和德文波特(普利茅斯，德文) ，获得了墓地，就像监狱一样。除了 Haslar 皇家海军公墓，迄
今为止很少有这样的墓地景观被注册。
1.8 Family mausolea
1.8 家族陵墓
For such buildings see the Commemorative Structures listing selection guide. Their
landscapes form part of parklands: these are considered in the Rural Landscapes selection
guide.
有关这些建筑物，请参阅纪念建筑物清单选择指南。它们的景观构成了公园的一部分: 这些被考
虑在乡村景观选择指南中。
2 Criteria
forRegistration
2 登记标准
All sites included on the Register of Parks and Gardens must hold a level of
significance defined as ‘special historic’ interest in a national context. Nine general
criteria have been defined: five relating to date and four to other considerations,
which have been used in assessing candidates for inclusion since the start of the
Register in the 1980s
公园和花园登记册上的所有地点都必须具有一定的重要性，在国家范围内被定义为”特殊
的历史”利益。确定了九项一般标准: 五项与日期有关，四项与其他考虑因素有关，自
1980 年代登记册开始以来，这些标准一直用于评估列入名单的候选人
2.1 Date and rarity
2.1 日期和罕见
The older a designed landscape is, and the fewer the surviving examples of its kind, the
more likely it is to have special interest. Likely to be designated are:
一个被设计的景观越古老，同类现存的例子越少，它就越有可能产生特殊的兴趣。可能被指定的
有:
Sites  formed before 1750 where at least a significant proportion of the principal features
of the original layout is still in evidence Sites  laid out between 1750 and 1840 where
enough of the layout survives to reflect the original design Sites  with a main phase of
development post-1840 which are of special interest and relatively intact, the degree of
required special interest rising as the site becomes closer in time Particularly  careful
selection is required for sites from the period after 1945 Sites  of less than 30 years old are
normally registered only if they are of outstanding quality and under threat
“1750 年以前形成的地点，至少有相当一部分原有布局的主要特征仍然存在”“1750 年至 1840
年间形成的地点，有足够的布局保留下来，以反映原有设计”“1840 年以后主要发展阶段的地点，
具有特殊利益和相对完整性，随着时间的推移，所需的特殊利益程度不断上升”“对于 1945 年
以后的地点，需要特别仔细的选择”“30 年以下的地点，通常只有在质量优异和受到威胁的情况
下才会登记
2.2 Further considerations
2.2 进一步考虑
Further considerations which may influence selection, and may exceptionally be sufficient
by themselves to merit designation, are:
可能影响选择的进一步考虑，以及可能在特殊情况下足以被指定的考虑，包括:
Sites  which were influential in the development of taste, whether through reputation or
reference in literature Sites  which are early or representative examples of a style of layout
or a type of site, or the work of a designer(amateur or professional) of national
importance Sites  having an association with significant persons or historic events Sites 
with a strong group value with other heritage assets
”通过声誉或文学参考对品味发展产生影响的遗址”是布局风格或遗址类型或国家重要设计师(业
余或专业人士)作品的早期或代表性例子的遗址”与重要人物或历史事件有联系的遗址”具有强大
群体价值和其他遗产资产的遗址
3
SpecificConsider
ations
3 特殊考虑
In this section, more specific guidance is given relating to the registration of
landscapes of remembrance, which outlines our approach in assessing candidates
for being added to the National Heritage List for England.
在这一部分，更具体的指导是有关登记的景
观纪念，其中概述了我们的方法，以评估候
选人被列入国家遗产名单为英格兰。
3.1 Pre-Victorian burial
grounds
3.1 前维多利亚时代的墓地
A high proportion of earlier burial grounds
have been built over, which adds to the
significance of those which remain. Extra
interest attaches to those which were
opened to serve minority faiths and
communities. Generally closed for burials in
the 1850s and later converted to public
park use, these burial grounds have often
undergone considerable alteration and
care is needed in their assessment. A
further complication lies in their relatively
plain and utilitarian design. Specific criteria
should include:
很大一部分早期的墓地已经建造完毕，这增加
了那些遗留下来的墓地的重要性。人们对那些
为少数民族信仰和社区服务而开放的墓地更感
兴趣。这些墓地一般在 19 世纪 50 年代关闭，
后来改作公园用途，但往往经过相当大的改动，
需要在评估时加以小心。进一步的复杂性在于
它们相对简单和实用的设计。具体的标准应包
括:
Early  date
”提前日期
Quality  and survival of monuments as a
contribution to the landscape Interest  of
later conversions to public park
use(including planting and hard
landscaping)
”古迹的质量和生存对景观的贡献”对日后改作
公园用途(包括种植和硬质景观)的兴趣
Rarity  as a survival
“作为一种生存方式的稀有。”
Significance  in terms of faith and
community
”在信仰和社区方面的意义
3.2 Early nineteenth-
centurycemeteries
3.2 十九世纪早期的墓地
There is a presumption to designate early
cemeteries from this period: the best will
warrant registering in a higher
grade.Specific criteria should include:
有一种推定是从这个时期开始指定早期墓地: 最
好的将保证登记在一个更高的等级。具体标准
应包括:
Intactness  of original design
“原始设计的完整性
Earliness  of date
日期提前
Overall  integration of landscaping,
buildings and tombs to produce an
arcadian effect
“整体整合景观、建筑和坟墓，产生一种庭院的
效果。”
Subsequent  influence on cemetery design
”随后对墓地设计的影响
Churchyards are generally not considered
for registration, unless planting of
exceptional interest is present, as at
Painswick.
教堂墓地一般不会被考虑注册，除非像佩恩斯威克那样有特殊利益的种植。
3.3 High Victorian and Edwardianmunicipal cemeteries
3.3 高维多利亚时代和爱德华时代的市政公墓
Specific criteria for this category of cemetery will be more stringent than for the earlier
categories.Sometimes it may be appropriate to designate only the early sections of a
cemetery if the later areas have less design interest; these may be the areas with greater
emotional sensitivity on account of possessing more recent burials, however.Specific
criteria should include:
这一类墓地的具体标准将比以前的类别更加严格。有时候，如果墓地的早期区域没有什么设计意
义，那么只指定墓地的早期区域也许是合适的; 然而，这些区域可能因为拥有较近期的墓葬而具
有较强的情感敏感性。具体的标准应该包括:
Quality  of original design
原创设计的品质
Intactness  and degree of alteration
“完整性和改动程度。”
Overall  effect of landscaping, buildings and tombs
景观美化、建筑物和坟墓的整体效果
Earliness  of date
日期提前
Innovation 
创新
Regional  or local distinctiveness
区域或地方特色
3.4 The twentieth-century funerarylandscape
3.4 二十世纪的葬礼景观
Selection will be especially stringent here; the principal specific criteria will be:
这里的选择将特别严格; 主要的具体标准将是:
Innovation  and rarity in design
”设计上的创新和稀缺
Intactness 
完整性
3.5 Military cemeteries
3.5 军人墓地
These already enjoy special protection and are managed with great care and sensitivity by
the CWGC and allied bodies. Accordingly,and following Historic England’s policy towards
monuments therein(for which see the Commemorative Structures listing selection guide)
the individual registration of cemeteries will not normally be warranted. However,the three
most notable military cemeteries –Brookwood, Madingley, and Cannock Chase
– have each been registered at Grade I as exceptional exemplars of cemetery designed landscapes
with profound historical associations.Where military cemeteries form adjuncts of civilian cemeteries,
any assessment will be of the cemetery as a whole; that will have to meet the general selection criteria,
although the war cemetery area may give added special interest.
这些墓地已经享有特殊的保护，并且由 CWGC 和相关机构以极大的谨慎和敏感性进行管理。因此，
按照历史上的英格兰对其中的古迹的政策(见纪念建筑物列表选择指南) ，墓地的个人登记通常是
不合理的。然而，三个最著名的军人墓地——布鲁克伍德、马丁利和坎诺克大通——都被登记为
一级墓地设计风景的杰出典范，具有深刻的历史联系。如果军人墓地是民用墓地的附属物，则任
何评估将是对整个墓地的评估; 这必须符合一般选择标准，尽管战争墓地区域可能会增加特殊意
义。
Where a military memorial stands within an enclosure with hard landscaping, this will
typically be included in the listing of the memorial itself.
如果一个军事纪念碑位于一个有硬景观的围墙内，这通常会包括在纪念碑本身的列表中。
3.6 Documentation
3.6 文件
Whatever its date and type, where a landscape’s creation or development is particularly
well documented, that will almost always add to its interest, and can merit designation at
a higher grade.
无论它的日期和类型，哪里的景观的创造或发展是特别良好的记录，这几乎总是增加其利益，并
可以值得指定在更高的等级。
3.7 Group value and survival
3.7 群体价值和生存
Cemetery buildings have generally been designed to form an integral part of an overall
scheme, and indeed the ground plan of the cemetery is often by the same hand as the
architecture. Where the full complement of buildings and structures survives, and
particularly where these are of high quality, this can increase the historic interest of a site
as seen in terms of the Register. Conversely,where the original buildings and other
structures have been lost, a site might still be of registerable quality if its landscaping is of
sufficient merit or if it is of sufficient historic interest as judged by any of the other criteria
outlined above. The existence of impressive groupings of monuments can add to the case
for registration as these were important elements in the overall conception of the design,
even though the original designers could not determine the forms these would
take.Monuments of note will increase the overall importance. Clearance of tombs can
sometimes lessen the overall interest of a cemetery, but, as with the loss of buildings,
need not be an absolute reason for non-registration.
墓地建筑一般被设计成整体规划的一个组成部分，事实上墓地的地面平面图往往与建筑物是同一
个手段。如果全部建筑物和构筑物都幸存下来，特别是这些建筑物和构筑物的质量很高，这可以
增加一个地点的历史价值，从登记册的角度来看。相反，如果原有的建筑物和其他结构已经丢失，
如果景观美化具有足够的价值，或者如果根据上述任何其他标准来判断具有足够的历史价值，一
个地点可能仍然具有可注册的质量。令人印象深刻的纪念碑群的存在增加了登记的理由，因为这
些是设计总体概念中的重要因素，尽管最初的设计者无法确定这些纪念碑将采取何种形式。名胜
古迹将增加整体的重要性。坟墓的清理有时会降低墓地的整体利益，但是，正如建筑物的损失一
样，不一定是不登记的绝对理由。
3.8 Planting
3.8 种植
Planting was given close attention in many cemeteries to help lend appropriate
character.Older and more ephemeral plantings and horticultural displays will inevitably
have been lost, but the main structural plantings of trees and longer-lived shrubs may
survive. Where planting schemes survive, these will probably add interest to the site; a
particularly fine scheme might contribute towards a high grade.
许多墓地都十分重视种植，以便增添适当的特色。更古老、更短命的植物和园艺展示将不可避免
地消失，但是树木和长寿灌木的主要结构性植物可能会存活下来。如果种植方案存活下来，这些
可能会增加该网站的兴趣; 一个特别好的方案可能有助于一个高等级。
3.9 Grading
3.9 等级
While all registered sites are considered to be of a sufficiently high level of interest to
merit a national designation, the sites included on the Register of Parks and Gardens are
divided into three grade bands to give added guidance on their significance. The three
grades are Grade I(of exceptional interest), Grade II*(of more than special interest) and
Grade II(of special interest, warranting every effort to preserve them). Having begun by
assessing the best-known designed landscapes, we accordingly have a high percentage
registered in the higher grades, and over 37 per cent of all such sites are graded in a
Grade I or Grade II* ranking; by way of comparison, only 8 per cent of listed buildings are
designated at these levels.
虽然所有登记的地点都被认为具有足够高的利益水平，值得国家指定，但列入公园和园林登记册
的地点分为三个等级，以便就其重要性提供更多的指导。这三个级别分别为一级(具特殊意义)、
二级 * (具特殊意义以上)及二级(具特殊意义，有必要尽力保存)。我们首先评估了最著名的景观设
计，因此，登记在较高级别的建筑物所占的百分比很高，其中超过 37% 的用地被评定为一级或二
级 * ; 相比之下，只有 8% 的列入名单的建筑物被评定为这些级别。
3.10 Other designations
3.10 其他指定
The Register of Parks and Gardens is primarily intended to flag up landscapes of particular
design interest. Individual buildings and monuments are listed for their architectural and
historic interest(including their artistic value): for more information on this, see our
Commemorative Structures selection guide. Few cemeteries have been comprehensively
assessed for listing, as well as for registration: many memorials await individual
designation, and the presence of important groups of monuments can strengthen the
case for landscape designation too.
「公园及园林名册」的主要目的，是标示具特别设计趣味的景观。个别建筑物及古迹因其建筑和
历史价值(包括其艺术价值)而被列出: 有关详情，请参阅我们的纪念建筑选择指南。很少有墓地被
全面评估列入名单和注册: 许多纪念碑等待个人指定，重要的纪念碑群的存在也可以加强景观指
定的理由。
A small number of post-medieval cemeteries (such as the Jewish burial ground in
Penzance)have been designated as scheduled monuments:this is not a designation
outcome we will be advocating in the future. Nor is wholesale listing an appropriate
outcome, as this will tend not to signify the special interest of a cemetery’s component
parts. That said, with very small burial grounds alongside places of worship, a single
listing can sometimes be the most sensible approach; an example is the Friends Meeting
House, Clare Road, Halifax, which is listed Grade II along with its small, walled, burial
ground and nineteenth-century headstones. Some cemeteries have been designated as
conservation areas by local planning authorities, which affords them extra protection in
the planning system and is often a very appropriate way of signalling local significance.
Natural designations include tree preservation orders. For more detailed guidance on the
management of cemeteries, see Paradise Preserved: An Introduction to the
Assessment,Evaluation, Conservation and Management of Historic Cemeteries(English
Heritage, 2007)
一小部分后中世纪墓地(如彭赞斯的犹太人墓地)已被指定为定期纪念碑: 这不是我们今后倡导的指
定结果。批发名单也不是一个合适的结果，因为这往往不会意味着公墓的组成部分的特殊利益。
尽管如此，由于墓地很小，旁边还有礼拜场所，有时候一个单一的清单可能是最明智的做法; 例
如，哈利法克斯克莱尔路的朋友会议室，它被列为二级，连同它的小型有围墙的墓地和 19 世纪
的墓碑。一些墓地已被地方规划当局指定为保护区，这在规划系统中为它们提供了额外的保护，
而且往往是表明地方重要性的一种非常适当的方式。自然指定包括树木保护令。有关墓地管理的
详细指引，请参阅「保存天堂: 历史墓地的评估、评估、保护和管理简介」(英国文化遗产，2007)

Rural Landscapes
乡村景观
Register of Parks and Gardens Selection Guide
公园及花园登记册选择指南
Summary
摘要
Historic England’s selection guides help to define which historic buildings
and sites are likely to meet the relevant tests for national designation. Four
guides, of which this is one, deal with the types of site included on Historic
England’s Register of Parks and Gardens of Special Historic Interest in
England which is a constituent part of the National Heritage List for England.
英格兰历史建筑的选择指南有助于确定哪些历史建筑和遗址可能符合国家指定
的相关测试。四个指南，其中之一，处理的遗址类型包括在历史英格兰的公园
和花园特别历史兴趣的英格兰登记册，这是一个组成部分的国家遗产清单的英
格兰。
Each guide falls into two halves. The first defines the types of site included in it,
before going on to give a brisk overview of how these developed through time,
with notice of the main designers and some of the key sites. The second half of
the guide sets out the particular tests a site has to meet if it is to be included on
the Register. A select bibliography gives suggestions for further reading.
每个向导分成两部分。首先定义了包含在其中的网站类型，然后在主要设计者和一
些关键网站的注意下，对这些网站是如何随着时间的推移发展起来的给出一个简要
的概述。指南的后半部分列出了一个网站如果要被列入注册表，必须要满足的特殊
测试。一个精选的参考书目提供了进一步阅读的建议。
This guide covers rural designed landscapes, including gardens and parks around
country houses. The other three guides treat Urban, and Institutional, landscapes,
and Landscapes of Remembrance, that is cemeteries and burial grounds.
这本指南涵盖了乡村设计的景观，包括花园和公园周围的乡村住宅。另外三本指南介
绍了城市、机构、景观和纪念景观，也就是墓地和墓地。
First published by English Heritage March 2013.
2013 年 3 月由英国文化遗产出版社首次出版。

2017 年 12 月由英格兰历史出版社出版。

Introduction
引言
The Register of Historic Parks and Gardens of Special Historic Interest in England (now a component
of the National Heritage List for England) was set up in 1983. It includes designed landscapes of many
types, private and public, which are identified using explicit criteria to possess special interest. To date
over 1650 sites have been included on the Register. Thereby Historic England seeks to increase
awareness of their significance, and to encourage appropriate long-term management. Although
registration is a statutory designation, there are no specific controls for registered parks and gardens
unlike listed buildings or scheduled monuments. However, the National Planning Policy Framework,
gives registered parks and gardens an equal policy status with listed buildings and scheduled
monuments.
英格兰特别历史名胜公园名录(现在是英格兰国家遗产名录的一个组成部分)于 1983 年建立。它包括设计
的许多类型的景观，私人和公共，这是确定使用明确的标准，以拥有特殊的利益。到目前为止，已有超
过 1650 个地点被列入登记册。因此，历史悠久的英格兰寻求提高对其重要性的认识，并鼓励适当的长期
管理。虽然注册是一个法定的指定，有没有具体的控制已注册的公园和花园不像列出的建筑物或规定的
纪念碑。然而，国家规划政策框架给予注册公园和花园与列入名录的建筑物和纪念碑同等的政策地位。
This is one of four complementary selection guides which briefly describe the types of designed
landscape included on the Register, and set out selection criteria for designation. This guide covers
rural landscapes, mainly around private houses, including parks around country houses. The other
three guides treat Urban
这是四个补充选择指南之一，简要说明登记册所载的设计景观类型，并列出指定的选择标准。这个指南
涵盖了乡村景观，主要是围绕着私人住宅，包括围绕着乡村住宅的公园。另外三本指南介绍了城市
and Institutional landscapes, and Landscapes of Remembrance. Inevitably there are some overlaps;
allotments and nurseries, for instance, are treated in the Urban guide. The listing of buildings in designed
landscapes is considered in the Garden and Park Structures selection guide, and the scheduling of
archaeological garden remains, principally but not exclusively medieval and early modern earthwork
remains, is discussed briefly below in section 4 but treated more fully in the Gardens scheduling selection
guide.
和机构景观，以及纪念景观。不可避免地会有一些重叠; 例如，拨款和托儿所，都在城市指南中处理。在《园
林和公园结构选择指南》中考虑了在设计景观中列出建筑物的问题，下文第 4 节简要讨论了考古园林遗址的安
排，主要但不仅限于中世纪和早期现代土方工程遗址，但在《园林安排选择指南》中得到了更充分的论述。
1 Historical Summary
1 历史概要
1.1 Before the Romans
1.1 在罗马人之前
In recent years the landscapes of prehistoric
England have continued to be explored and
revealed, with existing monuments and ancient
patterns of land use being interpreted through
ever-changing theoretical perspectives. The use
and meaning of space, whether in the house or in
great ritual complexes, was clearly highly
significant, and was constructed and adapted
over millennia. These are landscapes of immense
importance (as discussed in the scheduling
selection guide treating Ritual and Religious Sites
pre-410), but as yet there is no suggestion that
significant places had landscapes designed
purely for aesthetic effect and pleasure.
近年来，人们继续探索和揭示史前英格兰的景观，
通过不断变化的理论视角来解释现存的纪念碑和古
老的土地使用模式。空间的使用和意义，无论是在
房子里还是在伟大的仪式综合体里，显然是非常重
要的，并被建造和改造了几千年。这些景观具有极
其重要的意义(正如在公元前 410 年的宗教仪式场
所的时间表选择指南中所讨论的那样) ，但是迄今
为止，还没有迹象表明重要场所的景观设计纯粹是
为了美学效果和娱乐。
1.2 Roman gardens
1.2 罗马花园
Elaborate formal gardens associated with villas,
with topiary, pools and statuary are known from
classical sources. In England archaeological
evidence for such has occasionally been
recovered, most notably at Fishbourne (West
Sussex; a scheduled monument) where bedding
trenches for formal box hedges were found
精心设计的正式花园与别墅，灌木，池塘和雕像是
知道从古典的来源。在英格兰，有关这方面的考古
证据偶尔也会被发现，最引人注目的是在
Fishbourne (西苏塞克斯; 在册古迹) ，人们在那里
发现了用于正式的盒式篱笆的垫沟
in excavations in the 1970s, these later being used
as the basis for its reconstructed garden. At
Bancroft Villa (Buckinghamshire) a formal pool was
excavated in its courtyard and there have been
hints of other features elsewhere. At Gorhambury
(Hertfordshire) and Rivenhall (Essex; a scheduled
monument) villas have been argued to stand within
deliberately designed landscapes with vistas,
landmarks and avenues of trees. Both in rural and
urban contexts the recovery of plant remains
demonstrates the potential of developing a better
understanding of this aspect of Roman horticulture.
As later, a garden landscape around a villa could
flow into the productive estate beyond.
在 1970 年代的挖掘中，这些后来被用作其重建花园
的基础。在班克罗夫特别墅(白金汉郡)的院子里挖出
了一个正式的游泳池，其他地方也有其他特征的迹象。
在赫特福德郡(hertford shire)的 Gorhambury 和埃塞
克斯郡(Essex; 在册古迹)的瑞文霍尔(Rivenhall) ，人
们一直认为别墅位于经过精心设计的风景区内，有着
远景、地标和林荫大道。无论是在农村还是在城市，
植物残骸的恢复展示了更好地理解罗马园艺这一方面
的潜力。后来，别墅周围的花园景观可以流入更远的
生产区。
One notable discovery at Wollaston
(Northamptonshire) was an extensive area of
vineyards, evidenced by bedding trenches.
在伍拉斯顿(北安普敦郡)有一个值得注意的发
现，那是一片广阔的葡萄园区域，床上的沟渠
就是证据。
Hunting was popular in the Roman period (it
was depicted, for instance, on mosaics), but
where and how it was carried on in England,
and whether in defined hunting grounds, is
unknown. At Fishbourne it has been argued that
south of the palace there was an animal park or
vivarium (apparently similar to the later medieval
‘little parks’: see below) where in the first century
狩猎在罗马时期非常流行(例如，在马赛克上就有
描述) ，但是在英格兰的什么地方以及如何进行
狩猎，以及是否在确定的狩猎地点，都是未知的。
在 Fishbourne，有人认为宫殿的南面有一个动物
公园或者说是动物园(显然类似于中世纪后期的
“小公园”: 见下文) ，这是公元一世纪的地方
AD fallow deer were kept; for the moment
this remains unique.
公元休耕鹿被饲养; 目前这仍然是独特的。
1.3 Post-Roman
1.3 后罗马时代
In what is conventionally termed the Anglo-Saxon
period in England, neither archaeological nor
historical evidence suggests the presence of
designed landscapes around high status houses,
although that is not to deny the possibility that the
organisation of space in such complexes could be
very deliberate. Hunting was popular and is
mentioned in various historical sources, and the 71
‘hays’ (mostly in Worcestershire, Herefordshire,
Shropshire and Cheshire) – the meaning of the
word is uncertain but relates in some way to the
containment and management of deer – and 31
deer parks mentioned in Domesday Book
在传统上被称为英格兰盎格鲁-撒克逊时期的地方，
无论是考古学还是历史学的证据都没有表明高级住宅
周围存在设计好的景观，尽管这并不是否认这些建筑
群的空间组织可能是经过深思熟虑的。狩猎很受欢迎，
在各种历史资料中都有提到。71 个“干草”(主要分
布在伍斯特郡、赫里福德郡、希罗普郡和柴郡)——
这个词的含义不确定，但在某种程度上与遏制和管理
鹿有关——以及《末日之书》中提到的 31 个鹿园
(1086) show that, by the time of the Norman
Conquest, special enclosures for deer were
being constructed, as well as lodges for those
charged with their management.
(1086)表明，在诺曼征服时期，专门为鹿建造的
围栏，以及为那些负责管理它们的人建造的旅馆。
1.4 The Middle Ages
1.4 中世纪
It has long been known from literary sources like
the Romance of the Rose and from manuscript
从文学资料如《玫瑰罗曼史》和手稿中我们早就知
道了这一点
< < Contents 2
< < 目录 2

illuminations that castles and great houses could
have small but elaborate pleasure gardens:
照明城堡和大房子可以有小而精致的游乐园:
the hortus conclusus, or herber. Such sources –
admittedly mainly continental – indicate that in the
thirteenth and fourteenth centuries their features
could include turf benches, trellis work screens,
tunnels and arbours, fountains, pools and rills,
specimen trees and a wide range of sweet-smelling
flowers and herbs in beds. Later, in the fifteenth
and early sixteenth centuries, when more evidence
is forthcoming from England itself, we see the
appearance of knot gardens, where compartments
overlooked from the house were divided by paths,
typically into quarters, with curvilinear patterns
picked out using plants like thyme and rosemary
and coloured earth and sand. By this time great
gardens incorporated carved and painted
woodwork such as railings and heraldic beasts, all
of which is a reminder that we should not think of
‘the medieval garden’ as something fixed and
unchanging.
Hortus conclusus，或 herber。这些资料来源——无
可否认主要来自欧洲大陆——表明，在十三和十四世
纪，它们的特征可能包括草坪长凳、棚架工作屏风、
隧道和树荫、喷泉、池塘和小溪、标本树和各种芳香
的花和草本植物。后来，在 15 世纪和 16 世纪早期，
当更多的证据来自英格兰本身，我们看到了结花园的
出现，在那里，从房子里俯瞰的隔间被路径分割，通
常是分成四个区域，用百里香、迷迭香、彩色土壤和
沙子等植物挑选出曲线图案。到了这个时候，伟大的
花园融合了雕刻和绘画的木制品，例如栏杆和纹章兽，
所有这些都提醒我们，我们不应该把“中世纪花园”
看作是某种固定和不变的东西。
Sometimes the location of such gardens is known
(like the admittedly exceptional Rosamund’s
Bower, in Woodstock Park, Oxfordshire, part
有时候，这样的花园的位置是众所周知的(例如，在
牛津郡伍德斯托克公园的罗莎蒙德的凉亭，部分地
区)
of the Grade-I registered Blenheim Park) or can
be deduced. So far there have been no targeted
excavations, but the potential for investigating
their character and development is very
considerable. Surviving garden-related structures
are rare: the stone loggia or ambulatory at Horton
Court (Gloucestershire; listed Grade
一级注册的布莱恩海姆公园)或者可以推断。到目
前为止还没有有针对性的挖掘，但是研究它们的
性质和发展的潜力是非常可观的。幸存下来的与
花园相关的建筑是罕见的: 霍顿庭院(格洛斯特郡;
列出等级)的石头凉廊或走廊
I) of about 1530 is exceptional, although there are
a few early banqueting houses elsewhere.
Productive gardens, for vegetables and herbs,
were presumably commonplace, and monks are
thought to have had an expertise in the growing
and use of medicinal plants. Evidence for these
activities has sometimes been forthcoming in the
form of plant remains in waterlogged deposits.
Orchards for different types of fruit are frequently
documented; these too may have had an
ornamental dimension.
尽管其他地方也有一些早期的宴会厅，但 1530 年
左右的宴会厅是个例外。种植蔬菜和草药的高产
菜园大概是司空见惯的，僧侣们被认为具有种植
和使用药用植物的专业知识。这些活动的证据有
时会以植物残骸的形式出现在被水淹没的沉积物
中。不同种类水果的果园经常被记录在案; 这些果
园也可能有一个装饰性的维度。
< < Contents 3

High-status houses, whether lay or religious,
frequently stood within extensive designed
landscapes. There are two sites which embody this.
At Kenilworth Castle (Warwickshire; registered
Grade II*) a great artificial mere was created around
the royal castle in the thirteenth century, at the end
of which a large moated ‘pleasance’ or artificial
island garden was created in 1417 with a timber
banquetting house and corner towers. The use of
views, water, and carefully considered approaches
(where visitors were taken on a proscribed,
cirtuitous, route to show off the building) can also be
seen at the second type-site, the landscape around
Bodiam Castle (East Sussex; listed Grade I), built
by Sir Edward Dalingridge in the 1380s. Many more
examples are now known, and the setting of even
quite modest manorial complexes may have had an
aesthetic dimension. The most recurrent element in
these schemes is water: meres, moats, fishponds
and millpools, and it may be that the combination of
economically productive estate components within
the setting of a house was deliberate to emphasise
prosperity and hospitality.
高地位的房子，无论是世俗的还是宗教的，经常矗立
在广泛设计的景观。有两处遗址体现了这一点。13
世纪，在凯尼尔沃思城堡(沃里克郡，登记为二级 *) ，
围绕着皇家城堡创造了一个巨大的人造物，在城堡的
尽头，1417 年建造了一个巨大的有护城河的“愉
悦”或人造岛屿花园，其中有一个木制宴会厅和一些
角楼。在第二个类型的地点，也可以看到景观、水和
经过仔细考虑的方法(参观者被带到一条被禁止的迂
回路线来炫耀建筑) ，博迪亚姆城堡(东苏塞克斯; 列
为一级)周围的景观，由爱德华 · 达林里奇爵士在
1380 年代建造。更多的例子现在已经为人所知，甚
至相当普通的庄园综合体的设置可能有一个审美的维
度。这些方案中最经常出现的元素是水: 淡水、护城
河、鱼塘和水池，而且可能是将经济上具有生产力的
房地产组成部分组合在一个住宅中是为了强调繁荣和
好客。
A particular variation of medieval designed
landscape was the ‘little park’, noted especially in
the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries but also later.
These were clearly something different from the
usual deer park (treated below). Most stood close to
the house or overlooked by it, and appear to have
been semi-natural pleasure grounds which provided
a pleasing setting with animals and birds to watch
and hear, and probably somewhere to walk; they
were perhaps akin to the idealised parklands seen
in some manuscript illuminations. Two dozen or
more have been identified, most associated with
grander castles and houses; many more are
suspected.
中世纪设计的景观的一个特殊变体是“小公园”，尤
其是在十四和十五世纪，但也是后来。这些明显不同
于通常的鹿园(见下文)。它们大多数都站在房子附近，
或者被房子俯瞰着，似乎是半自然的游乐场所，提供
了一个愉快的环境，有动物和鸟类可以观看和听到，
也许还有地方可以散步; 它们也许类似于某些手稿照
明中看到的理想化的公园。至少有 24 座已经被确认，
大多数都与更宏伟的城堡和房屋有关，更多的被怀疑。
Hunting remained popular in the Middle Ages and
beyond. The English medieval kings had access to
vast hunting grounds, some wooded, where Forest
Law gave protection both to the deer and to the
trees. The administrative framework was
accompanied by structures such as lodges and
boundary banks. Deer hunting was also facilitated
by parks (Fig 1), where deer were confined and
managed within areas of wood and grassland
狩猎在中世纪及以后仍然很流行。中世纪的英国国王
可以进入广阔的狩猎场，有些是森林，森林法律保护
了鹿和树木。行政框架伴随着诸如旅馆和边界银行之
类的建筑。公园也为猎鹿提供了便利(图 1) ，在公园
里，鹿被限制在森林和草地的范围内并得到管理
circumscribed by a ‘pale’, that is a ditch with an
outer bank surmounted by a tall oak fence.
Typically parks lay away from settlements on
economically marginal land, and most were of 30-
80 ha. Many contained a lodge (often surrounded
by a moat) for the parker (responsible for the parks
management and security), and sometimes
fishponds and rabbit warrens too. Physical
evidence of medieval deer parks takes the form of
field boundaries which fossilize the line of the pale;
sometimes its surviving bank and ditch;
exceptionally a park wall; and the site of the lodge.
Some lodges survive as standing buildings, having
become farmhouses (the name lodge can be

the parker, lodges were where the huntsmen and
women took refreshment and planned the hunt; a
single upper entertainment room and sometimes
a viewing tower can give them a special plan form
and interest. The number of parks grew steadily
in the two centuries after the Norman Conquest,
park ownership spreading from the ranks of the
aristocracy to wealthier manorial lords. Estimates
about how many parks were in existence by the
earlier fourteenth century – largely based on the
sale of royal licences – vary widely; Oliver
Rackham thought about 3,200, although others
feel this is too high an estimate. But whatever the
total, they were commonplace. After the Black
Death (1348-9) their number declined, by perhaps
30 per cent over 150 years.

1.5 Country house gardens 1550-1660
1.5 乡村别墅花园 1550-1660
From the mid sixteenth century our knowledge of
gardens increases with the proliferation of
gardening texts and descriptions, estate mapping,
and documentation in general. There is also
much more that survives above ground, as the
gardens of the upper classes became larger,
more elaborately constructed with terraces,
mounts and water gardens, and studded with
garden buildings of various types.
从十六世纪中叶开始，我们对园艺的了解随着园艺
文本和描述、产业地图以及一般文献的增加而增加。
随着上层社会的花园越来越大，越来越精心建造的
露台、山峰和水上花园，以及各种类型的花园建筑，
地上还有更多的生存空间。

A very different style of garden was created at
Wilton House (Wiltshire; registered Grade I) in the
early 1630s by Isaac de Caus: three great flat
compartments with a broad central axis leading
from the house to an arcaded grotto. The first
comprised four ‘platts’ (formal lawns) with flowers
and statues; the second a grove, densely planted
with trees and containing fountains and statues; the
third was laid out with formal walks and ended with
an imposing transverse terrace beneath which was
the grotto. The central walk continued beyond this
into an area of less regular groves and
‘wildernesses’ with an amphitheatre, triumphal
arch, and statue of Marcus Aurelius.
17 世纪 30 年代早期，Isaac de Caus 在 Wilton
House (Wiltshire; 注册一级)创造了一个非常不同的
花园风格: 三个巨大的平面隔间，中轴线很宽，从房
子一直延伸到拱形的洞穴。第一个包括四个带有花
朵和雕像的“普拉特”(正式的草坪) ; 第二个包括一
个小树林，种满了树木，里面有喷泉和雕像; 第三个
包括正式的步行道，最后是一个壮观的横向平台，
下面是洞穴。中间的步道继续向前延伸，进入一个
不那么规则的小树林和“荒野”的区域，有一个圆
形剧场，凯旋门和马库斯 · 奥勒留的雕像。
1.6 Deer parks
1.6 鹿公园
The overall number of deer parks in the sixteenth
and seventeenth centuries is hard to estimate, in
part because while many were enclosed – that is
divided into fields and turned over to more
profitable mainstream agriculture – elsewhere,
new ones were being created to cater for the
16 世纪和 17 世纪的鹿园总数难以估计，部分原因

1.10 Victorian formality
1.10 维多利亚时代的礼节
Mid and later nineteenth-century garden styles
remained highly varied, although some common
trends can be picked out. Plant availability
increased markedly, both through introductions

的可用性显着增加

Technology also came more to the fore, with
cheap and relatively efficient lawnmowers.

的园艺出版社的鼓励(图 9)。技术也越来越突出，
廉价和相对有效的割草机。

1.11 The twentieth century and
Revivalism
1.11 二十世纪与复兴主义
That taste for Revivalism in garden design persisted
after the First World War. Many garden designers
travelled to Italy and elsewhere to study historic
gardens, which inspired their designs. At Cliveden
(Buckinghamshire; registered Grade I) and later at
Hever Castle (Kent; registered Grade I),
第一次世界大战之后，园林设计中对复兴主义的追求
依然存在。许多园林设计师前往意大利和其他地方研
究历史上的园林，这启发了他们的设计。在克莱夫登
(白金汉郡，注册一级) ，后来在赫弗城堡(肯特郡，
注册一级),
the former American Ambassador in Rome, William
Waldorf Astor, laid out extensive formal and
ornamental gardens in the Italian style. However,
the true spirit of Italian Revival gardens was
probably best expressed by Harold Ainsworth Peto.
At Iford Manor, Freshford (Bath and North East
Somerset / Wiltshire; registered Grade I), his own
home, he laid out an Italian formal garden on a
steep hillside, adorned with sculptures and artefacts
brought back from his travels in Italy. Garden
reconstruction and recreation became popular too.
At Hazelbury Manor, Box (Wiltshire; registered
Grade II) the architect Harold Brakspear laid out a
formal garden inspired by the early seventeenth-
century garden that once surrounded the house.
Other styles, including Moorish, Dutch, and Oriental
were also explored, as at Bitchet Wood, Seal (Kent;
registered Grade II*), where in 1919-21 the architect
Raymond Berrow laid out

1.12 Arts and Crafts gardens
1.12 工艺美术花园
From about 1900, influenced by the Arts and Crafts
Movement and inspired by William Morris’s garden
at Kelmscott Manor (Oxfordshire; registered Grade
II), many garden designers became interested in
English vernacular gardens using local materials
and native plants and flowers. Gertrude Jekyll and
Edwin Lutyens who collaborated on more than a
hundred commissions between 1890 and 1914,
were especially influential. One of the best
大约从 1900 年开始，受到艺术与工艺美术运动的影
响，并受到威廉•莫里斯(William Morris)设计的位于
凯尔姆斯科特庄园(Kelmscott Manor，牛津郡，注册
二级)的花园的启发，许多园林设计师开始对使用当
地材料和本土植物和花卉的英国本土花园产生兴趣。
Gertrude Jekyll 和 Edwin Lutyens 在 1890 年到 1914
年间合作完成了超过 100 个项目，他们的影响尤其深
远。其中最优秀的一位
examples of their collaboration is Hestercombe
(Somerset; registered Grade I; Fig 10). Here,
typically, Lutyens’ formal architectural features
were successfully combined with Jekyll’s informal
planting schemes characterised by drift planting
with colour sequences to create what Alexanda
Harris called ‘carefully planned spontaneity’.
他们合作的例子是 Hestercombe (Somerset; 注册一
级; 图 10)。典型的是，鲁琴斯的正式建筑特色与杰
基尔的非正式种植方案成功结合，其特点是漂移种
植与色彩序列，创造了亚历山大•哈里斯所谓的
“精心规划的自发性”。
In 1900 the landscape architect Thomas Mawson
published his book The Art and Craft of Garden
Making, which greatly influenced early twentieth-
century garden design. Although Mawson drew on
both revivalism and the Arts and Crafts movement,
he also embraced the use of modern materials
including concrete and asphalt for his hard
landscaping, thus paving the way to modern design.
1900 年，景观设计师托马斯 · 莫森出版了他的著作
《造园的艺术与工艺》 ，这本书极大地影响了 20 世
纪早期的园林设计。虽然 Mawson 同时借鉴了复兴主
义和艺术与工艺美术运动，但他也接受了现代材料的
使用，包括混凝土和沥青的硬景观，从而为现代设计
铺平了道路。

At this time, sports facilities such as tennis courts

1.13 Plant-centred gardens
1.13 以植物为中心的花园
Plant-centred gardening remained popular
throughout the twentieth century (Fig 11). Harold
Nicolson and Vita Sackville-West’s garden at
Sissinghurst Castle (Kent; registered Grade I),
以植物为中心的园艺在整个二十世纪仍然很流行
(图 11)。哈罗德 · 尼科尔森和维塔 · 萨克维尔 · 韦
斯特在锡辛赫斯特城堡的花园,
developed from 1930, and Rosemary Verey’s
garden at Barnsley House (Gloucestershire;
registered Grade II), to which she moved in 1951,
are often seen as the embodiment of this particular
gardening tradition. Sackville-West defined her
approach as ‘profusion, even extravagance and
exuberance, within confines of the utmost linear
severity.’ Also influential was the garden and
arboretum created between the 1950s and 1970s
by Sir Harold Hillier, a plantsman of world reknown,
at Jermyns House, near Romsey (Hampshire;
registered Grade II). During the twentieth century
gardening became a leading pastime for a growing
number of people as urbanisation and home-
ownership became increasingly widespread. From

1.14 Modernism and beyond
1.14 现代主义及其他
The 1930s saw strong Modernist themes emerge in
domestic architecture, but this rarely extended to
include garden design: The Homewood in Esher,
Surrey (1938; Listed Grade II), where the architect
Patrick Gwynne consciously planned a woodland
garden, is an early and rare example. What did
prove inspirational were the ideas of Le Corbusier
and Frank Lloyd Wright who revisited ideas on how
their houses should relate to the surrounding
landscape. Here the location of the house was
carefully chosen, making full use of the existing
geography and contours. In some cases existing
parkland with mature trees, or a former walled
garden, was seen as the ideal location. A
20 世纪 30 年代，强烈的现代主义主题出现在家庭建
筑中，但这种主题很少扩展到包括花园设计: 萨里郡
伊舍的 Homewood (1938 年; 列为二级) ，建筑师帕
特里克 · 格温(Patrick Gwynne)有意识地规划了一个
林地花园，是一个早期而罕见的例子。确实鼓舞人心
的是勒 · 柯布西耶和弗兰克 · 劳埃德 · 赖特的想法，
他们重新审视了他们的房子如何与周围的景观相联系
的想法。在这里，房子的位置是精心选择的，充分利
用了现有的地理位置和轮廓。在某些情况下，现有的
带有成熟树木的公园，或者以前有围墙的花园，被认
为是理想的位置。答:

During that post-war period English garden
designers found inspiration in the work of Dan Kiley
and Roberto Burle Marx in America and Brazil, and
were influenced by contemporary abstract painting
and sculpture. Use of abstract shapes, consisting of
strong lines or soft curves, and their symbolism and
spiritualism, had a profound impact on garden and
landscape design. Japanese gardens, having a long
tradition of successfully integrating in- and out-door
spaces, also became an important source of
inspiration, as did contemporary Scandinavian
landscape design. The Japanese Garden created in
1964
在战后时期，英国园林设计师从美国和巴西的丹 · 凯
利和罗伯特 · 伯勒 · 马克思的作品中获得灵感，并受
到当代抽象绘画和雕塑的影响。抽象形状的使用，包
括强有力的线条或柔和的曲线，他们的象征意义和唯
心主义，对园林和景观设计产生了深远的影响。日本
园林，有着成功整合室内和室外空间的悠久传统，也
成为一个重要的灵感来源，当代斯堪的纳维亚风景设
计。日本花园创建于 1964 年
at the New House, Shipton-under-Wychwood,
Oxfordshire (house listed Grade II*; garden registered
Grade II*) is a good example. Materials such as brick
and concrete were popular in hard landscaping, and
planting was mainly used architecturally, with
specimens selected for their strong shapes and
foliage patterns. Ideas were spread by publications
such as Sylvia Crowe’s Garden Design (1958) and
John Brookes’s Room Outside: A New Approach to
Garden Design (1969).
在牛津郡希普顿安德威奇伍德下面的新房子(房子列为
二级 * ; 花园列为二级 *)就是一个很好的例子。像砖和

于建筑，选择样本是因为它们强壮的形状和树叶的模
式。思想通过西尔维娅 · 克罗(Sylvia Crowe)的《花园
设计》(Garden Design，1958)和约翰 · 布鲁克斯
(John Brookes)的《室外: 花园设计的新方法》(Room
Outside: a New Approach to Garden Design，1969)
等出版物传播。

landscape architect, town planner and architect
Sir Geoffrey Jellicoe. Since the 1980s, garden
and landscape design has been influenced by
post-modernist theories, as explored (often on a

In the early twenty-first century interest in historic
gardens has seldom been greater; landscapes
are restored and added to, while ever more
publications explore the stories of particular
places and designers. England’s place in garden-
making has few challengers.
在二十一世纪早期，人们对历史性园林的兴趣从未
像现在这样浓厚; 园林景观得到修复和增加，同时
越来越多的出版物探索特定地点和设计师的故事。
英格兰在造园方面的地位几乎没有挑战者。
