2 Criteria for
Registration
注册准则
All sites included on the Register of Parks and Gardens must hold a level of significance
defined as ‘special historic’ interest in a national context. Nine general criteria have been
defined, five relating to date and rarity, and four to other considerations, which have been
used in assessing candidates for inclusion since the start of the Register in the 1980s.
公园和花园登记册上的所有地点都必须具有一定的重要性，在国家范围内被定义为”特殊
的历史”利益。自 1980 年代登记册开始以来，已经确定了九项一般标准，其中五项与日
期和稀有性有关，四项与其他考虑因素有关，用于评估候选人以便列入登记册。
2.1 Date and rarity
2.1 日期和稀有性
The older a designed landscape is, and the
fewer the surviving examples of its kind, the
more likely it is to have special interest. Likely to
be designated are:
一个被设计的景观越古老，同类现存的例子越少，
它就越有可能产生特殊的兴趣。可能被指定的有:
 Sites formed before 1750 where at
least a significant proportion of the
principal features of the original layout
is still in evidence
“1750 年以前形成的遗址，至少有相当一部分原
始布局的主要特征仍然存在
 Sites laid out between 1750 and 1840
where enough of the layout survives to
reflect the original design
”建于 1750 年至 1840 年之间的遗址有足够的布局保留
下来以反映原始设计
 Sites with a main phase of development
post-1840 which are of special interest
and relatively intact, the degree of required
special interest rising as the site becomes
closer in time
「在 1840 年以后主要发展阶段的土地具有特别意义，
而且相对完整，所需特别意义的程度随着土地日
益接近而上升。」
 Particularly careful selection is required for
sites from the period after 1945
“对于 1945 年以后的选址，需要特别仔细的挑选
 Sites of less than 30 years old are normally
registered only if they are of outstanding
quality and under threat.
”建成不足 30 年的土地，一般只有在质素优良和受到
威胁的情况下才会注册。
2.2 Further considerations
2.2 进一步考虑
Further considerations which may influence
selection, and may exceptionally be sufficient by
themselves to merit designation, are as follows.
In each case there is an expectation that at least
a significant proportion of the main elements of
the designed landscape layout survives:
以下是可能影响选择的其他考虑因素，这些考虑
因素本身可能在例外情况下足以被指定为候选人。
在每种情况下，设计景观布局中至少有相当一部
分的主要元素得以保留:
 Sites which were influential in the
development of taste, whether
through reputation or reference in
literature
”那些通过名声或文学作品中的参考文献，对品
味发展产生影响的地方
 Sites which are early or representative
examples of a style of layout or a type of
site, or the work of a designer (amateur
or professional) of national importance
”是一种布局风格或一种网站类型的早期或具有代表
性的例子，或是具有国家重要性的设计师(业
余或专业人士)的作品
 Sites having an association with significant persons –
the gardens of John Milton (Milton’s Cottage, Chalfont
St Giles, Buckinghamshire, registered Grade II); Jane
Austen (Chawton House, Faringdon, Hampshire,
registered Grade II); and Gilbert White (The Wakes,
Selborne, Hampshire, registered Grade II*), for
instance, are registered – or historic events
(Boscobel, Shropshire, registered Grade II, where
Charles II was concealed in the Royal Oak in 1651,
where the contemporary garden survives as well as
the successor to the Royal Oak)
“与重要人物有联系的遗址——约翰 · 弥尔顿(白金汉郡
查尔方特圣吉尔斯的米尔顿小屋，二级注册) ; 简
· 奥斯汀(汉普郡法灵顿的查顿庄园，二级注册) ;
吉尔伯特 · 怀特(汉普郡塞尔伯恩的守灵者，二级

下来，以及皇家橡树的继承者)

heritage assets
”具有强大群体价值的遗址与其他文物资产

< < 目录 20
3 Specific
具体点
Considerations
考虑事项
In this section, more specific guidance is given relating to the registration of
rural landscapes, which outlines our approach in assessing candidates for
being added to the National Heritage List for England.
在本节中，我们提供了有关农村景观登记的更为具体的指导，概述了我们评
估被列入英格兰国家遗产名录候选人的方法。
3.1 Documentation
3.1 文件
Whatever its date and type, where a
landscape’s creation or development is
particularly well documented it will
almost always add to its interest, and
can merit designation at a higher grade.
无论它的日期和类型，哪里的景观的创造
或发展是特别详细的记录，它几乎总是增
加其利益，并可以值得在更高的等级指定。
3.2 Group value and listing
3.2 集团价值及上市
The presence of a contemporary building around
which landscaping took place is not a prerequisite
for designation. However, if there is a
contemporary house, this will almost certainly
strengthen a case for designation, or possibly
designation at a higher grade. So too will the
presence of garden buildings and structures such
as walls and steps. This will especially be so where
those structures are listed (see the Garden and
Park Structures selection guide). The same
principles apply to designed landscapes at some
remove from a house like water gardens and deer
parks, where a lodge will add interest.
当代建筑的存在，其周围的景观美化发生不是一个先
决条件的指定。然而，如果有一个当代的房子，这几
乎肯定会加强的情况下指定，或可能指定更高的等级。
花园建筑和结构如墙壁和台阶的存在也会起到同样的
作用。特别是在这些结构被列出的地方(参见花园和
公园结构选择指南)。同样的原则也适用于设计景观
的一些远离房子的地方，如水上花园和鹿园，在那里
一个小屋将增加兴趣。
3.3 The natural landscape
3.3 自然景观
All designed landscapes, and not the least
landscape parks, will be influenced by, or draw
on the natural topography within their bounds,
and in the surrounding countryside (what is often
termed setting). In terms of assessment for
inclusion on the Register, and grading, as much
as possible natural advantage and beauty (or
lack of) will be set aside, and it will be the design
concept and its implementation and survival
which will be appraised. That said, there are
cases where the natural landscape has been
deliberately appropriated as a principal feature of
the design, and here this will be a factor –
sometimes an important one – in assessment.
This would apply, for instance for the
picturesque cleft forming Downton Gorge
(Shropshire and Herefordshire; registered Grade
II*), and with Thomas Mawson’s formal gardens
at Rydal (Cumbria; registered Grade II*) which
contrast deliberately and spectacularly with a
backdrop provided by the jagged peaks of the
Lake District.
所有设计的景观，尤其是景观公园，都会受到或利
用其范围内的自然地形，以及周边乡村(通常称为
环境)的影响。在评估是否被列入登记册和评级方
面，尽可能多的自然优势和美丽(或缺乏)将被搁置
一边，评估的将是设计概念及其实施和生存。也就
是说，在某些情况下，自然景观被故意作为设计的
一个主要特征，这将是一个因素-有时是一个重要
的-在评估。这也适用于唐顿峡谷(什罗普郡和赫里
福德郡; 登记为二级 *)的风景如画的裂缝，以及托
马斯 · 莫森在莱德尔(坎布里亚郡; 登记为二级 *)的
正式花园，这些花园与湖区参差不齐的山峰形成了
刻意而壮观的对比。
< < Contents 21
< < 目录 21
3.4 Authenticity
3.4 真实性
Especially where a house has remained as the
focal point of a designed landscape, its gardens,
pleasure grounds and parkland will have seen
change. This may at one end of the scale be the
result of ongoing routine management,
replacement and repair, and on the other the
product of more vigorous campaigns of alteration,
restoration or even recreation (Fig 12). Change
through routine works is unlikely to have had a
seriously detrimental effect on the character of
the landscape, whereas unsympathetic
restoration may have; each case will have to be
judged on its merits. A recreated landscape is
unlikely to merit designation, unless through time
(and almost certainly upwards of 30 years) it
becomes of historiographical interest. An example
of this is the Grade-II registered garden at Ann
Hathaway’s Cottage, Starford-on-Avon
(Warwickshire).
特别是在房子仍然是设计风景的焦点的地方，它的
花园、游乐场和公园将会发生变化。这可能一方面
是正在进行的日常管理、更换和修理的结果，另一
方面是更有力的改造、修复甚至娱乐活动的产物
(图 12)。通过日常工程进行的改变不太可能对景观
的特性产生严重的不利影响，而冷漠的修复可能会
产生这种影响; 每个案例都必须根据其是非曲直来
判断。一个重建的景观不太可能被指定，除非随着
时间的推移(几乎可以肯定超过 30 年)它成为历史的
兴趣。这方面的一个例子是安 · 海瑟薇(Ann
Hathaway)位于埃文河畔斯塔福德(Warwickshire)
的别墅的二级注册花园。
3.5 Condition
3.5 条件
If a site is in poor condition, or if a park is under
the plough (a rapidly reversible condition),
如果一个地点的条件很差，或者一个公园正在
犁地(一种快速可逆的条件) ,
it will nevertheless remain a candidate for
designation where its overall design or layout
remains sufficiently intact. However, if a site is
irrevesibly lost, for example to housing, it will
not be eligible for registration, irrespective of
any former historic importance.
然而，在其整体设计或布局保持完整的情况下，
它仍将是指定的候选人。然而，如果一个地点
不可挽回地丢失，例如房屋，它将不符合注册
资格，不管以前的任何历史重要性。
3.6 Planting and the Register
3.6 种植及登记册
For many people, the mention of the word garden
conjures up a vision of floral beauties or culinary
possibilities. However, the Register is concerned
with the more structural design elements in the
landscape such as landform, built structures, walks
and rides, water features, structural shrubberies,
arboreta, hedges and trees, and not the more
ephemeral, shorter-lived plantings of herbaceous
perennials, annuals, roses, and most shrubs.
However, where historic planting schemes or plant
collections survive, these will probably add interest
to the site; a particularly fine scheme might
contribute towards a high grade.
对于许多人来说，提到“花园”这个词会让人联想到
美丽的花朵或烹饪的可能性。然而，登记册关注的是
景观中更多的结构设计元素，如地形、建筑结构、步
行和骑乘、水景、结构性灌木、树木、树篱和树木，
而不是草本多年生植物、一年生植物、玫瑰和大多数
灌木的更短命的种植。然而，如果历史性的种植计划
或植物收藏保存下来，这些可能会增加兴趣的网站;
一个特别精细的计划可能有助于高等级。
Where a plant collection is of interest for purely
scientific or botanical reasons, it will not be
registerable. Responsibility for the national
collection of plants rests with the Royal Botanic
Garden, Kew.
如果纯粹出于科学或植物学原因而对植物收集
感兴趣，则不予注册。国家植物收藏的责任在
于皇家植物园，克佑。
3.7 Archaeological interest
3.7 考古兴趣
In terms of below-ground archaeology, it will only
exceptionally be the case that enough is known
about it for it to be included in the assessment. If,
however, whether through excavation or
geophysical survey, it is demonstrably the case
that there are high-quality, well-preserved, below-
ground remains, then this may well strengthen
the case for designation, or designation at a
higher grade. Normally, the earlier the date of any
known archaeological survivals, the greater their
potential importance.
就地下考古学而言，只有在特殊情况下，对其了解
足够，才能将其纳入评估。然而，如果无论是通过
挖掘还是勘探地球物理学调查，都能证明存在高质
量、保存完好的地下遗迹，那么这很可能加强指定
或更高级别指定的理由。通常，任何已知的考古遗
迹的日期越早，其潜在的重要性就越大。
Where an historic garden has been entirely
abandoned, scheduling rather than registration
will generally be the most appropriate designation
to consider. Scheduling can also be considered
for any substantial or significant portion of garden
earthworks or other archaeological remains which
lie in parkland or farmland beyond the boundary
of a current garden. For guidance in such cases
see the Gardens scheduling selection guide.
Some sites, such as Harrington
(Northamptonshire) have ‘double designation’,
that is they are both scheduled and registered
(the latter at Grade II*). Henceforward such
duplication will be avoided and the most
appropriate designation regime will be chosen. It
will remain the case that specific archaeological
sites (which may or may not be directly
associated with the designed landscape) may be
scheduled within a wider registered landscape.
如果一个历史悠久的花园已经被完全遗弃，安排而
不是注册通常将是最适当的指定考虑。园林土木工
程或其他考古遗迹的大部分或重要部分位于现有园
林境界的彼方的公园或农田内，也可以考虑进行安
排。在这种情况下的指导参见花园调度选择指南。
一些网站，如哈灵顿(北安普敦郡)有“双重指定”，
即他们既是计划和注册(后者在二级 *)。因此，今
后将避免这种重复，并选择最合适的指定制度。特
定的考古遗址(可能与设计的景观直接相关，也可
能与设计的景观没有直接相关)可能会安排在更广
泛的注册景观内，这种情况仍然存在。
3.8 Deer parks
3.8 鹿公园
The huge number of deer parks in medieval and
early modern England, and their character, are
discussed above. A very few survive fairly intact
today (the National Trust estimates that 10 per
cent of parks extant in 1300 still
上文讨论了中世纪和近代早期英国大量的鹿园及
其特点。今天，极少数公园仍然完好无损地存活
下来(据国家信托基金会估计，1300 年仍有 10%
的公园存在
< < Contents 22
< < 目录 22
contain deer) enjoying a mixture of deciduous
woodland and open grassland within a boundary
with a still-extant bank-and-ditch pale. Deer parks
established in the medieval to early modern periods
may be eligible for inclusion of the Register of Parks
and Gardens; fundamental will be the survival of the
park interior, or a large part of it, unenclosed for
agriculture and with its woods, trees and grassland
intact, and with its perimeter clearly defined by
banks, walls or hedges. The presence of structures
such as lodges and deer shelters, especially where
listed, will generally add to a park’s interest. So, too,
will be the survival of the principal house with which
the park was associated, especially where there is
a visual relationship between the two. An example
would be Whitcliff Park, which was (and is) the deer
park of Berkeley Castle (Gloucestershire) and is
inter-visible with it. Together, these landscapes are
registered at Grade II*.
包含鹿)享受一个混合的落叶林地和开放的草原边界
内仍然存在的河岸和沟渠苍白。建立于中世纪至近代
早期的鹿公园可能有资格列入《公园和花园登记册》
; 基本要素是公园内部或大部分地区的生存，这些地
区不封闭，用于农业，其森林、树木和草地完好无损，
其周边由堤岸、围墙或篱笆明确界定。建筑物的存在，
如旅馆和鹿的庇护所，特别是在上市的地方，通常会
增加公园的利益。同样，与公园相关的主要住宅的存
续也是如此，尤其是在两者之间存在视觉关系的地方。
Whitcliff 公园就是一个例子，它曾经是(现在也是)伯
克利城堡(Gloucestershire)的鹿公园，并且与它互相
可见。这些景观一起被登记在二级 * 。
3.9 Sports grounds
3.9 运动场
Country house parks which include golf courses
will be assessed as parks, rather than as sporting
landscapes. Structures associated with sports
grounds such as stands and pavilions may
包括高尔夫球场在内的郊野公园将被评定为公园，
而不是体育景观。与运动场相关的结构，如看台和
亭子，可以
be eligible for designation, and guidance on
this is provided in the Sports and Recreation
Buildings listing selection guide. Historic
England provides guidance on the design and
management of golf courses in historic parks
via Golf in Historic Parks and Landscapes.
符合指定资格，有关指引载于《体育及康乐建
筑物选择指引》。英格兰历史博物馆提供了历
史公园高尔夫球场设计和管理的指南，通过历
史公园和景观的高尔夫球场。
3.10 Grading
3.10 评级
While all registered sites are considered to be of a
sufficiently high level of special historic interest to
merit a national designation, the sites included on
the Register of Parks and Gardens are divided into
three grade bands to give added guidance on their
significance. The three grades are Grade I (of
exceptional interest), Grade II* (of more than
special interest) and Grade II (of special interest,
warranting every effort to preserve them). Having
begun by assessing the best-known designed
landscapes, we accordingly have a high percentage
registered in the higher grades, and 37 per cent of
all such sites are graded
虽然所有已登记的地点都被认为具有足够高的特殊历
史价值，值得国家指定，但列入《公园和园林登记
册》的地点分为三个等级，以便就其重要性提供更多
指导。这三个级别分别为一级(具特殊意义)、二级 *
(具特殊意义以上)及二级(具特殊意义，有必要尽力保
存)。我们从评估最著名的设计景观开始，因此，在
较高级别的地点登记的比例很高，所有这些地点中
有 37% 已经评级
in a Grade I or Grade II* ranking; by way of
comparison, only 8 per cent of listed buildings
are designated at these levels.
在一级或二级 * 的排名中; 相比之下，只有 8%
的表列建筑物被指定在这些级别。

Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
Arch，Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单
Preface
前言
Bridges – primarily road but also railway– are important cultural features within the Grand River watershed and
support the national status of the Grand River and its major tributaries as Canadian Heritage Rivers. Some, such as
the timber covered bridge of West Montrose, are unique survivors of once common designs. A few, such as the
massive, nine-span concrete bowstring bridge across the Grand River at Caledonia, are visually arresting in their
scale and form. Yet most of the structures in the watershed are “ordinary” steel or concrete bridges. However, close
examination can reveal that they are anything but ordinary in what they can tell us about the past and present. And
many, with steel trusses or concrete arches rising above the land have an aesthetic quality.
桥梁——主要是公路，也包括铁路——是大河流域内的重要文化特征，支撑着大河及其主要支流作为加拿
大遗产河的国家地位。一些桥梁，比如西蒙特罗斯的木质桥梁，是曾经共同设计的独特幸存者。在喀里多
尼亚横跨大河的巨大的九跨混凝土弓弦桥，其规模和形式在视觉上引人注目。然而，这个分水岭上的大多
数结构都是“普通”的钢筋或混凝土桥梁。然而，仔细研究可以发现，它们在告诉我们关于过去和现在的
信息方面绝不普通。许多钢桁架或混凝土拱门高出地面，具有一种美学特质。
Bridges, like people, have finite lives. Increased traffic loads, salt damage, and freeze/thaw cycles are some of the
common factors affecting bridge life. These events are predictable and the loss of key bridges can be planned for.
This is why an inventory, like this one of the Grand River watershed, is so important. The inventory can highlight
structures before they become a crisis. With pro-active planning it may be possible to reuse the bridge in less
strenuous locations, sympathetically repair rather than replace the bridge, or encourage the design of a new structure
to be of equal visual quality to the one it replaced.
桥梁，就像人一样，有着有限的生命。交通负荷的增加、盐的破坏以及冻融循环是影响桥梁寿命的一些常
见因素。这些事件是可以预测的，关键桥梁的损失是可以计划的。这就是为什么一个清单，像这个大河的
分水岭之一，是如此重要。清单可以在结构变成危机之前突出显示它们。通过积极主动的规划，也许可以
在不太费力的地方重新使用桥梁，同情地修复而不是替换桥梁，或者鼓励设计一个新的结构，使其具有与
它所替换的结构同样的视觉质量。
But the inventory is not only for management. For those that have a hankering for old bridges, Arch, Truss & Beam:
The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory is a gazetteer for anyone that wants to explore the area. You
can discover parts of Ontario and the adjoining resources you never knew existed.
但是库存不仅仅是为了管理。对于那些渴望旧桥，拱门，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单是一个地名词典，
为任何人谁想要探索该地区。你可以发现安大略省的部分地区和相邻的资源，你从来不知道它们的存在。
Christopher Andreae, PhD
克里斯托弗 · 安德烈博士
Heritage Resources Centre
文物资源中心

Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
Arch，Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单
Executive Summary
行政摘要
Bridges are an important component of our human heritage, representing an evolution in building materials and
techniques as well as reflecting the aesthetics of the time. Early bridges help to demonstrate the role of rivers in the
industrial and cultural development of Canada. Bridges in the Grand River watershed act as passageways through
time, providing clues as to how and why local communities and economies developed and evolved. These remaining
heritage bridges should be interpreted, conserved and celebrated as vestiges linking our collective present to our
past.
桥梁是人类遗产的重要组成部分，代表了建筑材料和技术的演变，也反映了当时的美学。早期的桥梁有助
于展示河流在加拿大工业和文化发展中的作用。大河流域的桥梁作为穿越时间的通道，为当地社区和经济
的发展和演变提供了线索。这些遗留下来的遗产桥梁应该被解释，保护和庆祝为连接我们的集体现在和我
们的过去的遗迹。
Heritage bridges represent an endangered species in the 21st century, with many contemporary issues challenging
conservation efforts. Rural bridges are experiencing capacity issues due to the intensification of agricultural
practices and large new machinery. And with urbanization spreading throughout the watershed in the form of new
residential growth and increasing road networks and capacities, heritage bridges are often ill-equipped to compete
with newer construction techniques in terms of ease of approvals, affordability and load capacity. Newer structures
are not built with an emphasis on design, materials and aesthetics as they once were. Restrictive municipal and
provincial budgets have led to an increasing number of utilitarian bridges crossing the watershed’s rivers, resulting
in an ever-increasing loss of the area’s unique cultural heritage identity.
遗产桥梁是 21 世纪的一个濒危物种，许多当代问题对保护工作构成挑战。由于强化的农业实践和大型新机
械，乡村桥梁正在经历容量问题。随着城市化以新的住宅增长和不断增加的道路网络和能力的形式在整个
流域蔓延，遗产桥梁往往装备不足，无法与更新的建筑技术在审批方便、负担能力和承载能力方面竞争。
较新的结构不再像过去那样强调设计、材料和美学。限制性的市政和省级预算导致越来越多的实用桥梁横
跨流域的河流，造成该地区独特的文化遗产特性日益丧失。
The Grand River Conservation Authority (GRCA), on behalf of watershed municipalities, is the steward of the
Canadian Heritage River designation for the Grand River and its major tributaries and has advocated the need for a
comprehensive inventory of heritage bridges in the watershed for many years. In 2012, the GRCA and the Heritage
Resources Centre at the University of Waterloo formed a partnership to carry out Arch, Truss, Beam: The Grand
River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory. The goal of this study was to support the designation of the Grand
River and its four tributaries, identify and encourage the listing or designation of bridges with significant cultural
heritage value under the Ontario Heritage Act, as well as promote the unique character and tourism potential of
structures located in each watershed municipality.
大河保护管理局(GRCA)代表流域市政当局，是指定大河及其主要支流的加拿大遗产河的管理者，多年来一
直主张需要对流域内的遗产桥梁进行全面清点。2012年，GRCA 和滑铁卢大学的遗产资源中心建立了合作
伙伴关系，开展了 Arch，Truss，Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 项目。这项研究
的目的是支持指定大河及其四条支流，确定和鼓励根据《安大略遗产法》列出或指定具有重要文化遗产价
值的桥梁，并促进每个流域城市建筑的独特性和旅游潜力。
To undertake this inventory, the 39 watershed municipalities (seven upper-tier, 26 lower-tier and six single-tier) and
two First Nations were contacted to obtain information on bridges under their jurisdiction. This resulted in full
municipal cooperation in the study. Various provincial, private and community organizations, as well as local
residents were consulted to gather further background research. Maps were reviewed and site visits carried out to
functional and abandoned bridges, as well as abutments. Each bridge that exhibited potential cultural heritage value
was evaluated using the Ontario Heritage Act’s (OHA), Ontario Regulation 9/06: Criteria for determining cultural
heritage value or interest. Of the 678 bridges inventoried, 167 (25%) were found to have heritage value. As well, 38
demolished structures were identified that were most likely heritage bridges. Additionally, 13 bridges formally
designated under the OHA were identified. Figure 1 illustrates the inventory’s main findings.
为了进行这项调查，与 39 个分水岭城市(7 个上级、26 个下级和 6 个单级)和两个第一民族进行了联系，以
获取其管辖范围内桥梁的信息。这导致了市政府在研究中的全面合作。征求了各省，私人和社区组织以及
当地居民的意见，以收集进一步的背景研究。对地图进行了审查，并对功能性桥梁和废弃桥梁以及桥台进
行了实地考察。使用《安大略遗产法》第 9/06 号条例: 确定文化遗产价值或兴趣的标准，对每座展示潜在文
化遗产价值的桥梁进行评估。在目录中的 678 座桥梁中，167 座(25%)被发现具有遗产价值。同时，38个被
拆除的建筑物被确定为最有可能的遗产桥梁。此外，确定了 13 座在 OHA 下正式指定的桥梁。图 1 说明了
清单的主要发现。

1.0 Introduction
1.0 简介
The awareness of cultural heritage assets in Canada is growing. Many cities and other municipalities now have
professional planners on staff dealing with heritage issues. Perhaps more importantly, most communities also have
dedicated volunteers working to conserve historic sites.
加拿大对文化遗产资产的认识正在增强。许多城市和其他城市现在都有专业的规划人员来处理文化遗产问
题。也许更重要的是，大多数社区也有专门的志愿者致力于保护历史遗迹。
Both heritage planning professionals and concerned citizens require an ever-increasing amount of reliable
information in order to do their work. When called upon to comment and advise decision makers, heritage experts
must be clear on the values that buildings and sites possess, what might be acceptable changes and which proposals
would compromise the historic value.
遗产规划专业人士和关心此事的公民都需要越来越多的可靠信息来完成他们的工作。当要求文物专家对决
策者提出意见和建议时，他们必须清楚地了解建筑物和遗址所具有的价值，什么是可以接受的改变，以及
哪些建议会损害历史价值。
Bridges are one class of heritage structures that are particularly important to our understanding of the cultural
landscape around us. Few other types of human built features are as iconic and can be considered landmarks as often
as bridges. In many cases they are the key structures that give character to an area whether rural or urban.
桥梁是一类文化遗产结构，对我们理解周围的文化景观特别重要。很少有其他类型的人类建筑特征像桥梁
一样具有标志性，并且经常被认为是地标性建筑。在许多情况下，它们是赋予一个地区特色的关键结构，
无论是乡村还是城市。
This study is intended to equip heritage advocates with the solid information they need to provide the best advice
possible to decision makers at all levels. We hope that readers find it useful.
这项研究旨在为遗产拥护者提供他们所需要的可靠信息，以便为各级决策者提供最好的建议。我们希望读
者能发现它有用。
Robert Shipley PhD, MCIP, RPP, CAHP
罗伯特希普利博士，MCIP，RPP，CAHP
Director, Heritage Resources Centre
文物资源中心主任
1.1 Background
1.1 背景
In 1987, the Grand River Conservation Authority (GRCA), on behalf of its member municipalities, spearheaded a
participatory process to have the Grand River and its major tributaries, the Speed, Eramosa, Nith and Conestogo
Rivers, declared Canadian Heritage Rivers (CHR). This status was achieved in 1994 based on outstanding river-
related human heritage and recreational features/values of national significance. The status gives national
recognition to the rivers but carries no regulatory or legal restrictions.
1987 年，大河保护管理局(GRCA)代表其成员市政当局率先开展了一个参与性进程，使大河及其主要支流
Speed 河、 Eramosa 河、 Nith 河和 Conestogo 河被宣布为加拿大遗产河(CHR)。这一地位是在 1994 年实现的，
基于杰出的河流相关的人类遗产和休闲特征/国家重要价值观。这一地位给予了国家对河流的承认，但没有
任何法律法规的限制。
While there is a general awareness throughout the Grand River watershed that the Grand River and its major
tributaries are Canadian Heritage Rivers, people are often unaware of the heritage features/values for which this
honour was based. Because many of these features/values are aging and deteriorating, there is significant pressure on
municipalities and landowners to replace them with modern structures (i.e. bridges) or to raze them (i.e. buildings) to
facilitate new development. In many cases, decisions to demolish a heritage structure are made without knowledge
that it is important to the heritage river designation. The creation and perpetuation of this knowledge was the
impetus to inventory the watershed’s heritage resources.
虽然整个大河流域都普遍认识到大河及其主要支流是加拿大的遗产河流，但人们往往不知道这一荣誉所依
据的遗产特征/价值观。由于许多这些特色/价值正在老化和恶化，市政当局和土地拥有人面临巨大压力，要
用现代建筑物(即桥梁)取代这些特色/价值，或拆除这些特色/价值(即建筑物) ，以促进新发展。在许多情况
下，拆除遗产建筑物的决定是在不知道它对遗产河的指定很重要的情况下做出的。这种知识的创造和延续
是清点流域遗产资源的动力。
The Heritage River Inventory, carried out from 1988-1990 prior to obtaining the designation, initially included only
the 12 heritage bridges identified in the Ontario Heritage Bridge Program (1991). Historic bridges represent one of
the key themes contained in the Cultural Framework for Canadian Heritage Rivers, released in 2000 by the
Canadian Heritage Rivers Board. This framework revealed a significant gap in the Heritage River Inventory because
the heritage value of most bridges within the Grand River watershed had not been formally assessed, leaving their
significance to the heritage river designation undetermined. Concurrently, because of their deteriorating condition, a
growing number of historic bridges throughout the watershed were being replaced. Consequently, the Heritage
Working Group, a group formed in 1995 to promote heritage features and values that support the Canadian Heritage
River designation, identified that an update to the Heritage River Inventory with a primary focus on heritage bridges
was needed.
在获得指定之前，1988-1990 年进行的遗产河清单，最初只包括安大略省遗产桥梁方案(1991 年)确定的 12 座
遗产桥梁。历史桥梁代表了包含在加拿大遗产河流文化框架中的关键主题之一，由加拿大遗产河流委员会
于 2000 年发布。这一框架揭示了遗产河清单中的一个重大差距，因为大河流域内大多数桥梁的遗产价值尚
未得到正式评估，其对遗产河指定的重要性尚未确定。同时，由于其恶化的状况，越来越多的历史桥梁在
整个流域被替换。因此，1995 年为促进支持加拿大遗产河指定的遗产特征和价值而成立的遗产工作组确定，
需要更新遗产河清单，主要侧重于遗产桥梁。
In 2003, Robinson Heritage Consulting was retained to undertake a Grand River Heritage Bridge Inventory (Grand
Old Bridges) in support of the first decadal Monitoring Report for the Grand River required for submission
2003 年，罗宾逊文物顾问公司受聘进行大河文物桥梁目录(大老桥)的编制工作，以支持提交首份大河十年监
测报告
4
Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
Arch，Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单
to the Canadian Heritage Rivers Board in 2004. Given the budget for the project, the inventory work was based on
secondary sources of information; no primary research was carried out. The consultants considered 99 bridges
throughout the watershed, most of them along the main stem of the Grand River. A total of 69 bridges were
considered to have heritage significance, supporting the heritage river designation. Due to the limitations of the
study, the inventory cannot be viewed as a definitive reference on the historic value of all bridge structures in the
Grand River watershed, as a limited study area was explored. The Grand Old Bridges inventory was supplemented
by information obtained through a comprehensive inventory (Spanning the Generations, Phases 1-3) of heritage
bridges in Waterloo Region undertaken by the Regional Municipality of Waterloo in 2004 and 2007. However,
knowledge of historic bridges in other parts of the watershed was still unexplored.
2004 年加拿大遗产河流委员会。考虑到项目的预算，清单工作是基于次要的信息来源; 没有进行初步的研究。
顾问们考虑了整个流域的 99 座桥梁，其中大部分沿着大河的主干道。共有 69 座桥梁被认为具有重要的文化
遗产意义，支持文化遗产河的指定。由于研究的局限性，该清单不能被视为大河流域所有桥梁结构的历史
价值的确切参考，因为该清单是一个有限的研究区域。滑铁卢区政府于 2004 年和 2007 年对滑铁卢区的遗产

流域其他地区历史桥梁的知识仍然没有得到探索。
From March 2012 to March 2013 the Heritage Resources Centre (HRC) at the University of Waterloo, in partnership with
the GRCA and the Heritage Working Group, undertook a comprehensive inventory of heritage bridges within the Grand
River watershed in an effort to inventory and evaluate as many bridges as possible. This inventory and report has been
compiled to support the watershed’s unique river-related heritage as well as to promote the outstanding structures that
should be conserved for future generations and celebrated as cultural relics of our past accomplishments. The Toronto and
Region Conservation Authority’s ground-breaking inventory, Crossing the Humber: The Humber River Heritage Bridge
Inventory (2011), has been used as a template to guide this work.
2012 年 3 月至 2013 年 3 月，滑铁卢大学遗产资源中心与格鲁吉亚政府保护区和遗产工作组合作，对大河流域内
的遗产桥梁进行了全面清查，努力清查和评估尽可能多的桥梁。汇编这份清单和报告是为了支持该流域与河流有
关的独特遗产，以及促进应该为后代保护的杰出建筑，并将其作为我们过去成就的文化遗产加以纪念。多伦多和
地区保护局的开创性清单，跨越亨伯河: 亨伯河遗产桥清单(2011 年) ，已被用作指导这项工作的模板。
1.2 Project Goals
1.2 项目目标
An inventory and evaluation of the significance of bridges in the Grand River watershed has never been carried out,
with the exception of Grand Old Bridges and the Region of Waterloo’s Spanning the Generations. This report
provides a comprehensive inventory of bridges in the watershed with the goal of identifying structures with cultural
heritage value eligible for listing or designation under the Ontario Heritage Act. A primary goal of the project was
to ensure that each municipality in the watershed cooperated in providing information on bridges under their
jurisdiction; this was achieved watershed-wide. This inventory should be viewed as an initial step in establishing an
ever-evolving inventory of heritage bridges that can be continuously updated as further information is obtained.
除了古老的大桥和滑铁卢跨越世代的地区之外，从来没有对大河流域桥梁的重要性进行过清点和评估。本
报告提供了流域内桥梁的全面清单，目的是查明具有文化遗产价值的结构，根据《安大略遗产法》有资格
列入清单或指定。该项目的一个主要目标是确保流域内的每个市政当局合作提供其管辖范围内桥梁的信息;
这在整个流域范围内都得到了实现。这个清单应该被看作是建立一个不断发展的遗产桥梁清单的第一步，
随着进一步的信息获得可以不断更新。
This bridge inventory will provide a planning tool for decision-makers to consult when work associated with a
bridge is contemplated. It will:
这一桥梁清单将为决策者在考虑与桥梁有关的工作时进行协商提供一个规划工具。它将:
• identify whether or not a bridge has heritage significance at both the regional and watershed scales. If
deemed significant, the bridge would be considered an important feature that supports the heritage river designation for the Grand
River and its major tributaries ensure consistency in the criteria and approach used to evaluate bridges across municipalities and
build on the work already completed by the Region of Waterloo identify bridges with heritage value to promote appropriate
policies and procedures for management of these assets as set out by the Provincial Policy Statement, the Ontario Heritage Act
and guided by the Ontario Heritage Tool Kit produced by the Ministry of Tourism, Culture & Sport identify whether or not a
Heritage Impact Assessment (HIA) would be required as part of an Environmental Assessment (EA) process. If required, the
information supplied in this inventory would provide a base for further research, thereby saving time and expense for the
proponent provide easily accessible information about the cultural heritage value of a bridge for planners, engineers, architects,
property owners, municipal heritage committees, developers, the tourism industry, educators and the interested members of the
general public through the GRCA’s Grand River Information Network (GRIN) mapping tool, thereby saving time and expense in
searching for information
确定一座桥梁在区域和流域尺度上是否具有重要的遗产意义。如果认为该桥具有重要意义，它将被视
为支持大河及其主要支流的遗产河指定的一个重要特征，确保用于评估跨市桥梁的标准和方法的一
致性，并在滑铁卢地区已经完成的工作的基础上，确定具有遗产价值的桥梁，以促进《省政策声
明》、《安大略遗产法》规定的管理这些资产的适当政策和程序，并在旅游、文化和体育部制作的
《安大略遗产工具包》的指导下，确定是否需要作为环境评估进程的一部分进行遗产影响评估。如
果需要，本清单中提供的信息将为进一步研究提供基础，从而为倡议者节省时间和费用，通过
GRCA 的 Grand River Information Network (GRIN)绘图工具，为规划者、工程师、建筑师、业主、
市政文物委员会、开发商、旅游业、教育工作者和感兴趣的公众提供有关桥梁文化遗产价值的便捷

• provide a central element of a municipal cultural plan that begins with mapping local cultural assets and

1.3 Evolution of Bridge Building in the Grand River Watershed
1.3 大河流域桥梁建设的演变
The history of bridge construction is important to understanding the cultural and developmental evolution of any
area. It has relevance not just locally, but speaks to the development of Canada as a nation. As technological
advances were made, construction techniques improved and life ways were able to advance and adapt to the
landscape. Canadian Heritage Rivers are celebrated for their representation of this evolution not just in settlement
patterns but also in the evolution of building technology, most notably bridges.
桥梁建设的历史对于理解任何地区的文化和发展演变都很重要。它不仅与当地有关，而且与加拿大作为一
个国家的发展有关。随着技术的进步，建筑技术的改进，生活方式也能够适应环境的变化。加拿大传统河
流因其对这种进化的表现而闻名，这种进化不仅体现在定居模式上，也体现在建筑技术的进化上，其中最
引人注目的是桥梁。
The Grand River and its major tributaries (Nith, Conestogo, Speed, Eramosa), designated Canadian Heritage Rivers,
played a significant role in the settlement of the area. Bridges over these rivers allowed settlers to spread and
communities to develop and thrive. Ingenuity was needed to build structures that could span large watercourses and
handle the unpredictability of flooding and harsh winters. It was this development of technology and innovation that
allows us to trace our past through the bridges that remain today.
格兰德河及其主要支流(第九河、科内斯托哥河、斯皮德河、埃拉莫萨河)被指定为加拿大的遗产河，在该地
区的定居中发挥了重要作用。跨越这些河流的桥梁使得定居者得以扩张，社区得以发展和繁荣。建造能够
跨越大型河道的建筑需要智慧，能够应对洪水和严冬的不可预测性。正是这种技术和创新的发展使我们能
够通过今天依然存在的桥梁追溯我们的过去。
First Nations peoples occupied the land of the Grand River watershed prior to the arrival of the Pennsylvania-Dutch
Mennonite pioneers who settled in the area around 1800. The First Nations’ strong knowledge of the landscape lead
to the identification of areas that allowed for the most accessible means across the watershed’s many streams and
rivers. Often these crossings were fords, such as Brant’s Crossing in the City of Brantford and Doon and Bridgeport
in the City of Kitchener. Today many of these fords are still used as active crossings and archaeological sites remain
at some of the most notable bridges in the watershed, such as the Cayuga Bridge in Haldimand Township.
1800 年左右，在宾夕法尼亚-荷兰门诺派先驱定居于此之前，第一民族占据了大河流域的土地。第一民族对
自然景观的深入了解导致他们确定了一些地区，这些地区可以在流域的许多溪流和河流中找到最容易到达
的方式。通常这些渡口都是福特车，比如布兰特福德和杜恩的布兰特渡口和基奇纳的布里奇波特渡口。今
天，许多这些浅滩仍然被用作活跃的过境点，考古遗址仍然保留在分水岭的一些最著名的桥梁上，例如
Haldimand 镇的卡尤加大桥。
Following the First Nations’ understanding of the land, Pennsylvania-Dutch Mennonite pioneers began to settle the area
building bridges out of timber at these early crossings. In order to accommodate agricultural land, the settlers cleared
forests, accumulating vast quantities of logs. This resulted in the construction of cheap and efficient timber bridges.
Initially, these timber bridges consisted of two straight logs laid across the stream with smaller boards placed across to
create a deck. These bridges, however, proved ineffective for rivers with larger spans. Therefore, settlers used their
knowledge of building barn roofs and applied it to bridge structures by utilizing king and queen post trusses in their design.
Timber was also used to build crib abutments and piers for bridges with more than one span.
随着第一民族对这片土地的了解，宾夕法尼亚-荷兰门诺派先驱者开始在这片土地上定居，在这些早期的过境点用
木材建造桥梁。为了适应农业用地，定居者砍伐森林，积累了大量的原木。这导致了廉价高效的木桥的建造。最
初，这些木桥由两根横跨小溪的直木和较小的木板组成，这样就形成了一个桥面。然而，事实证明，这些桥梁对
于跨度较大的河流是无效的。因此，定居者利用他们建造谷仓屋顶的知识，并将其应用到桥梁结构中，在他们的
设计中使用了国王和王后柱桁架。木材也被用来为跨度超过一个的桥梁建造婴儿床桥台和桥墩。
Railway companies introduced more elaborate truss bridges in Ontario around 1850. By this date, numerous truss
designs had been developed. Pratt and Warren trusses, seen throughout the Grand River watershed, were patented in
1844 and 1848 respectively. Truss bridges, at the time, were being built using wrought iron due to its functionality
and malleability. Wrought iron bridges were most often found in thriving industrial towns that could afford their
construction. For example, both Brantford and Paris had wrought iron bridges built in the 1870s. Timber bridges
were still extremely popular in Ontario until the 1890s when steel became a more affordable bridge material. The
first steel highway bridges appeared in Ontario around 1885. American steel truss bridges were the first to become
popular in south-western Ontario, including Carnegie Steel from Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. After 1900, companies in
Hamilton (Hamilton Bridge Company Ltd.) and Walkerville began producing steel for bridge construction and can
be identified to this day by their builder-plates displayed on the ends of bridges.
1850 年左右，铁路公司在安大略省引进了更精致的桁架桥。到了这个时候，许多桁架设计已经被开发出来。
普拉特(Pratt)和沃伦(Warren)桁架遍布格兰德河(Grand River)分水岭，分别于 1844 年和 1848 年获得专利。桁
架桥，在当时，由于其功能和延展性，正在使用锻铁建造。熟铁桥最常见于繁荣的工业城镇，这些城镇能
够负担得起它们的建造费用。例如，布兰特福德和巴黎都在 19 世纪 70 年代建造了锻造铁桥。直到 19 世纪
90 年代，木桥在安大略省仍然非常受欢迎，当时钢铁成为了一种更实惠的桥梁材料。1885年左右，第一座
钢制公路桥出现在安大略省。美国的钢桁架桥是安大略省西南部第一座流行的桥梁，包括宾夕法尼亚州匹
兹堡的卡内基钢铁公司。1900 年以后，汉密尔顿(汉密尔顿桥梁有限公司)和沃克维尔的公司开始生产用于桥
梁建设的钢材，直到今天，他们的建造者牌照仍然可以通过展示在桥梁的两端来识别。
Steel bridges allowed for larger load limits and continued to be built well into the automobile era. It was common for
these bridges to be built high above the river’s flood plain, as evidenced in several steel truss bridges in the Grand
River watershed due to its varying flow levels. Steel pony truss bridges were relatively inexpensive and could be
constructed quickly. These bridges are scattered throughout the rural areas of the watershed. Through trusses were
built where a large span was to be crossed, or where large loads were anticipated.
钢桥允许更大的负载限制，并继续建设，以及进入汽车时代。这些桥梁通常建在河流泛滥平原的高处，大
河流域的几座钢桁架桥就证明了这一点，因为它的水位不断变化。小型钢桁架桥相对便宜，建造起来很快 。
这些桥分散在流域的农村地区。穿过桁架的地方建立了大跨度的跨越，或大荷载的预期。
Although steel truss bridges were soon found throughout Ontario, many municipalities still could not afford to construct
them due to the high price of materials. As a result, concrete arch bridges with a simple design, built with local labour and
material, were often a better option for building affordable, yet durable spans in these municipalities. The first reinforced
concrete arch in Ontario was built in 1906. The oldest concrete bridge in the Grand River watershed is an earth-filled
concrete arch bridge, built in 1908 in the Township of Centre Wellington along the former Fourth Line.
尽管钢桁架桥很快在安大略省各地被发现，但由于高昂的材料价格，许多市政当局仍然负担不起建造它们的费用。
因此，用当地劳动力和材料建造的设计简单的混凝土拱桥，往往是在这些市政当局建造价格合理但经久耐用的跨
度的更好选择。安大略省第一座钢筋混凝土拱门建于 1906 年。格兰德河流域最古老的混凝土桥是一座填土混凝
土拱桥，建于 1908 年，位于中威灵顿乡，沿着原来的第四线。
6
Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
Arch，Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单
In 1899, A.W. Campbell, a government instructor in road building, encouraged the use of concrete to provide an
inexpensive, long-lasting bridge material. Concrete became a dominant material for bridge building in southern
Ontario from this time on, as local aggregates were easily accessible for local contractors. Several stone bridges
were also built around the turn of the century, but masonry was not used in excess to build bridges in Ontario due to
the required time, money and skill.
1899 年，a.w。坎贝尔，一位公路建设的政府指导员，鼓励使用混凝土来提供一种廉价的、持久的桥梁材料。
混凝土从此成为南安大略大学桥梁建设的主要材料，因为当地的集料很容易为当地承包商获得。在世纪之
交的时候也建造了几座石桥，但是由于时间、金钱和技术的需要，在安大略省没有过多地使用砖石建造桥
梁。
Another concrete design also became significant in this era: the concrete bowstring arch, or concrete truss bridge.
The first of its kind was built over the Etobicoke River in 1909. One of the most significant concrete bridge builders
in the Grand River watershed was Charles Mattaini. He was responsible for many of the concrete bowstring bridges
built between 1903 and 1929 in Wellington County, and several bridges in the Region of Waterloo and Grey
County. Originally from northern Italy where concrete bowstring bridges were common, Mattaini introduced the
design to Ontario and more specifically, the watershed. These single-lane concrete bowstring bridges are of
particular importance to Wellington County, more specifically the Township of Centre Wellington, because of their
age, style and concentration in numbers. These bridges are indicative of the transition from horse-drawn vehicles to
motorized vehicles and farm equipment. They also demonstrate the existence of an organized public works body as
many of these bridges were overseen by Mattaini, but built with local labour and materials. Experimentation with
the bowstring bridge design can be seen throughout the watershed by examining the varying stream sizes and
technical skills. Many of these structures are still in use, proving the durability of this particular design. However,
along with steel truss bridges, they represent the most endangered bridge type in the watershed. Bowstring bridges
are quickly being demolished to make way for larger, increased load bearing structures that can accommodate two
lanes of high-speed traffic.
另一个混凝土设计在这个时代也变得重要: 混凝土弓弦拱，或混凝土桁架桥。第一座同类建筑于 1909 年建
于 Etobicoke 河上。大河流域最重要的混凝土桥梁建造者之一是 Charles Mattaini。他负责在 1903 年至 1929
年间在威灵顿县建造的许多混凝土弓弦桥，以及在滑铁卢和格雷县地区建造的几座桥。Mattaini 最初来自意
大利北部，那里的混凝土弓弦桥很常见，Mattaini 把这种设计引入到安大略省，更具体地说，引入到分水岭。
这些单车道混凝土弓弦桥对威灵顿县尤其重要，特别是中威灵顿乡，因为它们的年龄，风格和数量集中。
这些桥标志着从马车到机动车和农业设备的转变。它们也证明了一个有组织的公共工程机构的存在，因为
许多这些桥梁是由 Mattaini 监督的，但是用当地的劳动力和材料建造的。弓弦桥设计的实验可以通过检查
不同的河流大小和技术技能在整个分水岭中看到。许多这样的结构仍在使用中，证明了这种特殊设计的耐
久性。然而，和钢桁架桥一样，它们代表了流域中最濒临灭绝的桥梁类型。弓弦桥正在被迅速拆除，以便
为更大更多的承重结构让路，这些结构可以容纳两条车道的高速交通。
After 1929, Mattaini gave permission for Barber & Young to use his design. Hired by the Wellington-Guelph County
Council, Barber & Young refined the design and continued to build bowstring bridges both in and outside of the
watershed. Mattaini did not patent or sell the design of these bridges. Instead he chose to leave a legacy in Canada as
thanks for welcoming him and his family. Barber & Young continued to build many noteworthy bowstring bridges in the
watershed, including Kitchener’s five-span Bridgeport Bridge in 1934. Other prominent bridge builders constructed
impressive multi-span bowstring bridges, such as the nine-span Caledonia Bridge constructed by Randolph MacDonald
Co. Ltd. in 1927, and the seven-span Freeport Bridge built by Campbell & Lattimore in 1926.
1929 年后，Mattaini 允许 Barber & Young 使用他的设计。在惠灵顿-圭尔夫县议会的雇佣下，Barber & Young 完
善了设计，并继续在分水岭内外建造弓弦桥。Mattaini 没有申请专利，也没有出售这些桥梁的设计。相反，他选
择在加拿大留下一笔遗产，以感谢对他和他的家人的欢迎。巴伯和杨继续在这个分水岭建造许多值得注意的弓弦
桥，包括 1934 年基奇纳的五跨布里奇波特大桥。其他著名的桥梁建造者建造了令人印象深刻的多跨弓弦桥，如
1927 年伦道夫麦克唐纳有限公司建造的 9 跨喀里多尼亚大桥，以及 1926 年坎贝尔和拉蒂摩尔建造的 7 跨弗里波
特大桥。
Simple, solid slab concrete bridges were also favourable during this period, as they were easy to build and ideal for
short spans. Concrete beam bridges were built to cross larger spans. Around 1930, the rigid frame bridge was
introduced and quickly became the favoured design for highway overpasses. This style can be seen dating back to
the early 1920s in the Grand River watershed, and is a common bridge design still seen today.
简单，实心板混凝土桥梁也有利于在这一时期，因为他们很容易建立和理想的短跨。混凝土梁桥可以跨越
更大的跨度。大约在 1930 年，刚构桥被引入，并迅速成为公路立交桥最受欢迎的设计。这种风格可以追溯
到 20 世纪 20 年代早期的格兰德河流域，至今仍是一种常见的桥梁设计。
World War I caused bridge construction to slow due to reduced labour, money and demand. After the war ended,
there was a spike in personal motorized vehicle use, which meant that larger, stronger bridges needed to be built.
During the Great Depression, bridge construction increased despite an economic downturn. Public works programs
were established to create make-work projects for the unemployed by increasing government work initiatives such
as the construction of many concrete structures in the watershed.
由于劳动力、资金和需求的减少，第一次世界大战导致桥梁建设速度放缓。战争结束后，个人机动车使用
量激增，这意味着需要建造更大、更坚固的桥梁。在大萧条时期，尽管经济低迷，桥梁建设还是增加了。
建立了公共工程方案，通过增加政府工作举措，例如在流域建造许多混凝土结构，为失业者创造创造就业
机会的项目。
During the period from 1914 to 1930, there were a variety of materials and designs available to those building bridges.
This lead to discussion amongst engineers about the aesthetics of bridge design and how much visual impact a bridge
should have on the surrounding environment. As early as 1911, Professor C.R. Young noted in a paper read to the
Canadian Society of Civil Engineers that there was a lack of attention to the aesthetics in bridge design and that it reflected
“graceless structural outlines, misuses of ornamental features, poor finishes, surface discolouration and untidy and ill-kept
approaches and surroundings” (Cuming, 1983). Also, in 1915, an editorial in The Canadian Engineer commented on the
increased need for aestheticism in bridge designs (Cuming, 1983). Engineers at the time were described as being too
concerned with building bridges from a utilitarian perspective with little care for the surrounding natural environment. By
1939, engineers and road builders were confident in the visual appeal of the structures they were building. However,
Victor Murray, an assistant engineer with the Ontario Department
在 1914 年至 1930 年期间，有各种各样的材料和设计可用于这些建设桥梁。这引发了工程师们关于桥梁设计的美
学以及桥梁对周围环境的视觉影响的讨论。早在 1911 年，c.r. Young 教授就在向加拿大土木工程师学会宣读的一
篇论文中指出，桥梁设计缺乏对美学的关注，反映了”结构轮廓粗糙、装饰特征的滥用、装饰效果差、表面变色
以及方法和环境不整洁和保养不良”(Cuming，1983)。同样，在 1915 年，《加拿大工程师》的一篇社论评论了
对桥梁设计美学需求的增加(Cuming，1983)。当时的工程师们被描述为过于关注从功利主义的角度建造桥梁，对
周围的自然环境几乎不关心。到了 1939 年，工程师和筑路工人对他们所建造的结构的视觉吸引力充满信心。然
而，安大略省部门的助理工程师 Victor Murray 呢
7
Heritage Resources Centre
文物资源中心
of Highways stated in The Canadian Engineer in 1939 that “a departure from the strictly functional is no longer
considered a sign of weakness” (Cuming, 1983). He continued to state, “a beautifully designed bridge has a certain
value to a community which cannot easily be expressed in dollars, but which pays in the pride that it creates in a
community” (Cuming, 1983). This observation still has relevance today for the many who value the cultural heritage
value of an ascetically appealing bridge.
1939 年《加拿大工程师》中指出，“偏离严格的功能不再被视为软弱的迹象” (Cuming，1983)。他继续说，
“一座设计精美的桥梁对于一个社区来说有一定的价值，这种价值不容易用金钱来表达，但是却可以从它
在社区中创造的自豪感中得到回报”(Cuming，1983)。这个观察至今仍然与许多珍视这座吸引人的苦行僧桥
的文化遗产价值的人有关。
In 1939, the Second World War caused bridge construction to slow dramatically. Few bridges were built throughout
the province due to high costs and the low availability of labour. After the war, however, bridge construction once
again rapidly increased as part of the ‘building boom.’ Thousands of bridges were constructed and rehabilitated.
Several of these were large projects including bridges on the Trans-Canada Highway and Highway 401. These larger
projects required longer bridges and overpasses. To accommodate these needs, the use of pre-cast and pre-stressed
concrete began to appear and continues to be the most widely used material in bridge construction today.
1939 年，第二次世界大战导致桥梁建设急剧放缓。由于高成本和劳动力供应不足，全省几乎没有桥梁建成。
然而，战后，作为“建筑热潮”的一部分，桥梁建设再次迅速增加。数以千计的桥梁被建造和修复。其中
一些是大型项目，包括加拿大横贯公路和 401 高速公路上的桥梁。这些大型项目需要更长的桥梁和立交桥。
为了满足这些需求，使用预制和预应力混凝土开始出现，并继续在桥梁建设中使用最广泛的材料今天。
With the rapid population increase, there was a greater demand for bridge capacity, as well as an increased focus on
safety. The design philosophy in 1965 was based on safety and engineering considerations. The Ontario Department
of Highways stated that “the ideal situation is one where the motorist is unaware he was crossing a bridge” (Cuming,
1983). This design was implemented by having no part of the bridge projecting above the road deck, carrying the
shoulders of the road across the bridge and by having low, concrete, simple guardrails. Aside from a few exceptional
bridges such as the Burlington Skyway (1958) and several steel through truss bridges built in the watershed (Fergus,
Elora, Drayton) during the 1950s and 1960s, many standardized rigid frame bridges were quickly built throughout
the watershed and the province in an attempt to reach optimum efficiency. This represented a significant diversion
from the sentiments of engineers in the first half of the 20th century who placed an increas-ing value on bridge design
and aesthetics. Many of these newer bridges were plain and lacked decoration to reduce construction time. During
this period, any steel, iron or timber bridge that was deemed unsafe and in need of repair was demolished and
quickly rebuilt using this standardized design, resulting in the loss of many of Ontario’s earliest and most unique
structures.
随着人口的迅速增长，对桥梁承载能力的需求越来越大，对安全的关注也越来越多。1965年的设计理念基
于安全和工程方面的考虑。安大略省公路部表示，“理想的情况是驾驶员不知道自己正在过
桥”(Cuming，1983)。这个设计是通过没有桥的一部分突出在路面上，承载路的肩膀通过桥梁和低，混凝土，
简单的护栏来实现的。除了一些特殊的桥梁，如伯灵顿高速公路(1958 年)和几个钢通过桁架桥梁建立在流域
(Fergus，Elora，Drayton)在 1950 年代和 1960 年代，许多标准化的刚构桥梁迅速建立在整个流域和该省，以
期达到最佳的效率。这代表了 20 世纪上半叶工程师们对桥梁设计和美学越来越重视的情感的重大转移。这
些新桥梁中的许多都很普通，缺乏装饰以减少施工时间。在此期间，任何被认为不安全和需要修理的钢铁
或木材桥梁都被拆除，并利用这种标准化设计迅速重建，造成许多安大略省最早和最独特的结构损失。
However, there are some extant success stories in the watershed representing designation, rehabilitation and
sympathetic new construction. Brant County has taken commendable strides to conserve the Brant Bowstring Bridge
(B4), the only of its type in the County. Its decision not to demolish the bridge, but rather to designate it, indicates
the active role the County is taking in protecting and preserving its heritage despite development pressure. Similarly,
the Township of East Garafraxa has dedicated significant funds to the rehabilitation of the McPherson Bridge (EX1),
a majestic double bowstring arch (tied) crossing the Grand River. The City of Guelph has undertaken the designation
of more bridges than any other watershed municipality, with five bridges protected under Part IV of the Ontario
Heritage Act. The Township of Guelph/Eramosa is taking the initiative to rebuild new structures that reflect the local
evolution of bridge design. The character of the area coupled with the designs of original builders and engineers
significant to the community are being reflected. For example, the Eden Mills Bridge (RGE1) was reconstructed in
1998 to reflect the elegance of the 1913 concrete bowstring arch bridge it replaced. And Hagan’s Bridge (RGE2), a
camelback pony truss structure was constructed in 1995, a rare find so late in the 20th century. As well, the Region of
Waterloo has invested heavily in the rehabilitation of the Freeport Bridge (K1) and Bridgeport Bridge (K2), ensuring
the conservation of these rare multi-span concrete bowstring arch structures for future generations.
然而，在这个分水岭也有一些现存的成功故事，它们代表了设计、修复和富有同情心的新建筑。布兰特县
在保护布兰特弓弦桥(B4)方面取得了值得称赞的进展，这是该县唯一的一座此类桥梁。它决定不拆除这座桥，
而是指定它，这表明尽管面临发展压力，该县在保护和保护其遗产方面发挥了积极作用。同样，东
Garafraxa 小镇也投入了大量资金用于修复横跨大河的麦克弗森大桥(EX1)。圭尔夫市承担了比任何其他分水
岭城市更多的桥梁指定工作，其中五座桥梁受《安大略遗产法》第四部分的保护。圭尔夫/埃拉莫萨镇正在
主动重建反映当地桥梁设计发展的新结构。该地区的特点，加上原始建筑师和工程师的设计对社区意义重
大，正在得到反映。例如，Eden Mills 大桥(RGE1)于 1998 年重建，以体现它所取代的 1913 年混凝土弓弦拱
桥的优雅。Hagan’s Bridge (RGE2) ，一个驼背小马桁架结构建于 1995 年，这在 20 世纪晚期是一个罕见的发
现。此外，滑铁卢地区在弗里波特大桥(K1)和布里奇波特大桥(K2)的修复工程上投入巨资，确保这些罕见的
多跨混凝土弓弦拱结构得以保存，供后代使用。

2.1 Scope of focus
2.1 焦点范围
This inventory evaluated bridges that cross bodies of water in the Grand River watershed, including each of the five
Canadian Heritage Rivers (Grand, Nith, Speed, Eramosa, Conestogo) and their tributaries. Bridge types recorded
include those that carry vehicles, rail and pedestrians, and may be active, inactive, remnant or demolished (if
information is available). For the most part, remnant bridges included abutments and/or piers. A cut off age of 35
years was decided upon. Although the provincial norm for a resource to be considered heritage is 40 years, 35 years
was chosen to provide a broader view of the watershed’s existing and future heritage resources. These structures
may be located on public or private property, and constructed of any material (see Appendix G for a general
overview of Ontario bridge types). Due to the vast area encompassed by the watershed (6,800 km2), culverts were
not evaluated as their numbers proved too numerous. All heritage bridges have been captured with site visits and
photographs and included in an overall bridge inventory database.
这 份 清 单 评 估 了 横 跨 大 河 流 域 水 体 的 桥 梁 ， 包 括 五 条 加 拿 大 传 统 河 流
(Grand，Nith，Speed，Eramosa，Conestogo)及其支流。记录的桥梁类型包括运载车辆、铁路和行人的桥梁，
可能是活动的、闲置的、残余的或被拆除的(如果有信息的话)。在大多数情况下，残余桥梁包括桥台和/或
桥墩。决定了 35 年的截止年龄。虽然被视为遗产的资源的省级标准是 40 年，但选择 35 年是为了更广泛地
了解流域现有和未来的遗产资源。这些结构可能位于公共或私人财产，并用任何材料建造(见附录 g，安大
略省桥梁类型的一般概述)。由于流域(6800 平方公里)覆盖面积广阔，涵洞数量过多，因此没有进行评估。
所有的遗产桥梁都已经被现场访问和照片捕捉，并包括在一个整体的桥梁库
存数据库。
Following the example set by the Toronto and Region Conservation Authority’s
(TRCA) award-winning inventory, Crossing the Humber: The Humber River
Heritage Bridge Inventory, the definition of “heritage” used to guide this inventory
is “based on the age of a known structure, its uniqueness, rarity, and contribution to
community culture and character” (2011).
根据多伦多及地区自然保护局(TRCA)获奖作品《穿越 Humber: Humber 河遗
产桥清单》(Crossing The Humber: The Humber River Heritage Bridge Inventory)
的例子，用于指导该清单的”遗产”定义是”基于已知结构的年代、其独特
性、稀有性以及对社区文化和特征的贡献”(2011)。
It is hoped that further
research on the watershed’s
bridges will continue to be
undertaken building on the
methodology and growing this
inventory.
2.2 Limitations
2.2 限制
Due to the extensive scope of this inventory and the limited temporal and financial resources available, some
limitations were unavoidable. The roadblocks experienced throughout the research process have been included to aid
in streamlining future inventory work.
由于这个库存的广泛范围和有限的时间和财政资源，一些限制是不可避免的。在整个研究过程中遇到的障
碍被包括在内，以帮助简化未来的库存工作。
The necessary reliance on multiple sources to obtain information made it difficult to ensure some bridges were not
missed through human error. For example, failure to attach an Ontario Structural Integrity Management (OSIM)
report for one bridge among many in an email, etc. Of the 678 structures that were inventoried, several more would
have been included if unused roads, private property and rail lines were explored. More bridges
由于必须依靠多种来源获取信息，因此难以确保某些桥梁不会因人为错误而被遗漏。例如，未能附加一个
安大略省结构诚信经营(OSIM)报告的一个桥梁，在许多在电子邮件，等等。在 678 个被列入清单的建筑物
中，如果未使用的道路、私人财产和铁路线被探索，还会有更多的建筑物被列入清单。More bridges 更多桥
梁
in the Region of Waterloo could also have been identified, however site visits were not
conducted as the Region had been extensively studied in two previ-ous inventories: Grand
Old Bridges and Spanning the Generations.
在滑铁卢地区也可以找到，但是没有进行实地考察，因为该地区已经在以前的两个
清单中进行了广泛的研究: 古老的大桥和跨越几代人。
To ensure time remained to visit and inventory unexplored portions of the
watershed, bridge information for the Region of Waterloo was extracted from
existing resources.
为了确保还有时间访问和盘点分水岭未勘探的部分，从现有资源中提取了
滑铁卢地区的桥梁信息。
The collection of archival information was also difficult as most relevant
information is scattered throughout the watershed’s 39 municipalities and two First
Nations, and maintained in varying degrees of organization by a plethora of
archives, groups, societies and committees. Information on builders, architects and
engineers was scarce and would have required a great deal of archival research.
收集档案资料也很困难，因为大多数相关资料分散在分水岭的 39 个城市和两
个第一民族，并由过多的档案、团体、社团和委员会以不同程度的组织方式
加以维护。关于建筑师、建筑师和工程师的信息很少，需要大量的档案研究。
9
Heritage Resources Centre
文物资源中心
The inventory’s inclusion of 167 structures did not permit in depth archival research on any one structure, rather
background information on each bridge was provided.
这份包含 167 座建筑物的清单不允许对任何一座建筑物进行深入的档案研究，而是提供了每座桥梁的背景信
息。
A specific obstacle that hindered the identification and evaluation process was the inability to confirm the exact
construction date of some bridges. The absence of historical records or incomplete maintenance reports contributed
to the necessity of hypothesizing some construction periods. Although the inclusion of this data would have allowed
for more precise evaluations, it is not believed to have negatively impacted the integrity of the inventory.
妨碍识别和评价进程的一个具体障碍是无法确定某些桥梁的确切建造日期。缺乏历史记录或不完整的维护
报告导致了假设一些施工期的必要性。尽管纳入这些数据将允许更精确的评估，但据信并没有对库存的完
整性产生负面影响。
Locating unknown watercourse names was another obstacle. GRCA GIS staff
provided support in identifying unknown rivers, creeks and streams. However,
many of the smaller watercourses are not formally named, resulting in an entry of
“Unknown” in the inventory’s river crossing section.
定位未知的水道名称是另一个障碍。GRCA 地理信息系统的工作人员为识别
未知的河流、小溪和溪流提供了支持。然而，许多较小的河道没有正式命名，
导致在清单的河流穿越部分输入“未知”。
The determination of an acceptable work plan for a heritage bridge
requires a case-specific balancing of all concerns. It is hoped that this
inventory will help to guide decisions that will affect bridges’ in the
future.
确定一个可接受的文物桥梁工作计划，需要在所有关注问题之间
取得具体个案的平衡。人们希望这份清单将有助于指导未来影响
桥梁的决策。
3.0 Methodology
3.0 方法论
The methodology of this inventory included five stages of research:
该清单的编制方法包括五个研究阶段:
1. Data gathering and bridge identification (sec. 3.1)
数据收集和桥梁识别(第 3.1 节)
2. Field inspections (sec. 3.2)
现场检查(第 3.2 节)
3. Archival research (sec. 3.3)
档案研究(第 3.3 节)
4. Community knowledge (sec. 3.4)
社区知识(第 3.4 节)
5. Evaluation (sec. 4.0)
评估(第 4.0 节)
It must be stated that this inventory
is not intended to take the place of
environmental and municipal
planning processes. This is a first
step in evaluating the watershed’s
heritage bridges, not a definitive
and exhaustive list of all extant
heritage bridges or an account of
each structure’s cultural heritage
value.
必须指出，本清单无意取代环境和
城市规划进程。这是评估流域遗产
桥梁的第一步，而不是对所有现存
遗产桥梁的确切和详尽的清单，或
对每个结构的文化遗产价值的说明。
Note: The methodology and criteria used for evaluation needs to be cognizant of the vast number of bridges
found in this 6,800 km2 watershed, and the limited time and financial/staff resources available to complete
the project. The information in this report is current as of February 1, 2013.
注: 评价所用的方法和标准需要认识到在这个 6800 平方公里的流域中发现的桥梁数量巨大，完成该
项目的时间和财政/人力资源有限。本报告中的信息截止到 2013 年 2 月 1 日。

3.1 桥梁识别

mapping and secondary sources of information, along with site visits was the chosen approach to bridge identification.
这份清单的目的是尽可能多地确定大河流域内的桥梁。依赖地图和次要信息来源，以及现场访问是桥梁识别的选
择方法。

为了确定流域中的桥梁和进行档案研究，咨询了下列小组:

3.2 Field Inspection
3.2 实地视察
Following the first stage of research, 678 bridges were included in the inventory. Information on each structure was
reviewed to determine if a site visit was necessary. Site visits were carried out to bridges with potential cultural
heritage value. This decision was made based on a bridge’s age, construction type, its surrounding context,
recommendations from the public, all in combination with information contained in Ontario Structural Integrity
Management (OSIM) reports obtained from municipalities.
在第一阶段的研究之后，678座桥梁被列入清单。对每个结构的信息进行审查，以确定是否需要进行现场访
问。对具有潜在文化遗产价值的桥梁进行实地考察。这一决定是根据桥梁的年龄、建筑类型、周围环境、
公众的建议，以及安大略省诚信经营(OSIM)从市政当局获得的结构完整性管理(OSIM)报告中所载的信息做
出的。
To ensure the watershed was systematically explored, a watershed-wide map was consulted to assist in dividing the
area into more manageable sections. Of the 39 upper, lower and single-tier municipalities and two First Nations that
comprise the watershed, 33 were found to contain bridges requiring field inspections. The remainder of the
municipalities are only partially located in the watershed and were not reported to contain potential heritage bridges.
As a result, they are not referenced in this report or included in the maps provided in Appendix A. To facilitate the
organization of site visits, small-scale maps were created for each municipality and potential heritage bridges were
plotted.
为了确保对流域进行系统的探索，征求了流域范围地图的意见，以协助将该地区划分为更易于管理的部分
在 39 个上层，下层和单层市政当局和两个第一民族组成的分水岭，33被发现包含桥梁需要实地检查。其余
的城市只是部分位于分水岭，并没有报告包含潜在的遗产桥梁。因此，本报告没有提及这些地图，也没有
将它们列入附录 a 所提供的地图中。为了便利实地考察的组织工作，为每个城市绘制了小比例尺地图，并
绘制了潜在的遗产桥梁。
11
11
Heritage Resources Centre
文物资源中心
To guide these site visits, an assessment protocol was created by the project’s Steering Committee. The Committee
was comprised of a diverse group of professionals working in the heritage, environmental and engineering fields.
The assessment protocol included the creation of a ‘Field Identification Form’ (Appendix B) to record site and
bridge specific details, as well as a procedure for photographic documentation. The goal of the Field Identification
Form was to record the location, type, materials, size, context and accessibility of a bridge. Additional factors based
on heritage designation criteria included in Ontario Regulation 9/06 were incorporated into the form to aid
researchers in determining if the bridge warranted further investigation as a candidate heritage bridge. Additional
factors assessed if the bridge was 35 years or older, contributed to a cultural heritage landscape, was a rare survivor,
remnant or unique type.
为了指导这些实地考察，项目督导委员会制定了一套评估方案。委员会由各种各样的专业人士组成，他们
在遗产、环境和工程领域工作。评估议定书包括编制”现场识别表格”(附录 b) ，以记录场址和桥梁的具体
细节，以及摄影记录程序。Field 识别表格的目标是记录桥梁的位置，类型，材料，大小，上下文和可访问
性。根据安大略省第 9/06 号条例所载遗产指定标准制定的其他因素被纳入该表格，以帮助研究人员确定该
桥是否值得作为候选文化遗产保护状况进一步调查。其他因素评估桥梁是否为 35 年或以上，有助于文化遗
产景观，是一个罕见的幸存者，遗留或独特类型。
To determine the existence of railway structures within the watershed, municipal maps were reviewed to locate rail
lines. Bridges that could be accessed via public property were documented. Given time constraints, structures that
proved difficult to access were not included. Information was requested from railway companies, however the
resources received did not facilitate the identification of additional bridges.
为了确定流域内是否存在铁路结构，对市政地图进行了审查，以确定铁路线的位置。可以通过公共财产进
入的桥梁被记录在案。给定的时间限制，结构证明难以访问不包括在内。要求铁路公司提供信息，但是收
到的资源并不能帮助确定更多的桥梁。
Due to the noted time and financial constraints associated with this project, private structures were not exhaustively
researched. However, seven notable bridges were discovered while conducting field inspections of other structures,
and included active and abandoned bridges, along with remnant abutments. The oldest earth-filled concrete arch
bridge (1908) in the watershed was discovered on private property in the Township of Centre Wellington.
由于与该项目相关的时间和财政限制，私人结构没有进行详尽的研究。然而，在对其他结构进行实地检查
时，发现了 7 座著名的桥梁，包括活动桥梁和废弃桥梁，以及残余的桥台。流域中最古老的填土混凝土拱桥
(1908 年)在中威灵顿乡的私人财产中被发现。
The Project Manager, a University of Waterloo co-op student and a Summer Experience Student carried out the
assess-ment and photography of 367 structures between June and September of 2012. The information gathered was
added to the electronic database to aid in the creation of a short list of bridges with heritage significance. This list
represented structures that merited further archival research and evaluation, to be discussed in Section 4.
2012 年 6 月至 9 月，滑铁卢大学合作社学生项目经理和暑期体验学生对 367 座建筑物进行了评估和拍摄。收
集到的信息被添加到电子数据库，以帮助创建一个具有重要文化遗产意义的桥梁短名单。这个列表代表了
值得进一步的档案研究和评估的结构，将在第 4 节讨论。
3.3 Archival Research
3.3 档案研究
The objective of this inventory was to identify bridges that have potential heritage value and could be listed on a
municipal register or designated following additional research and evaluation. As such, a cursory amount of research
was conducted on each bridge in an effort to examine and include as many structures as possible in the inventory.
这一清单的目的是确定具有潜在遗产价值的桥梁，可以列入市政登记册或在进一步研究和评估后指定。因
此，对每座桥梁进行了粗略的研究，以努力检查和包括尽可能多的结构在目录中。
Following the data gathering and field inspection stages of research, the compiled short list of bridges with
anticipated heritage significance was further researched. Although information on some structures was not available
or did not exist, museums, archives, heritage committees, libraries, historians and members of the public were
consulted to gather archival information.
经过数据收集和实地考察阶段的研究，编制的具有预期遗产意义的桥梁短名单进一步研究。虽然没有或根
本没有关于某些结构的资料，但为了收集档案资料，还是征求了博物馆、档案馆、文物委员会、图书馆、
历史学家和公众的意见。
3.4 Community Knowledge
3.4 社区知识
Local expertise, knowledge and community networks of the project team were relied upon to supplement archival
research. Through reaching out to colleagues and researching additional suggestions, more site visits were carried
out to newly discovered bridges, and the history of identified bridges grew richer. As well, the knowledge held by
local residents encountered in the field, and their willingness to share their history passed down through generations
of collective memory, further supplemented the research. Four bridges included in the inventory now have more
intricate histories thanks to the insight of residents and property owners.
项目团队的当地专业知识、知识和社区网络被用来补充档案研究。通过联系同事和研究额外的建议，对新
发现的桥梁进行了更多的实地考察，确定的桥梁的历史变得更加丰富。此外，当地居民在实地遇到的知识 ，
以及他们愿意分享他们的历史，通过代代相传的集体记忆，进一步补充了研究。由于居民和业主的洞察力 ，
目录中包含的四座桥梁现在有了更加复杂的历史。

Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
Arch，Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单
4.0 Evaluation
4.0 评估
In order to narrow the short list of bridges to a definitive list of heritage structures, evaluation criteria adapted from
Ontario Regulation 9/06: Criteria for determining cultural heritage value or interest was applied (see Appendix I).
The TRCA’s inventory, Crossing the Humber, proved to be an effective test case for the application of these criteria,
and inspired its use in this research.
为了将简短的桥梁清单缩小到最终的遗产结构清单，采用了根据安大略第 9/06 号条例改编的评估标准: 确定
文化遗产价值或利益的标准(见附录一)。TRCA 的清单，跨越亨伯，被证明是一个有效的测试案例，这些标
准的应用，并启发其在这项研究中的使用。
The adapted criteria contained in Ontario Regulation 9/06 read as follows:
安大略第 9/06 号条例所载的调整标准如下:
Design/Physical Value
设计/物理价值
I. Is a rare, unique, representative or early example of a style, type, expression, material or construction
是一种罕见的，独特的，有代表性的或早期的样式，类型，表达，材料或结构的例子
method
方法
II. Displays a high degree of craftsmanship or artistic merit
表现出高度的技艺或艺术价值
III. Demonstrates a high degree of technical or scientific achievement
表现出高度的技术或科学成就
Historic/Associative Value
历史/关联价值
I. Has direct associations with a theme, event, belief, person, activity, organization, or institution that is
significant to a community
与主题、事件、信仰、个人、活动、组织或机构有直接联系，对社区有重要意义
II. Yields, or has the potential to yield, information that contributes to an understanding of a community
or culture
产生或有可能产生有助于理解一个社区或文化的信息
III. Demonstrates or reflects the work or ideas of an architect, artist, engineer, builder, designer or theorist
who is significant to a community
展示或反映建筑师、艺术家、工程师、建筑师、设计师或理论家对社区有重要意义的作品或想法
Contextual Value
背景价值
I. Is important in defining, maintaining or supporting the character of an area
在界定、维持或支持一个地区的特征方面是重要的
II. Is physically, functionally, visually or historically linked to its surroundings
在物理上、功能上、视觉上或历史上与周围环境相联系
III. Is a landmark
是一个里程碑
The criteria were adapted slightly from the original form to incorporate the word “engineer” in the third criteria
under historic/associative value. Due to the nature of bridges, engineers may hold significant associative value as
they directly influence a bridge’s construction, function and appearance.
这些标准与原来的形式略有改动，以便将”工程师”一词纳入历史/联想价值下的第三项标准。由于桥梁的
性质，工程师可能具有重要的联想价值，因为他们直接影响桥梁的建设，功能和外观。
Following a provision in the Ontario Heritage Act (OHA) in 2005, Ontario
Regulation 9/06 was created. Although previous inventories did not have the
option to evaluate bridges in this way, it now allows for consistent and objective
evaluation criteria, representing a step towards designation under the OHA.
根据 2005 年安大略省遗产法案(OHA)的一项规定，安大略省第 9/06 号法规
被创建。虽然以前的清单没有以这种方式评价桥梁的选择，但现在允许采
用一致和客观的评价标准，这是朝着按照人道协调厅指定的方向迈出的一
步。

Although 167 heritage bridges in the Grand River watershed is a significant number, that figure would have been
higher if not for the demolition and replacement of older, often times deteriorating bridges. Information on 38
demolished, and probable heritage bridges, has been recorded in this inventory (Appendix E). Many of these
structures have been replaced with newer bridges capable of handling increased traffic volumes and loads or were
removed due to deteriorating conditions. The total number of heritage bridges would have also been significantly
higher if culverts were included, along with bridges that span roads and railways.
尽管大河流域有 167 座历史遗产桥梁，这是一个相当大的数字，但如果不是拆除和更换老旧的桥梁，这个数
字还会更高。本清单记录了 38 座被拆除的桥梁和可能的遗产桥梁的信息(附录 e)。许多这些结构已经被能够
处理增加的交通量和负荷的新桥所取代，或者由于条件恶化而被移除。如果涵洞以及跨越公路和铁路的桥
梁也包括在内，遗产桥梁的总数也会显著增加。

of the 167 heritage bridges can be found in the following pages.

到。

General Description
一般描述
The Caledonia Bridge spans the Grand River on Argyle Street North, between Forfar Street West and Caithness
Street in the town of Caledonia. The property consists of a nine-span concrete bowstring arch bridge that was
constructed in 1927. It is the longest bowstring arch bridge in Ontario and Canada. Due to its outstanding design and
scale, the structure was included on the Ontario Heritage Bridge List in 1990. It is the only remaining concrete
bowstring arch bridge in Haldimand County and one of few remaining examples of this bridge type as the
demolition of similar structures of shorter length have been accelerating in recent years.
喀里多尼亚大桥横跨阿盖尔北街的格兰德河，位于福弗尔西街和喀里多尼亚小镇的凯斯内斯街之间。该项
目包括一座建于 1927 年的九跨混凝土拱桥。它是安大略省和加拿大最长的弓弦拱桥。由于其出色的设计和
规模，该结构在 1990 年被列入安大略省遗产桥梁名单。这是哈尔迪曼德县仅存的一座混凝土弓弦拱桥，也
是这种桥型仅存的几个例子之一，因为近年来类似的短长结构的拆除速度不断加快。
The Caledonia Bridge is the fourth permanent bridge to be constructed at this crossing. The first bridge, of crib and
frame construction, was washed away by ice and floods. The second bridge, constructed in 1842, was a 60-foot
(18m) wide, six-span wooden structure reinforced with steel plates. It was constructed to provide permanent and
unimpeded passage to the plank road between Hamilton and Port Dover. After 19 years this structure was also
destroyed by the elements. In 1875, a large and impressive five-span iron Whipple Arch truss bridge was
constructed. This crossing became a toll bridge, and adjacent to the structure a red and buff brick Gothic revival
house was built for the new bridge’s toll keeper. Tolls were collected until about 1890 to help defray the cost of the
bridge, which was roughly $22,500. This former toll house still sits next to the Caledonia Bridge. It has been
designated for its cultural heritage value under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (By-law 655/88).
喀里多尼亚大桥是在这个交叉口建造的第四座永久性大桥。第一座桥梁是由摇篮和框架结构建造的，被冰
和洪水冲走了。第二座桥建于 1842 年，宽 60 英尺(18 米) ，六跨木结构，用钢板加固。它的建造为汉密尔
顿和多佛港之间的木板路提供了永久和不受阻碍的通道。19年后，这个结构也被自然力量摧毁了。1875年，
一座巨大而令人印象深刻的五跨铁质 Whipple 拱桁架桥建成。这座桥变成了一座收费桥，在桥的旁边建起
了一座红色和浅黄色的哥特式复兴建筑，供新桥的收费员使用。大约在 1890 年之前，通行费一直被征收，
以帮助支付大桥的费用，大约 22500 美元。这个以前的收费站现在仍然坐落在喀里多尼亚大桥旁边。根据
安大略省遗产法第四部分(第 655/88 号法令) ，它被指定为文化遗产价值。
In 1925, this third bridge on site collapsed under the weight of a truck carrying a load of stone. Following
negotiations between the Provincial government and the County Council, the existing Caledonia Bridge was
constructed in 1927. It was built by the Department of Public Highways of Ontario and Randolph MacDonald Co.
Limited, and was designed by A. B. Crealock, bridge engineer with the Department of Public Works. The bridge’s
erection took five months and was undertaken from June to November of 1927. Its opening was celebrated by the
town with a street dance.
1925 年，现场的第三座桥在一辆载满石头的卡车的重压下倒塌。经过省政府和县议会的协商，现有的喀里
多尼亚大桥于 1927 年建成。它由安大略省公路部和伦道夫麦当劳有限公司共同建造，由公共工程部桥梁工
程师 A.b. 克里洛克设计。大桥的建造历时 5 个月，于 1927 年 6 月至 11 月间完成。为了庆祝它的开通，小镇
举行了街头舞会。

Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
Arch，Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单
The Caledonia Bridge is a landmark gateway to the town centre. It provides both a vehicular and pedestrian link
between the residential areas to the south and the commercial core. For those passing through Caledonia it
demarcates the entrance to the community and the exit from it. The arches are graceful with slight indentations.
Pedestrian sidewalks on either side allow for excellent scenic viewing both up and down the Grand River. The
bridge is a locally recognized heritage asset that contributes to the special character of Caledonia and the
surrounding landscape.
喀里多尼亚大桥是通往市中心的地标性门户。它提供了南部居民区和商业中心之间的车辆和行人通道。对
于那些经过喀里多尼亚的人来说，它划分了社区的入口和出口。拱门优雅，有轻微的凹痕。两边的人行道
可以观赏到格兰德河上下游的优美景色。这座桥是当地公认的遗产资产，有助于喀里多尼亚的特色和周围
的景观。
The bridge is part of a group of four multiple-span concrete bowstring arch bridges spanning the Grand River that
were erected in the same time period and in a similar style. These bridges are a part of the upgrading work that took
place to the transportation networks in Ontario, after World War I, to accommodate the increased number of
automobiles. This group includes three bridges within the Region of Waterloo: the Freeport Bridge and Bridgeport
Bridge in the City of Kitchener, and the Main Street Bridge in the City of Cambridge.
这座桥是四座跨越格兰德河的多跨混凝土拱桥的一部分，这些拱桥都是在同一时期以类似的风格建造的。
这些桥梁是第一次世界大战后安大略省交通网络升级工作的一部分，以适应汽车数量的增加。这组桥梁包
括滑铁卢地区的三座桥梁: 基奇纳市的弗里奇波特大桥和布里奇波特大桥，以及剑桥市的主要街道大桥。
Due to the Caledonia Bridge’s deteriorating condition, it underwent short-term repairs in 2008. It is likely that the
bridge will be replaced in 2016 with a wider structure able to accommodate heavy traffic.
由于喀里多尼亚大桥的状况不断恶化，它在 2008 年进行了短期维修。这座桥很可能在 2016 年被更宽的结构
所取代，以适应繁忙的交通。
Sources: Historicbridges.org
来源: historicbridges. org

General Description
一般描述
The Cayuga Bridge is located on Talbot Road (Highway 3) between Maple Road and Ouse Street in the Town of
Cayuga. This bridge is recognized as a rare survivor on a provincial highway of a multi-span through truss steel
bridge. It is an attractive structure that marks the entrance to or exit from Cayuga on the west edge of the
community. The bridge is associated with the Talbot Road, an early road in southwestern Ontario that was taken
over by the Department of Highways in 1920 as part of the development of a provincial highway system. The bridge
is the third structure over the Grand River in Cayuga and the second at this location. The first bridge (1842) was
situated to the north of the existing bridge and the second bridge (1871) was located on the same alignment as the
existing bridge. The bridge is also situated in a site of archaeological importance. Three time periods are represented
on the west riverbank, and the entire flood plain is an active site. Stage 4 archaeological salvage efforts have
recovered ceramics, tools, and remnants of a historic stone structure.
卡尤加大桥位于卡尤加镇枫树路和 Ouse 街之间的 Talbot 路(3 号公路)上。这座桥被公认为是省级高速公路
上罕见的幸存者，这是一座多跨度的桁架钢桥。这是一个有吸引力的结构，标志着进入或出口卡尤加在社
区的西边缘。这座桥与塔尔博特公路有关，塔尔博特公路是安大略省西南部的一条早期公路，1920年被公
路部接管，作为省级公路系统发展的一部分。这座桥是位于卡尤加的格兰德河上的第三座桥，也是这里的
第二座桥。第一座桥(1842 年)位于现有桥梁的北部，第二座桥(1871 年)与现有桥梁位于同一线路上。这座桥
也位于一个具有重要考古价值的地点。河西岸分为三个时期，整个洪泛区是一个活跃的地点。第四阶段的
考古抢救工作已经恢复了陶瓷、工具和一个历史性石头结构的遗迹。
The Department of Highways under George Hogarth, Chief Engineer, prepared a design for the Cayuga Bridge in
1923. The Department of Highway Annual Report (1925) states that the Grand River Bridge at Cayuga was
completed in 1924 and replaced “an old iron bridge that was not only unsafe but entirely unsuited to present day
traffic” (p. 69). The Canadian Engineering and Contracting Company constructed the concrete substructure for the
sum of $57,000 and the Dominion Bridge Company supplied and erected the steel superstructure for $57,000. The
Department of Highways provided the balance of the work. The total cost of the bridge was $126,600.
在首席工程师乔治 · 霍加斯(George Hogarth)的领导下，公路部于 1923 年为卡尤加大桥(Cayuga Bridge)准备
了一份设计方案。公路部年度报告(1925 年)指出，卡尤加的大河大桥于 1924 年竣工，取代了”一座不仅不
安全而且完全不适合当今交通的旧铁桥”(第 69 页)。加拿大工程和承包公司以 57000 美元的价格建造了混
凝土下层结构，Dominion Bridge 公司以 57000 美元的价格提供和建造了钢结构上层结构。公路部提供了剩
余的工程。这座桥的总造价为 126,600 美元。
The Grand River Bridge at Cayuga is a five span, steel bridge. The through truss design uses Pratt trusses with parallel
chords. The steel members provided by Carnegie Steel are riveted in place and the steel superstructure is bolted to
concrete piers. On the north side of the bridge, a six-foot wide sidewalk is cantilevered on the outside of the truss with
original lattice railing. Plaques, likely maker’s plaques, located on the end truss at either end of the bridge beside the
sidewalk are visible in historical photographs. However, they appear to have been removed in the early 1970s.
卡尤加的大河大桥是一座五跨钢桥。直通式桁架设计采用了带有平行弦的普拉特桁架。卡内基钢铁公司提供的钢
构件被铆接到位，钢结构上部结构被螺栓固定在混凝土桥墩上。在桥的北侧，一条 6 英尺宽的人行道悬臂在桁架
外侧，原有的格子栏杆。在历史照片中可以看到位于人行道两侧桥梁两端桁架上的牌匾，很可能是制造者的牌匾。
然而，它们似乎是在 20 世纪 70 年代早期被移除的。
19
19
Heritage Resources Centre
文物资源中心
Repairs to the piers were undertaken in March 1971. An extensive rehabilitation of the bridge took place in 1976
including the installation of a new concrete deck, repair of the truss members, rehabilitation of expansion joints and
bearings and repair of concrete retaining walls, wing walls and abutments. The rehabilitation steel work is
identifiable from the original by the ‘Abitibi’ steel members bolted in place.
码头的维修工程于 1971 年 3 月进行。1976 年对该桥进行了广泛的修复，包括安装一个新的混凝土桥面，修
复桁架构件，修复伸缩缝和支座，以及修复混凝土挡土墙、翼墙和桥台。修复后的钢结构可以从原来的
Abitibi 钢结构构件中识别出来。
The Cayuga Bridge is a rare survivor as few truss bridges remain in use within the Provincial highway system and it
is the only surviving steel through truss bridge on a provincial highway in southwestern Ontario. Only 15 through
truss bridges exist on provincially-owned roads in the Province of Ontario. It is also notable for the number of spans
(5), its total length, concrete piers and walkway on the north side. The structure is visually appealing and contributes
to the character of the surrounding cultural heritage landscape. It is a physical landmark in the Town of Cayuga and
acts as a gateway into and out of the community from the west.
卡尤加大桥是一个罕见的幸存者，因为在省级公路系统中几乎没有桁架桥仍在使用，它是安大略省西南部
省级公路上唯一幸存下来的钢结构通过桁架桥。安大略省省属公路上仅存 15 座直通桁架桥。同样值得注意
的是桥的跨度(5) ，桥的总长度，北侧的混凝土桥墩和走道。这个结构在视觉上很有吸引力，并且有助于周
围文化遗产景观的特点。它是卡尤加小镇的一个地标性建筑，作为一个从西部进出社区的门户。
Due to heavy truck traffic the Cayuga Bridge has deteriorated. It is scheduled for replacement by the end of 2013.
由于重型卡车交通，卡尤加大桥已经损坏，计划在 2013 年底更换。
