General Description
一般描述
The Seneca Bridge is a small steel and concrete Warren pony truss bridge that crosses Black Creek on River Road
(Highway 54) in Seneca Park, Haldimand County. Following the 1912 Good Road Convention’s guidelines, the
bridge was constructed to handle all the road traffic between Caledonia and Cayuga.
塞尼卡大桥是一座小型钢筋混凝土瓦伦小马桁架桥，横跨哈尔迪曼德县塞尼卡公园的黑溪河路(54 号高速公
路)。根据 1912 年《良好道路公约》的指导方针，建造这座桥是为了处理喀里多尼亚和卡尤加之间的所有道
路交通。
The Good Road Convention, at Toronto on May 7, 1912, recommended that all new bridges from 4-40 feet in length be
built with steel beams embedded in concrete for structural stability. Any bridge over 40 feet (12m) in length should be
built solely of steel. The Seneca Bridge, built in 1912, and following these recommendations, has lasted more than 100
years. Though it is no longer in use, the bridge’s steel under supports and decorated side crash walls remain intact.
1912 年 5 月 7 日在多伦多举行的《好路公约》建议，所有 4-40 英尺长的新桥都应该用钢梁嵌入混凝土，以保证结
构的稳定性。任何长度超过 40 英尺(12 米)的桥梁都应该完全用钢材建造。塞尼卡大桥建于 1912 年，遵循这些建
议，已经持续了 100 多年。虽然现在已经不再使用，但是桥梁的钢材支撑和装饰的侧面防撞墙仍然完好无损。
Constructed by local contractor Melvin Runchey, the bridge stands as a testament to the area’s economic development.
这座桥由当地承包商 Melvin Runchey 建造，是该地区经济发展的见证。
It is also one of very few remaining bridges constructed of Linerod steel.
它也是仅存的几座用 Linerod 钢铁建造的桥梁之一。
The Ontario provincial government took over control of River Road between Cayuga and Caledonia from the Country, in
or before 1937. At that time, it was renamed Highway 54. The Seneca Bridge handled all traffic between the two towns
from 38 years until 1950 when it was closed and replaced with a larger structure. The Seneca Bridge was desig-nated for
its cultural heritage value under the Ontario Heritage Act in 1984 through Haldimand County By-law 443/84.
1937 年或之前，安大略省政府从该国接管了卡尤加和喀里多尼亚之间的河道。当时，它被重新命名为 54 号公路。
塞尼卡大桥承载着两个城镇之间 38 年来的所有交通，直到 1950 年关闭，取而代之的是一个更大的结构。塞尼卡
大桥是根据 1984 年通过哈尔迪曼德县第 443/84 号法律的《安大略遗产法》设计的文化遗产价值。
Sources: Canadian Register of Historic Places
资料来源: 加拿大历史名胜名录

General Description
一般描述
The York Bridge is located on Haldimand Road 9, 0.4 km east of River Road in the community of York. This four-
span steel girder bridge was built in 1935. It spans the Grand River upon concrete piers and abutments. The deck
carries two lanes of traffic and is adorned with metal railings. It represents a landmark in the communi-ty of York
linking the small commercial centre to the River Road, which leads to the nearby Town of Caledonia. The York
Bridge underwent rehabilitation in 2007.
约克大桥位于 Haldimand 路 9 号，约克社区的 River Road 以东 0.4 公里。这座四跨钢梁桥建于 1935 年。它
在混凝土桥墩和桥墩上横跨格兰德河。甲板承载着两条车道，并用金属栏杆装饰。它是约克社区的一个地
标性建筑，连接着小型商业中心和通往附近喀里多尼亚小镇的河道。约克大桥在 2007 年进行了修复。

General Description
一般描述
The Dunnville Bridge is located on Rainham Road (Queen Street), 0.1 km west of Highway 3 (Main Street) in the
Town of Dunnville. This eight-span steel I-beam bridge was constructed in 1963. It crosses the Grand River and is
set upon concrete piers and abutments. The deck carries two lanes of traffic and metal railings with concrete ends
embossed with decorative horizontal lines.
邓维尔大桥位于雷纳姆公路(皇后街) ，3号公路(主街)以西 0.1 公里的邓维尔镇。这座 8 跨 i 型钢梁桥建于
1963 年。它横跨格兰德河，建在混凝土桥墩和桥墩上。甲板上有两条车道的交通和金属栏杆，混凝土两端
浮雕着装饰性的水平线。
Bridges have been located at this site since the 1830s when the Welland “feeder” canal was built here. Earlier
structures were of wood construction. The current bridge’s piers are significantly wider than the bridge deck
indicating that they may have previously carried another structure.
自 19 世纪 30 年代威兰“支流”运河建成以来，这里就一直有桥梁。早期的结构是木结构。现在这座桥的桥
墩比桥面宽得多，这表明它们之前可能承载了另一种结构。
The Dunnville Bridge represents a landmark in the area linking the smaller community of Byng to the Town of Dun-
nville on the north shore of the Grand River. The bridge underwent rehabilitation in 1991 and 2011.
邓维尔大桥是这个地区的一个地标性建筑，它把宾的小社区与格兰德河北岸的邓维尔镇连接起来。这座桥
在 1991 年和 2011 年进行了修复。

General Description
一般描述
The Caledonia Railway Bridge is located 0.7 km west of Argyle St. North in the Town of Caledonia. The Northern
& Northwestern Railway originated this line of track in 1875 and later fell under ownership of the Grand Trunk
Railway. The current railway bridge was constructed in 1911 and is now owned by the Canadian National Railway.
It still carries an active rail line through the Town of Caledonia.
喀里多尼亚铁路大桥位于喀里多尼亚城市阿盖尔大街以西 0.7 公里处。北部和西北部铁路在 1875 年起源于
这条铁路线，后来归大主干铁路所有。现在的铁路桥建于 1911 年，现在归加拿大国家铁路公司所有。它仍
然承载着一条贯穿喀里多尼亚小镇的铁路线。
The bridge’s eleven-span structural steel frame is set high above the Grand River on alternating concrete and
masonry piers. It is sited just east of a dam across the Grand River. Due to the bridge’s physical prominence it acts
as a landmark along the riverscape in the Town of Caledonia, joined by the Grand River Mill and striking Caledonia
bowstring arch bridge located just south of this structure.
这座桥的 11 跨结构钢框架高高地矗立在格兰德河上，混凝土和砖石桥墩相互交替。它坐落在横跨格兰德河
的一座大坝的东面。由于桥的物理突出，它作为一个地标沿河景观在喀里多尼亚城，加入大河磨坊和引人
注目的喀里多尼亚弓弦拱桥位于这个结构南部。

General Description
一般描述
The Cayuga Railway Bridge is located north of Talbot Road (Highway 3), between Maple Road and Munsee Street North
in the Town of Cayuga. The first railway bridge at this site spanning the Grand River, built in 1872, was replaced after an
accident on the bridge in 1877. The present bridge was constructed in 1902. The bridge is a five-panel rivet-connected
Pratt deck truss that is set above the Grand River on four piers of varying design and construction materials. Some of the
piers are composed of decoratively embossed concrete, masonry or a combination of both. It is likely that the original
abutments and piers were built of stone while later rehabilitation efforts resulted in the use of concrete.
卡尤加铁路大桥位于塔尔博特路(3 号高速公路)以北，介乎枫树路和卡尤加镇的孟西北街之间。第一座横跨大河
的铁路桥建于 1872 年，在 1877 年桥上发生事故后被更换。现在的这座桥建于 1902 年。这座桥是一座由五个面板
的铆钉连接的普拉特桥面桁架，位于格兰德河上方，四个桥墩采用不同的设计和建筑材料。一些桥墩由装饰性浮
雕混凝土、砖石或两者的组合构成。原来的桥台和桥墩很可能是用石头建造的，而后来的修复工作导致了混凝土
的使用。
The advent of the railways to the towns along the Grand River drew trade away from the river. The Great Western
Railway began the Canada Air Line as an alternate route to the Canadian Southern Railway. The line ran from Fort
Erie through Welland Junction, Canfield, Tillsonburg and St. Thomas to meet up with the Great Western Railway at
Glencoe. The Cayuga Subdivision between Robbins and St. Thomas opened for traffic in 1873. The rail line ran east
to west along the north side of Cayuga with a station located close to where Munsee Street North (Highway 54)
crosses the rail line. After a series of amalgamations, the line became part of the Canadian National (CN) Railway
system in 1923. CN owned this line until it was abandoned in 1996.
通往格兰德河沿岸城镇的铁路的出现，把贸易从格兰德河吸引过来。大西部铁路开通了加拿大航空公司，
作为通往加拿大南部铁路的替代路线。这条铁路从伊利堡穿过威兰交界处，坎菲尔德，蒂尔森堡和圣托马
斯，在格伦科与大西部铁路会合。罗宾斯和圣托马斯之间的卡尤加分区于 1873 年通车。这条铁路线沿着卡
尤加的北边向东向西延伸，有一个车站位于蒙西北街(54 号高速公路)与铁路线交叉的地方附近。经过一系
列的合并，这条线路在 1923 年成为加拿大国家铁路系统的一部分。CN 拥有这条铁路，直到 1996 年被废弃。
The bridge’s physical prominence contributes to the riverscape in the Town of Cayuga, joined by the multi-span
Cayuga Bridge located just south of this structure.
大桥的物理突出贡献了卡尤加镇的河流景观，连接多跨卡尤加大桥位于这个结构的南部。
Sources: Andreae, C. (1997). Lines of Country: An atlas of railway and waterway history in Canada
资料来源: Andreae，c. (1997)。国家线: 加拿大铁路和水路历史地图集

General Description
一般描述
The former River Road Bridge is located parallel to River Road, 3.9 km south of Highway 3. It was constructed
circa 1920 and is estimated to be one of few early remaining half through girder bridges in Haldimand County. The
bridge is now abandoned and was likely closed to traffic in 1965 when River Road was realigned and the current
concrete rigid frame bridge, Structure Number 000017, was built.
原河道桥位于 3 号公路以南 3.9 公里，与河道平行。这座桥大约建于 1920 年，估计是哈尔迪曼德县仅存的
几座早期半横梁桥之一。这座桥现在已经废弃了，可能在 1965 年被关闭，当时河道被重新定线，现在的混
凝土刚架桥，结构编号 000017 建成。
There is little information available on this structure. Large stones in the concrete and the impression of thin board
marks used to set the concrete on site indicate that it is of early construction. The bridge exhibits solid concrete
railings embossed with decorative square and rectangular panels, as well as square concrete top caps and
pronounced concrete footings. “Art Gibson 1950” is hand written in one of the concrete of abutments, perhaps
indicating a previous rehabili-tation date as the concrete appears newer than the rest of the bridge.
关于这个结构的信息很少。混凝土中的大石块和用来在现场固定混凝土的薄板标记表明它是早期建造的。
桥梁展示了实心混凝土栏杆浮雕装饰方形和矩形板，以及方形混凝土顶盖和明显的混凝土基础。“艺术吉
布森 1950 年”是手写在一个混凝土的桥墩，也许表明一个以前的修复日期，因为混凝土似乎比桥梁的其他
部分新。
Source: Haldimand County Municipal Structure Inspection Forms, 2011, G. Douglas Vallee Limited
资料来源: 2011 年哈尔迪曼德县市政结构检查表，g. Douglas Vallee 有限公司

General Description
一般描述
The Lorne Bridge spans the Grand River on Colborne Street between Brant Avenue and Icomm Drive in the City of
Brantford. The property consists of a three-span reinforced concrete arch bridge that was constructed in 1924. It is
located on the Grand River near Brant’s Crossing, a ford representing an historic crossing.
洛恩大桥横跨科尔伯恩大街上的格兰德河，位于布兰特大道和布兰特福德市的 Icomm 大道之间。该建筑由
一座建于 1924 年的三跨钢筋混凝土拱桥组成。它坐落在布兰特渡口附近的格兰德河上，这是一个代表历史
性渡口的浅滩。
The first bridge on this site was timber and was constructed in 1812. The wooden structure collapsed when the first
team of horses crossed it. Next, an iron bridge was built, but it was destroyed by high waters in 1878. In response,
the original Lorne Bridge was built in 1879, and it was named after the Marquis of Lorne. The Marquis of Lorne,
who served as Governor General of Canada from 1878-1883, helped found the National Art Gallery and married
Queen Victoria’s fourth daughter. Cracks in the first Lorne Bridge necessitated the bridge’s replacement with the
current struc-ture, which was built between 1923 and 1924.
这里的第一座桥是木桥，建于 1812 年。当第一队马跨过桥时，木结构倒塌了。接下来，一座铁桥建成了，
但在 1878 年被洪水摧毁。作为回应，最初的洛恩大桥建于 1879 年，并以洛恩侯爵的名字命名。1878年至
1883 年担任加拿大总督的洛恩侯爵帮助建立了国家美术馆，并与维多利亚女王的第四个女儿结婚。第一座
洛恩大桥的裂缝使得这座大桥不得不换成现在的结构，这座桥建于 1923 年至 1924 年之间。
Brantford City Engineer, Frank P. Adams, designed the three-span reinforced concrete arch bridge. The bridge was
constructed by the Port Arthur Construction Company. The Lorne Bridge is a good example of the period when
bridge construction shifted from a reliance on steel to concrete. Adams designed the bridge in concrete because he
felt it was superior to steel. He believed concrete bridges were easier to maintain and were able to display beauty
and design more prominently. Unlike steel, concrete strengthened over time and the material required no painting or
rust removal. The foundation support consists of three identical arches set upon abutments and together these arches
span 424 feet (129m). Between each arch and the super structure are a series of looped braces. The design creates a
distinct light shadow effect.
布兰特福德城市工程师弗兰克 p 亚当斯设计了三跨钢筋混凝土拱桥。这座桥由阿瑟港建筑公司建造。洛恩
大桥是一个很好的例子，当时桥梁建设从依赖钢铁转向混凝土。亚当斯之所以用混凝土来设计这座桥，是
因为他觉得它比钢铁更优越。他相信混凝土桥梁更容易维护，能够展示美丽，设计更突出。与钢铁不同的
是，混凝土随着时间的推移得到了加固，而且这种材料不需要油漆或除锈。地基支撑由三个相同的拱门组
成，这些拱门一起跨越 424 英尺(129 米)。在每个拱和上部结构之间有一系列的环形支撑。设计创造了一个
独特的光影效果。
R.S. Middleton, City Engineer, reconstructed the superstructure in 1980. The reconstruction removed the original
decorative balustrades and improvements were made to the deck. However, the stairs leading from the bridge to Lorne
Park still feature the 1920s decorative open balustrades with thick handrails and tear drop-shaped balusters and flag masts.
A plaque with the city’s crest is located on the north side of the bridge and identifies the construction date and
米德尔顿，城市工程师，在 1980 年重建了上层建筑。重建拆除了原有的装饰性栏杆，并对甲板进行了改进。然
而，从大桥通往洛恩公园的楼梯仍以 20 世纪 20 年代装饰性的开放式栏杆为特色，栏杆上有厚厚的扶手，还有泪
滴形的栏杆和旗杆。大桥北侧有一块刻有洛杉矶城徽的牌匾，上面标明了建造日期和时间
34
34
Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
Arch，Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单
individuals, organizations and companies involved in the construction of Lorne Bridge.
参与洛恩大桥建设的个人、组织和公司。
The Lorne Bridge spans the Grand River and is a prominent landmark in Brantford. The northern reaches of the
bridge rest close to the Dufferin Armouries, the neighbouring Lorne Park and Boer War Memorial, along with the
nearby bridges spanning the Grand River, all of which contribute to the formation of an important cultural heritage
landscape in the City of Brantford.
洛恩大桥横跨格兰德河，是布兰特福德的标志性建筑。桥的北端靠近杜夫林军械库、邻近的洛恩公园和布
尔战争纪念碑，以及附近横跨格兰河的桥梁，所有这些都有助于形成布兰特福德市重要的文化遗产景观。
Sources: City of Brantford Bridge Appraisal Data
资料来源: 布兰特福德桥市评估数据

General Description
一般描述
The Toronto, Hamilton and Buffalo Railway (T.H. & B.) Bridge spans the Grand River between Colborne Street West and
Veterans Memorial Parkway in the City of Brantford. The structure is a four-span steel half through beam bridge with a
timber deck, steel piers and cut stone masonry abutments that was constructed in 1890. “Illinois, USA” is pressed in the
bridges steel beams, indicating the steel was likely sourced from the Illinois Steel Company. At this time it was the
world’s largest steel company and formed in 1889 through the merger of most of the large Chi-cago-area mills—including
North Chicago, South Works, Union, and Joliet. Importing steel from the USA was a common occurrence in steel bridge
construction in Ontario as the material was easily transported by rail.
多伦多、汉密尔顿和布法罗铁路大桥横跨科尔伯恩西街和布兰特福德市退伍军人纪念公园大道之间的格兰德河。
这座桥的结构是一座四跨钢结构的中承式梁桥，桥面为木质甲板，桥墩为钢结构，桥台为切割石砌体，建于 1890
年。美国伊利诺斯州被压在桥梁的钢梁上，这表明钢材很可能来自伊利诺斯钢铁公司。当时它是世界上最大的钢
铁公司，1889 年通过芝加哥地区大多数大型钢铁厂的合并而成立，包括芝加哥北部、南方工厂、联合钢铁公司和
乔利埃特钢铁公司。从美国进口钢材是安大略省钢桥建设中的常见现象，因为材料很容易通过铁路运输。
The T.H. & B. Railway likely built this bridge. In the 1870s the T.H. & B. Railway was organized as an attempt to break
the stranglehold that the Great Western Railway (G.W.R.) (soon to amalgamate with the Grand Trunk Railway (G.T.R.)),
had taken on southern Ontario – specifically the network they had established in and around Hamilton and Lake Ontario.
The T.H. & B.’s first line stretched south from Hamilton to Port Dover, where it linked with other American lines and was
able to successfully divert traffic and business away from the G.W.R. and G.T.R. The T.H. & B. continued to strike
alliances with other companies such as Canadian Pacific. These alliances allowed the smaller rail line to construct and
operate sections of a much larger line owned by a much larger company. By the late 1890s, the Grand Trunk monopoly on
southern Ontario had been shattered. Competition began to spring up all over the area. Small, independent companies
followed the example set by the T.H. & B. and made agreements with larger American companies. The result was a highly
competitive market that allowed the Hamilton and Brant-ford area to prosper from its strategic central location and
proximity to the US border. The Brantford T.H. & B. Railway station, constructed in 1896, still exists at 60 Market Street
South and is located on the City of Brantford’s heritage inventory.
铁路公司很可能建造了这座桥。19 世纪 70 年代，为了打破大西部铁路(g.w.r.)(不久将与大主干铁路(g.t.r.)合并)对
南安大略的束缚，特别是他们在汉密尔顿和安大略湖周围建立的铁路网。运输和交通局的第一条线路从汉密尔顿
向南延伸到多佛港，在那里它与其他美国线路相连，并成功地将交通和业务从 g.w.r. 和 g.t.r 转移到别处。Th & b
继续与加拿大太平洋公司等其他公司结盟。这些联盟使得规模较小的铁路公司能够建造和运营一条规模更大的铁
路线的一部分，而这些铁路线的所有者是一家规模更大的公司。到 19 世纪 90 年代末，南安大略的大干线垄断被
打破了。竞争开始在整个地区兴起。小型独立公司效仿 t.h & b 的做法，与大型美国公司签订了协议。其结果是
一个高度竞争的市场，使得汉密尔顿和布兰特-福特地区从其战略中心位置和邻近美国边境蓬勃发展。建于 1896
年的布兰特福德 t.h. & b 火车站仍然存在于南市场街 60 号，位于布兰特福德城市的遗产清单上。
The bridge has been converted from a railway crossing to pedestrian trail, and now carries the Dike Trail. The T.H.
这座桥已经从一个铁路道口改为步行道，现在承载着堤道。

bridge contributes to a cultural heritage landscape with the Dike Trail CNR Truss Bridge, Lorne Bridge, Lorne Park and the designated,

铁路桥是横跨布兰特福德市中心附近格兰德河的四座桥之一。这座大桥有助于形成一个文化遗产景观，包括堤道

General Description
一般描述
The Dike Trail CNR Truss Bridge spans the Grand River carrying the Dike Trail, 0.3 km south of Colborne Street West in
the City of Brantford. The structure is a four-span steel double through truss bridge with a timber deck and concrete piers
and abutments. It exhibits unusual rolled angles, known as bulb angles, that compose some of the bridge’s built up
members. The use of bulb angles, rather than simple angles, is quite unusual to find on a truss bridge such as this.
堤道 CNR 桁架桥横跨格兰德河，在布兰特福德市科尔伯恩西街以南 0.3 公里处承载着堤道。该桥是一座四跨双向
钢桁架桥，桥面为木质甲板，桥墩和桥台为混凝土结构。它展示了不同寻常的卷角，称为球形角，构成了一些桥
梁的组成部分。灯泡角的使用，而不是简单的角度，在这样的桁架桥上是很少见的。
The bridge’s two truss spans are very similar but not identical. This could indicate that one span was damaged or
destroyed and replaced at some time. Its date of construction is estimated to be circa the 1920s. This bridge may
have been a part of the Grand Trunk Railway carrying a rail line that connected Brantford to southern Ontario and
the US. The Canadian National Railway eventually took over ownership of the track before it was decommissioned
in phases. This structure has been converted to a pedestrian bridge. The original train tracks and ties are still located
below the timber deck, providing context for its original use.
这座桥的两个桁架跨度非常相似，但并不完全相同。这可能意味着其中一个跨度在某个时候被损坏或摧毁
并被替换。它的建造时间估计在 20 世纪 20 年代左右。这座桥可能是连接布兰特福德与南安大略和美国的大
主干铁路的一部分。加拿大国家铁路公司最终接管了这条铁路的所有权，之后这条铁路分阶段退役。这个
结构已经被改造成了一座人行天桥。原来的火车轨道和纽带仍然位于木质甲板下面，为原来的使用提供了
背景。
The Dike Trail CNR Truss Bridge is one of four bridges that span the Grand River in close proximity to Brantford’s
downtown. This bridge contributes to a cultural heritage landscape with the T.H. & B. Railway Bridge, Lorne
Bridge, Lorne Park and the designated, Jubilee Terrace Park. This structure and the T.H. & B. Railway Bridge both
carry the Dike Trail, part of the larger Gordon Glaves Memorial Pathway.
大堤小径 CNR 桁架桥是横跨格兰德河的四座桥之一，紧邻布兰特福德的市中心。这座桥有助于文化遗产景
观与铁路桥，洛恩大桥，洛恩公园和指定的，银禧台公园。这个结构和 t.h. & b 铁路桥都承载着堤防小径，
是更大的戈登 · 格雷夫斯纪念小径的一部分。

General Description
一般描述
The Grand River Abutments are located on the east and west banks of the Grand River between Veterans Memorial
Parkway (Grand River Crossing Bridge) and the T.H. & B. Railway Bridge in the City of Brantford.
格兰德河的桥墩位于格兰德河东岸和西岸，介于退伍军人纪念公园大道(格兰德河过河大桥)和布兰特福德市
的 t.h & b 铁路大桥之间。
It is unknown whether the bridge was a railway or road bridge, but its use of concrete rather than masonry signifies
it was likely constructed after 1900. There are large rocks in the concrete and a thin board finish is still visible, both
features that indicate an early construction date. The abutments are skewed, with the western base located further
south along the Grand River than the eastern base.
目前尚不清楚这座桥是铁路桥还是公路桥，但它使用的混凝土而不是砖石意味着它很可能是 1900 年以后建
造的。混凝土中有大块的岩石，薄薄的板面仍然清晰可见，这两个特征都表明了早期的建造日期。桥墩是
倾斜的，西边的基地比东边的基地更靠南，沿着大河。
The Grand River Abutments are located among four bridges that span the Grand River in close proximity to
Brantford’s downtown. The abutments contribute to a cultural heritage landscape with the T.H. & B. Railway
Bridge, Dike Trail CNR Truss Bridge, Lorne Bridge, Lorne Park and the designated, Jubilee Terrace Park.
格兰德河桥墩(The Grand River Abutments)位于四座桥梁之间，这些桥梁横跨格兰德河，与布兰特福德市中
心非常接近。铁路大桥、堤道 CNR Truss 大桥、洛恩大桥、洛恩公园和指定的银禧台公园等，构成了文化
遗产景观。

General Description
一般描述
The Murray Street Bridge is located on Murray Street, 0.02 km north of Greenwich Street in the City of Brantford. This
solid spandrel arch was designed by City Engineer Frank P. Adams and built in 1921 over the Brantford Cut of the Grand
River Navigation Company Canal and Lock System (now the Mohawk Waterway). Brantford’s economic development
was spurred by the opening of the Grand River Navigation Company’s canals that linked Brantford by water to the
Welland Canal and important industrial cities like Buffalo. The Brantford Cut was the final part of the system to be built
and opened to great fanfare in 1848. This canal brought freight and passengers right into Brantford’s downtown and
increased trade and attracted new businesses to the area.
墨累街大桥位于布兰特福德市格林威治街以北 0.02 公里的墨累街。这个坚固的拱肩是由城市工程师弗兰克 p。亚
当斯设计的，建于 1921 年的布兰特福德切割大河航运公司运河和船闸系统(现在的莫霍克水道)。布兰特福德的经
济发展得益于大河航运公司开通的运河，这些运河通过水路将布兰特福德与威兰运河以及像布法罗这样的重要工
业城市连接起来。1848 年，布兰特福德水道是这个系统的最后一部分，并在大张旗鼓的宣传下开通。这条运河把
货物和乘客直接带到了布兰特福德的市中心，增加了贸易，吸引了新的商业来到这个地区。
The popularity of solid spandrel bridges was concentrated in the period from 1905 to 1919, and by 1919 there were at least
22 of these bridges with spans over 60 feet (18 m) reported in Ontario. The popularity of the design began to decline by
1919, although they continued to be built in small numbers into the 1930s. The 60-foot span of the Murray Street Bridge is
perhaps typical of the decorative use of the arch in later years. In the 1920s, open spandrel arches and bowstring bridges
tended to replace the solid spandrel arches for longer spans and concrete beam bridges for shorter spans. This explains
Frank P. Adams’ choice to use an open spandrel design for the nearby Lorne Bridge in 1924, just three years after the
construction of this solid spandrel structure.
实心拱桥的流行集中在 1905 年至 1919 年期间，到 1919 年，据报道在安大略省至少有 22 座这样的桥跨度超过 60
英尺(18 米)。到了 1919 年，这种设计的受欢迎程度开始下降，尽管到了 20 世纪 30 年代，它们仍然是少量建造的。
60 英尺跨度的莫里街大桥可能是后来拱门的典型装饰用途。在 20 世纪 20 年代，开放式拱桥和弓弦桥倾向于取代
较长跨度的实心拱桥和较短跨度的混凝土梁桥。这就解释了弗兰克 · p · 亚当斯在 1924 年为附近的洛恩大桥选择
使用开放式拱肩设计的原因，当时距离这座坚固的拱肩结构建成仅仅三年。
The bridge is a single span structure of reinforced cast-in-place concrete with an elliptical arch with a smooth soffit. The thin
board finish is still visible in the concrete. Concrete railings with decorative tear-shaped balustrades extend along both sides of
the deck and curve around the corner of Murray Street extending onto Greenwich Street. Designed by Frank P. Adams, the
distinctive Beaux-Arts style balustrade design with cast concrete railing and balusters had been used earlier in the Alfred Street
Bridge, Brantford (pre-1911) and later in the Lorne Bridge, Brantford (1924). In 2003 the original balustrade forms were used to
make replacement balusters during the repair and rehabilitation of the upper level of the bridge.
该桥为单跨钢筋现浇混凝土结构，拱为椭圆形，拱脚光滑。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土中看到。带有装饰性泪形栏杆的
混凝土栏杆沿着甲板的两侧延伸，并绕过美利街的拐角延伸到格林威治街。由弗兰克 p。亚当斯设计，独特的美术风格
的栏杆设计与铸造混凝土栏杆和栏杆早期在布兰特福德的阿尔弗雷德街大桥(1911 年前)和后来在洛恩大桥，布兰特福德
(1924 年)使用。2003 年，原来的栏杆形式被用来在大桥上层的维修和修复过程中更换栏杆。
A city plaque is affixed to the structure commemorating those responsible for its design and construction.
一块城市牌匾固定在结构上，以纪念负责其设计和建造的人员。

General Description
一般描述
The Great Western Railway Bridge remnants are located along the Cambridge to Paris Rail Trail, between West
River Road South and East River Road, parallel with Blue Lake Road.
大西部铁路大桥遗址位于剑桥至巴黎铁路沿线，在西河南路和东河路之间，与蓝湖路平行。
The bridge deck is gone, but the stone piers and abutments remain. The cut stone piers supported a metal truss
bridge that linked Harrisburg to Paris. The original bridge was built in 1858 and the remaining remnants are among
the oldest in the watershed. The eastern abutment has become the Murray Lookout, a scenic stop along the
Cambridge to Paris Rail Trail owned and maintained by the Grand River Conservation Authority. The County of
Brant owns the piers.
桥面已经没有了，但是石头桥墩和桥墩依然存在。切割的石墩支撑着一座连接哈里斯堡和巴黎的金属桁架
桥。最初的桥建于 1858 年，现存的遗迹是这个分水岭最古老的遗迹之一。东边的桥墩已经变成了默里瞭望
台，一个沿着剑桥到巴黎铁路线的风景优美的站点，由大河保护局拥有和维护。布兰特县拥有这些码头。

General Description
一般描述
The Paris Railway Bridge is located between Grand River Street North and Willow Street, north of Portland Road and
John Avenue in the Town of Paris. Although the date of construction is unknown, it is likely that the Grand Trunk Rail-
way built this structure circa 1860. It originally carried a line that connected Goderich to Fort Erie and the US border.
Although the Grand Trunk line between Paris and Stratford was eventually decommissioned, the bridge is now owned by
the Canadian National Railway and still carries an active rail line through the Town of Paris.
巴黎铁路大桥位于格兰德河北街和柳树街之间，波特兰路以北和巴黎城的约翰大道。虽然建造日期不详，但大干
线铁路很可能是在 1860 年左右建造的。它最初是一条连接 Goderich 和伊利堡以及美国边境的铁路线。尽管巴黎
和斯特拉特福之间的大干线最终退役了，但这座桥现在归加拿大国家铁路公司所有，并且仍然通过巴黎城运营着
一条铁路线。
The bridge’s steel truss frame is set high above the Grand River on concrete and cut stone piers and abutments. Due
to the bridge’s physical prominence it acts as a gateway marking the entrance to and from Paris.
大桥的钢桁架架设在格兰德河上方高高的混凝土和切割过的石墩和桥台上。由于大桥的物理突出，它作为
一个门户，标志着进出巴黎。
Sources: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory
资料来源: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory
Andreae, C. Lines of Country: An atlas of railway and waterway history in Canada, 1997
Andreae，c。国家线: 加拿大铁路和水路历史地图集，1997 年

General Description
一般描述
The Nith River Bridge is located on Grand River Street, 0.2 km south of William Street where the Grand and Nith
Riv-ers converge in the Town of Paris. A plaque on the bridge commemorates those responsible for its 1932
construction, notably Keystone Contractors Ltd. and engineer A.L.S. Nash. This two-span reinforced concrete solid
spandrel arch bridge displays a high degree of artistic merit. It is decorated with false arches, dentils, columns, and a
symmetrical railing system of posts and balustrades. In 2005, portions of the railing were removed.
Nith 河大桥位于格兰德河街，在威廉街以南 0.2 公里处，格兰德河和 Nith 河的居民在巴黎的城镇汇合。桥
上的一块牌匾是为了纪念那些对 1932 年大桥的建造负责的人，特别是 Keystone Contractors ltd 和工程师
a.l.s。这座两跨钢筋混凝土实心拱桥展示了高度的艺术价值。它装饰有假拱门，齿轮，圆柱，以及一个对称
的栏杆和栏杆系统。2005 年，部分栏杆被拆除。
Pedestrians are welcomed to cross the bridge with ease as sidewalks line both sides of the bridge. The Nith River
Bridge, along with the other structures that cross the Grand River in the Town of Paris, contributes to a valuable
cultural heri-tage landscape.
欢迎行人轻松过桥，因为人行道沿着桥的两边排列。Nith 河大桥，连同其他跨越巴黎小镇格兰德河的建筑，
构成了一个有价值的文化遗产景观。
Sources: Municipal Structure Inspection Form, County of Brant
资料来源: 市政结构检查表，Brant 县

General Description
一般描述
The Brant Bowstring Bridge spans the Grand River on Colborne Street East between Brant Avenue in Brantford and
Gilkison Street in the County of Brant. The property consists of a single-span concrete bowstring arch bridge that
was constructed in 1931. The County of Brant designated the bridge in 2006 for its historic and architectural
significance under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (By-law 198-06).
Brant Bowstring 大桥横跨布兰特福德的布兰特大道和布兰特郡的吉尔吉森街之间的科尔伯恩东街上的格兰
德河。该建筑由一座建于 1931 年的单跨混凝土弓弦拱桥组成。2006年，布兰特县根据《安大略省遗产法》
(第 198-06 号附则)第四部分的规定，指定这座桥具有历史和建筑意义。
The Brant Bowstring Bridge is the only bowstring arch bridge in the County of Brant. Spanning the Grand River on
Colborne Street East at the boundary between the City of Brantford and the County of Brant, it serves as a gateway
marker. Built in 1931 of reinforced concrete, it was part of the Ontario Government’s upgrading of transportation
networks after World War I to accommodate the increasing number of automobiles in the area. The bridge’s
bowstring design was popular in the 1920s and 1930s as it required minimal material, was simple to install and
could easily ac-commodate vehicular traffic.
布兰特弓弦桥(Brant Bowstring Bridge)是布兰特郡唯一的弓弦拱桥。它横跨科尔伯恩东街的格兰德河，位于
布兰特福德市和布兰特县的交界处，是一个入口标志。这座建于 1931 年的钢筋混凝土建筑，是安大略省政
府在第一次世界大战后为了适应该地区日益增长的汽车数量而对交通网络进行升级改造的一部分。这座桥
的弓弦设计在 20 世纪 20 年代和 30 年代很流行，因为它只需要最少的材料，安装简单，而且可以很容易地
适应车辆交通。
The Brant Bowstring Bridge, located next to the simple rigid frame Likins Bridge, exhibits decorative concrete
railings, balustrades and deck beams and a sidewalk along the north side. It is considered by some to be the sister
bridge to the Main Street Bridge in Cambridge, which was also constructed in 1931 using the bowstring design. The
inclusion of pedestrian sidewalks is a unique feature of bowstring arch bridges located in urban settings.
布兰特弓弦大桥(Brant Bowstring Bridge)位于简单的刚性框架 Likins 大桥旁，展示了装饰性的混凝土栏杆、
栏杆和甲板横梁，北侧还有一条人行道。一些人认为它是剑桥主街大桥的姊妹桥，该桥也是在 1931 年使用
弓弦设计建造的。人行道的包含是弓弦拱桥在城市环境中的一个独特特征。
The Brant Bowstring Bridge was threatened with demolition by scheduled repair work. However, the Brant Heritage
Committee was successful in presenting the importance of the bridge to Council who in early 2006, subsequently
ap-proved work for rehabilitation at a cost of $1.1 million. In addition to this, Council changed its name from Starr
Bridge to the Brant Bowstring Bridge.
Brant 弓弦桥由于预定的维修工作而面临被拆除的威胁。然而，Brant 遗产委员会成功地向理事会介绍了桥
梁的重要性，理事会于 2006 年初批准了修复工程，费用为 110 万美元。除此之外，委员会把它的名字从斯
塔尔桥改为布兰特弓弦桥(Brant Bowstring Bridge)。
Sources: County of Brant By-law 198-06
资料来源: 布兰特县法律 198-06
Canadian Register of Historic Places
加拿大历史名胜名录

General Description
一般描述
The Glen Morris Road Bridge is located on Glen Morris Road East, 0.1 km east of Branchton Road in the Township
of South Dumfries. Constructed circa 1854, this is likely the second oldest bridge remaining in the Grand River
water-shed, after the Mill Creek Bridge (1837) in the City of Cambridge. The Great Western Railway Company
constructed this cut stone bridge over Glen Morris Road East to link Harrisburg with Galt. It is a beautiful example
of masonry work.
格伦莫里斯路桥位于格伦莫里斯路东，0.1 公里以东的 Branchton 路在南邓弗里斯小镇。大约建于 1854 年，
这可能是继剑桥市的米尔克里克大桥(1837)之后，大河流域仅存的第二座最古老的桥梁。大西部铁路公司
(Great Western Railway Company)在格伦莫里斯东路(Glen Morris Road East)上建造了这座切开的石桥，连接
哈里斯堡和高尔特(Galt)。这是一个美丽的砖石工程的例子。
The abutments and superstructure are composed of finely tooled, rock-faced stone. The keystone at the centre of
each arch has no date imprint, but is bordered by finely detailed voussoirs. Its unique double arches allow both the
road and a stream to pass under it. Little is known about this structure. The design and craftsmanship point to a pre-
confeder-ation construction date. The age, materials, and design characteristics of the structure contribute greatly to
its cultural heritage value. The Glen Morris Road Bridge includes the only culvert in this heritage bridge inventory
and has been included as an exception due to its unique design and outstanding construction. The Township of South
Dumfries designated this bridge in 1991 under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act.
桥墩和上部结构是由精细的工具，岩石表面的石头组成的。每个拱门中央的拱石没有日期标记，但是边界
上有精细的拱门。它独特的双拱使得道路和溪流都可以通过它。人们对这种结构知之甚少。设计和工艺指
向一个预联盟建设日期。建筑的年代、材料和设计特点对其文化遗产价值有很大的贡献。格伦莫里斯路桥
包括了唯一的涵洞在这个遗产桥清单，并已作为一个例外，由于其独特的设计和杰出的建设。南邓弗里斯
小镇在 1991 年根据安大略省遗产法第四部分指定了这座桥。

General Description
一般描述
The Mill Street Bridge is located on Mill Street, 0.6 km north of Brant County Highway Number 53. The bridge is
as-sociated with the historical theme of the 19th and 20th century development of road transportation in the former
town-ships that now comprise the County of Brant. The bridge was constructed in 1922 and is one of two surviving
earth-filled solid spandrel concrete arch bridges in the County of Brant, joined by the Cleaver Road Bridge.
米尔街大桥位于米尔街，布兰特县 53 号高速公路以北 0.6 公里。这座桥与 19 世纪和 20 世纪道路交通发展
的历史主题联系在一起。这座桥建于 1922 年，是 Brant 县现存的两座填土实心拱肋混凝土拱桥之一，由
Cleaver Road 大桥连接。
The Bridge’s early date of construction fits the typical age range, 1905-1919, when this bridge type was popular.
Most of the early activity in concrete bridge construction in Ontario focused on the earth-filled, solid spandrel arch
form. The first arches were semicircular in shape while later developments used an elliptical form to achieve longer
spans. The popularity of solid spandrel bridges, like this one, appears to have declined after 1919, although they
continued to be built in small numbers into the 1930s.
这座桥的早期建造日期符合典型的年龄范围，1905年至 1919 年，当时这种桥型很流行。在安大略省，大多
数早期的混凝土桥梁建造活动都集中在填土的实心拱肋形式上。最初的拱形是半圆形的，后来的发展使用
椭圆形的形式来实现更长的跨度。1919年以后，像这样的实心拱桥的受欢迎程度似乎有所下降，尽管直到
20 世纪 30 年代，它们仍然是少量建造的。
The Mill Street Bridge is a single span, solid spandrel concrete arch structure of reinforced cast-in-place concrete.
The thin board finish is still visible in the concrete. It has an elliptical arch with a smooth soffit. Solid concrete
spandrel walls contain the earth-filled core used to build up the structure to the road deck. Solid concrete railings
extend along both sides of the deck and include decorative features highlighted with recessed panels set between
concrete posts. The bridge is considered a good example of functional engineering design clearly expressing the
transfer of loads through the arch to the abutments. The simple arch design is sculptural in its proportions and shape.
No significant modifica-tions to the bridge have been carried out.
磨坊街大桥是一座单跨实腹式钢筋现浇混凝土拱结构。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土中看到。它有一个椭圆
形的拱门和一个光滑的底座。实心混凝土拱肩墙包含填土的核心，用于建造通往路面的结构。坚固的混凝
土栏杆沿着甲板的两侧延伸，包括装饰性的特征，在混凝土柱子之间设置嵌入式面板。桥梁被认为是功能
工程设计的一个很好的例子，清楚地表达了荷载通过拱门传递到桥台。简单的拱门设计是雕塑的比例和形
状。桥梁没有进行任何重大的修改。

General Description
一般描述
The Cleaver Road Bridge is located on Cleaver Road, 1.2 km north of Brant County Highway Number 53. The
bridge is associated with the historical theme of the 19th and 20th century development of road transportation in the
former townships that now comprise the County of Brant. The bridge was constructed in 1922 and is one of two
surviving earth-filled solid spandrel concrete arch bridges in the County of Brant, joined by the Mill Street Bridge.
克利弗路桥位于克利弗路上，在布兰特县 53 号公路以北 1.2 公里处。这座桥与 19 世纪和 20 世纪公路交通
发展的历史主题有关，这些城镇现在组成了布兰特县。这座桥建于 1922 年，是 Brant 县现存的两座填土实
心拱肋混凝土拱桥之一，由 Mill Street 大桥连接。
The Bridge’s early date of construction fits the typical age range (1905-1919) when this bridge type was popular.
Most of the early activity in concrete bridge construction in Ontario focused on the earth-filled, solid spandrel arch
form. The first arches were semicircular in shape while later developments used an elliptical form to achieve longer
spans. The popularity of solid spandrel bridges appears to have declined after 1919, although they continued to be
built in small numbers into the 1930s.
该桥的早期建造日期符合典型的年龄范围(1905 年至 1919 年) ，当时这种桥梁类型是流行。在安大略省，大
多数早期的混凝土桥梁建造活动都集中在填土的实心拱肋形式上。最初的拱形是半圆形的，后来的发展使
用椭圆形的形式来实现更长的跨度。1919年以后，固体拱肋桥的流行程度似乎有所下降，尽管直到 20 世纪
30 年代，它们仍然是少量建造的。
The Cleaver Road Bridge is a slightly skewed single span, solid spandrel concrete arch structure of reinforced cast-
in-place concrete. The thin board finish is still visible in the concrete. It has an elliptical arch with a smooth soffit.
Solid concrete spandrel walls contain the earth-filled core used to build up the structure to the road deck. Solid
concrete rail-ings extend along both sides of the deck and include decorative features highlighted with recessed
panels set between concrete posts. The ends of the railings are slightly angled outward widening the initial access to
the bridge deck. The bridge is considered a good example of functional engineering design clearly expressing the
transfer of loads through the arch to the abutments. The simple arch design is sculptural in its proportions and shape.
克利弗路大桥是一座略微倾斜的单跨实心拱桥，由现浇钢筋混凝土构成。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土中看
到。它有一个椭圆形的拱门和一个光滑的底座。实心混凝土拱肩墙包含填土的核心，用于建造通往路面的
结构。坚固的混凝土栏杆沿着桥面两侧延伸，包括装饰性的特征，在混凝土柱子之间设置嵌入式面板。栏
杆的两端稍微向外倾斜，扩大了通往桥面的最初通道。桥梁被认为是功能性工程设计的一个很好的例子，
清楚地表达了荷载通过拱门传递到桥台。简单的拱门设计是雕塑的比例和形状。
No significant modifications to the bridge have been made over the years. Water Survey of Canada benchmarks are
located on both the southwest and northeast ends of the bridge, one is labeled 0-804-607.
这些年来，这座桥没有做过任何重大的修改。加拿大水资源调查基准位于大桥的西南端和东北端，其中一
个标记为 0-804-607。

General Description
一般描述
Burt Road Bridge is located on Burt Road, 0.3 km south of Brant County Highway Number 5 in the community of
South Dumfries. It was constructed circa 1920 and is the only remaining steel truss road bridge in the County of
Brant. The Reaker Bridge, which was of similar construction and estimated to have been built in the same year, was
demolished in late 2012.
伯特路桥位于南邓弗里斯社区布兰特县 5 号公路以南 0.3 公里的伯特路上。它建于 1920 年左右，是布兰特
县仅存的钢桁架公路桥。雷克大桥也是同样的建筑，估计也是在同一年建成，于 2012 年末被拆除。
Burt Road Bridge is skewed 35 degrees to Fairchild Creek. It is riveted and has a concrete deck and abutments. The
bridge is closed and an approval for demolition was granted in October 2011. However, as of July 2012 it was still
in place.
伯特路桥向费尔柴尔德溪倾斜了 35 度。它是铆接的，有一个混凝土甲板和桥台。这座桥已经关闭，2011年
10 月已经批准拆除。然而，截至 2012 年 7 月，大桥仍然在原地。

General Description
一般描述
Harry Martin Bridge is located on Maple Avenue North, 1.5 km north of Brant County Highway Number 53 near
the community of Burford. It was constructed in 1955 and is one of few early T-beam bridges built in the County of
Brant during the 1950s.
哈里马丁大桥位于枫树大道北部，布兰特郡 53 号高速公路以北 1.5 公里，靠近伯福德社区。它建于 1955 年，
是 20 世纪 50 年代布兰特郡少数几座早期 t 型梁桥之一。
This bridge has unique concrete and metal railings that reflect the Art Deco style. The concrete balustrades are em-
bossed with a series of three lines and the metal balustrades follow a uniformly appealing triangular pattern. The
Harry Martin Bridge contributes to a picturesque setting along Maple Avenue North.
这座桥有独特的混凝土和金属栏杆，反映了艺术装饰风格。混凝土栏杆浮雕了一系列的三线和金属栏杆遵
循一个统一的吸引人的三角形模式。哈里 · 马丁大桥沿着枫树大道北侧形成了一个风景如画的环境。
Despite the widespread use of T-beam structures in the United States from the 1920s to the 1960s, there was a more
limited use of this bridge type within Ontario. The concrete rigid frame, introduced in Ontario in the 1930s,
continued to be the dominant bridge type in the province during the 1950s when pre-stressed precast concrete beam
and post-tension cast in place structures were introduced in the 1960s. Therefore, the Harry Martin Bridge is a rare
and decora-tive example of later T-beam bridge construction in the Grand River watershed.
尽管从 20 世纪 20 年代到 60 年代，t 型梁结构在美国得到了广泛的应用，但在安大略省，这种桥型的应用却
比较有限。1930 年代在安大略引进的混凝土刚架，在 1960 年代引进预应力混凝土预制梁和后张法现浇结构
后，在 1950 年代继续成为该省的主要桥型。因此，哈里马丁大桥是后来在大河流域建造 t 型梁桥的一个罕
见和装饰性的例子。
Sources: Municipal Structure Inspection Form, County of Brant

Cultural Heritage Evaluation Report, May 2012, Unterman McPhail Associates
文化遗产评估报告，2012 年 5 月，Unterman McPhail Associates

General Description
一般描述
The Cunningham Bridge is located on Jenkins Road, 0.2 km west of Cockshutt Road in the community of Oakland.
This is the only wooden bridge remaining in the County of Brant. It is constructed of an undefined vernacular style
and features a timber deck, superstructure, wingwalls, and support logs affixed to the abutments. The bridge is set at
a ten degree skew to McKenzie Creek.
坎宁安大桥位于奥克兰社区 Cockshutt 路以西 0.2 公里的 Jenkins 路上。这是 Brant 县仅存的一座木桥。它是
由一种不明确的乡土风格建造的，其特点是木质甲板、上部结构、翼墙和固定在桥墩上的支撑原木。这座
桥与麦肯齐溪呈 10 度倾斜。
Although little is known about the structure directly, it is apparent that it was named for the Cunningham Family
who settled at East Oakland at the turn of the 19th century and remained on the site for generations. Although a
bridge inspection report from 1985 indicates the bridge was constructed in 1962, it is likely it was constructed much
earlier, perhaps in the late-19th to early-20th century. Access across McKenzie Creek at this site would have been
necessary for the Cunningham’s who farmed the area and for those attending the school located on Cunningham’s
property, which was operational from 1862 to 1965. A flour mill was also located along Jenkins Road at the East
Oakland Pond, further necessitating a bridge at this crossing. Local knowledge indicates there was a structure here
as far back as 1935. Plans for a proposed steel bridge at this site also date to 1935. It is possible the bridge was
constructed of timber rather than steel.
尽管人们对这座建筑知之甚少，但它显然是以 19 世纪初定居在奥克兰东部的坎宁安家族命名的，他们世代
居住在这里。尽管 1985 年的一份桥梁检查报告显示，这座桥建于 1962 年，但它很可能建造得更早，可能在
19 世纪末至 20 世纪初。从麦肯齐河穿过这个地点对于在这个地区耕种的坎宁安夫妇和那些在坎宁安财产上
就读的学校来说都是必要的，这所学校从 1862 年到 1965 年一直在运营。马更些。在东奥克兰池塘的詹金斯
路沿线还有一个面粉厂，这就需要在这个路口建一座桥。当地的知识表明这里早在 1935 年就有一个建筑。
在这里建造一座钢桥的计划也可以追溯到 1935 年。这座桥可能是用木材而不是钢材建造的。
The Cunningham Bridge underwent rehabilitation efforts in 2011. Photographs from 1968 indicate the structure
once had white painted wooden railings. They have since been removed and replaced with a concrete barrier wall
that ob-scures any view of the structure with the exception of the timber deck.
坎宁安大桥在 2011 年进行了修复工作。1968年的照片显示，这座建筑曾经有白色的木制栏杆。后来，它们
被拆除，取而代之的是一堵混凝土屏障墙，遮挡了除了木质甲板以外的所有视野。
Sources: Municipal Structure Inspection Form, County of Brant
资料来源: Brant 县市政结构检查表
Oakland History Volume 1, 2 and 4
奥克兰历史第一，第二和第四卷

General Description
一般描述
John Leishman Bridge is located on Bishops Gate Road, 1.5 km north of Brant County Highway Number 53 near
the community of Burford. Constructed in 1956, it is the oldest I-beam structure in the County of Brant. Its early
construc-tion date sets it apart from the numerous other I-beam bridges in the County.
约翰利什曼大桥位于主教门路，1.5 公里以北的布兰特县高速公路 53 号附近的伯福德社区。它建于 1956 年，
是布兰特县最古老的工字钢结构。它的早期建造日期使它有别于该县其他众多的 i 型梁桥。
Plaques commemorating those responsible for the construction of John Leishman Bridge are located on opposite
sides of the bridge’s simple concrete railings. Specifically, the plaque pays homage to County Engineer, R.M. Lee
and John Leishman, the Road Foreman and bridge’s namesake.
纪念那些负责建造 John Leishman 大桥的人的牌匾位于大桥简单的混凝土栏杆的对面。具体来说，这个牌匾
是为了向县工程师 r.m。 Lee 和 John Leishman 致敬，他们是公路工程师，也是大桥的同名人。
John Leishman Bridge underwent repairs in 1998.
约翰 · 利什曼大桥于 1998 年进行了维修。
Source: Municipal Structure Inspection Form, County of Brant
资料来源: 布兰特县市政结构检查表

General Description
一般描述
The Grand River Bridge is located on Dundas Street East, 1.1 km west of Paris Road in the Town of Paris. The
bridge crosses both the Grand River and Ball Street and is prominent feature in the view along the Grand River in
the Town of Paris. It is located slightly south of the now demolished Willow Street Bridge, a wrought iron truss
bridge constructed in 1877 and removed in 1988.
大河大桥位于巴黎市中心巴黎路以西 1.1 公里的邓达斯东街。这座桥横跨格兰德河和鲍尔街，是巴黎城格兰
德河沿岸的显著特色。它位于现已拆除的柳树街大桥的南部，柳树街大桥是一座锻铁桁架桥，建于 1877 年，
1988 年拆除。
Constructed in 1967, the Grand River Bridge is slightly skewed and set upon unique concrete piers and decoratively
arched and painted steel I-beams. The railings are simple and constructed of concrete and metal. The Grand River
Bridge underwent repairs in 2005 and 2009.
大河大桥建于 1967 年，略有倾斜，设置在独特的混凝土桥墩和装饰性的拱形和涂漆钢 i 型梁上。栏杆很简
单，由混凝土和金属构成。大河大桥在 2005 年和 2009 年进行了维修。

General Description
一般描述
The William Street Bridge is located on William Street, 0.1 km east of Grand River Street North in the Town of
Paris. The attractively designed bridge features prominently in the view along the Grand River and acts as a gateway
to down-town Paris.
威廉街大桥位于巴黎市格兰德河北街以东 0.1 公里的威廉街。这座设计精美的桥在格兰德河沿岸的风景中显
得尤为突出，是通往巴黎市中心的大门。
Constructed in 1968, this bridge replaced a multi-span through truss bridge built in the late 19th century. The
William Street Bridge is set upon concrete piers and exhibits decorative concrete railings and balustrades and
classically de-signed streetlights. The William Street Bridge underwent repairs in 1985 and in 2012 the parapet walls
and streetlights were replaced and repairs were made to the girders, piers and abutments. The bridge has sidewalks
on both sides, al-lowing pedestrians safe passage into downtown Paris.
这座桥建于 1968 年，取代了建于 19 世纪末的多跨下承式桁架桥。威廉街大桥设置在混凝土桥墩上，展示了
装饰性的混凝土栏杆和栏杆以及经典设计的街灯。威廉街大桥在 1985 年进行了维修，2012年更换了护墙和
路灯，并对大梁、桥墩和桥台进行了维修。这座桥的两侧都有人行道，可以让行人安全地进入巴黎市中心。
Sources: Municipal Structure Inspection Form, County of Brant
资料来源: Brant 县市政结构检查表

General Description
一般描述
The New England School Road abutments are located parallel to and just south of McBay Road, 4.8 km south of
Brant County Highway Number 2/53, east of the City of Brantford. The abutments are just south of the Jack
Devereaux Bridge that now carries McBay Road across Big Creek. The abutments were constructed circa the 1920s
and appear to have originally carried New England School Road, which now ends at McBay Road.
新英格兰学校路的桥墩与 McBay 路平行，位于布兰特县高速公路 2/53 以南 4.8 公里处，布兰特福德市以东。
这些桥墩位于杰克•德弗罗大桥(Jack Devereaux Bridge)的南部，现在这座桥把麦克贝路带过了大溪。这些
桥墩大约建于 20 世纪 20 年代，最初似乎承载着新英格兰学校路，现在终止于 McBay 路。
According to local knowledge, a man, with the last name Simpson, poured the abutments, and there is memo-ry of
the bridge crossing these remnants since 1944, but it was likely there longer. There have been three bridges on this
site, two of which were demolished when McBay Road and Big Creek were rerouted, possibly when the Jack
Devereaux Bridge was built in 1958. One of these bridges is remembered to have been steel. The last bridge on site
was demolished between 1988 and 1990.
据当地人所知，一个姓辛普森的男人浇筑了桥墩，而且自 1944 年以来，人们就记得这座桥横跨这些遗迹，
但它可能在那里的时间更长。这里有三座桥，其中两座在 McBay 路和 Big Creek 改道时被拆除，可能是
1958 年 Jack Devereaux 大桥建成时。其中一座桥被认为是钢结构的。现场最后一座桥在 1988 年至 1990 年
间被拆除。

General Description
一般描述
The two-track Canning CNR Bridge is located just south of Township Road 2, east of Canning Road. Although the
date is unknown, it is likely that this structure was built in the early 1900s. The first tracks at this crossing were laid
by the Great Western Railway as early as 1863. By the late 19th century Great Western Railway had merged with the
Grand Trunk Railway (GTR). The GTR took over ownership and by 1917 a second track had been added. This
trestle now carries the Canadian National Railway through the community of Canning. The bridge’s steel girder
frame is set high above the Nith River on a central concrete pier and two steep masonry abutments.
双轨 CNR 大桥位于坎宁路以东的 2 号乡道以南。尽管日期不详，但这座建筑很可能建于 20 世纪早期。早
在 1863 年，大西部铁路就在这个十字路口铺设了第一条铁轨。到 19 世纪晚期，大西部铁路与大主干铁路
(GTR)合并。GTR 接管了所有权，到 1917 年又增加了第二条铁路。这座栈桥现在承载着加拿大国家铁路通
过坎宁社区。大桥的钢梁架设在 Nith 河上方的一个中心混凝土桥墩和两个陡峭的砖石桥墩上。
The Canning CNR Bridge is located just south of the pedestrian Canning (South-East) Truss Bridge.
坎宁 CNR 大桥位于行人通道坎宁(东南)桁架桥的南面。
Sources: Andreae, C. Lines of Country: An atlas of railway and waterway history in Canada, 1997

General Description
一般描述
The Canning (South-East) Truss Bridge is located just north of Township Road 2, east of Canning Road. This
structure is a simply supported Pratt through truss of steel with concrete abutments. If the estimated date of
construction (1898) is correct, this bridge is an early example of field riveting. The abutments have been scored to
represent blockwork. The former wood deck was removed around 1960, and the bridge is now used as a pedestrian
walking trail. A water survey benchmark is located on a post beside the bridge. The structure is set in a secluded
area, but is visible from the nearby Canning CNR Bridge located to the south. A steel beam deck bridge replaced a
truss bridge over the Nith River in the hamlet of Canning, which was similar to this bridge, in 1999.
坎宁(东南)桁架桥位于坎宁路以东的 2 号乡道以北。这个结构是一个简单的普拉特通过钢桁架与混凝土桥台。
如果预计的建造日期(1898 年)是正确的，这座桥是一个早期的现场铆接的例子。这些桥墩已经被划分为代
表块体结构。以前的木质甲板在 1960 年左右被拆除，现在这座桥被用作行人步道。大桥旁边的柱子上有一
个水质测量基准。这座建筑位于一个隐蔽的地方，但是从南面附近的坎宁 CNR 大桥可以看到。1999 年，在
坎宁村，一座钢梁桥取代了 Nith 河上的一座桁架桥，这座桥与这座桥很相似。
The Canning (South-East) Truss Bridge belongs to a group of six remaining steel truss bridges in the Township that
range in age from the late 19th century to 1937. This group includes: Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge, Blandford-
Blenheim Bridge #20, Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #24, Silver Bridge and Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #25.
坎宁(东南)桁架桥属于该镇现存的六座钢桁架桥，年代从 19 世纪末到 1937 年不等。这一组包括: Oxford-
Waterloo Road Bridge，Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 20，Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 24，Silver Bridge and
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 25。

General Description
一般描述
The Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge is located on Oxford Waterloo Road, 0.05 km west of River Road, spanning both
the Township of Blandford-Blenheim (Oxford County) and Wilmot Township (Region of Waterloo). The Hamilton
Bridge and Tool Company constructed this single-lane structure in August of 1912. The Oxford-Waterloo Road
Bridge is a steel camelback Pratt through truss with eight panels and riveted connections. The original railings have
been removed and in 1990 the substructure was rehabilitated and the deck was replaced. The bridge’s east abutment
was reconstructed after Hurricane Hazel caused damage in 1954.
牛津-滑铁卢大桥位于牛津滑铁卢路，河道以西 0.05 公里，横跨布兰德福德-布伦海姆镇(牛津郡)和威尔莫特
镇(滑铁卢地区)。汉密尔顿桥和工具公司在 1912 年 8 月建造了这个单车道结构。Oxford-Waterloo Road
Bridge 是一座钢制的驼背式普拉特跨桁架桥，有 8 个面板和铆接连接。原来的栏杆已经被拆除，1990年，
地下结构被重建，甲板被替换。在 1954 年黑兹尔飓风造成损坏后，桥的东侧桥台被重建。
This structure is the second oldest steel truss bridge in the Township of Blandford-Blenheim after the Canning
(South-East) Truss Bridge. Including the Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge, there are six remaining steel truss bridges
in Blandford-Blenheim that range in age from the late 19th century to 1937. This group includes: Canning (South-
East) Truss Bridge, Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #20, Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #24, Silver Bridge and Blandford-
Blenheim Bridge #25.
这是继 Canning (东南部)桁架桥之后，Blandford-Blenheim 镇第二古老的钢桁架桥。包括牛津-滑铁卢公路大
桥(Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge)在内，布兰福德-布伦海姆(Blandford-Blenheim)现存的钢桁架桥有 6 座，年
代从 19 世纪末到 1937 年不等。这一组包括: Canning (South-East) Truss Bridge，Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #
20，Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 24，Silver Bridge and Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 25。
Among the remaining through truss bridges in the Region of Waterloo, the Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge is the
oldest existing camelback through truss. Other camelback through trusses in the Region were built later: the
Winterbourne and Bridge Street Bridges were built in 1913 and the Chamber’s Bridge was built in 1930.
在滑铁卢地区现存的下承式桁架桥中，oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge 是现存最古老的驼背式下承式桁架桥。
该地区的其他驼背式桁架桥是后来建造的: 温特伯恩大桥和桥街大桥建于 1913 年，商会大桥建于 1930 年。
This bridge is considered a rare survivor due to the increasing occurrence of steel truss bridges being demolished but
not replaced. It is also a significant landmark as it represents the transition between Wilmot and Blandford-Blenheim
Townships.
这座桥被认为是一座罕见的幸存者，因为钢桁架桥越来越多地被拆除，但没有被取代。它也是一个重要的
地标，因为它代表了 Wilmot 和 Blandford-Blenheim 镇之间的过渡。
Sources: Township of Blandford-Blenheim OSIM Reports 2011
资料来源: 2011 年 Blandford-Blenheim OSIM 报告

General Description
一般描述
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #20 is located on Township Road 12, 3.1 km east of Blenheim Road. It was constructed
in 1920 and belongs to a group of six remaining steel truss bridges in the Township that range in age from the late
nineteenth century to 1937. This group includes: Canning (South-East) Truss Bridge, Oxford-Waterloo Road
Bridge, Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #24, Silver Bridge and Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #25.
Blandford-Blenheim 大桥 20 号位于布莱尼姆路以东 3.1 公里的 12 号乡镇公路上。它建于 1920 年，属于该镇
现存的六座钢桁架桥，年 代从 19 世纪末到 1937 年不等。该组包括 : Canning (South-East) Truss
Bridge ， Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge，Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 24 ， Silver Bridge and Blandford-
Blenheim Bridge # 25。
Specially, this bridge is grouped with Blandford-Blenheim Bridges #24 and #25. They are located on Township
Road 12, each one concession apart, crossing the Nith River. They exhibit similar construction de-tails, although
each bridge was constructed nine years apart. However, each bridge has something different in its overall design
resulting from the varying conditions at the three river crossings. Township Road 12 offers a unique opportunity to
observe how bridge designs were adjusted to accommodate different site conditions, such as span lengths and
alignment skews.
特别是，这座桥与布兰福德-布伦海姆桥(Blandford-Blenheim Bridges) # 24 和 # 25 组合。它们位于 12 号乡镇
公路上，每条公路相隔一个特许权，跨越 Nith 河。他们展示了类似的建筑细节，尽管每座桥的建造时间相
隔 9 年。然而，由于三个河口的不同条件，每座桥的总体设计都有所不同。乡镇公路 12 号提供了一个独特
的机会来观察桥梁设计是如何调整以适应不同的场地条件，如跨度长度和线性倾斜。
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #20 is a steel, seven-panel, rivet-connected camelback through truss. Aside from its
early date of construction, this bridge, along with others in its group, is rare due to its use of Carn-egie Steel.
Although it is not uncommon for steel used in Ontario’s bridges to be sourced from the United States, it is less
common to find Carnegie steel in the Grand River watershed. The Carnegie Steel Company, headed by Andrew
Carnegie, was located in Pittsburg, Pennsylvania and was in operation from 1892 to 1901 before it was purchased by
The United States Steel Company.
Blandford-Blenheim 大桥 20 号是一个钢结构，七个面板，通过桁架铆钉连接的驼背。除了它的早期建设日
期，这座桥，连同其他组，是罕见的，因为它使用 Carn-egie 钢铁。尽管安大略省桥梁使用的钢材来自美国
并不罕见，但在大河流域发现卡内基钢材的情况并不常见。卡内基钢铁公司由安德鲁 · 卡内基领导，位于宾
夕法尼亚州匹次堡，1892 年至 1901 年运营，后被美国钢铁公司收购。
The bridge underwent repairs in 1995, 1997 and 2004. This bridge is considered a rare survivor due to the increasing
occurrence of steel truss bridges being demolished but not replaced.
这座桥在 1995 年、1997年和 2004 年进行了维修。这座桥被认为是罕见的幸存者，因为越来越多的钢桁架
桥被拆除，但没有更换。
Sources: Township of Blandford-Blenheim OSIM Reports 2011, GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory
资料来源: 2011 年 Blandford-Blenheim OSIM 报告，GRCA 遗产桥清单

General Description
一般描述
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #24 is located on Township Road 12, 1.2 km west of Blenheim Road. It was
constructed in 1929 and belongs to a group of six remaining steel truss bridges in the Township that range in age
from the late nineteenth century to 1937. This group includes: Canning (South-East) Truss Bridge, Oxford-Waterloo
Road Bridge, Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #20, Silver Bridge and Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #25.
Blandford-Blenheim 大桥 24 号位于布莱尼姆路以西 1.2 公里的 12 号乡镇公路上。它建于 1929 年，属于该镇
现存的六座钢桁架桥，年 代从 19 世纪末到 1937 年不等。该组包括 : Canning (South-East) Truss
Bridge ， Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge，Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 20 ， Silver Bridge and Blandford-
Blenheim Bridge # 25。
Specially, this bridge is grouped with Blandford-Blenheim Bridges #20 and #25. They are located on Township Road 12,
each one concession apart, crossing the Nith River. They exhibit similar construction details, although each bridge was
constructed nine years apart. However, each bridge has something different in its overall design resulting from the varying
conditions at the three river crossings. Township Road 12 offers a unique opportunity to observe how bridge designs were
adjusted to accommodate different site conditions, such as span lengths and alignment skews.
特别是，这座桥与布兰福德-布伦海姆桥(Blandford-Blenheim Bridges)分别为 20 英镑和 25 英镑。它们位于 12 号乡
镇公路上，每条公路相隔一个特许权，跨越 Nith 河。他们展示了类似的建筑细节，尽管每座桥的建造时间相隔 9
年。然而，由于三个河口的不同条件，每座桥的总体设计都有所不同。乡镇公路 12 号提供了一个独特的机会来
观察桥梁设计是如何调整以适应不同的场地条件，如跨度长度和线性倾斜。
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #24 is a steel, eight-panel, rivet-connected Pratt through truss that underwent rehabilita-
tion in 1980. Aside from its early date of construction, this bridge, like some of the others in its group, is rare due to
its use of Carnegie Steel. Although it is not uncommon for steel used in Ontario’s bridges to be sourced from the
United States, it is less common to find Carnegie steel in the Grand River watershed. The Carnegie Steel Company,
headed by Andrew Carnegie, was located in Pittsburg, Pennsylvania and was in operation from 1892 to 1901 before
it was pur-chased by The United States Steel Company.
Blandford-Blenheim 大桥 24 号是一座钢结构，八个面板，铆钉连接的 Pratt 通过桁架在 1980 年进行了修复。
除了它的早期建设日期，这座桥，像其他的一些组，是罕见的，因为它的使用卡内基钢铁。尽管安大略省
桥梁使用的钢材来自美国并不罕见，但在大河流域发现卡内基钢材的情况却不多见。卡内基钢铁公司由安
德鲁 · 卡内基领导，位于宾夕法尼亚州匹次堡，1892 年至 1901 年运营，后来被美国钢铁公司收购。
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #24 is considered a rare survivor due to the increasing occurrence of steel truss bridges
being demolished but not replaced.
Blandford-Blenheim 大桥 24 号被认为是一个罕见的幸存者，因为越来越多的钢桁架桥梁被拆除，但没有取
代。

General Description
一般描述
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #25 is located on Township Road 12, 0.3 km east of Oxford County Road 8. It was con-
structed in 1937 and belongs to a group of six remaining steel truss bridges in the Township that range in age from
the late nineteenth century to 1937. This group includes: Canning (South-East) Truss Bridge, Oxford-Waterloo Road
Bridge, Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #20, Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #24 and Silver Bridge.
Blandford-Blenheim 大桥 25 号位于 12 号乡镇公路上，距牛津郡 8 号公路以东 0.3 公里。它建于 1937 年，属
于该镇现存的六座钢桁架桥，年代从 19 世纪末到 1937 年不等。该组包括: Canning (South-East) Truss
Bridge，Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge，Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 20，Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 24 和
Silver Bridge。
Specially, this bridge is grouped with Blandford-Blenheim Bridges #20 and #24. They are located on Township Road 12,
each one concession apart, crossing the Nith River. They exhibit similar construction details, although each bridge was
constructed nine years apart. However, each bridge has something different in its overall design resulting from the varying
conditions at the three river crossings. Township Road 12 offers a unique opportunity to observe how bridge designs were
adjusted to accommodate different site conditions, such as span length and alignment skew.
特别是，这座桥与布兰福德-布伦海姆桥 20 号和 24 号组合在一起。它们位于 12 号乡镇公路上，每条公路之间都
有特许权，跨越 Nith 河。他们展示了类似的建筑细节，尽管每座桥的建造时间相隔 9 年。然而，由于三个河口的
不同条件，每座桥的总体设计都有所不同。乡镇公路 12 号提供了一个独特的机会来观察桥梁设计是如何调整以
适应不同的场地条件，如跨度长度和线路倾斜。
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #25 is a steel, seven-panel, rivet-connected Pratt through truss that underwent
rehabilita-tion in 1997. Aside from its early date of construction, this bridge is unique due to its use of Algoma Steel.
The steel used for most truss bridges in Ontario was sourced from the United States. However, “ALGOMA
CANADA” is pressed in the bridge’s steel girders, indicating that the material was sourced in Canada from Algoma
Steel, a company founded in 1902 and located on the St. Marys River in Sault Ste. Marie, ON.
Blandford-Blenheim 大桥 # 25 是一座钢结构、七块面板、铆钉连接的普拉特大桥，在 1997 年进行了修复。
除了早期的建设，这座桥是独一无二的，因为它使用了 Algoma 钢铁。安大略省大多数桁架桥使用的钢材来
自美国。然而，“加拿大阿尔戈马”被压在大桥的钢梁上，表明这种材料来自加拿大阿尔戈马钢铁公司，
该公司成立于 1902 年，位于加拿大安大略省苏圣玛丽的圣玛丽河畔。
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #25 is considered a rare survivor due to the increasing occurrence of steel truss bridges
being demolished but not replaced.
Blandford-Blenheim 大桥 25 号被认为是一个罕见的幸存者，因为越来越多的钢桁架桥梁被拆除，但没有取
代。

General Description
一般描述
Silver Bridge is located on Blenheim Road, 0.25 km south of Oxford County Road 39. It was constructed in 1930
and belongs to a group of six remaining steel truss bridges in the Township that range in age from the late nineteenth
century to 1937. This group includes: Canning (South-East) Truss Bridge, Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge,
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #20, Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #24, and Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #25.
银桥位于布莱尼姆路，距牛津郡路 39 号以南 0.25 公里。它建于 1930 年，属于该镇现存的六座钢桁架桥，
年代从 19 世纪末到 1937 年不等。这一组包括: Canning (South-East) Truss Bridge，Oxford-Waterloo Road
Bridge，Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 20，Blandford-Blenheim Bridge # 24，and Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #
25。
Silver Bridge is a steel, eight-panel, rivet-connected double-intersection Warren through truss. The bridge deck
underwent rehabilitation in 1996. This bridge is rare due to its use of Carnegie Steel. Although it is not uncommon
for steel used in Ontario’s bridges to be sourced from the United States, it is less common to find Carnegie steel in
the Grand River watershed. The Carnegie Steel Company, headed by Andrew Carnegie, was located in Pittsburg,
Pennsylvania and was in operation from 1892 to 1901 before it was purchased by The United States Steel Company.
银桥是一座钢结构、八面板、铆钉连接的双十字交叉桁架结构。桥面于 1996 年进行了修复。这座桥是罕见
的，因为它使用了卡内基钢铁。尽管安大略省桥梁使用的钢材来自美国并不罕见，但在大河流域发现卡内
基钢材的情况并不常见。卡内基钢铁公司由安德鲁 · 卡内基领导，位于宾夕法尼亚州匹次堡，1892年至
1901 年运营，后被美国钢铁公司收购。
Silver Bridge is considered a rare survivor due to the increasing occurrence of steel truss bridges being demolished
but not replaced.
银桥被认为是一个罕见的幸存者，因为越来越多的钢桁架桥梁被拆除，但没有取代。
Sources: Township of Blandford-Blenheim OSIM Reports 2011
资料来源: 2011 年 Blandford-Blenheim OSIM 报告

General Description
一般描述
Lot 1, Conc IX, Blenheim Bridge is located on a rise of Trussler Road, 0.14 km north of Blandford-Blenheim
Township Concession Road 9. It was constructed in 1965 and is paired with Lot 1, Conc X, Blenheim Bridge, a
similarly designed structure with concrete and green painted metal railings on Trussler Road. Although this bridge
type is commonly found, Lot 1, Conc IX, Blenheim Bridge is a good example of the style and is part of a well-
designed pair that adds context to Trussler Road.
布莱尼姆大桥位于 Trussler 路上，距离 blandford-Blenheim 镇特许公路 9 号以北 0.14 公里。它建于 1965 年，

个很好的例子，是为 Trussler Road 添加上下文的一对设计良好的桥梁的一部分。

piers exhibit icebreakers.

General Description
一般描述
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #8 is located on Township Road 14, 0.5 km east of Blandford-Blenheim/East Zorra-
Tavistock Boundary. It was constructed in 1960 and is one of the earliest rigid frame structures found in the
Township. It is representative of the concrete rigid frame bridges built throughout the watershed in the 1960s. This
bridge is paired with Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #5, which is also located on Township Road 14 and built in the
same year.
Blandford-Blenheim 大桥 8 号位于 14 号乡镇公路上，距 Blandford-Blenheim/East Zorra-Tavistock 边界 0.5 公
里。它建于 1960 年，是该镇最早发现的刚性框架结构之一。它是 20 世纪 60 年代在整个流域建造的混凝土
刚架桥的代表。这座桥与 Blandford-Blenheim 大桥 # 5 配对，它也位于 14 号乡镇公路上，同年建成。
Blandford-Blenheim Bridge #8 has a slightly shorter span than other similar bridges and depicts simple concrete
railings.
布兰德福德-布莱恩海姆大桥 8 号桥的跨度比其他类似桥梁略短，并描绘了简单的混凝土栏杆。
Source: Township of Blandford-Blenheim OSIM Reports 2011
来源: 2011 年 Blandford-Blenheim OSIM 报告

General Description
一般描述
Roulston Bridge is located on Road 129, 0.1 km south of Line 64 (Mill St. E) in the community of Milverton. It was
constructed circa 1920 and is one of two remaining steel truss bridges in the Township of Perth East, joined by a
pony truss located on private property at 4424 Line 76.
Roulston 桥位于米尔弗顿社区 64 号线以南 0.1 公里的 129 号公路上。它建于 1920 年左右，是珀斯东部小镇
仅存的两座钢桁架桥之一，由位于 76 号线 4424 号的私人地产上的小马桁架连接。
Roulston Bridge is a riveted pony truss with a concrete deck and abutments set quite high above the Smith Creek
floodplain amidst a picturesque rural landscape. The bridge’s north end stringers were replaced in 2003. This pony
truss represents a rare survivor in the Grand River watershed, as steel truss bridges are increasingly being removed
but not replaced.
Roulston 桥是一个铆钉小马桁架与混凝土甲板和桥台设置相当高的上述史密斯河泛滥平原在一个风景如画
的乡村景观。大桥北端的特约记者在 2003 年被更换。这个矮小的桁架代表了大河分水岭罕见的幸存者，因
为钢桁架桥越来越多地被拆除，但没有被取代。
Source: Perth East 2011 Bridge & Culvert Biennial Inspection Reports (Book 2 of 2)
来源: Perth East 2011 Bridge & Culvert Biennial Inspection Reports (Book 2 of 2)

General Description
一般描述
The Line 76 Truss Bridge is located on private property on Line 76, just east of Road 129 in the community of New-
ton. This uniquely simple pony truss was constructed circa 1920 and is one of two remaining steel truss bridges in
the Township of Perth East, joined by the Roulston Bridge.
76 号线桁架桥位于 76 号线的私人财产上，就在 129 号公路以东的纽顿社区。这座独一无二的简易小马桁架
大约建于 1920 年，是珀斯东部小镇仅存的两座钢桁架桥之一，由 Roulston 桥连接。
The Line 76 Truss Bridge appears to be a pin jointed pony truss with a timber deck and very small concrete abutments.
The bridge is now located on private agricultural land but was originally built by the Township of Perth East and located
somewhere along Line 76. The bridge was moved to its current location in 1963. This pony truss represents a rare sur-
vivor in the Grand River watershed, as steel truss bridges are increasingly being removed but not replaced.
76 号线桁架桥看起来像是一个木质甲板和非常小的混凝土桥墩连接的小马桁架。这座桥现在位于私人农业用地上，
但最初是由东珀斯镇建造的，位于 76 号线的某个地方。1963年，这座桥被移到了现在的位置。这个矮小的桁架
代表了大河流域罕见的幸存者，因为钢桁架桥越来越多地被拆除，但没有被取代。

General Description
一般描述
Site Number 71 Bridge is located on Line 80, 0.2 km east of Perth Road 131. It was constructed circa 1930 and is
one of the earliest rigid frame bridges remaining in the Township of Perth East. It is representative of riged frame
bridges built in this era throughout the watershed. However, Site Number 71 Bridge is more decorative than other
rigid frames, exhibiting art deco inspired concrete balustrades with inset boxes embossed with varying line lengths.
The thin board finish is still visible in the concrete.
71 号大桥位于 80 号线，珀斯公路 131 号以东 0.2 公里。它建于 1930 年左右，是珀斯东部小镇现存的最早的
刚构桥之一。它是这个时代在整个流域建造的钢架桥的代表。然而，71号桥比其他刚性框架更具装饰性，
展示了艺术装饰风格的混凝土栏杆与嵌入框浮雕的不同线长。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土中看到。

General Description
一般描述
Site Number 72 Bridge is located on Line 80, 0.2 km east of Road 129, east of the hamlet of Burns. It was
constructed circa 1940 and is one of the earlier rigid frame bridges remaining in the Township of Perth East. It is
slightly skewed to the watercourse, displays a uniquely decorative design and is paired with Site Number 74 Bridge.
72 号桥位于 80 号线，129 号公路以东 0.2 公里，伯恩斯村以东。它建于 1940 年左右，是珀斯东部小镇现存
的早期刚构桥梁之一。它略微倾斜于河道，显示出独特的装饰设计，并与 74 号场地桥配对。
Site Number 72 Bridge is representative of the rigid frame bridge type built in this era throughout the watershed.
However, it is uniquely decorative on the river facing sides with large, solid square pilasters with smaller square top
caps and embossed lines. The pilasters placed between the start of the abutments and the elliptical arch, as well as at
the abutment ends, project outward slightly and run all the way to the ground. These pilasters feature three embossed
lines. The thin board finish is still very visible in the bridge’s concrete.
72 号桥是这个时代在整个流域建造的刚性框架桥的代表。然而，它在面向河流的两岸有着独特的装饰性，
大的，实心的方形壁柱，小的方形顶盖和浮雕线条。壁柱放置在桥墩开始和椭圆形拱门之间，以及在桥墩
末端，稍微向外突出，一直延伸到地面。这些壁柱有三条浮雕线条。薄薄的板面在大桥的混凝土中依然清
晰可见。
Source: Perth East 2011 Bridge & Culvert Biennial Inspection Reports (Book 2 of 2)
来源: Perth East 2011 Bridge & Culvert Biennial Inspection Reports (Book 2 of 2)

General Description
一般描述
Site Number 74 Bridge is located on Line 76, 0.1 km west of Perth Road 131. It was constructed circa 1940 and is
one of the earlier rigid frame bridges remaining in the Township of Perth East. It displays a uniquely decorative
design and is paired with Site Number 72 Bridge.
74 号桥位于 76 号线，珀斯 131 号公路以西 0.1 公里。它建于 1940 年左右，是珀斯东部小镇现存的较早的刚
构桥之一。它展示了一种独特的装饰设计，并与 72 号桥结合在一起。

ever, it is uniquely decorative on the river facing sides with large, solid square pilasters with smaller square top caps and

ends, project outward slightly and run all the way to the ground. These pilasters feature three embossed lines.
74 号桥是这个时代在整个分水岭建造的刚性框架桥的代表。无论如何，它都是独一无二的装饰在面向河流的两侧，
有大的，实心的方形壁柱，小的方形顶盖和浮雕线条。壁柱放置在桥墩开始和椭圆形拱门之间，以及在桥墩末端，
稍微向外突出，一直延伸到地面。这些壁柱有三条浮雕线条。

General Description
一般描述
Site Number 75 Bridge is located off Line 76, 0.4 km west of 128 Road and provides access to a private farmstead.
It was constructed circa 1940 and is one of the earlier rigid frame bridges remaining in the Township of Perth East.
75 号大桥位于 76 号线以外，在 128 路以西 0.4 公里处，通往一个私人农场。它建于 1940 年左右，是珀斯东
部小镇现存的早期刚构桥梁之一。
Site Number 75 Bridge is representative of the rigid frame bridge type built in this era throughout the watershed.
How-ever, it displays a uniquely decorative design with its use of steel beam railings mixed with art deco inspired
concrete balustrades. The large, solid square pilasters are embossed with three lines and exhibit smaller square top
caps. The wing walls on this structure are unique, as they project from the abutment in a triangular form on each side
of the bridge. The thin board finish is quite visible on the concrete abutment walls beneath the bridge.
75 号场地桥梁代表了这个时代在整个流域建造的刚构桥型。无论如何，它展示了一个独特的装饰设计，钢
梁栏杆与艺术装饰风格的混凝土栏杆混合使用。大型实心方形壁柱上浮雕有三条线条，并展示了较小的方
形顶盖。这个结构的翼墙是独一无二的，因为它们在桥的每一边都以三角形的形式从桥台伸出。薄板装饰
在桥下的混凝土桥台墙上非常明显。

General Description
一般描述
Millbank Bridge is located on Elgin Street, between Princess Street and Church Street, in the community of
Millbank, in the Township of Perth East. It was constructed circa 1970 and contributes to a cultural heritage
landscape in Mill-bank, joining two neighbourhoods over the Nith River along the gently curving Elgin Street.
Millbank 大桥位于埃尔金街，公主街和教堂街之间，在珀斯东部的 Millbank 社区。它建于 1970 年左右，是
Mill-bank 的一处文化遗产景观，连接了 Nith 河上的两个街区，沿着缓缓弯曲的埃尔金街道。
This concrete rigid frame bridge has metal railings and a pleasing elliptical arch. The bridge appears to be celebrated by
the community due to its adornment with flowers and plaques commemorating locals. A larger plaque was erected by The
Millbank Association to thank community members for their help with a local Beautification Competition.
这座混凝土刚构桥有金属栏杆和令人愉快的椭圆拱。这座桥由于装饰着鲜花和纪念当地人的牌匾而受到当地社区
的欢迎。Millbank 协会竖立了一个更大的牌匾，以感谢社区成员对当地美化比赛的帮助。
Source: Perth East 2012 Bridge & Culvert Biennial Inspection Reports (Book 2 of 2)

General Description
一般描述
The Nithvale Bridge spans the Nith River 0.05 km south of Piper Street at the end of Nith Road and is thought to be the third
bridge at this crossing. Built in 1873 by Alex Mathison for $1,426, the Nithvale Bridge is the older of two abandoned truss
bridges in the Township of North Dumfries, joined by the Piper Street Steel Truss Bridge located just to the south. This structure
is the oldest truss bridge in the Region of Waterloo, having been built early in the era of truss bridge construction.
Nithvale 大桥横跨 Nith 河，位于 Piper 街以南 0.05 公里，位于 Nith 路的尽头，被认为是这个路口的第三座大桥。
Nithvale 大桥由 Alex Mathison 于 1873 年建造，造价 1426 美元，是北邓弗里斯小镇两座废弃桁架桥中较老的一座，与之
相连的是位于南边的 Piper 街钢桁架桥。这座桥是滑铁卢地区最古老的桁架桥，建于桁架桥建造的早期。
The Nithvale Bridge is an eight-paneled, single span, Pratt through truss bridge constructed of both wrought iron and steel. This
use of materials reflects the transition in bridge building that took place in the late 1800s where the reliance on wrought iron
shifted to steel. Few wrought iron bridges remain in the watershed, furthering speaking to the uniqueness of this struc-ture. The
Nithvale Bridge is pin-jointed rather than riveted, suggesting it was built before riveting technology reached the area. In 1914, the
Hamilton Bridge Company added a short, steel girder span to the south end of the truss. The bridge was closed to vehicular traffic
in 1967 due to safety concerns. However, the bridge is still used by pedestrians today.
Nithvale 大桥是一座由熟铁和钢构成的八层单跨普拉特桁架桥。这种材料的使用反映了 19 世纪晚期桥梁建筑的转变，
当时对锻铁的依赖转移到了钢材上。几乎没有锻铁桥梁保留在分水岭，进一步说明了这种结构的独特性。Nithvale 大桥
是用销钉连接而不是铆接的，这表明它是在铆接技术到达该地区之前建造的。 1914 年，汉密尔顿大桥公司在桁架的南
端增加了一个短的钢梁跨度。出于安全考虑，这座桥在 1967 年关闭，禁止车辆通行。然而，这座桥今天仍然被行人使
用。
The Nithvale Bridge is said to be a landmark linked to the previous Village of Nithvale. The small village was home to
two sawmills and a flourmill. The village never flourished due to increased development in neighbouring towns that
eventually amalgamated to form the Village of Ayr. Today, the Nithvale Bridge remains abandoned and almost
completely concealed by foliage along Piper Street.
Nithvale 大桥据说是连接 Nithvale 村庄的地标性建筑。这个小村庄是两个锯木厂和一个面粉厂的所在地。由于邻
近城镇的不断发展，最终合并成了艾尔村庄，这个村庄从未繁荣过。今天，Nithvale 大桥仍然被遗弃，几乎完全
隐藏在沿着 Piper 街的树叶中。
The Nithvale Bridge and the Piper Street Steel Truss Bridge form a pair of two truss bridges in the Township of North Dum-fries.
Other similar truss bridges within the Region of Waterloo include: Wellesley Bridge #6, Holland Mills Road Bridge, Black
Bridge Road Bridge, Conestogo Bridge, Haysville Bridge (demolished), the Hartman Bridge and Shade Street Bridge.
Nithvale 大桥和 Piper 街钢桁架桥在 North Dum-fries 镇形成了两座桁架桥。滑铁卢地区其他类似的桁架桥包括: 韦尔斯利
大桥 6 号、荷兰米尔斯路大桥、黑桥路大桥、 conesstogo 大桥、海斯维尔大桥(已拆除)、哈特曼大桥和遮荫街大桥。

General Description
一般描述
The Piper Street Steel Truss Bridge, also known as the Slabtown Bridge, was built circa 1915. It is located on private
agricultural land 0.2 km east of Trussler Road and 0.05 km south of Piper Street, near the Village of Ayr, in the Township
of North Dumfries. The bridge is a riveted Pratt through truss with a similar design to other early trusses in the area. The
structure likely required a highly skilled bridge crew to assemble it. If it had been pin-jointed together, rather than riveted,
it could have been easily secured by hand.
派珀街钢桁架桥，也称为 Slabtown 大桥，建于 1915 年左右。它位于私人农业用地 Trussler 路以东 0.2 公里，Piper
街以南 0.05 公里，靠近北邓弗里斯小镇的艾尔村庄。这座桥是一个铆接普拉特通过桁架与类似的设计在该地区的
其他早期桁架。这种结构可能需要一个技术高超的桥梁工作人员来组装。如果它是用大头针连接在一起，而不是
用铆钉固定，那么用手就可以轻松地固定住。
The Piper Street Steel Truss Bridge is the oldest remaining riveted truss bridge in the Township of North Dumfries, and is one of
two remaining Pratt truss bridges. The other bridge that belongs to this set is the Nithvale Bridge. Located in close proximity to
each other, during major flood periods on the Nith River, they both usually suffer the same damage. However, the Piper Street
Steel Truss Bridge has been built with heavier construction than the Nithvale Bridge and fares better.
派珀街钢桁架桥是北邓弗里斯小镇现存最古老的铆接桁架桥，也是现存的两座普拉特桁架桥之一。另一座属于这座桥的
是 Nithvale 大桥。在 Nith 河的大洪水期间，它们彼此靠得很近，通常都会遭受同样的破坏。然而，派珀街钢桁架桥的
建设比 Nithvale 大桥要重，而且票价更高。
Several repairs have been made to the bridge throughout its lifetime. The deck has been replaced multiple times and the
abutment foundations have been filled with cement twice. Aside from the noted repairs, the original steel truss and the
overall form of the bridge has remained intact in order to preserve the bridges historical integrity.
在这座桥的整个使用寿命期间，已经进行了几次维修。桥面已经更换了好几次，桥台地基也用水泥填充了两次。
除了著名的维修，原来的钢桁架和桥梁的整体形式保持完整，以保持桥梁的历史完整性。
The structure is also referred to as the Slabtown Bridge after the historic hamlet that was located just to the west. The
small village had a sawmill and several smaller houses for its workers, and the bridge represents a landmark that reminds
people of this historic settlement. Presently, the ruins of the sawmill and the millrace can still be seen near the bridge and a
wooden house, built circa 1860, remains beside the structure. The bridge’s rustic appearance also provides a strong sense
of character that contributes to its surrounding rural landscape.
这座建筑也被称为 Slabtown 桥，因为它位于历史悠久的小村庄西面。这个小村庄有一个锯木厂和几个小房子为其
工人，桥代表了一个地标，提醒人们这个历史性的定居点。目前，锯木厂和磨坊的废墟仍然可以看到附近的桥梁
和一个木制房子，建于 1860 年左右，仍然在建筑物旁边。桥的质朴外观也提供了一种强烈的特征感，有助于其
周围的乡村景观。
The Piper Street Steel Truss Bridge and the Nithvale Bridge form a pair of two truss bridges in the Township of North Dum-fries.
Other similar truss bridges within the Region of Waterloo include: Wellesley Bridge #6, Holland Mills Road Bridge, Black
Bridge Road Bridge, Conestogo Bridge, Haysville Bridge (demolished), the Hartman Bridge and Shade Street Bridge.
Piper 街的钢桁架桥和 Nithvale 桥在 North Dum-fries 镇形成了两座桁架桥。滑铁卢地区其他类似的桁架桥包括: 韦尔斯利
大桥 6 号、荷兰米尔斯路大桥、黑桥路大桥、 conesstogo 大桥、海斯维尔大桥(已拆除)、哈特曼大桥和遮荫街大桥。
Sources: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory

General Description
一般描述
The Main Street Bridge spans the Grand River between Water and Melville Streets, in the former City of Galt, now the
City of Cambridge. The bridge is a multiple-span concrete bowstring arch bridge and was constructed in 1931. The
property was designated by the City of Cambridge in 1982 for its heritage value under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage
Act (By-law 2225). The Cambridge Main Street Bridge has also been listed on the Ontario Heritage Bridge list, a list of
provincially-significant bridges maintained by the Ministry of Tourism, Culture and Sport.
主街大桥横跨格兰德河，在沃特和梅尔维尔街之间，位于前高尔特市，现在的剑桥市。这座桥是一座多跨混凝土
弓弦拱桥，建于 1931 年。1982 年，剑桥市根据《安大略省遗产法》第四部分(第 2225 号法令)指定该建筑为其遗
产价值。剑桥大街大桥也被列入了安大略省遗产桥梁名单，这是一份由旅游、文化和体育部维护的省级重要桥梁
名单。
Cambridge’s Main Street Bridge is located in the historic centre of the former City of Galt and spans the Grand River, a
Canadian Heritage River. It is part of a group of four multiple-span concrete bowstring arch bridges spanning the Grand
River that were erected in the same time period and in a similar style. These bridges are a part of the upgrading work that
took place to the transportation networks in Ontario, after the First World War, to accommodate the increased number of
automobiles. This group includes two other bridges within the Region of Waterloo, the Freeport Bridge and the Bridgeport
Bridge in Kitchener. The fourth bridge, the Caledonia Bridge is located in the community of Caledonia.
剑桥的主街大桥位于前高尔特市的历史中心，横跨加拿大文化遗产河格兰德河。它是横跨大河的四座多跨混凝土
拱桥的一部分，这些拱桥都是在同一时期以类似的风格建造的。这些桥梁是第一次世界大战后安大略省交通网络
升级工作的一部分，以适应汽车数量的增加。这一组包括滑铁卢地区的另外两座桥梁，弗里波特大桥和基奇纳的
布里奇波特大桥。第四座桥，喀里多尼亚大桥位于喀里多尼亚社区。
The Cambridge Main Street Bridge crosses the Grand River and connects the east and west sides of downtown Galt,
making it the most important bridge in the City of Cambridge. The first bridge on this site was a three-span steel truss
bridge built in 1819 and rebuilt 1858. The current bridge was commissioned by the former City of Galt, at a cost of
approximately $55,000. The structure was designed by Archibald B. Crealock, a consulting engineer from Toronto and
was built in four months, by W.H. Yates Construction Company Limited of Hamilton. The official opening of the Main
Street Bridge took place on December 22, 1931.
剑桥大街大桥横跨格兰德河，连接高尔特市中心的东西两侧，使其成为剑桥市最重要的桥梁。这里的第一座桥是
一座三跨钢桁架桥，建于 1819 年，重建于 1858 年。目前的这座桥是由前 Galt 市委托建造的，花费大约 55000 美
元。这座桥由 Archibald b。 Crealock 设计，他是一位来自多伦多的咨询工程师，由汉密尔顿的 w.h。 Yates 建筑
有限公司在四个月内建成。主街大桥于 1931 年 12 月 22 日正式通车。
The Cambridge Main Street Bridge is a reinforced concrete bowstring arch bridge with decorative concrete rails and
balustrades. The bridge’s bowstring design was popular in the 1920s and 1930s as it required minimal material, was
simple to install and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic. The bridge’s abutments and piers are built entirely on
limestone bedrock. Two lanes of cars can cross the bridge and eight-foot wide sidewalks, one on either side of the
vehicular traffic, allow for safe pedestrian passage.
剑桥主街大桥是一座钢筋混凝土拱桥，有装饰性的混凝土轨道和栏杆。这座桥的弓弦设计在 20 世纪 20 年代和 30
年代很流行，因为它只需要很少的材料，安装简单，容易容纳车辆。大桥的桥墩和桥墩完全建在石灰岩基岩上。
两车道的汽车可以通过桥梁和 8 英尺宽的人行道，一边的车辆交通，允许安全的行人通道。
Sources: City of Cambridge By-law 2225; City of Cambridge Report, 2002; Municipal Structure Inspection Form, County of
Brant; Spanning the Generations, Phase 2
