General Description
一般描述
The Black Bridge spans the Speed River on Black Bridge Road, 2.4 km east of Highway 24, in the community of
Hes-peler, in the City of Cambridge. Lying on the border of the Township of Puslinch and the City of Cambridge it
con-tributes to the surrounding scenic rural landscape. Typical of the era, the bridge is a single-lane, pin-jointed,
steel Pratt through truss bridge, which was constructed in 1916. The bridge was designated by the City of
Cambridge in 2003 for its cultural value or interest under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (By-law 16-03).
黑桥位于剑桥市的 he-peler 社区，位于 24 号高速公路以东 2.4 公里的黑桥路上，横跨速度河。它位于
Puslinch 镇和剑桥市的交界处，为周围的乡村风景做出了贡献。这座桥是那个时代的典型，它是一座单车道、
铰接的普拉特钢桁架桥，建于 1916 年。2003年，剑桥市根据《安大略省遗产法》(第 16-03 号附则)第四部
分的规定，以其文化价值或利益为由，指定了这座桥。
It is predicted that the bridge was constructed circa 1916 due to a wooden timber with ‘1916’ stamped on the bottom
discovered during one of the repairs the bridge has undergone. Despite these extensive repairs in 1931 and 1996, the
Black Bridge has retained its original form. It is the only remaining steel bridge of its kind in the City of Cambridge.
The history of the bridge is commemorated with a Region of Waterloo interpretive plaque located on the west side
of the structure.
据预测，这座桥是在 1916 年左右建造的，因为在一次大桥维修过程中发现了底部刻有“1916”字样的木材。
尽管在 1931 年和 1996 年进行了大规模的维修，黑桥还是保留了原来的样子。它是剑桥市仅存的同类型钢桥。
为了纪念这座桥的历史，在它的西侧有一块滑铁卢地区的解说牌匾。
On site, there is evidence of a wooden bridge present as early as 1910. Black Bridge Road was historically part of
Block Line, an important boundary in Waterloo County. Block Line divided Wilson’s Upper Block from Wilson’s
Lower Block, and was used as a reference point on several historic maps dating back to 1805.
在现场，早在 1910 年就有木桥存在的证据。黑桥路在历史上曾是 Block Line 的一部分，Block Line 是滑铁
卢县的重要边界。街区线把威尔逊的上街区和威尔逊的下街区分开，并作为一些历史地图的参考点，可以
追溯到 1805 年。
The Black Bridge is one of a group of similar truss bridges located in the Region of Waterloo including: Wellesley
Bridge #6, Holland Mills Road Bridge, Piper Street Steel Truss Bridge, Nithvale Bridge, Conestogo Bridge,
Haysville Bridge (demolished), the Hartman Bridge and Shade Street Bridge.
黑桥是位于滑铁卢地区的一组类似的桁架桥之一，包括: 韦尔斯利大桥 6 号、荷兰米尔斯路大桥、派珀街钢
桁架桥、 Nithvale 大桥、 conesstogo 大桥、海斯维尔大桥(拆除)、哈特曼大桥和遮荫街大桥。
Sources: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory

General Description
一般描述
The Grand River Viaduct carries the Canadian Pacific Railway (CPR) across the Grand River just north of Park Hill
Road in the City of Cambridge. The Grand River Viaduct is a landmark and acts as a gateway into the downtown
area of Galt. The viaduct can only be seen from downstream locations such as the Park Hill Road Bridge. It is
estimated that the Credit Valley Railway built this three-span, steel deck truss viaduct circa 1880 as this was roughly
when the railway was constructed through Galt.
大河高架桥承载着加拿大太平洋铁路(CPR)穿过大河，就在剑桥市公园山路以北。格兰德河高架桥是一个地
标性建筑，是进入 Galt 市中心的门户。高架桥只能从下游的位置看到，比如公园山路桥。据估计，大约在
1880 年左右，信贷谷铁路建造了这座三跨钢桥面桁架高架桥，因为当时铁路是通过 Galt 建造的。
The bridge is part of a significant landscape in Galt. The associated Canadian Pacific Railway station is located at 10
Front Street and is composed of two brick and stone buildings built between 1898-1900. The two structures, a
railway station (1898-1899) and express shed (1900), were designated under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act in
1991. They reflect the importance of the railway to the social and industrial development of the community of Galt.
The comple-tion of this CPR station in 1899 affirmed the existing mutual significance of town and railway. When a
local electric railway system was created, the electric trains met the steam trains at this station, playing an even
larger social and economic role in the community.
这座桥是 Galt 重要景观的一部分。相关的加拿大太平洋火车站位于前街 10 号，由两座建于 1898-1900 年间
的砖石建筑组成。这两个建筑物，一个火车站(1898-1899 年)和快车棚(1900 年) ，是根据 1991 年《安大略遗
产法》第四部分指定的。它们反映了铁路对 Galt 社区的社会和工业发展的重要性。这个 CPR 站在 1899 年
完工，肯定了城镇和铁路现有的相互重要性。当地方电气化铁路系统建成后，电气化列车在这个车站与蒸
汽列车相遇，在社区中发挥着更大的社会和经济作用。

General Description
一般描述
The Blair Stone Arch is an abandoned stone masonry arch bridge located over Bowman Creek/Blair Creek, 25 m
west of the intersection of Blair Road and Fountain Street in the City of Cambridge. Based on the unique design of
the bridge and the materials used, it is likely of very early construction. In Ontario, several stone bridges were built
around the turn of the century, however masonry was not used in excess due to the time, money and skill that was
required. Concrete quickly became a more popular building material. As a result, the Blair Stone Arch represents a
rare survivor in the watershed and the province.
布莱尔石拱桥是一座废弃的石砌拱桥，位于剑桥市布莱尔路和喷泉街交叉口以西 25 米处的鲍曼河/布莱尔河
上。基于这座桥独特的设计和使用的材料，它很可能是非常早期的建筑。在安大略省，几座石桥是在世纪
之交建造的，然而由于时间、金钱和技术的需要，砖石并没有过度使用。混凝土很快成为一种更受欢迎的
建筑材料。因此，布莱尔石拱门代表了一个罕见的幸存者在分水岭和该省。
The bridge appears to have been abandoned for a number of years and is now only suitable for pedestrian use.
这座桥似乎已经废弃多年，现在只适合行人使用。

General Description
一般描述
The George Street Underpass spans both George Street and the Grand River, 0.15 km north of James Street in the
City of Cambridge. It is a three-span, steel deck truss on masonry piers and abutments. There is a concrete cap on
the bridge engraved with the year ‘1931’, the bridge’s date of construction. The bridge is maintained and partly
owned by the Canadian Pacific Railway and is a portion of the Grand River Viaduct. It is located near several other
railway bridges that carry the same track just outside of downtown Galt.
乔治街地下通道横跨乔治街和格兰德河，位于剑桥市詹姆斯街以北 0.15 公里处。这是一个三跨钢桥面桁架，
位于石砌桥墩和桥台上。桥上有一个混凝土盖，上面刻着“1931”，这是大桥的建造日期。这座桥由加拿大
太平洋铁路公司负责维护和部分拥有，是格兰德河高架桥的一部分。它位于高尔特市中心外的几座铁路桥
附近，这几座铁路桥承载着同样的轨道。

General Description
一般描述
The Mill Creek Overpass spans Mill Creek in the north end of Soper Park near Elgin and Samuelson Streets in the City of
Cambridge. It is a single-span railway viaduct constructed of structural steel. The Credit Valley Railway likely built this
bridge circa 1880, as this was the year the railway was laid through Galt. The abutments are composed of rock-faced
stone, further supporting the bridge’s estimated date of construction pre-1900. The Credit Valley Railway was short lived
and ownership of the line passed to the Canadian Pacific Railway in the late 19th century.
在剑桥市的埃尔金和 Samuelson 街附近的索珀公园的北端，Mill Creek 立交桥跨越了 Mill Creek。这是一个单跨铁
路高架桥，由结构钢构成。信贷谷铁路很可能在 1880 年左右建造了这座桥，因为这一年铁路通过 Galt 铺设。桥
墩由岩石表面的石头构成，进一步支撑了大桥在 1900 年之前的建造时间。信贷谷铁路存在的时间很短，在 19 世
纪后期，这条铁路的所有权转移到了加拿大太平洋铁路。
Sources: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1, 2004
资料来源: 跨越几代人，阶段 1,2004
Andreae, C. (1997). Lines of Country: An atlas of railway and waterway history in Canada
《国家线: 加拿大铁路和水路历史地图集》

General Description
一般描述
The Blair Bridge is located on Fountain Street, east of Blair Road in the City of Cambridge. Designed by D.M. Jordon, the
bridge was built in 1957 and officially opened on December 12, 1957. It was constructed by R.A. Blyth and en-gineered
by M.M Dillon. The Blair Bridge was dedicated to Joseph A. Armstrong. The bridge’s three arched spans of reinforced
concrete maintain an ascetically appealing look and contribute to the history and prominence of the Blair Village Heritage
Conservation District, which was designated under Part V of the Ontario Heritage Act in 2002.
布莱尔大桥位于剑桥市布莱尔路以东的喷泉街上。该桥由 d.m。乔丹设计，建于 1957 年，于 1957 年 12 月 12 日
正式通车。它由 r.a。 Blyth 建造，M.M。 Dillon 设计。布莱尔大桥是献给约瑟夫 · 阿姆斯特朗的。大桥的三个钢
筋混凝土拱形跨度保持了一种苦行僧式的吸引人的外观，并有助于历史和突出的布莱尔村遗产保护区，这是指定
根据第五部分的安大略省遗产法在 2002 年。
Historically, there have been several other bridges over the Grand River downstream from this location in the com-
munity of Blair, including a shingle-roofed covered bridge built as early as 1835. An iron bridge replaced the
covered bridge in 1857 and remained in use until 1957 when the Blair Bridge was built. The iron piers of this
previous bridge can still be seen downstream from the Blair Bridge.
从历史上看，在布莱尔社区的格兰德河下游还有其他几座桥，包括早在 1835 年就建成的一座带屋顶的屋顶
桥。1857 年，一座铁桥取代了盖桥，一直使用到 1957 年布莱尔大桥建成。从布莱尔大桥下游可以看到之前
这座桥的铁桥墩。
Sources: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory

General Description
一般描述
The Mill Creek Bridge is located on Dundas Street in the City of Cambridge’s Soper Park. It was constructed in
1837, making it the oldest documented bridge in the Region of Waterloo and likely the oldest in the Grand River
water-shed. British pioneers, John Galt and thousands more first used the bridge, representing a historic link to the
Region’s past. Today, the bridge crosses Mill Creek via Dundas Street and the pedestrian sidewalks that pass
through the arch beneath the bridge.
米尔克里克大桥位于剑桥市索珀公园的邓达斯街上。它建于 1837 年，是滑铁卢地区有文献记载的最古老的
桥梁，也可能是大河流域最古老的桥梁。英国拓荒者约翰 · 高尔特(John Galt)和其他数千人首先使用了这座
桥，它代表了与该地区过去的历史联系。今天，这座桥通过邓达斯街穿过米尔河，人行道穿过桥下的拱门。
In 2004, this unique bridge underwent major reconstruction, including the replacement of the existing concrete and
replication of the original structure. The roadway was widened and new parapet walls composed of natural stones
were installed to replace the previous steel railings. The original stones were individually numbered before
reconstruction and were incorporated in the facing of the new structure and parapet walls to disguise the
reconstructed concrete arch beneath. A plaque was erected on site in 2007 by the Region of Waterloo to celebrate
the bridge’s significant historic past.
2004 年，这座独特的桥梁进行了大规模的重建，包括更换现有的混凝土和复制原来的结构。道路被拓宽，
新的由天然石头组成的护墙被安装以取代之前的钢栏杆。原来的石头在重建之前被单独编号，并且被纳入
新结构和护墙的表面，以掩盖下面重建的混凝土拱。滑铁卢地区于 2007 年在现场竖立了一块牌匾，以庆祝
这座大桥重要的历史性过去。
Sources: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory

Cambridge Times, 2007

General Description
一般描述
The Park Hill Road Bridge is located on Park Hill Road, 0.5 km west of Water Street in the City of Cambridge in the
area of old Galt. This four-span concrete T-beam structure was built in 1933 and features decorative concrete
railings and piers.
公园山路桥位于剑桥市水街以西 0.5 公里的公园山路上，旧高尔特地区。这座四跨混凝土 t 型梁结构建于
1933 年，具有装饰性的混凝土栏杆和桥墩。
The Park Hill Road Bridge is credited as one of three bridges that contributed to the early development of Galt. This
bridge is part of a grouping of bridges that cross the Grand River allowing passage into downtown Galt. The other
bridges in this group include the Main Street Bridge and the Concession Street Bridge. Together they represent local
landmarks and gateways as travelers enter the downtown core.
公园山路桥被认为是对 Galt 的早期发展做出贡献的三座桥之一。这座桥是跨越格兰德河的一组桥梁的一部
分，这些桥梁允许进入市中心的 Galt。这一组中的其他桥梁包括主街大桥和特许街大桥。当游客进入市中
心时，它们一起代表了当地的地标和门户。
The Cambridge Mill Race Park is located to the southeast of the Park Hill Road Bridge, an area consisting of old
mill ruins along with an excavated mill raceway. The Turnbull Knitting Mill was built on this site in 1867 and
became part of Dobbie Industries in 1946. Water was still used to power the mill in the 1950s and the business ran
well into the 1970s. The site of the mill was dedicated in 1977 to recognize the contribution of the pioneering
manufacturers and the importance of the river to this community. A Grand River Canadian Heritage River
designation plaque is also located in this park.
剑桥磨坊赛道公园位于公园山路桥的东南部，这个地区由旧磨坊废墟和挖掘出的磨坊赛道组成。特恩布尔
针织厂建于 1867 年，1946 年成为多比工业的一部分。在 20 世纪 50 年代，水仍然是这家纺织厂的动力来源，
这家公司的生意一直持续到 20 世纪 70 年代。1977 年，为了表彰先驱制造商的贡献以及河流对这个社区的
重要性，工厂的选址被奉献出来。大河加拿大遗产河指定牌匾也位于这个公园。
In 2002 Park Hill Road was widened and the bridge was reconstructed. However, this work respected the original fabric of
the bridge as the structure retains the same design and the new railing and lighting replicate original features.
2002 年，公园山路被拓宽，桥梁被重建。然而，这项工作尊重了桥的原始结构，因为结构保留了相同的设计和新
的栏杆和照明复制了原有的特点。

General Description
一般描述
The King Street Bridge is located on King Street, 0.11 km west of Chopin Drive in the City of Cambridge. The
original bridge at this site was likely built in 1924, however a large portion of the bridge was replaced in 1987. The
northern most end of the bridge, the portion that crosses the millrace, is the only portion of the 1924 bridge
remaining. This three-span structure was rebuilt to look similar to the original bridge. It is now a box girder bridge
constructed of pre-cast concrete. Efforts were made to decorate the bridge with embossed concrete, built in
flowerbeds and several lamp posts that line the bridge railings on both sides.
国王街大桥位于剑桥市肖邦大道以西 0.11 公里的国王街。这里最初的桥可能建于 1924 年，然而大部分桥梁
在 1987 年被更换。桥的最北端，穿过磨坊的部分，是 1924 年大桥仅存的部分。这座三跨结构的桥梁经过重
建，看起来与原来的桥梁相似。它现在是一个箱梁桥建造的预制混凝土。人们努力用浮雕混凝土装饰这座
桥，这些浮雕混凝土建在花坛里，还有几根灯柱沿着桥的两侧栏杆排列。
A CPR railway bridge is located directly to the north of the bridge, along with remnants of a dam once used to
power the millrace. The millrace belongs to Dover Flour Mills located to the west of the bridge. They have retained
the func-tion of the mill raceway should they require waterpower in the future.
一座 CPR 铁路桥直接位于桥的北面，还有一座曾经用来为磨坊提供动力的大坝的残余部分。磨坊属于位于
桥西的多佛面粉厂。他们保留了磨坊滚道的功能，以备将来需要水力时使用。

Speed Island Trail Bridge

General Description
一般描述
The Speed Island Trail Bridge is located 0.5 km west of Beaverdale Road on the Speed Island Trail in the City of
Cam-bridge and leads to an island with a private home. It is believed that the bridge was built circa 1950. The
structure is a three-span, I-beam bridge constructed of steel and concrete. The abutments and piers appear to be quite
old as the thin board finish is still visible in the concrete. The deck has also been recently replaced, possibly around
1990. The City of Cambridge has no records of the bridge, however it was likely a public works project.
速度岛步道桥位于坎布里奇市速度岛步道 Beaverdale 路以西 0.5 公里处，通往一个拥有私人住宅的岛屿。据
信，这座桥建于 1950 年左右。这座桥是一座由钢筋和混凝土构成的三跨 i 型梁桥。桥墩和桥墩看起来相当
古老，因为在混凝土中仍然可以看到薄薄的板面。甲板最近也被更换了，可能是在 1990 年左右。剑桥市没
有这座桥的记录，但它很可能是一个公共工程项目。
Source: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1

General Description
一般描述
The Elgin Street Bridge is located at the end of Elgin Street, near the north exit of Soper Park in the community of
Galt, City of Cambridge. It is located just south of the Mill Creek Overpass. Previously a road bridge, the structure
is now only suitable for pedestrian use. The bridge is a two-span, precast concrete slab structure with solid,
decorative concrete railings embossed with rectangles and featuring pronounced end posts with square top caps. The
two-span construction of this bridge is a unique feature, seldom seen in a structure of this type and design spanning
such a narrow watercourse.
埃尔金街大桥位于埃尔金街的尽头，靠近索珀公园的北出口，位于剑桥市高尔特社区。它位于米尔克里克
立交桥的南部。以前是一座公路桥，现在只适合行人使用。桥梁是一个两跨，预制混凝土板结构与实心，
装饰混凝土栏杆浮雕矩形和突出的结束柱与方形顶盖。这座桥的两跨结构是一个独特的特点，在这种类型
的结构和跨越如此狭窄的水道的设计中很少见。

General Description
一般描述
The Holland Mills Road Bridge is located on Holland Mills Road, 0.3 km south of Bleams Road, just outside the
Town of New Hamburg in the Township of Wilmot. The bridge was likely built in 1910, however it is believed that
it may have been built earlier due to the way the bridge truss has been hammered together. It was constructed by the
Hamilton Bridge & Tool Company. The structure is a steel, pin-jointed Pratt through truss with a timber deck, which
was replaced in 1978. The wooden piles of a previous bridge can be seen 40m northwest of the bridge. There was
previously a woollen and gristmill located on the Nith River near this site. However, the Holland Mills Road Bridge
is the only remaining structure that signifies this past development.
荷兰米尔斯路桥位于荷兰米尔斯路，Bleams 路以南 0.3 公里，就在威尔莫特镇的新汉堡镇外。这座桥很可
能建于 1910 年，然而人们认为它可能建造得更早，因为桥梁桁架被锤打在一起的方式。它是由汉密尔顿桥
和工具公司建造的。这个结构是一个钢结构，钉连接的普拉特通过桁架与木材甲板，这是在 1978 年被取代。
在桥西北方向 40 米处可以看到以前桥梁的木桩。在这个地点附近的 Nith 河上曾经有一个羊毛磨坊。然而，
荷兰米尔斯路桥是唯一标志着过去发展的剩余结构。
The bridge belongs to a grouping of several steel truss bridges in the Township that symbolize the rural community
and landscape of Wilmot. The other bridges in the group include: Shade Street Bridge, Hartman Bridge, Haysville
Bridge (demolished), Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge, and Bridge Street Bridge. Of these, the Oxford-Waterloo Road
Bridge is the existing prototype, even though the Holland Mills Road Bridge was likely constructed earlier.
Although it is the oldest steel truss bridge in the Township, it was not the first to be built. The bridge was originally
built in northern Ontario and was moved to Holland Mills Road between 1925 and 1930. Since its relocation, the
bridge has not been significantly modified. It is the oldest pin-jointed structure in the Township and is representative
of the era in which it was built.
这座桥属于镇上几座钢桁架桥的一部分，象征着威尔莫特的乡村社区和景观。其他大桥包括: 遮荫街大桥、
哈特曼大桥、海斯维尔大桥(已拆除)、 Oxford-Waterloo 路大桥和桥街大桥。其中，Oxford-Waterloo 公路大
桥是现有的原型，尽管荷兰米尔斯公路大桥可能建造得更早。尽管它是该镇最古老的钢桁架桥，但它并不
是第一座建成的桥。这座桥最初建于安大略省北部，1925年至 1930 年间迁至荷兰米尔斯路。自搬迁以来，
这座桥并没有得到明显的修改。它是该镇最古老的柱节点结构，也是它建造时代的代表。
The Holland Mills Road Bridge has been considered for replacement due to safety concerns.
出于安全考虑，荷兰米尔斯公路大桥已被考虑更换。
Sources: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1

General Description
一般描述

Bridge Street Bridge is located on Bridge Street, east of Tye Road near the community
桥街大桥位于桥街，Tye 路以东，邻近社区
of Haysville
来自海斯维
尔
个
in the Township of Wilmot. The bridge is a single-span, eight-paneled, welded, Pratt camelback through truss. The
Hamilton Bridge Company built this structure in 1913 and its plans date to August 1912. This company has been
responsible for constructing many steel truss bridges in the Grand River watershed. The bridge spans 47.5m over the
Nith River and exhibits a concrete deck. It has been repaired several times, with a significant amount of rehabilita-
tion efforts undertaken in 1982. A load limit of 11 tonnes is enforced in order to ensure the longevity of the bridge.
在威尔莫特镇。这座桥是一座单跨、八块嵌板、焊接的普拉特驼背式桁架结构。汉密尔顿大桥公司在 1913
年建造了这个结构，它的计划可以追溯到 1912 年 8 月。这家公司负责在格兰德河流域建造许多钢桁架桥。
这座桥跨越 Nith 河，高 47.5 米，展示了一个混凝土桥面。它已经被修复了好几次，在 1982 年进行了大量
的修复工作。为了确保大桥的使用寿命，11 吨的负荷限制被强制执行。
The Bridge Street Bridge has a similar design to the Oxford-Waterloo Bridge, located downstream. The Oxford-
Waterloo Bridge is the prototype for this design in the Township of Wilmot as it was constructed a year earlier, in
1912. As a pair they represent significant landmarks in the Township.
桥街大桥的设计与下游的 Oxford-Waterloo 大桥相似。牛津-滑铁卢大桥(Oxford-Waterloo Bridge)是威尔莫特
(Wilmot)镇这种设计的原型，它于一年前(1912 年)建成。作为一对，它们代表了该镇的重要标志性建筑。
The Bridge Street Bridge provides a gateway on Bridge Street in Wilmot Township. It also provides a connection
from the community of New Dundee to the community of Haysville. The bridge belongs to a group of other
significant through camelback truss bridges in the Region of Waterloo. These other bridges include the Chambers
and Winterbourne Bridges in Woolwich Township and the Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge located to the south in
Wilmot Township.
桥街大桥提供了威尔莫特小镇桥街上的一个入口。它也提供了从新邓迪社区到海斯维尔社区的联系。这座
桥属于滑铁卢地区其他一些重要的驼背桁架桥。其他桥梁包括 Woolwich 镇的 Chambers 桥和 Winterbourne
桥，以及位于威尔莫特镇南部的 Oxford-Waterloo Road 桥。

General Description
一般描述
The Hartman Bridge is located on Huron Street in the Township of Wilmot, 0.2 km east of Waterloo Street, within
the New Hamburg Heritage Conservation District (HCD). The HCD was designated under Part V of the Ontario
Heritage Act in 1992 (Bylaw 92-90). The HCD is comprised of the historic downtown core of the Town of New
Hamburg. The community was originally settled along the Nith River in the early 19th century, but underwent
significant commercial and industrial development when the Grand Trunk Railway arrived in 1856. The District is
anchored with two landmark structures, the B & W Mills and the Hartman Bridge.
哈特曼大桥位于新汉堡文物保护区(HCD)以东 0.2 公里的威尔莫特镇的休伦街上。HCD 是根据 1992 年安大
略省遗产法第五部分(第 92-90 号附则)指定的。HCD 是由新汉堡市历史上的市中心核心区组成的。这个社区
最初是在 19 世纪早期沿着 Nith 河定居的，但是在 1856 年大主干铁路到达时经历了重大的商业和工业发展。
该地区有两个地标性建筑，b & w 工厂和哈特曼大桥。
This structure was built in 1936 during the Great Depression, on the site of the Village’s original Hartman Bridge.
Both bridges were named after the Hartman family who initially owned the land across the river but donated it for
the bridge construction. The current bridge was designed by County Engineer D.J. Emery and was built by the
Hamilton Bridge Company, a significant bridge building company within the Grand River Watershed, building
many steel truss bridges in various municipalities.
这座建筑建于 1936 年大萧条时期，位于该村原来的哈特曼大桥所在地。这两座桥都是以哈特曼家族的名字
命名的，哈特曼家族最初拥有河对岸的土地，但将其捐赠给了桥梁建设。目前的这座桥是由郡工程师 d.j. 埃
默里设计的，由汉密尔顿桥公司建造。汉密尔顿桥公司是大河流域内一家重要的桥梁建造公司，在各个城
市建造了许多钢桁架桥。
The structure is a steel Pratt through truss bridge crossing the Nith River in a single, 41.5m span. The bridge
includes a concrete sidewalk with a steel-latticed handrail. Although concrete bridges were popular in the 1930s, the
steel bridge design was chosen for both economic and practical reasons during the Great Depression. This bridge,
along with the other truss bridges in the Township, depicts the evolution of truss bridge design and technology in the
early 20th century. A commemorative plaque, erected in 2007 by the Region of Waterloo, celebrates the history
associated with the bridge. Maker’s plaques, a County plaque and The Hamilton Bridge Company’s oval-shaped
plaque are also found on the bridge.
这座钢结构的普拉特通过桁架桥横跨 Nith 河，跨度为 41.5 米。这座桥包括一条混凝土人行道和一个钢格子
扶手。虽然混凝土桥梁在 20 世纪 30 年代很流行，但是在大萧条时期，钢桥的设计是出于经济和实际的原因。
这座桥和镇上的其他桁架桥一起，描绘了 20 世纪早期桁架桥设计和技术的演变。滑铁卢地区于 2007 年竖立
了一块纪念牌匾，以纪念与这座桥相关的历史。在桥上还发现了制造者牌匾、郡牌匾和汉密尔顿桥公司的
椭圆形牌匾。
Hartman Bridge is the last remaining steel truss bridge on the Waterloo Regional road system and was nominated to the
Ontario Heritage Bridge List in 2005. It was also ranked number four of the top ten heritage bridges in the Region of
Waterloo in the 2004 bridge inventory, Spanning the Generations. The Heritage Canada Foundation selected the Hartman
Bridge for its National Achievement award for its perceived value as a heritage structure in the community following its
2006 bridge restoration project. The structure was only slightly altered during this restoration,
哈特曼大桥是滑铁卢地区道路系统中仅存的钢桁架桥，于 2005 年被提名为安大略省遗产桥梁名录。在 2004 年跨
越几代人的大桥清单中，它也是滑铁卢地区十大遗产桥梁中排名第四的。加拿大传统基金会选择哈特曼大桥作为
其国家成就奖，因为它在 2006 年大桥修复项目之后被认为具有社区遗产结构的价值。在这次修复过程中，这座
桥的结构只有轻微的改变,

the largest modification being the deck replacement and repainting.
最大的改动是甲板的更换和重新油漆。
The Hartman Bridge is seen as a landmark structure within the Town of New Hamburg and the Region of Waterloo.
Both the current and previous bridge served as an important link between the west and east sides of town, helping to
make the core of the district a commercial centre in the Township of Wilmot. The bridge’s inclusion in the New
Hamburg HCD ensures the future preservation and survival of the prominent landmark.
哈特曼大桥被视为新汉堡和滑铁卢地区的标志性建筑。目前和以前的桥梁都是城镇西部和东部之间的重要
纽带，有助于使该地区的核心成为威尔莫特镇的商业中心。大桥被纳入新汉堡 HCD 保证了这个著名地标的
未来保存和生存。

General Description
一般描述
The Shade Street Bridge, also known as the, the D.J. Emery Bridge, is located on Shade Street, east of Perth Street
near the Town of New Hamburg in the Township of Wilmot. The Canadian Bridge Company built this riveted Pratt
through truss in 1953, the year of D.J. Emery’s passing. D.J. Emery was the Waterloo County Engineer from 1932
to 1953, working on many of the bridges within the Region.
树荫街大桥，也被称为 d.j. 埃默里大桥，位于树荫街，珀斯街以东，靠近威尔莫特镇的新汉堡镇。加拿大桥
梁公司在 1953 年，埃默里逝世的那一年，通过桁架建造了这座铆接的普拉特桥。从 1932 年到 1953 年，
d.j。 Emery 是滑铁卢县的工程师，在该地区的许多桥梁上工作。
This bridge is unique as it became less common to find steel bridges built in the 1950s, as concrete was proving to be a
cheaper and easier construction material. The Shade Street Bridge is constructed of steel with a reinforced concrete deck
and abutments and includes a four-foot wide sidewalk on its north side. A maker’s plaque and com-memorative plaque are
located on the structure. This bridge is the second on the site, having replaced a 1903 structure.
这座桥是独一无二的，因为在 20 世纪 50 年代建造的钢桥越来越少见，因为混凝土被证明是一种更便宜、更容易
的建筑材料。遮荫街桥由钢筋混凝土桥面和桥台构成，北侧包括一条 4 英尺宽的人行道。一个制造商的牌匾和纪
念牌匾位于结构上。这座桥是现场的第二座，取代了 1903 年的结构。
The Shade Street Bridge has a similar design to the Hartman Bridge, which was built earlier in 1936. Together, both
of these bridges contribute to the appeal of the Town of New Hamburg and add to the rustic and rural character of
the Township. This bridge acts as a gateway to the Town.
遮荫街大桥的设计与 1936 年早些时候建造的哈特曼大桥相似。这两座桥共同增加了新汉堡镇的吸引力，也
增加了该镇的乡村风情。这座桥充当了通往城镇的大门。

General Description
一般描述
The Suspension Bridge is located north of the intersection of Christner Road and Waterloo Street near the
community of New Hamburg in the Township of Wilmot. It is a privately owned and constructed bridge that spans
the Nith River. The date of construction is not known, but it is assumed to have been built in the last half of the 20 th
century. It is the only known suspension bridge within the Grand River watershed and represents a very unique
vernacular style and landmark in the community.
悬索桥位于 Christner 路和滑铁卢街交叉口以北，邻近 Wilmot 镇的新汉堡社区。这是一座私人拥有和建造的
桥梁，横跨 Nith 河。这座桥的建造日期尚不清楚，但据推测它是在 20 世纪后半叶建成的。它是大河流域内
唯一已知的悬索桥，代表了一个非常独特的乡土风格和社区里的地标。
Source: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1, 2004
资料来源: 跨越世代，第一阶段，2004 年

General Description
一般描述
The Freeport Bridge spans the Grand River on King Street East between Riverbank Drive and Stonegate Drive in the City
of Kitchener. The property consists of a seven-span concrete bowstring arch bridge that was constructed between 1925 and
1926.
弗里波特大桥横跨国王街东部的格兰德河，位于基奇纳市的河岸大道和 stongate 大道之间。该建筑由一座建于
1925 年至 1926 年间的七跨混凝土拱桥组成。
It was designated by the City of Kitchener in 2001 for its historical and/or architectural value under Part IV of the Ontario
Heritage Act (By-law 2001-208). The history of the bridge is commemorated on site with a Region of Waterloo
interpretive plaque. The Freeport Bridge has also been listed on the Ontario Heritage Bridge list, a list of provincially-
significant bridges maintained by the Ministry of Tourism, Culture & Sport.
2001 年，基奇纳市根据《安大略省遗产法》(2001-208 年附则)第四部分的规定，将其指定为历史和/或建筑价值。
这座桥的历史是用滑铁卢地区的解释性牌匾来纪念的。弗里波特大桥也被列入了安大略省遗产桥梁名单，这是一
份由旅游、文化和体育部维护的省级重要桥梁名单。
The Freeport Bridge spans the Grand River and serves as a gateway between the City of Kitchener and the City of
Cambridge on the Old Highway 8. It is part of a group of four multiple-span concrete bowstring arch bridges spanning the
Grand River that were erected in the same time period and are similar in style. This group of bridges represents the
upgrading of the transportation networks that occurred in Ontario after World War I to accommodate the increased number
of automobiles. The group includes two other bridges within the Region of Waterloo, the Main Street Bridge in
Cambridge and the Bridgeport Bridge in Kitchener. Of these three bridges, the Freeport is the oldest. The fourth bridge,
the Caledonia Bridge, is located in the community of Caledonia.
弗里波特大桥横跨格兰德河，在 8 号高速公路上作为基奇纳城和剑桥城之间的门户。它是横跨大河的四座多跨混
凝土拱桥的一部分，这些拱桥建于同一时期，风格相似。这组桥梁代表了第一次世界大战后安大略省交通网络的
升级，以适应汽车数量的增加。该组包括滑铁卢地区的另外两座桥梁，剑桥的主街大桥和基奇纳的布里奇波特大
桥。在这三座桥中，弗里波特是最古老的。第四座桥，喀里多尼亚大桥，位于喀里多尼亚社区。
A prominent landmark in the Region of Waterloo, the Freeport Bridge is widely recognized as the most important bridge
in the Region. The current Freeport Bridge is the fourth consecutive bridge in this location. The first bridge was erected in
1820, with successive constructions in 1865, circa 1880 and this bridge in 1925.
弗里波特大桥是滑铁卢地区的一个著名地标，被广泛认为是该地区最重要的桥梁。目前的弗里波特大桥是该地区
连续第四座大桥。第一座桥建于 1820 年，1865 年，大约 1880 年和 1925 年相继建成。
A.B. Crealock, the Bridge Engineer for the Province of Ontario in the 1920s, designed this reinforced concrete bowstring
arch bridge. Construction began in 1925 and was finished in 1926 at an estimated cost of $85,000. The bridge’s bowstring
design was popular in the 1920s and 1930s as it required minimal material, was simple to install and could easily
accommodate vehicular traffic. It has a length of 160 meters, with seven spans and six piers. Two lanes of cars can cross
the bridge and the six-foot wide sidewalk is a unique feature found on this bowstring arch bridge.
20 世纪 20 年代，安大略省的桥梁工程师 a.b。 Crealock 设计了这座钢筋混凝土拱桥。这项工程始建于 1925 年，
竣工于 1926 年，预计耗资 85000 美元。这座桥的弓弦设计在 20 世纪 20 年代和 30 年代很受欢迎，因为它只需要
最少的材料，安装简单，容易容纳车辆。它长 160 米，有 7 个跨度和 6 个桥墩。两车道的汽车可以通过这座桥，6
英尺宽的人行道是这座弓弦拱桥的独特之处。
Sources: City of Kitchener By-Law 2001-208, Reasons for Designation; Spanning the Generations: Heritage Assessment, Freeport Bridge,
2004; Freeport Bridge Heritage Plaque Unveiling Information, 2005; Canadian Register of Historic Places
资料来源: 《2001-208 年基奇纳城市法》 ，指定理由; 跨代: 遗产评估，弗里波特大桥，2004 年; 弗里波特大桥遗产牌匾揭幕资料，2005 年; 加拿
大历史地点登记册，2005 年

General Description
一般描述
The Bridgeport Bridge, located in the community of Bridgeport, spans the Grand River on Bridge Street East between
Lancaster Street West and Tyson Drive in the City of Kitchener. It is a five-span reinforced concrete bowstring arch bridge
that was constructed in 1934 and is included on the Ontario Heritage Bridge List.
布里奇波特大桥位于布里奇波特社区，横跨格兰德河东桥街，位于兰开斯特西街和基奇纳市泰森大道之间。这是
一座五跨钢筋混凝土拱桥，建于 1934 年，被列入安大略省遗产桥梁名单。
The Bridgeport Bridge connects the north and south portions of the former Village of Bridgeport. The current bridge is the
fourth consecutive bridge in this location and as such provides an important linkage to the history of the community. The
first bridge, a wire suspension bridge, was erected in 1836 by John Wissler to reach his tannery. Two wooden bridges
replaced the wire bridge after it had fallen into the river. These structures were replaced in 1897 by a two-span steel Pratt
through truss bridge, followed by the construction of the current Bridgeport Bridge in 1934.
布里奇波特大桥连接了前布里奇波特村的南部和北部。现在的这座桥是这个地区的第四座连续桥梁，因此它与这
个社区的历史有着重要的联系。第一座桥是钢丝悬索桥，由约翰 · 威斯勒于 1836 年建造，通往他的制革厂。两座
木桥取代了落入河中的钢丝桥。这些结构在 1897 年被两跨的普拉特钢桁架桥所取代，随后在 1934 年建造了现在
的布里奇波特大桥。
The Bridgeport Bridge was a public works project during the Great Depression. During this time, to create work for those
unemployed, various levels of governments created construction projects and offered subsidies for large infrastructure
projects. The Bridgeport Bridge was constructed with local, provincial and federal contributions.
布里奇波特大桥是大萧条时期的一个公共工程项目。在此期间，为了为失业者创造就业机会，各级政府创建了建
筑项目，并为大型基础设施项目提供补贴。布里奇波特大桥是由地方、省和联邦政府出资建造的。
This reinforced concrete bowstring arch bridge was designed by D.J. Emery, the Waterloo County Road Super-intendant,
and constructed by Storms Contracting Co Ltd. Construction was completed in 1934 at an estimated cost of $65,600. The
bridge’s bowstring design is representative of a style that was popular in the 1920s and 1930s. It required minimal
material, was simple to install, represented newer construction materials and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic. It
has a length of 126 meters, with five spans and four piers. Two lanes of cars can cross the bridge and a wide sidewalk is an
unique feature found on this bowstring arch bridge.
这座钢筋混凝土拱桥由滑铁卢县道路总监 d.j. 埃默里设计，暴风承包有限公司建造。建造于 1934 年完成，估计花
费 65,600 美元。这座桥的弓弦设计代表了 20 世纪 20 年代和 30 年代流行的一种风格。它需要最少的材料，安装
简单，代表了更新的建筑材料，可以很容易地适应车辆交通。它长 126 米，有 5 个跨度和 4 个桥墩。两车道的汽
车可以通过这座桥，宽阔的人行道是这座弓弦拱桥的独特之处。
The Bridgeport Bridge spans the Grand River and serves as a gateway between the Region of Waterloo and Wellington
County. It is an important landmark in the region and forms part of a group of four multiple-span concrete bow -string
arch bridges spanning the Grand River that were erected in the same time period and in a similar style. This group of
bridges represents the upgrading of the transportation networks that occurred in Ontario after World War I to
accommodate the increased number of automobiles. The group includes two other bridges within the Region of Waterloo,
the Main Street Bridge in Cambridge and the Freeport Bridge in Kitchener. The fourth bridge,
布里奇波特大桥横跨格兰德河，是滑铁卢地区和威灵顿县之间的门户。它是该地区的一个重要标志性建筑，是横
跨大河的四座多跨混凝土拱桥的一部分，这些拱桥都是在同一时期以类似的方式建造的。这组桥梁代表了第一次
世界大战后安大略省交通网络的升级，以适应汽车数量的增加。该组包括滑铁卢地区的另外两座桥梁，剑桥的主
街桥梁和基奇纳的弗里波特桥梁。第四座桥,
the Caledonia Bridge, is located in the community of Caledonia.
喀里多尼亚大桥位于喀里多尼亚社区。

General Description
一般描述
The Huron Road Bridge is located on Huron Road, 0.21 km east of Homer Watson Boulevard in the former Village
of Doon in the City of Kitchener. Huron Road was an early colonization road built from 1828-1831 by the Canada
Company, which was responsible for opening the million-acre Huron Tract. Built in 1930, this structure is unique as
it represents the earliest example of a bridge with a visible I-beam in the Region of Waterloo. It is a single-span
concrete bridge with a steel I-beam superstructure. It exhibits decorative concrete railings representative of the era in
which it was constructed. The Huron Road Bridge, which crosses Schneider Creek, contributes to the character of
the area, along with a pedestrian wooden bridge that lies to the north, in the Doon Heritage Village in Kitchener’s
south end. The structure was reconstructed in 2012.
休伦路大桥位于休伦路上，距霍默沃森大道以东 0.21 公里，位于基奇纳市的前杜恩村。休伦公路是加拿大
公司在 1828-1831 年间建造的早期殖民地公路，负责开辟百万英亩的休伦公路。这座建于 1930 年的建筑是
独一无二的，因为它代表了滑铁卢地区最早的一座带有可见工字梁的桥梁。它是一座单跨混凝土桥梁，上
部结构为钢 i 梁。它展示了具有装饰性的混凝土栏杆，代表了它建造的那个时代。横跨 Schneider Creek 的
休伦路桥，以及一座位于基奇纳南端的杜恩遗产村的行人木桥，成就了这个地区的特色。桥梁结构于 2012
年重建。

General Description
一般描述
The Roos Island Bridge is located in Victoria Park, south of Jubilee Drive, near the terminus of Water Street South
in the City of Kitchener. The structure, built in early May 1896, is set in Victoria Park, a Romantic-style 60-plus
acre park. Queen, Joseph, and Victoria Streets, as well as Highland Road and West Avenue in Kitchener, bound the
associated neighbourhood. It includes hundreds of homes and has been designated as a Heritage Conservation
District under Part V of the Ontario Heritage Act. Schneider Creek runs through the park and creates a small lake
that surrounds three islands. The Roos Island Bridge provides pedestrian access to the island for which it was named
and access to the Park’s bandstand. Roos Island was named after one of the park’s founders, William Roos, a
member of the Board of Park Management.
鲁斯岛桥位于维多利亚公园，朱比利大道以南，靠近基奇纳市水街南的终点站。它建于 1896 年 5 月初，坐
落在维多利亚公园，一个浪漫风格的 60 多英亩的公园。皇后大道、约瑟夫大道、维多利亚大街，以及基奇
纳的高地道和西大道，连接着相关的社区。根据安大略省遗产法第五部分，它包括了数百个家庭，并被指
定为遗产保护区。施耐德溪流穿过公园，形成一个环绕三个岛屿的小湖。鲁斯岛桥(Roos Island Bridge)为行
人提供了通往这座岛屿的通道，它也是以这座岛屿命名的，还可以通往公园的音乐台。鲁斯岛是以公园创
始人之一、公园管理委员会成员威廉 · 鲁斯的名字命名的。
The Roos Island Bridge is a cast iron cantilevered pin-connected through truss structure. It was constructed the year
the park was opened in 1896 for $740 by the Central Bridge & Engineering Company of Peterborough, ON and de-
signed by architect, William H. Law, also of Peterborough, ON. The Central Bridge & Engineering Company
appears to have engaged in a variety of projects including work on the Trent-Severn Canal.
鲁斯岛桥是一座铸铁悬臂大桥，通过桁架结构连接。1896年，彼得伯勒的中央桥梁与工程公司以 740 美元
的价格开放了这座公园。中央桥梁工程公司似乎参与了各种项目，包括特伦特-塞文运河的工程。
This structure is one of very few cast iron bridges remaining in Ontario. It is a rare example of a pre-1900 cantilever
truss, and is perhaps one of the simplest and shortest expressions possible of this design. Cantilever trusses were
nor-mally reserved for extremely long spans, such as the St. Lawrence River. The use of this complex structure type
for a short crossing is unusual. It may have been designed as a cantilever to provide an unusual design for
pedestrians to enjoy. The bridge reflects the Romantic style landscape of the park, and is delicately decorated with
hanging lamps, overhead bracing and thin railings. The bridge retains ornate builder plaques on top of the single
overhead bracing that runs between the main posts. “Jones & Laughlins” is imprinted in the bridge’s trusses. These
cast iron components were sourced from the Jones and Laughlin Steel Company. Although they originally only
produced iron, they eventu-ally went on to produce steel and provided the most able competition to the Carnegie
Steel Company in the vicinity of Pittsburg, US.
这座桥是安大略省仅存的几座铸铁桥之一。它是 1900 年前悬臂桁架的一个罕见例子，也许是这种设计中最
简单、最短的表达方式之一。悬臂桁架通常只用于极长的跨度，比如圣劳伦斯河。使用这种复杂的结构形
式作为一个短的跨越是不寻常的。它可能被设计成一个悬臂，为行人提供一个不同寻常的设计享受。这座
桥反映了公园浪漫风格的景观，精致地装饰着悬挂的灯，头顶的支撑和细细的栏杆。大桥在主要柱子之间
的单个顶部支撑上保留了华丽的建筑牌匾。大桥的桁架上印有“ Jones & Laughlins”的字样。这些铸铁部件
来自琼斯和劳克林钢铁公司。尽管他们最初只生产钢铁，但最终他们还是联合起来生产钢铁，并为美国匹
次堡附近的卡内基钢铁公司提供了最有力的竞争对手。
154154
Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
Arch，Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单
Although the bridge underwent rehabilitation in 1974-75 at a cost of $25,300, it remains largely unaltered, reflecting
its original appearance. This is quite significant as the Roos Island Bridge is over 100 years old and represents the
only original bridge (there were once ten bridges) remaining in Victoria Park. As such, this bridge is a visual
landmark and valuable centerpiece in Victoria Park.
虽然这座桥在 1974-1975 年间花费了 25,300 美元进行了修复，但是它基本上没有改变，反映了它最初的外
观。这是相当重要的，因为鲁斯岛桥是超过 100 年的历史，代表了唯一的原始桥梁(曾经有十个桥梁)保留在
维多利亚公园。因此，这座桥是维多利亚公园的视觉地标和有价值的核心装饰品。

General Description
一般描述
The Iron Horse Trail Trestle Bridge is located on the pedestrian Iron Horse Trail that passes through Victoria
Park, .29 km south of Victoria Street South, just east of West Avenue in the City of Kitchener. The structure is a
railway trestle constructed entirely of timber and built circa 1903. The bridge spans Schneider Creek on two piers
and abutments constructed entirely of timber.
铁马步道栈桥位于维多利亚公园步行铁马步道上，维多利亚南街以南 29 公里，基奇纳市西大道以东。这是
一个完全由木材建造的铁路栈桥，大约建于 1903 年。这座桥横跨 Schneider Creek，两个桥墩和桥墩完全由
木材构成。
The Iron Horse Trail is located along a 5 km portion of abandoned right-of-way of the Grand River Railway between
Ottawa Street in Kitchener and Allen Street in Waterloo. Originally built as the Preston & Berlin Railway, the electri-
cally-operated rail line was to provide a direct means of transportation for the municipalities in the southerly portion of the
County, including Galt, Preston, Hespeler and the intervening sections to and from Berlin, the county town. At the same
time it was hoped to provide the towns of Berlin and Waterloo, as well as the surrounding district with a long-desired
railway connection for passenger, freight and express traffic with the Canadian Pacific Railway at Galt.
铁马小径位于基奇纳渥太华街和滑铁卢艾伦街之间的大河铁路废弃路段 5 公里处。这条电力运营的铁路最初是作
为普雷斯顿和柏林铁路而建的，目的是为该县南部的市政当局提供直接的交通工具，包括高尔特、普雷斯顿、赫
斯佩勒以及往返于柏林和该县城之间的路段。与此同时，希望为柏林和滑铁卢城镇以及周边地区提供一条渴望已
久的铁路连接线，用于客运、货运和与 Galt 的加拿大太平洋铁路的快速交通。
On August 18, 1903, a by-law was passed by the Town of Berlin authorizing the Preston & Berlin Railway to extend its
freight line from a point on King Street, across Cedar Grove Avenue, to and along Wilmot, Turek, Park and Victoria
Streets. This brought the railway line to a point beside Victoria Park where a freight shed and yard tracks were to be built.
This extension of the line was likely when the Iron Horse Trail Trestle Bridge was constructed by A.A. McDonald
1903 年 8 月 18 日，柏林市通过了一项附则，授权普雷斯顿和柏林铁路公司将其货运线路从国王街的一个点延伸
到雪松格罗夫大道，再沿着威尔莫特、图雷克、帕克和维多利亚街延伸。这使得铁路线到达了维多利亚公园旁边
的一个点，在那里将建造一个货运站和院子里的铁轨。这条铁路的延伸很可能是由 a.a。麦当劳建造的铁马小径
栈桥
& Co., the firm awarded the contract to construct the Preston & Berlin Railway. The Preston & Berlin Street
Railway and the Galt, Preston & Hespeler Street Railway were amalgamated in 1908, under the name Berlin, Waterloo, Welles-
ley & Lake Huron Railway Company and leased to the Canadian Pacific Railway for 99 years. In 1914, the name was changed to
the Grand River Railway Company Limited.
该公司授予了建设普雷斯顿和柏林铁路的合同。普雷斯顿和柏林街铁路公司与高尔特、普雷斯顿和赫斯佩
勒街铁路公司于 1908 年合并，名为柏林、滑铁卢、威尔斯利和休伦湖铁路公司，租给加拿大太平洋铁路公
司长达 99 年。1914 年，改名为格兰德河铁路有限公司。
Following the closure of the line, the Iron Horse Trail Trestle Birdge was incorporated into the publically accessible
Iron Horse Trail. The tracks were retained, signifying the structure's historic past.
随着铁路的关闭，铁马小径栈桥被并入铁马小径。铁轨被保留下来，象征着这座建筑的历史性过去。

General Description
一般描述
The Freeport Viaduct is located just east of the Freeport Bridge and King Street, 0.2 km north of Riverbank Drive in
the City of Kitchener. Although this bridge features traditional railway construction, it is significant as an example
of very long deck plate girder construction. This railway viaduct is composed of structural steel, with timber ties and
concrete piers and abutments. The sides and tops of some of the piers exhibit decorative masonry. It is anticipated
that this structure is likely as old as the Freeport bridge, circa 1930. The Grand River Railroad passed through this
area as early as 1903 and the railroad is now owned by the Canadian Pacific Railway.
弗里波特高架桥位于弗里波特大桥和国王街以东，距离基奇纳市的河岸大道以北 0.2 公里。尽管这座桥以传
统的铁路建设为特色，但它作为一个非常长的桥面板梁建设的例子是非常重要的。这座铁路高架桥由钢结
构、木结构、混凝土桥墩和桥台组成。一些桥墩的侧面和顶部呈现出装饰性的砖石结构。据估计，这种结
构很可能与 1930 年左右的弗里波特大桥一样古老。大河铁路早在 1903 年就通过了这个地区，现在这条铁路
属于加拿大太平洋铁路公司。
Sources: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1, 2004

General Description
一般描述
Schneider Creek Bridge 1 is located on Doon Village Road, 0.3 km south of Homer Watson Boulevard in the com-
munity of Doon, City of Kitchener. It was constructed in 1929 and is one of only two remaining earth-filled concrete
arch bridges in the City, along with its partner bridge Schneider Creek Bridge 2. It features solid concrete railings
with decorative embossed rectangles and a defined arch. A second solid railing wall is located between the sidewalk
and the road on the north side of the bridge to protect pedestrians from traffic, an unique addition to this type of
structure. Schneider Creek Bridge 1 has undergone significant rehabilitation, however its single-lane construction is
indicative of its age.
Schneider Creek Bridge 1 位于基奇纳市杜恩社区的霍默沃森大道以南 0.3 公里的杜恩村路上。它建于 1929 年，
是该市仅存的两座填土混凝土拱桥之一，与它的合作伙伴桥施耐德河大桥 2 号。它以实心的混凝土栏杆为
特色，带有装饰性的浮雕矩形和一个明确的拱门。第二道坚实的栏杆墙位于桥北侧的人行道和道路之间，
以保护行人免受交通阻碍，这是这种结构的独特之处。施耐德河大桥 1 号桥已经经历了重大的修复，然而
它的单车道建筑显示了它的年龄。
Arched bridges are one of the oldest bridge forms and are very efficient at supporting large loads over a long period
of time. Most of the early activity in concrete bridge construction in Ontario focused on the earth-filled, solid
spandrel arch form. This bridge type gained in popularity because they were easy and inexpensive to build.
However, the popu-larity of solid spandrel bridges appears to have declined after 1919, although they continued to
be built in small num-bers into the 1930s since it was still an economic structure in circumstances where solid
ground permitted adequate foundations.
拱桥是最古老的桥梁形式之一，能够有效地承受长时间的大荷载。在安大略省，大多数早期的混凝土桥梁
建设活动都集中在填土、实心拱肋形式上。这种桥型之所以受到欢迎，是因为它们建造起来既简单又便宜
然而，坚实的拱肩桥的普及程度在 1919 年之后似乎有所下降，尽管直到 1930 年代仍然是少量建造，因为在
坚实的地基允许有足够基础的情况下，这仍然是一种经济结构。
Many of these early 20th century earth-filled concrete arches have been removed from the Province’s roads because
they are too narrow to meet modern traffic needs. As a result, solid spandrel concrete arch bridges in active use, such
as Schneider Creek Bridge 1, are now considered rare survivors.
许多这些 20 世纪早期的填土混凝土拱门已经从该省的道路上拆除，因为它们太窄，不能满足现代交通的需
要。因此，现在活跃使用的实心拱肋混凝土拱桥，如施耐德溪桥 1 号，现在被认为是罕见的幸存者。

是一个里程碑 
General Description
一般描述
Wellesley Bridge No. 6 spans the Nith River on Chalmers-Forrest Road (Township Road 18 South) between Perth Line 56
and Township Road 3 in the Township of Wellesley. The property consists of a Pratt through truss bridge that was
constructed circa 1910 by an unknown builder. The Bridge spans the Nith River, south of the Hamlet of Kingwood. At one
time it provided a gateway to the south along Township Road 18 South for residents of the hamlet.
韦尔斯利大桥 6 号横跨 Nith 河的 Chalmers-Forrest 路(南 18 号乡镇公路)之间的珀斯 56 号线和 3 号乡镇公路在韦尔
斯利镇。该房产由一座普拉特通过桁架桥组成，大约在 1910 年由一位不知名的建筑商建造。这座桥横跨金伍德
哈姆雷特以南的 Nith 河。有一段时间，它为村民提供了一个沿着 18 号乡镇公路向南的入口。
Wellesley Bridge No. 6 is one of twelve through truss bridge structures remaining in Waterloo Region today, and the only
structure of this type in Wellesley Township. It is believed that the bridge was constructed and used elsewhere and then
moved to its current location.
韦尔斯利 6 号大桥是目前滑铁卢地区仅存的 12 座下承式桁架桥结构之一，也是韦尔斯利镇唯一的此类结构。人
们相信，这座桥是在其他地方建造和使用的，然后迁移到现在的位置。
The Bridge represents a literary landmark within the community as it was featured in Jane Urquhart’s award winning
Canadian novel, “The Stone Carvers.” Urquhart was inspired by this structure due to its strong visual appeal and situation
at the bottom of a valley on Chalmers-Forrest Road, resulting in a surprise vista as you head south from Kingwood.
这座桥代表了社区里的一个文学里程碑，因为它在简 · 厄克特获奖的加拿大小说《石雕家》中占有一席之地
Urquhart 的灵感来自于这个结构，因为它的强大的视觉吸引力和位于 Chalmers-Forrest 路谷底的情况，导致一个
惊喜的景观，你从金伍德向南前进。
The Bridge is a slim, single-lane, single-span, pin jointed steel Pratt through truss structure. It has a laminated timber and
asphalt paint deck and a concrete pier. It maintains its original pole railings and has attractive caps on the ends of the top
cord. Its design, a good representation of the Pratt truss style originally patented in the United States in 1844, reflects the
evolution of bridge building technology. It features vertical beams in compression and diagonal tie rods in tension. This
type of bridge construction represented a step forward in the transition from timber and iron to wholly metal structures.
Wellesley Bridge No. 6 is an early example of this type of steel bridge construction, which proliferated after 1900 as it was
easy to erect and relatively inexpensive.
桥梁是一个细长的，单车道，单跨度，销连接钢普拉特通过桁架结构。它有一个层压木材和沥青涂料甲板和一个
混凝土桥墩。它保留了原来的杆栏，并且在顶部绳子的末端有吸引人的帽子。它的设计很好地代表了 1844 年在
美国获得专利的普拉特桁架风格，反映了桥梁建造技术的发展。它以压缩的垂直梁和拉紧的斜拉杆为特色。这种
类型的桥梁建设代表了从木材和铁向全金属结构过渡的一个进步。韦尔斯利 6 号大桥是这种钢桥结构的早期例子，
它在 1900 年以后因为容易架设而且相对便宜而大量涌现。
The bridge falls into a group of other Pratt through truss structures in the Region of Waterloo, which include the Nithvale and
Piper Street Bridges in North Dumfries, the Hartman, Shade Street and Holland Mills Road Bridges in Wilmot, the Blackbridge
Road Bridge in Cambridge, and the Conestogo Bridge in Woolwich. Within the Region of Waterloo, Wellesley
这座桥通过滑铁卢地区的桁架结构归入另一个普拉特公司，其中包括北邓弗里斯的 Nithvale 和 Piper 街桥、威尔莫特的
Hartman、 Shade 街和 Holland Mills 路桥、剑桥的 Blackbridge 路桥和伍尔维奇的 Conestogo 桥。在滑铁卢地区，韦尔斯
利
Bridge No. 6 is considered the fourth oldest Pratt through truss and one of four remaining pin-jointed structures.
6 号桥被认为是第四个最古老的普拉特通过桁架和四个剩余的钉连接结构之一。
It has undergone numerous improvements and alterations over time, but in 2006 it was decided that the bridge
should be closed and vehicular traffic deterred as it was no longer structurally sound.
随着时间的推移，这座桥经历了许多改进和改造，但 2006 年决定关闭这座桥，并阻止车辆通行，因为它的
结构已不再完善。

Wellesley; Spanning the Generations, Phase 3, 2007; Heritage Resources Centre, Wellesley Bridge No. 6 Designation Report, 2009

尔斯利桥第 6 号指定报告，2009 年

General Description
一般描述
The Dewar Bridge is located on Chalmers-Forrest Road (Township Road 18 South), 1.4 km south of Streicher Line
near the community of Kingwood. It was constructed in 1934 and is the earliest rigid frame bridge remaining in the
Township of Wellesley. It is representative of the bridge type built in this era throughout the watershed. The Dewar
Bridge, however, is more decorative than other rigid frames, depicting elaborate concrete railings and engravings
that detail those involved in the bridge’s construction. The Dewar Bridge was built during the depression with relief
labour as a public works project.
迪尤尔大桥位于 Chalmers-Forrest 路(南 18 号乡镇公路) ，Streicher 线以南 1.4 公里，靠近金伍德社区。它建
于 1934 年，是韦尔斯利镇现存的最早的刚构桥。它是这个时代在整个流域建造的桥梁类型的代表。然而，
迪尤尔大桥比其他刚性框架更具装饰性，描绘了精心制作的混凝土栏杆和雕刻，详细描绘了大桥建造过程
中的细节。迪尤尔大桥是在大萧条时期建造的，作为一个公共工程项目使用了救济劳工。
Source: K Smart Associates Limited, Municipal Structures Inventory and Appraisal Study Report, Township of Wellesley
资料来源: 韦尔斯利镇 k Smart Associates 有限公司，市政结构清单和评估研究报告，韦尔斯利镇

General Description
一般描述
Wellesley Bridge No.17 is located on Deborah Glaister Line (Township Road 3 West), 1 km east of Road 116 in the
community of Kingwood. It was constructed in 1946 and is the only remaining concrete arch bridge in the Township
of Wellesley and one of few remaining in the Region of Waterloo. The bridge exhibits a unique design, but it is
similar to the Floradale Bridge and Schuett Bridge, both concrete earth-filled arch structures located in the
neighbouring Township of Woolwich.
17 号韦尔斯利大桥位于金伍德社区 116 号公路以东 1 公里的德博拉格莱斯特线(3 号乡镇公路以西)。它建于
1946 年，是韦尔斯利镇仅存的混凝土拱桥，也是滑铁卢地区仅存的几座混凝土拱桥之一。这座桥展示了一
种独特的设计，但它与 Floradale 大桥和 Schuett 大桥相似，两者都是混凝土填土拱结构，位于邻近的伍尔维
奇镇。
Wellesley Bridge No.17 has a relatively long span and graceful arch. The concrete is embossed with horizontal lines
that extend the length of the bridge. It features decorative art deco inspired metal railings with concrete balustrades
over the arch and solid concrete railings at each end of the bridge. The thin board finish is still visible in the
concrete. Abutments of a previous bridge can be seen just to the south of this structure.
韦尔斯利大桥 17 号桥跨度相对较长，拱形优美。混凝土浮雕的水平线延长了桥的长度。它以装饰艺术风格
的金属栏杆为特色，拱上有混凝土栏杆，两端都有实心的混凝土栏杆。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土中看到
在这个结构的南面可以看到之前一座桥的桥墩。
Many of these early 20th century concrete arches have been removed from the Province’s roads because they are too
narrow to meet modern traffic needs. As a result, solid spandrel concrete arch bridges in active use, such as
Wellesley Bridge No.17, are now considered rare survivors.
许多 20 世纪早期的混凝土拱门已经从该省的道路上拆除，因为它们太窄，不能满足现代交通的需要。因此，
实心拱肋混凝土拱桥在积极使用，如韦尔斯利大桥 17 号，现在被认为是罕见的幸存者。
Sources: K Smart Associates Limited, Municipal Structures Inventory and Appraisal Study Report, Township of
Wellesley Spanning the Generations, Phase 1, 2004

General Description
一般描述
The West Montrose Covered Bridge is a late-19th century covered wooden bridge that spans the Grand River in the rural village
of West Montrose, in the Township of Woolwich. Connecting Hill Street, Covered Bridge Drive and Rivers Edge Drive, the
bridge is just over 200 feet (61 m) in length and covered with red-painted pine paneling and a gable roof. It is one of two
remaining covered bridges in Ontario, joined by the Covered Lattice Truss Bridge built in the City of Guelph in 2009. It is also
the second oldest surviving bridge in the Region of Waterloo. It was designed by a local contractor, John Bear, who, with his
brother Benjamin, constructed the bridge in 1881 as a replacement for an earlier open bridge at the same location.
西蒙特罗斯覆盖桥是一座 19 世纪晚期的木桥，横跨伍尔维奇镇西蒙特罗斯乡村的格兰德河。连接希尔街，覆盖桥道和
河边道，桥只是超过 200 英尺(61 米)长，覆盖着红色油漆的松木镶板和山形屋顶。它是安大略省仅存的两座有盖桥之一，
2009 年在圭尔夫建造的有盖格状桁架桥与之相连。它也是滑铁卢地区现存第二古老的桥梁。这座桥是由当地承包商约
翰 · 贝尔设计的，他和他的兄弟本杰明在 1881 年建造了这座桥，以取代之前在同一地点建造的一座开放式桥梁。
Originally, the bridge was constructed solely of wood. Over the course of more than a century, a number of improvements have
been made to maintain the function and integrity of the bridge. It escaped demolition in 1942 due its picturesque appearance and
sound condition. The bridge materials today are a mix of wood, stone, asphalt, concrete and steel, represent-ing not only the
evolution of bridge technology but also the stewardship of the Township, the Region and the Province. While the materials have
been altered from the original, the form of the bridge designed by John Bear has been largely retained.
最初，这座桥是完全用木头建造的。经过一个多世纪的发展，人们对这座桥的功能和完整性进行了许多改进。 1942 年，
由于其风景如画的外观和完好的状况，它逃过了拆除。今天的桥梁材料是木材、石材、沥青、混凝土和钢材的混合物，
不仅代表了桥梁技术的发展，也代表了城镇、地区和省份的管理。虽然材料已经从原来的改变，由约翰贝尔设计的桥梁
形式大部分保留了下来。
The ‘Kissing Bridge’, as it was appropriately nicknamed due to the intimacy and privacy that the covered bridge offered
its travellers, is an iconic structure. It is a prominent and recognizable feature in arguably one of the most picturesque
landscapes in Ontario. It is also representative of the early history of Woolwich Township and of an earlier time in the
village. The local Hartwick family is intimately connected with this bridge, as they lived in a stone house nearby and
assumed the duty of hang-ing lanterns each evening on the bridge’s portals.
这座“亲吻桥”是一个标志性建筑，因为这座覆盖的桥为游客提供了亲密和隐私，所以得到了一个恰如其分的昵
称。这是一个突出的和可辨认的特征，可以说是安大略省最风景如画的景观之一。它也代表了伍尔维奇镇的早期
历史和该村庄的早期时代。当地的哈特威克家族与这座桥有着密切的联系，因为他们住在附近的一座石头房子里，
每天晚上负责在桥的入口处挂灯笼。
The West Montrose Covered Bridge was designated in 2007 by the Township of Woolwich as being of cultural heritage
value or interest under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (By-law 60-2007). It has also been listed on the Ontario Bridge
List since 1962, a list of provincially-significant bridges maintained by the Ministry of Tourism, Culture & Sport, and is
recognized by a plaque erected by the Ontario Heritage Trust. Additionally, the bridge is located within a Cultural
Heritage Landscape Policy Area in the village of West Montrose, as determined by the Township of Woolwich.
根据《安大略遗产法》(第 60-2007 号法令)第四部分，西蒙特罗斯覆盖桥于 2007 年被伍尔维奇镇指定为具有文化
遗产价值或利益的桥梁。自 1962 年以来，它也被列入安大略省桥梁名单，这是由旅游、文化和体育部维护的省
级重要桥梁名单，并被安大略省遗产信托基金竖立的牌匾所认可。此外，该桥位于西蒙特罗斯村的文化遗产景观
政策区，由伍尔维奇镇决定。
Sources: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1 & Phase 2, 2004

General Description
一般描述
The Winterbourne Bridge is located on Peel Street, 0.65 km west of Katherine Street in the Township of Woolwich. It is a
camelback Pratt through truss constructed of steel with a laminated timber deck. The Grand River is quite wide at this
crossing, resulting in the use of a double-span truss. Longer structures and multi-spans indicate greater engineering and
technical achievement, as they are less common and prove more difficult to build. The bridge is also pin connected. This
method of construction is less common than rivet-connections, and often found on earlier strictures before field riveting
was made possible.
Winterbourne 桥位于 Peel 街，距离 Woolwich 镇 Katherine 街以西 0.65 公里。这是一座驼背式的普拉特桥，由钢结
构桁架和层压木桥面组成。格兰德河在这个十字路口相当宽，因此采用了双跨桁架。更长的结构和多跨度表明更
大的工程和技术成就，因为它们不太常见，并证明更难建造。这座桥也是用销钉连接的。这种施工方法不像铆接
那么常见，而且在现场铆接成为可能之前，这种方法经常出现在早期的结构上。
The Winterbourne Bridge is one of three remaining truss bridges in the Township of Woolwich, including the Conestogo
Bridge and Chamber’s Bridge. An unknown builder constructed the bridge in 1913, making it the oldest existing
camelback through truss structure in the Township. In the Region of Waterloo, the Oxford-Waterloo Road Bridge, located
in Wilmot Township, is the oldest existing camelback through truss having been built in 1912, a year earlier than the
Winterbourne Bridge. At least two bridges were constructed at this site before the current Winterbourne Bridge. It has
experienced no major modifications other than a deck replacement in 1983. Precautions are being taken to preserve the
bridge including a 20km/h speed limit and a 10-tonne load limit.
Winterbourne 大桥是伍尔维奇镇仅存的三座桁架桥之一，包括 Conestogo 大桥和 Chamber’s 大桥。1913 年，一位
不知名的建造者建造了这座桥，使它成为该镇现存最古老的驼背式桁架结构。在滑铁卢地区，位于威尔莫特镇的
oxford-Waterloo 公路大桥是现存最古老的驼背式桁架桥，建于 1912 年，比 Winterbourne 大桥早一年。在现在的
Winterbourne 大桥之前，这里至少建造了两座桥。除了 1983 年的甲板更换之外，它没有经历过任何重大的改造。
为了保护这座桥梁，人们采取了预防措施，包括限速 20 公里/小时和限重 10 吨。
The Winterbourne Bridge is an important landmark in the rural landscape as it is the only significant double-span camelback
Pratt through truss bridge in the Region. It also acts as a gateway to the Village of Winterbourne. The structure has strong visual
appeal and has been captured by a local aerial photographer, Carl Hiebert and famous local artist, Peter Etril Snyder.
Winterbourne 大桥是乡村景观中的一个重要地标，因为它是该地区唯一一座重要的双跨驼背普拉特跨桁架桥。它也是通
往温特伯恩村的门户。这座建筑具有强烈的视觉吸引力，被当地航空摄影师 Carl Hiebert 和当地著名艺术家 Peter Etril
Snyder 捕捉到。
The Winterbourne Bridge belongs to the group of through camelback truss bridges in Waterloo Region. The other through
camelback truss bridges in the Region includes the Oxford-Waterloo Road, the Chamber’s and the Bridge Street Bridges.
However, this structure is the only double-span.
Winterbourne 大桥属于滑铁卢地区的驼背桁架桥。另一座穿过该地区的驼背式桁架桥包括 Oxford-Waterloo
Road、 Chamber’s 和 Bridge Street Bridges。然而，这种结构是唯一的双跨结构。
Sources: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1, 2004

General Description
一般描述
The Conestogo Bridge, also known as the Glasgow Bridge, is located on Glasgow Street South, 0.3 km south of
King Street in the village of Conestogo, Woolwich Township at the base of a steep hill in a vast open floodplain.
Constructed in 1886 by The Hamilton Bridge Company, which at the time was known as the Hamilton Bridge and
Tool Company, this structure is a pin-jointed, steel Pratt through truss with a timber deck that carries a single lane of
traffic. It is among the oldest steel truss bridges remaining in Canada and is the second oldest truss bridge in the
Grand River watershed after the Nithvale Bridge (1873), located in the Township of North Dumfries. A discrepancy
in construction dates has been found in previous bridge inventories, however the truss superstructure stylistically
dates to the 1880s and maker’s plaques dated 1886 are affixed to the ends of the structure’s top cord. The bridge
undoubtedly dates to 19th century, however it is possible the abutments and piers may be of newer construction.
Conestogo 大桥，也被称为格拉斯哥大桥，位于格拉斯哥南街，距离国王街以南 0.3 公里，位于
Conestogo，Woolwich 小镇的一个陡峭的山脚下，在一个巨大的开阔的泛滥平原上。1886年由汉密尔顿桥
公司建造，当时被称为汉密尔顿桥和工具公司，这个结构是一个销连接，钢 Pratt 通过桁架木材甲板，承载
一个单一的车道交通。它是加拿大现存最古老的钢桁架桥之一，也是继位于北邓弗里斯小镇的 Nithvale 大
桥(1873 年)之后，大河流域第二古老的桁架桥。在以前的桥梁清单中发现了施工日期的差异，然而桁架上
部结构的风格可以追溯到 19 世纪 80 年代，1886年制造商的牌匾被贴在结构顶部绳索的末端。这座桥毫无
疑问可以追溯到 19 世纪，但是桥墩和桥墩可能是更新的建筑。
There are several unique construction details observed on the Conestogo Bridge, such as heavy use of pin
connections in the bracing and the use of non-traditional eyebars (or eye rods). These details may be the only
surviving examples in Ontario. This technique is generally found only on earlier truss bridges, such as this. The
bridge’s two-span structure is also significant in that it required greater engineering skills and technical achievement
to construct, as this bridge would have proven more difficult to build than a similar single-span structure. The bridge
underwent rehabilitation in 1984 in response to its natural deterioration.
在 Conestogo 大桥上观察到一些独特的建筑细节，比如大量使用大头针连接的支撑和使用非传统的眼杆(或
眼杆)。这些细节可能是安大略省仅存的例子。这种技术通常只能在早期的桁架桥上找到，比如这个。这座
桥的两跨结构也很重要，因为它需要更高的工程技术和技术成就来建造，因为这座桥比类似的单跨结构更
难建造。这座桥在 1984 年进行了修复，以应对它的自然恶化。
The beauty of the Conestogo Bridge is so intriguing that it attracted two local artists, Carl Hiebert and Peter Etril
Snyder, to capture pictures of it. A painting done by Peter Etril Snyder entitled, “Conestogo Flats” depicts the
Cones-togo Bridge in the right corner of the painting.
Conestogo 桥的美丽是如此吸引人以至于它吸引了两位当地艺术家 Carl Hiebert 和 Peter Etril Snyder 来拍摄它
的照片。Peter Etril Snyder 的一幅名为“ Conestogo Flats”的画作描绘了画作右角的锥形多哥桥。
The Conestogo Bridge is a significant landmark in the area. Along with the Winterbourne Bridge, it is one of only two
double-span through truss bridges located in the Region of Waterloo. However, because the Winterbourne Bridge is a
camelback through truss, this structure is a prototype of a pure double-span Pratt through truss bridge in the Region.
Conestogo 大桥是该地区的一个重要地标。和 Winterbourne 大桥一样，它也是滑铁卢地区仅有的两座双跨桁架桥
之一。然而，由于 Winterbourne 桥是一个驼背穿桁架，这个结构是一个纯双跨 Pratt 穿桁架桥在该地区的原型。

175
Heritage Resources Centre
文物资源中心
It is located within the historic Mennonite community of Conestogo on the border of the City of Waterloo, acting as a
gateway between urban and rural settings. The Conestogo Bridge belongs to a group of 13 through trusses in the Region of
Waterloo and a group of Pratt through truss bridges including: the Nithvale, Piper Street Steel Truss, Welles-ley Bridge
#6, Holland Mills Road, Haysville (demolished), Hartman, Shade Street and Black Bridge Road bridges.
它位于滑铁卢市边界的科内斯托哥历史悠久的门诺派社区内，是城市和农村之间的门户。Conestogo 大桥属于滑
铁卢地区的 13 座直通桁架桥和一些普拉特直通桁架桥，包括 Nithvale、 Piper 街钢桁架、 Welles-ley 桥 6 号、
Holland Mills 路、海斯维尔(已拆除)、 Hartman、 Shade 街和 Black Bridge 路桥。

General Description
一般描述
The Chamber’s Bridge spans the Grand River on Weisenburg Road, 2.4 km west of Katherine Street North near the
community of Inverhaugh in the Township of Woolwich. The one-lane, timber deck, camelback Pratt through truss
was built in 1930 by an unknown builder and engineered by Herbert J. Bowman. It is believed that the super-
structure was brought to the Grand River from another location in 1946. This is the also the year when the west
abutment was constructed. Several other bridges have been located at this crossing prior to the current bridge, the
first as early as 1845. Knowledge of these previous structures helps to explain the superfluous pier that is not
structurally necessary for supporting the current bridge but may indicate a previous double-span bridge. In a 1906
Atlas, the bridge was seen located next to John Chamber’s land. This is probably why it was named the “Chamber’s
Bridge.” The structure is also part of the Grand Valley Trail, which travels along the west end of the Grand River
and crosses the bridge.
商会大桥横跨伟森堡路上的格兰德河，距离凯瑟琳街北部 2.4 公里，靠近伍尔维奇镇 inverhagh 社区。单车
道，木质甲板，驼背普拉特通过桁架建造于 1930 年，由一个不知名的建造者和工程师赫伯特 j 鲍曼。人们
相信这个超级结构是在 1946 年从另一个地方带到格兰德河的。也是在这一年修建了西侧的桥墩。在现在的
这座桥之前，已经有几座其他的桥位于这个交叉路口，第一座早在 1845 年就建成了。了解这些先前的结构
有助于解释多余的桥墩，这是不是结构上必要的支持目前的桥梁，但可能表明以前的双跨桥梁。在 1906 年
的地图集中，这座桥位于 John Chamber 的土地旁边。这可能就是它被命名为“商会之桥”的原因这座建筑
也是格兰德山谷小道的一部分，它沿着格兰德河的西端穿过大桥。
In 1994, the bridge was deemed unsafe and closed to both vehicles and pedestrians due to its deteriorating deck and
rusting steel supports. This resulted in an eight-year closure of the bridge between 1994 and 2002. The bridge
underwent repairs and is now open to the public with a posted load limit of three tonnes.
1994 年，这座桥被认为是不安全的，由于桥面和生锈的钢支撑，车辆和行人都不能通行。这导致了 1994 年
到 2002 年间，这座桥关闭了 8 年。大桥进行了维修，现在向公众开放，公布的载重限制为 3 吨。
The Chamber’s Bridge belongs to the larger group of camelback Pratt through truss bridges in Waterloo Region.
The other significant bridges in this group include the Winterbourne Bridge also in Woolwich Township and the
Oxford-Waterloo Road and Bridge Street bridges in Wilmot Township.
商会桥属于滑铁卢地区较大的驼背普拉特跨桁架桥群。其他重要桥梁还包括位于 Woolwich 镇的
Winterbourne 大桥和位于 Wilmot 镇的 Oxford-Waterloo 路和 Bridge Street 大桥。
Sources: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1, 2004
资料来源: 跨越几代人，阶段 1,2004

General Description
一般描述
The St. Jacobs Viaduct is located south of Regional Road 17, across the Conestogo River, in the Village of St.
Jacobs, Township of Woolwich. It is a two-span deck truss railway viaduct constructed of structural steel with
limestone abut-ments. The quarried limestone blocks were hauled to their current location by wagons. The viaduct
was built in 1890 for the Grand Trunk Railway, now part of the Canadian National Railway. It was part of a railway
extension to Elmira and was the most expensive portion of the railroad built. It is possible that there was an older
structure at this location, as wooden piers from a previous viaduct are still in place.
圣雅各布斯高架桥位于 17 号区域公路以南，横跨 Conestogo 河，位于 Woolwich 镇圣雅各布斯村。这是一个
两跨桥面桁架铁路高架桥，由结构钢和石灰石构成。开采出来的石灰石块被货车拖到现在的位置。这座高
架桥建于 1890 年，是为了修建大主干铁路，现在是加拿大国家铁路的一部分。它是通往埃尔迈拉的铁路延
伸的一部分，也是铁路建设中最昂贵的部分。这个地方可能有一个更古老的结构，因为之前高架桥的木质
桥墩仍然存在。
In the past, many carloads of cattle, sheep and pigs were shipped annually from St. Jacobs for export. The village be-came
one of the leading shipping points on the Galt & Elmira Branch of the Grand Trunk Railway. It is a reminder of the past
when rails were the main method of transportation and necessary for the establishment of communities. The viaduct also
contributes to the historic charm of the St. Jacobs area as it can be viewed from King Street North (Region-al Road 8),
which travels through the village and from the Grand River Walking Trail that hugs the Conestogo River.
在过去，每年都有许多牛、羊和猪从圣雅各布斯出口。这个村庄是大主干铁路 Galt & Elmira 支线上的主要运输点
之一。它提醒人们，过去铁路是主要的交通工具，是建立社区的必要条件。高架桥也有助于圣雅各布斯地区的历
史魅力，因为它可以从国王街北(地区-al 路 8) ，旅行通过村庄和从环抱 Conestogo 河的大河步行小道。
Sources: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1, 2004

滑铁卢县纪事报“历史上的圣雅各布”

General Description
一般描述
Mennonite Bridge is a low-level, seven-span, concrete slab bridge that spans 23.2 m over the Conestogo River. It is
located on Three Bridges Road, 0.61 km west of Henry Street, just west of the Village of St. Jacobs. The bridge is
sited next to the St. Jacobs dam. The first dam at this site was built in the 1840s to provide power to a sawmill. The
materials for the bridge were provided to a Mennonite community by Woolwich Township. Volunteers from the Old
Order Mennonite community built the bridge in 1962 over three days. Due to annual flooding, permanent railings
were not built on the bridge. Rather, portable railings are installed along both sides of the bridge. It is considered to
be a hidden tourist attraction in the St. Jacobs area and frequented by pedestrians on the Grand River Walking Trail,
which follows the Conestogo River.
Mennonite 大桥是一座低矮的七跨混凝土板桥，跨度 23.2 米，横跨 conesstogo 河。它位于三桥路，亨利街以
西 0.61 公里，圣雅各布斯村庄以西。这座桥位于圣雅各布斯大坝旁。这里的第一座水坝建于 19 世纪 40 年
代，为锯木厂提供电力。大桥的材料由伍尔维奇镇提供给一个门诺派社区。1962年，来自旧秩序门诺派社
区的志愿者花了三天时间建造了这座桥。由于每年的洪水，这座桥上没有修建永久的栏杆。相反，可移动
的栏杆安装在桥的两侧。它被认为是圣雅各布斯地区一个隐蔽的旅游胜地，沿着 Conestogo 河的 Grand
River 步行小道上的行人经常光顾。
Sources: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1, 2004

General Description
一般描述
Floradale Bridge is located on Floradale Road, just north of the Village of Floradale in the Township of Woolwich.
It is a single span concrete earth-filled arch structure. Earth filling of early concrete arches such as this was typically
used for small spans. They were filled with earth, rocks and or other types of fill, and the spandrel walls served as
retaining walls.
Floradale 桥位于 Floradale 路上，就在 Woolwich 镇 Floradale 村的北面。它是一个单跨混凝土填土拱结构。
像这样的早期混凝土拱的填土通常用于小跨度。他们填充土，岩石和或其他类型的填料，和拱肩墙作为挡
土墙。
Most of the early activity in concrete bridge construction in Ontario focused on the earth-filled, solid spandrel arch
form. The main construction period between 1905-1919 for solid spandrel arch bridges in Ontario was a relatively
short time span of 14 years. This bridge type gained in popularity because they were easy and inexpensive to build.
Many of these early 20th century earth-filled concrete arches have been removed from the Province’s roads because
they are too narrow to meet modern traffic needs. As a result, solid spandrel concrete arch bridges such as this that
remain in active use are considered rare survivors.
在安大略省，大多数早期的混凝土桥梁建设活动都集中在填土、实心拱肋形式上。1905-1919 年间，安大略
省实心拱桥的主要施工阶段是相对较短的 14 年。这种桥型之所以受到欢迎，是因为它们建造起来既简单又
便宜。许多这种 20 世纪早期的混凝土拱门已经从该省的道路上拆除，因为它们太窄，不能满足现代交通的
需要。因此，像这样仍在积极使用的实心拱肋混凝土拱桥被认为是罕见的幸存者。
Sources: Spanning the Generations, Phase 1, 2004

General Description
一般描述
The Stone Road Bridge, or McQuillian’s Bridge, is located parallel to Stone Road, between Victoria Road South and
Watson Parkway South in the City of Guelph. It was constructed in 1916 and spans the Eramosa River on what was
then the boundary line between the Township of Guelph and the Township of Puslinch. The bridge is an early
example of reinforced concrete bowstring truss construction or tied arch span, and was built to replace an earlier
wooden span, commonly called McQuillan’s Bridge, due to the proximity of this river crossing to lots cleared and
settled by the Mc-Quillan family.
石路大桥，或称 McQuillian 大桥，位于圭尔夫市维多利亚南路和沃森南路之间，与石路平行。它建于 1916
年，横跨 Eramosa 河，当时是圭尔夫镇和 Puslinch 镇的分界线。这座桥是早期的钢筋混凝土弓弦桁架结构
或系杆拱桥的一个例子，它的建造是为了取代早期的木质桥梁，通常被称为 McQuillan 大桥，因为这座跨
河桥靠近 Mc-Quillan 家族清理和定居的地块。
The Stone Road Bridge was built under the direction of Wellington County Engineer A. W. Connor as a sturdy and
more permanent structure to meet the demand for better road conditions required by increased settlement and ag-
ricultural production in the area. The bridge was built by Charles Mattaini, a local contractor and craftsman who
developed skills in the use of concrete for many local building projects and, in particular, bridges. Mattaini, a native
of northern Italy, built over fifty bridges that were constructed in this area, and his work was well known and
admired outside of Wellington County. The Stone Road Bridge is the only example of the concrete bowstring arch
form within the City of Guelph and is one of few remaining examples of this type in the watershed.
石路桥是在威灵顿县工程师 A.w. 康纳的指导下建造的，作为一个坚固和更永久的结构，以满足该地区增加
的定居点和农业生产对更好的道路条件的需求。这座桥是由当地承包商和工匠查尔斯•马泰尼 (Charles
Mattaini)建造的，他发展了在许多当地建筑项目中使用混凝土的技能，尤其是桥梁。马太尼是意大利北部人，
他在这个地区建造了超过 50 座桥梁，他的作品在威灵顿县以外的地区广为人知并受到赞赏。石路大桥是圭
尔夫市内混凝土弓弦拱形式的唯一例子，也是该流域仅存的几个这种类型的例子之一。
The first span of this bridge type in Ontario was built in 1909 and featured a system of cross bracing between the verti-cal
hangers. While these bridges share a basic form, there is considerable variety among the structures. The Stone Road
Bridge is distinguished from the 1909 Ontario prototype in that it does not include a system of cross bracing. This form of
design was later to become typical of the standard practice of concrete bowstring arch construction in Ontario that was
most popular between 1915 and 1930. The Stone Road Bridge is also distinguished by the height of its arches, which
required them to be connected by a single cross beam, inscribed with the date of construction. The bridge’s graceful arches
and simple design are considered to be a significant element of the riverscape at this location.
在安大略省，这种桥型的第一个跨度建于 1909 年，其特点是垂直吊架之间的交叉支撑系统。虽然这些桥梁共享
一个基本的形式，有相当多的不同结构。石路大桥不同于 1909 年安大略省的原型，因为它不包括交叉支撑系统。
这种形式的设计后来成为典型的标准做法混凝土弓弦拱在安大略省是最流行的 1915 年和 1930 年之间。石路大桥
的另一个特点是其拱门的高度，这就要求它们通过一个单一的横梁连接起来，横梁上刻有施工日期。桥梁优美的
拱门和简单的设计被认为是这个位置河景的重要元素。
The introduction and success of the concrete bowstring arch bridge reflects the transition from horse-drawn vehicles to
motorized forms of transportation as this type of bridge provided a safer and more durable design than the traditional
timber bridge found commonly in rural areas in the 19th century. The concentration of this bridge type in Wellington
混凝土弓弦拱桥的引进和成功反映了从马车到机动交通形式的转变，因为这种桥提供了比 19 世纪在农村地区普
遍存在的传统木桥更安全和更耐用的设计。这种桥型集中在惠灵顿
186186
Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
Arch，Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单
County is notable and reflects the availability of local aggregate and the particular skills of a local craftsman. The
Stone Road Bridge is included on the Ontario Heritage Bridge List, spans a designated Canadian Heritage River
route and is considered to be an early and rare surviving example of concrete bowstring arch construction in a local,
provincial and national context.
县是值得注意的，反映了当地集合的可用性和当地手工艺人的特殊技能。石路桥被列入安大略省遗产桥梁
名录，跨越加拿大遗产河的指定路线，被认为是当地、省和全国范围内混凝土弓弦拱施工的早期罕见的幸
存例子。
In 2000, Stone Road East underwent rehabilitation and was widened to two lanes. The City of Guelph decided to re-
route the road in order to preserve the bridge. The bridge was designated in 2004 for its cultural heritage value and
interest under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (By-law (2004)-17357A). The bridge is now used as a pedestrian
bridge and is part of the municipal trail system.
2000 年，石东路进行了修复，并扩大到两条车道。圭尔夫市政府决定重新规划道路，以保护这座桥。 2004
年，根据《安大略省遗产法》(2004 年)第四部分(第 17357a 号附则) ，该桥因其文化遗产价值和利益而被指
定。这座桥现在被用作行人桥，是市政轨道系统的一部分。
Sources: City of Guelph Inventory of Heritage Structures

General Description
一般描述
The Norwich Street East Bridge is located on Norwich Street East, 0.05 km southwest of Arthur Street North in the
Goldie Mill neighbourhood in the City of Guelph. This steel and iron bridge was built in 1882 by the Hamilton
Bridge Company at a cost of just over $1,000 to City Council, who commissioned the work.
诺威奇街东桥位于圭尔夫市金磨坊附近的诺威奇街东，距亚瑟街北西南 0.05 公里。这座钢铁大桥建于 1882
年，由汉密尔顿桥公司花费 1000 多美元委托市议会建造。
A bridge spanned the Speed River at this location as early as 1860 and was known first as “the Wellington Foundry
Bridge” and later “the Inglis-Hunter Bridge” because of its close proximity to one of the very early industries in
Guelph, established circa 1860 on the easterly bank of the river.
早在 1860 年，这里就有一座桥横跨斯皮德河，最初被称为“惠灵顿铸造大桥”，后来又被称为“英格利斯-
亨特大桥”，因为它靠近圭尔夫最早的工业之一，大约 1860 年在河东岸建成。
The bridge became an important link in the movement of materials across the river, serving the needs of the many
foundries and mills which occupied this area in the mid-1800’s, and the choice of iron over the more traditional and
less expensive wooden bridge reflects the growing industrialization of the community. Today, this single span
bridge acts as a gateway to the residential area on the east side of the Speed River and serves as a connecting link
between the east and west sides of what is now known as the Goldie Mill Neighbourhood. The bridge is the only
surviving example of several iron and steel bridges which once existed in Guelph, and is important as a distinctive
heritage feature of the riverscape in this area. It was designated by the City of Guelph under Part IV of the Ontario
Heritage Act (By-law 1998-15786) in 1998.
桥梁成为横跨河流的材料运输的一个重要环节，满足了 19 世纪中期占据这一地区的许多铸造厂和工厂的需
要，选择铁而不是更传统和更便宜的木桥反映了社区日益增长的工业化。今天，这座单跨桥梁作为一个门
户，通往 Speed 河东侧的居民区，并作为连接东西两侧的纽带，现在被称为 Goldie Mill 居民区。这座桥是
圭尔夫仅存的几座钢铁桥梁，作为该地区河流景观的一个独特遗产，具有重要意义。1998年，圭尔夫市根
据《安大略省遗产法》(1998-15786 年法律)第四部分指定了这个城市。

General Description
一般描述
The CNR Railway Viaduct crosses the Speed River in downtown Guelph at the intersection of Macdonell Street and
Woolwich Street. Constructed of limestone and steel, it is a functional, multi-double pier structure of seven bays
straddling an earlier roadway. It exhibits rusticated stone piers and abutments, four built up steel girders, wooden
cross ties, and a modern railed catwalk. It was built circa 1857 by the Grand Trunk Railway (GTR), a company
established to build a railway line across Canada, from coast to coast. However, in 1919 the government took over
the GTR and today it is owned by the Canadian National Railway. It appears that the viaduct supported two tracks at
one time, however, only one track remains.
CNR 铁路高架桥横跨圭尔夫市中心的速度河，位于 Macdonell 街和 Woolwich 街的交叉口。它由石灰石和钢
铁建造，是一个功能性的，多双墩结构的 7 个海湾跨越早期的道路。它展示了粗糙的石头桥墩和桥台，四
个已建成的钢梁，木质十字架，和一个现代化的有轨猫道。它建于 1857 年左右，由大主干铁路(GTR) ，一
个公司成立，建设一条横跨加拿大的铁路线，从海岸到海岸。然而，1919年政府接管了 GTR，今天它归加
拿大国家铁路公司所有。看起来这座高架桥同时支撑着两条铁轨，然而，现在只剩下一条了。
The context of the site surrounding the CNR Railway Viaduct has substantial historic and cultural value. On the east
abutment, there is a tablet that marks the spot where John Galt, the General Agent of the Canada Company, cut the
first tree in founding the City of Guelph on April 23rd, 1827.
中国北车铁路高架桥周围的环境具有重要的历史和文化价值。1827年 4 月 23 日，加拿大公司的总代理人约
翰 · 高尔特(John Galt)在东边的桥墩上砍下了建立圭尔夫城市的第一棵树。
The viaduct is also sited in close to proximity to a number of other bridges. It sits above the Old Speed River Bridge,
now abandoned, and to the west of the CPR Speed River Bridge and the remnants of Allan’s Mill. All of these sites,
along with the CNR Railway Viaduct, contribute to the culture heritage value of Guelph’s historic downtown.
这座高架桥也靠近其他一些桥梁。它位于旧 Speed 河大桥(现已废弃)的上方，以及 CPR Speed 河大桥和艾伦
磨坊遗迹的西面。所有这些遗址，连同中国北车铁路高架桥，都为圭尔夫历史悠久的市中心的文化遗产价
值做出了贡献。
Sources: City of Guelph Inventory of Heritage Structures

General Description
一般描述
The Old Speed River Bridge is located near the intersection of Macdonell Street and Woolwich Street, spanning the
Speed River. This steel and concrete bridge was built circa 1930 by the Hamilton Bridge Company. Decorated
concrete balustrades support ornamental metal railings in the Art Deco style. The bridge lies cradled under two
spans of the CNR Railway Viaduct above. Now abandoned, the bridge once carried Macdonell Street.
老速河大桥位于 Macdonell 街和 Woolwich 街交叉口附近，横跨速河。这座钢筋混凝土大桥由汉密尔顿桥公
司于 1930 年左右建成。装饰混凝土栏杆支撑着装饰艺术装饰风格的金属栏杆。这座桥位于中国北车铁路高
架桥的两个跨度之下。现在这座桥已经废弃，它曾经支撑着 Macdonell 大街。
The Old Speed River Bridge, along with several nearby historic sites such as the CNR Railway Viaduct, the CPR
Speed River Bridge and Allan’s Mill remnants, actively contribute to a cultural heritage landscape surrounding
Guelph’s downtown core.
古老的速度河大桥，连同几个附近的历史遗址，如中国北车铁路高架桥，CPR 速度河大桥和艾伦磨坊遗址，
积极贡献了围绕圭尔夫市中心的文化遗产景观。
Built in 1830, the remnants of Allan’s Mill can be seen to the east of the bridge. Vestiges of this mill remain,
including a dam and a weir underneath the bridge that regulates and slows the flow of the river.
建于 1830 年的艾伦磨坊的遗迹可以在桥的东边看到。这座磨坊的遗迹依然存在，包括桥下的一座大坝和一
个堰，它们调节和减缓了河水的流速。
Sources: City of Guelph Inventory of Heritage Structures
资料来源: 圭尔夫市遗产结构清单

General Description
一般描述
The Heffernan Street Footbridge, located in the downtown area of Guelph, crosses the Speed River connecting
Wool-wich Street and Arthur Street. It was built in 1914 by Galbraith and Cate and designed by Ernest E. Clawson,
the City Engineer. It replaced an earlier metal arch bridge. There has been a footbridge at this location since 1881
that connects the residential neighborhood on one side to the downtown commercial core on the other.
赫弗南街人行桥位于圭尔夫市中心，横跨连接羊毛街和亚瑟街的速度河。它由 Galbraith 和 Cate 于 1914 年
建造，由城市工程师 Ernest e。它取代了早期的金属拱桥。自 1881 年以来，这里就有一座人行天桥，将居
民区的一侧与市中心的商业中心区连接起来。
The bridge was designated under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (By-law 1990-13541) for its heritage value by
the City of Guelph in 1990. Shortly after this designation, parts of the bridge were reconstructed between 1990 and
1991. The original open-spandrel arch design was maintained as well as the open-poured concrete balustrade
railings, and the twin pier pedestal supports to the approaches with solid paneled balustrades. The bridge is a unique
feature along the Speed River and has become a landmark within Guelph’s downtown area.
1990 年，圭尔夫市根据《安大略遗产法》(1990-13541 年法律)第四部分的规定，指定这座桥具有遗产价值。
在这项指定之后不久，部分桥梁在 1990 年至 1991 年间重建。保留了原有的开拱设计，以及开浇混凝土栏杆
和双墩底座支撑的方法与实心镶板栏杆。这座桥是斯皮德河沿岸的一个独特特征，已经成为圭尔夫市中心
地区的一个地标。

General Description
一般描述
The Gordon Street Bridge is located on Gordon Street, 0.9 km north of Water Street in the City of Guelph. It was
built in 2001 to replace a 4-span steel beam bridge with masonry abutments and piers, originally built circa 1935.
Although it does not reflect the original structure, it complements Gow’s Bridge, visible downstream from this
structure, with its arches and multiple arched spans. The bridge design also includes patterned concrete balustrade
piers, ornamental steel balustrades and integrated decorative lampposts. The bridge won the Precast Concrete
Material Development & Innovation Award at the 2001 Ontario Concrete Awards.
戈登街大桥位于圭尔夫水街以北 0.9 公里的戈登街上。它建于 2001 年，用砖石桥台和桥墩取代 4 跨钢梁桥，
最初建于 1935 年左右。尽管它没有反映出原来的结构，但它补充了九大桥，从这个结构的下游可以看到它
的拱和多个拱跨。桥梁设计还包括图案化的混凝土栏杆墩，装饰钢栏杆和综合装饰灯柱。这座桥赢得了
2001 年安大略省混凝土大奖的预制混凝土材料发展与创新奖。
The Gordon Street Bridge contributes to a cultural landscape with the designated Boat House and Covered Lattice
Truss Bridge to the north, Gow’s Bridge to the south and Royal City Park adjacent to the structure. The bridge also
acts as a gateway between the University and Downtown areas of Guelph.
戈登街大桥北面是指定的船屋和有盖的格状桁架桥，南面是 Gow 大桥，毗邻皇家城市公园。桥梁还作为圭
尔夫大学和市中心之间的门户。
