SCOTLANDALBA
苏格兰阿尔巴
Scotland’s Inventory of Gardens and Designed Landscapes
苏格兰园林和景观设计清单
Above: Estate staff, The Glen, Scottish Borders, before 1910 © Royal Commission on the Ancient and Historical Monuments of Scotland Cover: Drummond Castle, Perth and Kinross © Keith
Fergus, Scottish Viewpoint
上图: 苏格兰边区格兰庄园的工作人员，1910 年之前的皇家苏格兰古迹和历史遗迹委员会封面: 德拉蒙德城堡，珀斯-金罗斯基思-费格斯，苏格兰观点
This booklet explains what being on the inventory means and how we assess gardens and designed landscapes
for designation.
这本小册子解释了什么是在清单意味着，我们如何评估花园
和设计景观指定。
Scotland’s historic environment has been shaped by people for over 10,000
years.Past generations have left their mark on our towns and cities, and the
countryside around us. The sense of place and the strong cultural identity
that our historic environment provides are rooted in our communities and
promote a positive image of Scotland across the world.
苏格兰的历史环境已经被人类塑造了一万多年。过去的几代人在我们的城镇和城
市以及我们周围的乡村留下了他们的印记。我们的历史环境所提供的地方感和强
烈的文化认同感植根于我们的社区，并在世界范围内提升了苏格兰的正面形象。
Measures to protect our built environment first became law in the United
Kingdom in 1882. The inventory of gardens and designed landscapes was
begun in 1987and there are now over 300 sites on the inventory. This
number changes regularly as sites are added or reviewed.
保护建筑环境的措施于 1882 年在英国首次成为法律。花园和设计景观的清单开
始于 1987 年，现在有超过 300 个地点在清单上。这个数字随着地点的增加或审
查而定期变化。
The inventory recognises grounds intentionally laid out for artistic effect
which are of national importance.We believe that they are among
Scotland’s greatest assets.
这份清单确认了有意为艺术效果设计的具有国家重要性的场地。我们相信，这些
场地是苏格兰最大的资产之一。
Inventory sites chart Scotland’s history.They help to make Scotland a great
place to live, work and visit. The historic character of our environment is
important to our quality of life and it helps us to understand who we are.
库存网站记录了苏格兰的历史。它们使苏格兰成为一个适合居住、工作和旅游的
好地方。我们环境的历史特征对我们的生活质量很重要，它帮助我们了解我们是
谁。
Inventory sites range from country estate landscapes, botanic garden
collections,and urban parks to cemeteries. This varied and exceptional
heritage is a testament to the vision and skills of our predecessors.
目录网站的范围从乡村庄园景观，植物园收藏，城市公园到墓地。这些丰富多彩
的特殊遗产证明了我们前人的远见卓识和技能。
Adding these sites to the inventory helps us to recognise their
achievements and pass them on to future generations.
将这些网站添加到目录中，有助于我们认识到它们的成就，并将它们传递给后代。
Today’s owners of inventory sites have an important part to play in
managing our heritage. They can help to make sure that future
generations will be able to enjoy these areas of national importance.
今天的库存网站的所有者在管理我们的遗产方面扮演着重要的角色。他们可以帮
助确保后代能够享受这些国家重要的领域。
Above: Aerial view of the King’s Knot, Stirling © Historic Environment Scotland
上图: 苏格兰斯特林国王结的鸟瞰图
What is the inventory?
目录是什么？
Above: Dunrobin Castle and gardens, Highland © Historic Environment Scotland(Aerial Photography Collection)
上图: 敦罗宾城堡和花园，苏格兰高地历史环境(航拍摄影集)
The inventory is a list of Scotland’s most important gardens and designed landscapes.
这份清单列出了苏格兰最重要的花园和设计风景。
Gardens and designed landscapes are grounds intentionally laid out for
artistic effect.
园林和景观设计是为了达到艺术效果而特意布置的场地。
We maintain the inventory under the terms of the Ancient Monuments and
Archaeological Areas Act 1979,legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1979/46.
我们根据 1979 年《古代遗迹和考古地区法案》(legislation.gov.
uk/ukpga/1979/46)的条款保留了目录。
The purpose of the inventory is to identify sites of national importance and
provide information about them.When a garden and designed landscape is
included on the inventory it becomes a material consideration in the
planning process. This means that it has to be taken into account when
deciding planning applications.
清单的目的是查明具有国家重要性的场址，并提供有关这些场址的信息。当一个
花园和设计的景观包括在清单中，它成为一个物质考虑在规划过程中。这意味着
在决定规划应用时必须考虑到它。
To be added to the inventory, a site must be of national importance
and(see page 7). The most common type of site on the inventory is the
country estate landscape, developed for both pleasure and productive
purposes.
要加入清单，一个网站必须具有国家重要性和(见第 7 页)。目录中最常见的场地
类型是乡村地产景观，开发用于娱乐和生产目的。
Well-known examples include Hopetoun House in West Lothian, Culzean
Castle in South Ayrshire, and Haddo House in Aberdeenshire. However, the
inventory also recognises the significance of many other types of designed
landscape throughout Scotland. Sites on the inventory range in size from
one hectare to well over 1000 hectares and date from the medieval period
up until the 20th century.
著名的例子包括西洛锡安的 Hopetoun House，南埃尔郡的 Culzean Castle 和
阿伯丁郡的 Haddo House。然而，清单也承认了许多其他类型的景观设计在整
个苏格兰的重要性。清单上的遗址面积从 1 公顷到 1000 公顷不等，可以追溯到
中世纪直到 20 世纪。
They usually have a combination of different features such as built
structures,planting, open grounds, evidence of earth-moving(for example,
garden terraces), water management,archaeological remains and natural
landscape features, all of which may contribute to the value of a site.Within
the boundary of a garden and designed landscape, we may also designate
buildings as listed buildings or archaeological sites as scheduled
monuments. Scottish Natural Heritage may also recognise the scientific or
nature conservation value of sites.
它们通常具有不同的特征，例如建筑物、种植、开阔地面、移土证据(例如花园梯
田)、水质管理、考古遗迹和自然景观等，所有这些都可能有助提高遗址的价值。
在花园和设计景观的边界内，我们也可以将建筑物指定为列入清单的建筑物，或
将考古遗址指定为列入清单的古迹。苏格兰自然遗产也可以承认遗址的科学或自
然保护价值。
Above: The restored parterre garden at Pitmedden,Aberdeenshire © Historic Environment
Scotland
上图: 位于阿伯丁郡 Pitmedden 的修复花园
Assessing sites for the inventory
为库存评估场地
Above: The Necropolis, Glasgow © Historic Environment Scotland
上图: 墓地，格拉斯哥历史环境苏格兰
We assess each garden and designed landscape on its own merits.
我们评估每个花园和设计的景观各自的优点。
Our designation policy and selection guidance explains how we assess
gardens and designed landscapes for the inventory. See
historicenvironment.scot/designation-policy.
我们的指定政策和选择指南解释了我们如何评估花园和为清单设计景观。
To be included on the inventory, a garden and designed landscape must be
of national importance.
为了被列入清单，一个花园和设计景观必须具有国家重要性。
To decide if a site is of national
决定一个地点是否属于国家级
importance, we assess its:
重要性，我们评估它的:
– a rtistic interest
一种艺术兴趣
– historical interest
历史兴趣
– h orticultural interest
对园艺有兴趣
– a rchitetecural interest
- 建筑兴趣
– a rchaeological interest
考古方面的兴趣
– s cenic interest, and
利益，以及
– n ature conservation area interest.
- 自然保育区的利益。
We also assess the overall integrity.
我们还评估了整体的完整性。
The integrity of a garden and designed
一个完整的花园和设计
landscape means its wholeness and
景观意味着它的整体性
relates to the survival and condition of
与... 的生存和状况有关
features that contribute to its national
的特征，而这些特征有助于
importance. The inventory is not intended to recognise lost landscapes.
这份清单并不是为了确认失去的风景。
For each category, we measure interest on a scale ranging from
‘outstanding’ to ‘no interest’. Generally, the greater the number of
outstanding or high interests,the more likely the site is to be included on
the inventory. However, in some cases a garden and designed landscape
may be of such exceptional significance for only one area of interest that it
can also be regarded as nationally important.
对于每一个类别，我们用从“杰出”到“无兴趣”的范围来衡量兴趣。一般来说，
未完成或高兴趣的数量越多，网站被列入清单的可能性越大。然而，在某些情况
下，一个花园和设计的景观可能只对一个感兴趣的领域具有特殊的意义，它也可
以被认为是全国重要的。
Although a garden can be most widely known for its colourful flower
displays, this actually represents the most short-lived part of the
landscape.When assessing a site, we normally consider the more enduring
features.Typically, these include built structures,planting(including trees
with a lifespan of 100 years or more), open grounds,evidence of earth-
moving(for example,garden terraces), water management,archaeological
remains and natural landscape features. All of these may contribute to the
overall interest of the site.
虽然一个花园可以最广为人知的五颜六色的花展，这实际上代表了最短命的一部分景观。在评估一个地点时，我们通常会考虑更持久的特征。一般而言，这些建筑物
包括建筑物、种植(包括树木寿命达 100 年或以上)、开阔地面、移土证据(例如花园梯田)、水资源管理、考古遗迹和自然景观特色。所有这些都可能有助于整个遗址的
利益。
Above: Aberdour Castle and garden terraces, Fife © Historic Environment Scotland
上图: 阿伯杜尔城堡和花园露台，法夫历史环境苏格兰
Designation proposals and reviews
指定建议和审查
Anyone can ask us to designate a site or place, or to review an existing designation.
任何人都可以要求我们指定一个地点或地点，或者审查现有
的指定。
You can do any of these things by filling in our application form. The form is
available on our website at historicenvironment.scot/designation-
你可以通过填写我们的申请表来完成这些事情。申请表可以在我们的网站
historicenvironment.scot/designation-上找到
application or we can post you a copy.
或者我们可以寄给你一份副本。
Once we receive your form, we will acknowledge your application and
decide how best to deal with your request. In some circumstances we may
not go ahead with an application. If we decide not to go ahead, we will let
you know as soon as possible. You can find more detailed information on
how we assess sites and places, including our criteria and selection
guidance, in our designation policy at
一旦我们收到您的表格，我们将确认您的申请，并决定如何最好地处理您的要求。
在某些情况下，我们可能不会提出申请。如果我们决定不继续，我们会尽快通知
你。您可以在我们的指定政策中找到更多关于我们如何评估站点和地点的详细信
息，包括我们的标准和选择指南
historicenvironment.scot/designation-policy.
Historicenvironment.scot/指定政策。
Our assessments will normally include research and choosing which of the
heritage designations is most appropriate for the site that you’ve
proposed(see page 16 for information on all our heritage designations). We
may also visit the site.
我们的评估通常包括研究和选择哪些文物名称最适合您所提议的遗址(关于我们所
有文物名称的信息见第 16 页)。我们也可以参观这个遗址。
If we find that the site or place meets the criteria for designation, we will
publish a report on our online portal at portal.historicenvironment.scot,
giving information about our proposed decision.This is called a report of
handling and it normally includes an assessment of the site or place.
如果我们发现该网站或地点符合指定标准，我们将在我们的在线门户网站
portal.historicenvironment.scot 上发布一份报告，提供有关我们拟议决定的信
息。这就是所谓的处理报告，它通常包括对网站或地点的评估。
We normally consult those directly affected, including the owner, occupier
or tenant and the planning authority, before designating a site or
amending
a designation. We also normally welcome views from interested people or
groups through our website.
在指定用地或修订指定用地前，我们通常会谘询直接受影响的人士，包括业主、
占用人或承租人及规划当局。我们通常亦欢迎有兴趣的人士或团体透过我们的网
站提出意见。
We follow the same process for removing existing designations.
我们也遵循同样的流程来删除现有的名称。
We publish our final decision and the completed report of handling on our
online portal. See our website for more information about our service
standards and timescales for designation proposals.
我们在我们的在线门户网站上公布我们的最终决定和完成的处理报告。有关我们
的服务标准和时间表的更多信息，请参见我们的网站。
If you are the owner or occupier of all or part of the site or place, we will
make reasonable efforts to tell you if it has been designated or has had its
designation amended. The same applies to removals.
如你是该用地或地方的全部或部分的拥有人或占用人，我们会尽力告知你该用地
或地方是否已被指定或已被修改。这同样适用于拆除。
We will also tell the planning authority about these changes.
我们也会把这些变化告诉规划当局。
Left: One of the ancient Cadzow Oaks, Chatelherault,South Lanarkshire © Historic
Environment Scotland Below: Ornamental steps, Dawyck Botanic Garden,Scottish Borders ©
Historic Environment Scotland
左图: 古老的 Cadzow 橡树之一，南拉纳克郡的 Chatelherault 历史环境苏格兰下图: 装饰台阶，

The inventory record
库存记录
Above: Balbirnie, Fife © Historic Environment Scotland
上图: Balbirnie，Fife Historic Environment 苏格兰
Each inventory garden and designed landscape is given a record.This consists of written information and a map
which shows the extent of the inventory boundary.
每个库存花园和设计景观给予一个记录。这包括书面信息和
显示库存边界范围的地图。
It is intended to help people understand why a garden and designed
landscape is of national importance. The record is usually accompanied by
photographs.
它旨在帮助人们理解为什么一个花园和设计的景观是国家的重要性。这份记录通
常伴随着照片。
You can search the records online on our website
portal.historicenvironment.scot.
你可以在我们的网站 portal.historicenvironment.scot 上搜索这些记录。
Inventory records are based on information gathered during the site visit
and research. Documentary evidence for a site can include historical
maps,estate records, photographs, designs and plans, and other material
including books,statistical records and magazine articles.
库存记录是基于网站访问和研究过程中收集的信息。遗址的文件证据可包括历史
地图、遗产记录、照片、设计和平面图，以及其他材料，包括书籍、统计记录和
杂志文章。
Each record includes a summary of why a site is important, information on
its location and setting, a site history,and information about different
aspects of the site, such as architectural features,parkland, woodland, or
water features.Earlier records may not be as complete as later records.
每个记录包括一个网站为什么重要的摘要，它的位置和设置的信息，网站的历史，
以及网站的不同方面的信息，如建筑特征，公园，林地，或水的特征。早期的记
录可能不如后来的记录完整。
Defining the boundary
界定边界
Each inventory garden and designed landscape has a map with a defined
boundary showing the geographical extent of the designation.
每个库存花园和设计景观都有一张地图，地图上有一个明确的边界，显示指定的
地理范围。
We use historic documents and maps,together with evidence collected
during the site visit, to help us define the
我们使用历史文献和地图，以及在实地考察期间收集的证据，来帮助我们定义
boundary, particularly in the case of
边界，特别是在
country house policies where there may be inner designed garden grounds
and parkland within a much larger agricultural estate.
乡村住宅政策，在一个规模大得多的农业区内，可能有内部设计的花园和公园。
Sometimes, features such as policy walls and gates clearly show where a
boundary can be drawn. In other circumstances, it is less clear-cut, and we
use our professional judgement to define the most logical boundary line.
有时候，政策墙和大门等特征会清楚地表明可以在哪里划定界限。在其他情况下，
它不是很明确，我们用我们的专业判断来定义最合乎逻辑的边界线。
Who currently owns the land does not affect how we define the boundary.
目前谁拥有这片土地并不影响我们如何界定边界。
Above: Detail from ‘A map of East Lothian, survey’d’ by J. Adair 1736, reproduced by
permission of the Trustees of the National Library of Scotland
上图: 细节来自“东洛锡安地图，由 j. Adair 1736 年勘测 d”，经苏格兰国家图书馆托管人许可复制
Living and working within an inventory garden and designed
landscape
生活和工作在一个库存花园和设计景观
When a garden and designed landscape is included on the inventory this does not mean that changes cannot be
made to it.
当一个花园和设计景观是包括在库存，这并不意味着不能作
出改变。
Gardens and designed landscapes are by their nature constantly
evolving.They cannot be ‘frozen in time’ and change is often necessary.
花园和设计的景观从本质上来说是不断发展的。它们不能“冻结在时间里”，改
变往往是必要的。
Being on the inventory does not mean that owners need to open their
property to the public. There are many privately owned sites on the
inventory which have no formal access arrangements. The Scottish
Outdoor Access Code has more information about access rights, at
outdooraccess-scotland.scot.
存货清单并不意味着业主需要向公众开放他们的财产。存货清单上有许多私人拥
有的网站没有正式的访问安排。苏格兰户外访问代码有更多关于访问权限的信息，
在户外访问-苏格兰。苏格兰。
Neither we nor the planning authority have to be consulted for work such
as:
无论是我们还是规划部门，都不需要为以下工作征求意见:
– d ay-to-day maintenance
日常维护
– planting
- 种植
– r emoving planting
移除种植
– r edesign which does not need planning permission, or – l andscaping
which does not need planning permission.
ー不需要规划许可的重新设计; 或ー l 不需要规划许可的绿化。
Being on the inventory does have an effect when a proposed development
needs planning permission. This type of development is set out in The
Town and Country Planning(Development Management Procedure)
(Scotland)Regulations 2013 as development which may affect a historic
garden and designed landscape.
当一个拟议的开发项目需要规划许可时，库存确实会产生影响。《2013 年城乡规
划(发展管理程序)(苏格兰)规例》把这类发展列为可能影响历史花园及设计景观的
发展。
If you want to make a change which needs planning permission, you need
to first contact your planning authority for guidance. If your plans involve a
listed building or scheduled monument,they can also advise you about any
other permission you might need.
如果你想做出需要规划许可的改变，你需要首先联系你的规划部门寻求指导。如
果你的规划涉及一个列出的建筑物或在册古迹，他们也可以建议你可能需要的任
何其他许可。
Where a development requires planning permission, the planning authority
will consult us for our view on the proposals.Our role is to provide advice
and expert knowledge.
如发展项目需要规划许可，规划监督会就有关建议谘询我们的意见。我们的角色
是提供建议和专业知识。
The planning authority grant planning permission and the decision rests
with them. They are also responsible for tree preservation orders(TPOs).
For advice on the implications of natural heritage designations, such as
Sites of Special Scientific Interest(SSSI), please contact Scottish Natural
Heritage at nature.scot.
规划当局授予规划许可，决定权在他们手中。他们还负责树木保护令(TPOs)。有
关自然遗产指定的意见，例如「具特殊科学价值地点」(SSSI) ，请联络苏格兰自
然遗产(nature.scot)。
The Forestry Commission Scotland may also consult us for our views on
woodland management issues within inventory sites, such as felling.
苏格兰林业委员会也可以征求我们对于森林管理问题的意见，例如伐木。
We are happy to provide advice and guidance on development affecting
inventory sites and you can find out more about this on our website.
我们很乐意就影响库存地点的开发提供建议和指导，你可以在我们的网站上找到更多相关信息。
Owners’ responsibilities
业主的责任
Responsibility for the routine maintenance of an inventory garden or
designed landscape lies with the owners and the occupiers.
业主和使用者有责任对库存花园或设计景观进行日常维护。
The owners of Scotland’s finest gardens and designed landscapes face
many challenges, ranging from climate change and managing the site as a
whole to dealing with specific problems such invasive species, tree and
plant diseases,or maintaining built structures.
苏格兰最好的花园和设计景观的所有者面临着许多挑战，从气候变化和管理整个
场地到处理具体问题，如入侵物种、树木和植物疾病，或维护建筑结构。
We support targeted and positive ways of managing gardens and designed
landscapes and welcome more comprehensive plans for managing the
sites now and into the future.
我们支持有针对性和积极的管理花园和设计景观的方法，并欢迎更全面的管理现
在和未来的网站计划。
We encourage owners to get professional advice on landscape
management issues and to find solutions which fit with the character of
their garden or designed landscape.
我们鼓励业主就园林管理问题征询专业意见，并寻找符合其园林或设计景观特色
的解决方案。
Below: Loch of Fyvie, Fyvie Castle, Aberdeenshire © Historic Environment Scotland Right:
View of Bayley Balfour Memorial Hut, Benmore Botanic Garaden,Argyll and Bute © Historic
Environment Scotland
下图: 阿伯丁郡费维湖，费维城堡，历史环境苏格兰右图: 贝利贝尔弗纪念小屋，本莫尔植物园，阿
盖尔和布特历史环境苏格兰贝利贝尔弗纪念小屋
Other heritage designations
其他文物名称
We are also responsible for designating other types of heritage assets, including listed buildings, scheduled
monuments and historic battlefields.
我们还负责指定其他类型的遗产资产，包括列入清单的建筑
物、纪念碑和历史战场。
We also advise the Scottish Government on designating sites as historic
marine protected areas. There is more information about these on our
website.
我们也建议苏格兰政府将这些地点指定为历史性的海洋保护区。在我们的网站上
有更多关于这些地区的信息。
Scotland has over 600 conservation areas which are designated by
planning authorities. Planning authorities must decide which parts of their
areas are of special architectural or historic interest, and they may
designate these as conservation areas. The public will normally be
consulted on any proposal to designate conservation areas or to change
their boundaries.
苏格兰有超过 600 个由规划部门指定的保护区。规划当局必须决定哪些地区具有
特殊的建筑或历史价值，他们可以指定这些地区为保护区。任何指定保育区或改
变其边界的建议，通常都会征询公众的意见。
World Heritage Sites are recorded by UNESCO(The United Nations
Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation) as places of outstanding
universal value in terms of their cultural or natural heritage
whc.unesco.org.
世界遗产被联合国教科文组织(联合国教科文组织)记录为具有突出的文化或自然
遗产普遍价值的地方。
Scotland currently has six World Heritage Sites. Information on these is
given on our website historicenvironment.scot/world-heritage-sites.
苏格兰目前有六个世界遗产地点。关于这些地点的信息可以在我们的网站
historicenvironment.scot/World-Heritage-Sites 上找到。
Searching for inventory sites,other designations and
our decisions
搜索库存网站，其他指定和我们的决定
You can search by keyword or map for all our designations on our online
portal at portal.historicenvironment.scot. You will also find information
about our designation decisions. If you are still not sure whether a site is
included on the inventory, you can email or phone us for help. Our contact
details are at the end of this booklet.
你可以通过关键字或地图在我们的门户网站 portal.historicenvironment.scot 上
搜索我们所有的设计。你也可以找到关于我们设计决定的信息。如果你仍然不确
定某个网站是否包含在清单中，你可以给我们发邮件或打电话寻求帮助。我们的
联系方式在这本小册子的最后。
You can also carry out map searches on Scotland’s Environment website,
where you can find more environmental information, including
conservation area boundaries: environment.gov.scot.
你也可以在苏格兰的环境网站上进行地图搜索，在那里你可以找到更多的环境信
息，包括自然保护区的边界: Environment.gov.scot。

Glasgow Botanic Gardens © Historic Environment Scotland

Rural Landscapes
Register of Parks and Gardens Selection Guide
Front cover
Deene Park, Northamptonshire (registered Grade II),
created in the mid sixteenth century. The lake and
bridge (listed Grade II) are of the mid eighteenth century.
Summary
Historic England’s selection guides help to define which historic buildings and sites
are likely to meet the relevant tests for national designation. Four guides, of which
this is one, deal with the types of site included on Historic England’s Register of Parks
and Gardens of Special Historic Interest in England which is a constituent part of the
National Heritage List for England.
Each guide falls into two halves. The first defines the types of site included in it, before
going on to give a brisk overview of how these developed through time, with notice
of the main designers and some of the key sites. The second half of the guide sets out
the particular tests a site has to meet if it is to be included on the Register. A select
bibliography gives suggestions for further reading.
This guide covers rural designed landscapes, including gardens and parks around
country houses. The other three guides treat Urban, and Institutional, landscapes, and
Landscapes of Remembrance, that is cemeteries and burial grounds.
First published by English Heritage March 2013.
This edition published by Historic England December 2017.
