二级 *)
in Letchworth (Hertfordshire) in 1912, such
progressive concerns were a major objective of
the Garden City Movement and introduced the
idea of planned industrial zones. As industry
expanded evermore into the outskirts of towns,
the development of the planning profession,
following the Planning Act of 1909, became a
considerable influence on the siting and design of
industrial facilities.
1912 年，在莱奇沃思(赫特福德郡) ，这种进步的
关注是花园城市运动的一个主要目标，并引入了
规划工业区的想法。随着工业不断向城镇郊区扩
展，1909 年《规划法》颁布后，规划专业的发展
对工业设施的选址和设计产生了相当大的影响。
1.4 1914 to the present
1.41914 至今
The industrial heritage of the last 100 years is less
easy to evaluate as regards designation. Many of
the more traditional industries have steadily
declined until there are relatively few sites left. The
coal industry contracted dramatically in
过去 100 年的工业遗产不太容易评估。许多比较传
统的产业已经稳步衰落，直到剩下的遗址相对较少。
2010 年，煤炭工业急剧萎缩
the 1980s and early 1990s with many historic sites
cleared before a full evaluation could be made of
their significance. The last deep coal mines in
England closed in 2015. The iron and steel
industry, which had contracted to only a handful of
works focused on specialist steels by the end of the
twentieth century may also be in terminal decline.
Engineering has also refined its operations to the
precision end of the market and the huge
complexes employing thousands of workers
virtually disappeared in the latter half of the
twentieth century. Even the newer engineering
industries – for instance, car manufacture and the
aerospace industry – have undergone similar
cycles of contraction and concentration and
relatively few buildings worthy of designation
survive.
20 世纪 80 年代和 90 年代初，许多历史遗迹在对其
重要性进行全面评估之前被清理干净。英格兰最后
一个深井煤矿于 2015 年关闭。到 20 世纪末，钢铁
工业已经缩减到只有少数几家专门生产特种钢的工
厂，现在也可能处于末期衰落。工程部门也将其业
务精确到了市场的终端，雇用了数千名工人的大型
综合设施在 20 世纪后半叶几乎消失了。即使是较新
的工程行业——例如汽车制造业和航空航天工业
——也经历了类似的收缩和集中周期，几乎没有值
得指定的建筑物幸存下来。
However, significant changes were made to the
image of industry through the spread of American
and German industrial methods, allied to advances
in planning. The attempts to improve the quality of
industrial products in Germany before the First
World War led to the creation of the Deusche
Werkbund – a reforming association of industrialists
and designers which became the model for its
British counterpart, the Design and Industries
Association (founded 1915). Works such as Berlin’s
classically-inspired turbine assembly hall of 1908,
by Peter Behrens for the AEG, came to symbolize
this new relationship between ‘Art and Industry’, and
influenced some of the more progressively minded
manufacturers. From the US the concept of the
‘daylight factory’ was introduced: its major impact
was first felt in Trafford Park (Greater Manchester).
These long, low, and sleek modern buildings with
large areas of glazing, in pleasant grassed settings,
account for many of the so-called ‘by-pass modern’
factories. Frequently sited along new arterial roads
such as London’s Great Western Road, the best
known are those designed by Wallis, Gilbert and
Partners, such as their Hoover Factory (1932-5,
listed Grade II*; Fig 3). Recent developments in
architecture have brought renewed attention to the
challenges of factory design, and a number of
significant High Tech structures from firms of
international renown have been built such as the
Renault Distribution Centre, Swindon (1983), by
Foster and Partners (listed Grade II*). Another
theme of the period has been the establishment of
ever-more laboratories for scientific research: the
British Gas Research Station, Killingworth, North
Tyneside, designed by Ryder and Yates in 1965
and completed in 1967 (listed Grade II*; Fig 4), is a
good example.
然而，随着美国和德国工业方法的传播，伴随着规划
的进步，工业形象发生了重大变化。在第一次世界大
战之前，为了提高德国工业产品的质量，德意志工业
联合会(Deusche Werkbund)应运而生。德意志工业
联合会是一个由工业家和设计师组成的改革性协会，
后来成为英国设计与工业协会(Design and Industries
Association)的典范(成立于 1915 年)。彼得 · 贝伦斯
(Peter Behrens)为 AEG 设计的 1908 年柏林经典风
格的涡轮机装配大厅等作品，象征着“艺术与工
业”之间的这种新关系，并影响了一些思想更为进
步的制造商。从美国引入了“日光工厂”的概念: 它
的主要影响首先在特拉福德公园(大曼彻斯特)感受到。
这些长长的、低矮的、光滑的现代化建筑带有大面
积的玻璃，在宜人的草地环境中，构成了许多所谓
的“旁路现代化”工厂。最著名的是由
Wallis，Gilbert and Partners 设计的公路，如他们
的胡佛工厂(1932-1935 年，列为二级 * ; 图 3)。最近
建筑方面的发展使人们重新注意到工厂设计的挑战，
福斯特建筑事务所和合作伙伴(列为二级 *)建造了一
些国际知名公司的重要高科技建筑，例如斯温顿的
雷诺配送中心(1983 年)。这一时期的另一个主题是
建立越来越多的科学研究实验室: 由 Ryder 和 Yates
于 1965 年设计并于 1967 年完工的英国气体研究站，
位于北泰恩赛德(North Tyneside)的基灵沃思
(Killingworth) ，就是一个很好的例子。
The textile industry witnessed a final expansive
phase in the first quarter of the twentieth century
but almost all manufactories and mills have now
closed or been converted to other uses – many
in the last three decades. The garment industry
survived somewhat longer with a flourish in the
1930s producing notable modern buildings along
many of the new bypass roads and boulevards:
but even those have largely gone.
纺织工业在二十世纪第一季度经历了最后的扩张
阶段，但几乎所有的工厂和纺织厂现在都已关闭
或转用于其他用途——许多是在过去三十年中。
20 世纪 30 年代，服装业蓬勃发展，沿着许多新
的绕行公路和林荫大道建造了许多著名的现代化
建筑，但即使这些建筑也基本消失了。

2 Overarching
Considerations
总体考虑
2.1 Scheduling and protection
2.1 调度和保护
Archaeological sites and monuments vary greatly
in character, and can be protected in many ways:
through positive management by owners, through
policy, and through designation. In terms of
考古遗址和古迹的性质差异很大，可以通过许多方
式加以保护: 通过业主的积极管理、通过政策和通
过指定。根据
our designation system, this consists of several
separate approaches which operate alongside
each other, and our aim is to recommend the
most appropriate sort of protection for each asset.
Our approach towards designation will vary,
depending on the asset in question: our selection

我们的指定系统，这包括几个独立的方法，这些方

Scheduling, through triggering careful control and

调度，通过触发仔细的控制和历史英格兰的参与，

2.2 Listing and scheduling
2.2 列表和日程安排
Considerable numbers of sites of industrial
archaeological importance have been scheduled as
monuments. Past practice has generally been to
schedule sites and remains, where
monumentalised, and to list buildings. There is
considerable overlap, however, and some dual
designation, that is where the same asset is both
scheduled and listed. Our current approach is to
consider what the appropriate designation response
is, and consider how the site or structure is best
managed. This is more fully discussed in the
Industrial Sites scheduling selection guide.
相当数量的具有工业考古重要性的遗址已被列为古迹。
过去的做法通常是规划遗址和遗迹，在纪念碑，并列
出建筑物。有相当大的重叠，然而，和一些双重指定，
这是在同一资产的既定计划和上市。我们目前的方法
是考虑什么是适当的指定响应，并考虑如何最好地管
理网站或结构。这一点在工业网站调度选择指南中有
更详细的讨论。
2.3 Heritage assets and
national importance
2.3 遗产资产和国家重要性
Paragraph 139 of the National Planning Policy
Framework (March 2012) (https://www.gov.
uk/government/uploads/system/uploads/
attachment_data/file/6077/2116950.pdf) states
that in order to conserve and enhance the historic
environment ‘non-designated heritage assets of
archaeological interest that are demonstrably of
equivalent significance to scheduled monuments,
should be considered subject to the policies for
designated heritage assets’. These assets are
defined as having National Importance (NI).
国家规划政策框架(2012 年 3 月)第 139 段
(https://www.gov)。英国/政府/上载/系统/上载/附
件 _ data/file/6077/2116950.pdf)指出，为了保护
和改善历史环境，「具考古价值的非指定文物资
产，如证明与列入名册的古迹具有同等重要性，
应考虑受指定文物资产政策的约束」。这些资产
被定义为具有国家重要性(NI)。
This is merely the latest iteration of a principle
first raised in PPG16 (1990-2010) and later in
PPS5 (2010-12).
这仅仅是 PPG16(1990-2010)和后来的
PPS5(2010-12)首次提出的原则的最新迭代。
Historic England is currently (2016) undertaking a
series of activities relating to NI in discussion with
government and the sector which aims to produce
a draft framework setting out agreed Principles of
Selection, and agree a draft protocol clarifying
how Local Authority Historic Environment
Services would be involved in this.
历史悠久的英格兰目前(2016 年)正在开展一系列与
国家机构有关的活动，与政府和部门进行讨论，目
的是制定一个框架草案，阐明商定的选择原则，并
商定一个议定书草案，澄清地方当局历史环境服务
部门将如何参与这项工作。

2.4 选择标准
The particular considerations used by the

3 General Principles
三项一般原则
3.1 Integrated sites
3.1 综合网站
With industrial sites it is important to consider
how they functioned in terms process-flow:
from receiving and storing raw materials, via
the various manufacturing stages, through to
warehousing and the selling of the end product.
In addition, other structures may be present
which served the needs of the workforce
对于工业场所，重要的是要考虑它们在工艺流程
方面如何运作: 从接收和储存原材料，经过各个
制造阶段，到仓储和最终产品的销售。此外，其
他结构可能会出现，以满足劳动力的需求
or facilitated maintenance. With sites of
acknowledged historic interest, consideration
should be given to listing all relevant
或便于维护。与公认的历史名胜，应考虑列出
所有相关的
structures, even where they are architecturally
utilitarian. If elements have been lost from the
complex, undermining the understanding of how
the site functioned, this may make the surviving
buildings unlistable unless they are of special
interest for some other reason.
建筑物，即使它们在建筑上是实用的。如果建筑
群中的元素丢失，破坏了人们对场地功能的理解，
那么，除非出于其他原因，幸存的建筑物具有特
殊意义，否则可能无法列入清单。

3.3 Regional factors
3.3 区域因素
Some industries are concentrated in particular
regions, and designation is a way of capturing
representative examples of buildings and
complexes which give places their particular
character. One example is the boot and shoe
industry of Northamptonshire, another being
listings in the Kent coalfield which preserve
tangible evidence that not all coal came from
the great northern coalfields. Some structures
are so emblematic of a major national
industry that they can be designated even
when largely ruinous, as with Cornish tin
mining engine houses (Fig 5), many of which
also form part of a World Heritage Site
一些工业集中在特定的地区，而指定是捕捉建
筑物和综合体的代表性例子的一种方式，这些
建筑物和综合体赋予了地方特殊的性质。一个
例子是北安普敦郡的制鞋业，另一个例子是肯
特煤田的上市公司，这些公司保存了有形的证
据，证明并非所有的煤炭都来自北方的大煤田。
一些建筑如此象征着一个主要的国家工业，以
至于它们甚至可以被指定为破坏性很大的建筑，
如康沃尔锡矿机房(图 5) ，其中许多也构成了
世界遗产的一部分
Whittle developed the jet engine, one of the
defining developments of the twentieth century.
In such cases careful consideration needs to be
given to how influential the development or
variation proved to be; the greater interest will
always lie with the ‘breakthrough’ innovation.
Normally there should be some direct evidence
of the innovation exhibited in the structure itself.
Buildings may also be of special architectural
interest for the use of technology in their physical
construction (such as fireproofing). Associations
with significant engineers, millwrights or
entrepreneurs may also give, or enhance,
special interest and grading.
惠特尔发明了喷气式发动机，这是二十世纪最重
要的发展之一。在这种情况下，需要仔细考虑发

在于“突破性”创新。通常情况下，结构本身应
该有一些创新的直接证据。建筑物也可能是特殊
的建筑兴趣，在他们的物理建筑中使用技术(如防
火)。与重要的工程师、木匠或企业家的协会也可
能给予或加强特殊的兴趣和等级。
Individual buildings must be assessed on their
own merits. However, it is important to consider
the wider context and where a building forms
part of a functional group with one or more listed
(or listable) structures this is likely to add to its
own interest. Examples might include process
buildings associated with industrial or military
sites. Key considerations are the relative dates
of the structures, and the degree to which they
were functionally inter-dependent when in their
original uses.
个别建筑物必须按其本身的情况进行评估。然而，
重要的是要考虑更广泛的背景，如果一个建筑物
构成了一个或多个列出(或可列出)结构的功能组的
一部分，这可能会增加其自身的利益。例子可能
包括与工业或军事场所相关的工艺建筑。关键的
考虑因素是结构的相对日期，以及它们在最初使
用时功能上相互依赖的程度。
3.4 Machinery
3.4 机械
Because redundant machinery is typically either
replaced or sold for scrap, buildings retaining
intact nineteenth-century or earlier machinery are
exceptional; its presence can provide good
justification for designation, sometimes at a high
grade. Even where machinery has been removed,
sufficient evidence of it may remain to allow a
good understanding of manufacturing processes,
and in some cases provide justification for
designation either via listing or scheduling.
由于多余的机械通常要么被替换，要么被当作废品
出售，保留完整的 19 世纪或更早的机械的建筑物是
例外; 它的存在可以为指定提供很好的理由，有时是
高级别的。即使机器已被拆除，仍可保留足够的证
据，以便对制造工艺有充分的了解，并在某些情况
下通过列表或日程安排为指定提供理由。
3.5 Historic interest,
including innovation
3.5 历史利益，包括创新
Some buildings may be of special historical interest
because they were where new technology was
developed, such as Ladywood Works in
Lutterworth, (listed Grade ll*) where Sir Frank
一些建筑可能具有特殊的历史意义，因为它们是新
技术发展的地方，例如拉特沃思的 Ladywood Works
(列为二级) ，弗兰克爵士就是在这里建造的
3.6 Extent of listing
3.6 上市范围
Amendment to the Planning (Listed Buildings and
Conservation Areas) Act 1990 provides two potential
ways to be more precise about what is listed.
1990 年《规划(列入清单的建筑物和保护区)法》的修正
案提供了两种可能的方法，以便更准确地说明所列的内
容。
The empowerments, found in section 1 (5A) (a)
and (b) of the 1990 Act, allow the List entry to
say definitively whether attached or curtilage
structures are protected; and/or to exclude from

do not apply retrospectively, but New listings and
substantial amendments from 2013 will provide

1990 年法案第 1(5A)(a)和(b)节规定的授权允许清

追溯，但从 2013 年新的列表和实质性修正将提供

Clarification on the extent of listing for older

可通过当地规划局或历史悠久的英格兰加强咨询

4 Industry-Specific
特定行业
Considerations
考虑因素
The following sections examine the special interest of specific industrial building
types, splitting the category into three functional sub-sections: extraction; processing
and manufacturing; and storage and distribution. It is particularly important when
reading this section to bear in mind the general principles outlined above.
以下章节探讨了特定工业建筑类型的特殊利益，将这一类别划分为三个功能部分: 提取、
加工和制造以及储存和分销。在阅读这一部分时，特别重要的是要记住上面概述的一般
原则。
4.1 Extraction
4.1 提取
This can be divided into three groups. Firstly,
coal, most iron ores and some other deposits
such as fire clay, salt and some building
stones all form relatively thick seams which
are generally horizontally bedded and have
been exploited by seam mining. Secondly,
some iron ores and all other metal ores (such
as lead, copper and tin) occur as veins that
are typically narrow, intermittent and often cut
across bedding planes vertically, resulting in a
different range and distribution of buildings.
Thirdly, surface quarrying and opencasting (of
coal, iron ore, clay, aggregate and most
building stones) which generally required little
in the way of permanent buildings.
这可以分为三组。首先，煤炭、大部分铁矿石和
一些其他矿床，如火粘土、盐和一些建筑石头，
都形成较厚的煤层，一般为水平层状，已被煤层
开采。其次，一些铁矿石和所有其他金属矿石(如
铅、铜和锡)的矿脉通常是狭窄的、间歇性的，并
且往往垂直地穿过层面，导致建筑物的范围和分
布不同。第三，地面采石和露天开采(煤、铁矿石、
粘土、集料和大多数建筑用石头) ，通常对永久
性建筑物的需求很少。
Seam mining
Seam mining 煤层开采
Early mines exploiting seams of coal or iron ore
were shallow and consisted of multiple shafts
spread across the landscape. Any surface
structures are likely to have been temporary and
will now only survive archaeologically.
早期开采煤层或铁矿石的矿井很浅，由分布在整
个地貌上的多个竖井组成。任何表面结构都可能
是暂时的，现在只能在考古学上幸存下来。
The earliest permanent buildings were vertical
engine houses for pumping water from the
mine workings, first introduced in the
eighteenth century but not becoming
widespread until the nineteenth. Ventilation
chimneys, designed to
最早的永久性建筑是垂直的机房，用于从矿井中
抽水，最初是在 18 世纪引进的，但直到 19 世纪
才开始普及。通风烟囱，设计用于

十九世纪中期柴郡博灵顿一座异常华丽的城堡式烟囱，

draw foul air out of the workings, generally date
from the first half of the nineteenth century (Fig 6).
It was not until around the mid-nineteenth century,
when steam-powered winding started to replace
horse power, that the archetypal pit head with
buildings clustered around a pair of shafts really
developed. Thus mining buildings pre-dating about
1850 may be listable even if they appear to be
isolated from their mining context and, because of
their rarity, may merit designation even if ruinous or
converted to other uses. The highly capitalised
pitheads that are now seen as emblematic of the
coal industry (but were also a feature of iron mining
in Cleveland and Furness) mainly date to the
second half of the nineteenth and the early
twentieth centuries. Because of a general policy of
clearance after closure, few pithead complexes
survive complete; accordingly, the completeness of
a complex
通常可以追溯到 19 世纪上半叶(图 6)。直到大约 19
世纪中叶，蒸汽动力绕组开始取代马力，原型坑头
和建筑群围绕着一对竖井才真正发展起来。因此，
大约 1850 年以前的采矿建筑物即使看起来与其采矿
背景相隔离，也可以列入清单，而且由于其稀有性，
即使是具有破坏性或转用于其他用途，也可以列入
清单。现在被视为煤炭工业象征(但也是克利夫兰和
弗内斯铁矿开采的一个特征)的高度资本化的矿坑主
要可以追溯到 19 世纪下半叶和 20 世纪初。由于关
闭后清理的一般政策，很少有坑式建筑群能够完整
地存活下来; 因此，一个坑式建筑群的完整性
will be a bonus rather than a precondition for
designation. Buildings representing fragmentary
将是一种奖励，而不是指定的先决条件
survivals of pithead complexes are likely to need
some additional factor to be of special interest, such
as some particular architectural elaboration (such as
the 1911 winding houses at Ledston Luck, West
Yorkshire modelled on Elizabethan prodigy houses,
listed Grade II), or because they are a particularly
rare survival (such as headstocks, as at Brittain
Colliery, Derbyshire (see Fig 7) and fan houses,
Snowdown Colliery, Kent both Grade II); isolated,
utilitarian, non-specialist buildings such as

坑头综合体的幸存者可能需要一些额外的因素来引起
特别的兴趣，比如一些特殊的建筑细节(比如 1911 年

代的天才住宅，被列为二级住宅) ，或者因为它们是

Derbyshire (见图 7)和扇形房屋，Snowdown 煤矿，
Kent 都是二级住宅) ; 孤立的、实用的、非专业的建
筑，比如车间，不太可能被列入名单。
Vein mining
矿脉开采
Mineral mining has a much longer history than
coal mining, stretching back into the Bronze Age,
with earlier workings normally obscured by later
reworking. The earliest permanent structures
associated with mineral mines were smelt mills,
the furnaces used for converting the mineral into
usable metal. These, along with the associated
remains of ore processing, generally survive
矿物开采的历史比煤矿开采的历史要长得多，可以
追溯到青铜时代，早期的工作方式通常被后来的重
新开采所掩盖。与矿山有关的最早的永久性建筑是
冶炼厂，用于将矿物转化为可用金属的熔炉。这些，
连同相关的矿石加工残留物，一般都存活了下来

as archaeological sites more appropriately
designated via scheduling. Veins were typically
worked via open cuts and shafts sunk down the line
of the veins and via adits driven from adjacent
valleys, the adits draining the mine workings. Such
drainage adits were often expensive to construct
and were sometimes given embellished portals that
may merit listing, such as that to the Swinhope
Horse Level, Allendale (Northumberland; listed
Grade II). Exploitation below the lowest drainage
level required pumping which was done by hand,
horse-power or even waterwheel. Although Wheal
Vor mine in Cornwall experimented with steam
power for pumping as early as 1710, it was not until
the later eighteenth century that improvements in
the efficiency of steam engines made steam
pumping viable for mines that were not close to a
coalfield which could supply fuel. This economic
factor saw Cornish mining engineers like Richard
Trevithick (1771-1833) pioneer many improvements
to the steam engine resulting in the spread of the
classic Cornish engine house across the south-west
and beyond in the nineteenth century. Again
because of economics (and because less material is
generally brought to the surface with mineral mines
compared to collieries), steam winding was
generally only employed at the best capitalised
mines in the later nineteenth century. At some
mines, the only permanent buildings were for a
pumping engine and its associated boilers, so
apparently isolated surviving buildings may still be
listable. Some mines, in remote uplands,
作为考古遗址更适当的指定，通过时间表。矿脉通常
是通过明显的切口和矿井沿矿脉线下沉，并通过从邻
近山谷开出的通道进行开采，这些通道排干了矿井工
作。这种排水通道的建造费用往往很高，有时候还会
给出一些可能值得列入清单的装饰门户，例如通往
Swinhope Horse Level，Allendale (Northumberland;
列入二级)的门户。低于最低排水水位的开采需要用
手、马力甚至水车来抽水。尽管康沃尔的沃尔煤矿早
在 1710 年就开始尝试使用蒸汽动力抽水，但直到 18
世纪后期，蒸汽机效率的提高才使得蒸汽抽水在靠近
可以提供燃料的煤田的矿井中成为可能。这种经济因
素促使康沃尔采矿工程师理查 · 特里维西克(richard
trevithick，1771-1833)率先对蒸汽机进行了许多改进，
从而使经典的康沃尔发动机房在 19 世纪传遍了西南
部和更远的地方。同样，由于经济原因(同时由于与
煤矿相比，矿井带到地面的材料通常较少) ，蒸汽绕
组通常只在 19 世纪后期资本最充足的矿井中使用。
在一些矿山，唯一永久性的建筑物是抽水机和相关
的锅炉，所以显然孤立的幸存的建筑物仍然可以列
入名单。一些位于偏远高地的矿井,
had mineshops, buildings providing dormitory
accommodation for miners, often including a
manager’s office. These may merit designation
even when ruinous and dating to the late
nineteenth century. Assessments of vein mining
sites should take regionality into especial
consideration, as a Cornish tin mine has different
characteristics to a Derbyshire lead mine which in
turn is distinct from a lead mine in the North
Pennines.
有矿车间，为矿工提供宿舍的建筑物，通常包括经
理办公室。这些建筑即使是在 19 世纪末的废墟中也
值得一提。对矿脉采矿地点的评估应特别考虑到区
域性，因为康沃尔锡矿与德比郡铅矿的特点不同，
而德比郡铅矿又不同于奔宁山脉北部的铅矿。
4.2 Processing and manufacturing
4.2 加工及制造
Furnaces and kilns
熔炉和窑炉
Nationally, the most common form of furnace (a
structure in which the application of heat is used
to convert a material’s chemical composition) is
the lime kiln (for a convenient summary see Pre-
Industrial Lime Kilns IHA. These were used to
burn chalk or limestone to produce lime
在全国范围内，最常见的炉型(一种利用热量转换
材料化学成份的结构)是石灰窑。它们被用来燃烧
白垩或石灰石来生产石灰
for building (mortar, cement, plaster) or for
agricultural use (as a soil-improver; Fig 8). Most
are flare kilns, which were loaded with stone
stacked within the kiln and fired from beneath for
a few days before being allowed to cool before
emptying. The late eighteenth century saw the
invention and development of the draw kiln (which
externally could look identical to a flare kiln)
where a mix of fuel and stone was loaded into the
top, and continuously burnt with the lime drawn
out from draw holes or eyes at the base. Lime
kilns can vary considerably in scale

煤炭、石头、粘土或集料的表面开采有时涉及面很

其他形式的炉子，如焦炭厂、煅烧窑、铁高炉、

Corn mills (and similar)
玉米磨坊(以及类似的地方)
Before the second half of the nineteenth century
mills supplied local markets, were generally
small-scale and typically wind- or water-driven
(for an overview see the IHA on Mills). Up until
the eighteenth century, watermills were typically
single-storey and were often attached to the
miller’s house. Such examples are often listable
even if now converted to domestic use with the
loss of all machinery. The decades either
在 19 世纪下半叶之前，工厂供应当地市场，一般

工厂的 IHA)。直到 18 世纪，水磨坊都是典型的
单层建筑，并且经常附属于磨坊主的房子。这样

用所有的机器损失。数十年

multi-storey watermills. These had attic
storage, feeding to the milling floor below, that
in turn was set above the ground floor where
the flour was bagged and dispatched, all
making good use of gravity in the processing.
Such mills pre-dating to about 1850 may

In comparison to watermills, windmills have a

与水车相比，风车的存活率较低，这可能是因为

In the later nineteenth century, flour milling became
more industrial in scale, steam or electrically driven,
with new mills normally constructed by major
companies, usually associated with large granaries
at ports. Often designed with a measure of

在十九世纪后期，面粉加工在规模、蒸汽或电力驱动

Textile workshops
纺织车间
Before the introduction of the factory system (see
below), woollen, linen, silk and cotton manufacture
was carried out in houses, which increasingly from
the early eighteenth century (earlier in some
places) were specially adapted for the task. Cotton
and flax was best woven in damp conditions, in
basements; survivals in Lancashire and Yorkshire
are quite rare and may be identified by blocked
cellar windows. The most characteristic loomshops
for the other fabrics occupied the top floor of
houses and are marked by long rows of mullioned
windows; many survive in Yorkshire and the south-
west (for wool). Similar garret workshops are
associated with silk (they form a distinctive feature
in some Cheshire towns such as Macclesfield),
cotton (Derbyshire), hosiery (Leicestershire) and
lace (Nottinghamshire). Differences in plan and
construction differ according to the availability of
building materials and the nature of the product.
The development of larger machines necessitated
separate buildings (for instance, framework knitters’
workshops or frameshops which proliferated
在引进工厂制度之前(见下文) ，羊毛、亚麻、丝绸和
棉花的生产是在房子里进行的，从 18 世纪初(在一些
地方更早)开始，房子越来越多地被特别适应这项工
作。棉花和亚麻最好在潮湿的条件下编织，在地下
室; 兰开夏郡和约克郡的幸存者相当罕见，可以通过
堵塞的地下室窗户来识别。其他纺织品的最具特色的
织布车间占据了房子的顶层，并以一排排长长的带竖
框的窗户为标志; 许多织布车间在约克郡和西南部(为
了羊毛)幸存下来。类似的阁楼作坊与丝绸有关(它们
在一些柴郡城镇形成了区辨特征，如麦克莱斯菲尔

郡)。不同的计划和建筑根据建筑材料的可用性和产

(例如，框架编织车间或框架车间的激增
in the east midlands after the 1830s), as did

在 19 世纪 30 年代后的中东部地区) ，商业结构

Metal and other workshops
金属及其他车间
Factory-scale production came late or not at all to
some metal-making processes. As with textiles,
these activities were carried out in, behind or close
to the operative’s house. The reasons for the
survival of small-scale production are various. In the
jewellery trade (notably in Birmingham’s Jewellery
Quarter) this was because the production of a single
item might involve numerous processes carried out
in the workshops of different firms, and where
neighbourliness was essential when moving
valuable materials about. In contrast, nail making
was a low-skill, low-value activity that never justified
investment in factories although some nineteenth-
century nail masters accumulated sufficient capital
to build terraced houses with adjacent smitheries
that they hired out to tenant workers. These
examples indicate the extremes of metal workshop
organisation: the clock and watchmakers, furniture
makers, locksmiths, cutlery and edge-tool workers
and so forth were workshop-based for much

Drink and food processing
饮品及食品加工
A rapidly increasing population from the late
eighteenth century on, together with revolutions in
transport, led to major changes in the organisation
of the food and drink trades, to mechanisation in
processing, and transformations in the scale of
buildings. Consequently, many early buildings –
the predecessors of the giants of the later
nineteenth and twentieth centuries – have
disappeared
从十八世纪后期开始，人口迅速增长，加上交通运
输的革命，导致食品和饮料贸易的组织、加工的机
械化和建筑物规模的转变发生了重大变化。因此，
许多早期的建筑——十九世纪后期和二十世纪巨人
的前身——已经消失了
or been substantially altered or camouflaged.
Such buildings (for instance, eighteenth-century
maltings) are rare and will be serious candidates
for listing, even if substantially changed.
或者被大量改变或者伪装。这样的建筑(例如，18 世
纪的麦芽酒)非常罕见，即使经过实质性的改变，也
会成为上市的重要候选建筑。
Oast houses
Oast houses 奥斯特住宅
These are effectively drying kilns (see also the
Agricultural Buildings selection guide: most are
found on farm sites). The earliest date from the
mid-eighteenth century but most are nineteenth.
Oast houses are distinctive buildings in hop-
growing areas, notably the south-east and
Herefordshire. Plans vary: most have round
towers with a conical cowl, but some are square.
Very few survive in use and the majority have
been converted to dwellings with consequent loss
of internal features. However, if they remain
recognisable, they may still be listable, especially
pre-1850 examples.
这些都是有效的干燥窑(参见农业建筑选择指南: 大
多数是在农场地点)。最早可以追溯到 18 世纪中叶，
但大部分是 19 世纪。在啤酒花种植区，尤其是东
南部和赫里福德郡，奥斯特房屋是独特的建筑。建
筑规划各不相同: 大多数建筑都有带锥形罩的圆塔，
但也有一些是方形的。很少有人能在使用中幸存下
来，大多数已经被改造成住宅，随之而来的是内部
特征的丧失。然而，如果他们仍然可以辨认，他们
可能仍然可以列出，特别是 1850 年以前的例子。
Maltings
Maltings 麦芽糖
Maltings are recognizable by their cowls and
rows of small windows that ventilate rather than
light the shallow germinating floors. In
competition with mechanised pneumatic malting
from the late nineteenth century, floor maltings
are highly vulnerable, especially since the floor
heights make conversion difficult. Like oast
houses, but built on a much more industrial
scale, maltings can make a major contribution to
the landscape. Some in Lincolnshire are vast,
such as that at Sleaford (1892-1905; listed Grade
II*), and show industrial architecture at its most
monumental.
麦芽威士忌可以通过它们的头罩和一排排的小窗
户辨认出来，这些小窗户通风，而不是照亮浅浅
的发芽地板。在与 19 世纪末的机械化气动麦芽的
竞争中，地板麦芽是非常脆弱的，特别是因为地
板的高度使得转换变得困难。就像烘烤房屋一样，
但是建立在更加工业化的规模上，麦芽可以对景
观做出重大贡献。林肯郡的一些建筑规模巨大，
如斯利福德(Sleaford，1892-1905; 被列为二级建
筑 *) ，展示了其最具纪念意义的工业建筑。
Breweries
啤酒厂
Breweries grew rapidly in size from the eighteenth
century to meet increased demand and
accommodate changes in science and technology,
notably the introduction of steam engines and the
widespread use of metal equipment. While oast
houses continued to dry hops on the farm
自 18 世纪以来，啤酒厂的规模迅速扩大，以满足日
益增长的需求，并适应科学和技术的变化，特别是
蒸汽机的引进和金属设备的广泛使用。与此同时，烘
房继续在农场上种植啤酒花
in Kent, Herefordshire and elsewhere (Fig 12),
the nineteenth century saw the introduction of
mechanised mashing (1855), improvements
在肯特郡，赫里福德郡和其他地方(图 12) ，19
世纪见证了机械化捣碎(1855)的引进，改进

grist hopper, mash tun, and wort receiver, and a
wider range of functions – from malting to bottling

个建筑物内垂直整合工艺流程——”塔”，其中包

monumental in scale and architectural ambition
(especially during the construction boom of 1880-
1900), but many towns contained one or more that
were equally up-to-date, replete with tower, albeit
built on a smaller scale. Oxfordshire’s Hook Norton
brewery (1872; listed Grade II) exemplifies the
ornamental functionalism of such Victorian plants.

Food processing buildings
食品加工大楼
These survive in enormous numbers and the
nineteenth century in particular saw immense
changes in technology and scale, especially
following the spread of railways. This selection
guide cannot touch on them all and some sectors
have not been fully researched on the building
side. As with industrial buildings generally,
candidates for designation need to be assessed
within the context of their specific industry
这些建筑数量巨大，尤其是在 19 世纪，随着铁路

背景下进行评估
as well as with regard to the completeness of

instance, this would range from the collecting
depots at railheads in dairy country to wholesale
collecting points and bottling plants in cities
such as London; with meat production, the key

assumed an industrial scale (for instance, Frank

changes in these industries was the development of
refrigeration, used commercially from the 1850s but
on a massive scale after the invention of the

frozen food industry established by Clarence

as a distinct building type around 1900; sometimes
their cavernous interiors were given imposing
outward architectural treatment which can

20 世纪 20 年代早期建立的冷冻食品工业。1900 年

Engineering works and factories
工程及工厂
The difference between the terms ‘works’ and
‘factories’ is not a technical one but is adopted
here to make a useful distinction between
manufacturing and assembly plants that revolved
around the erecting shop and those that did not.
Although there is considerable overlap
“工厂”和“工厂”这两个术语之间的区别并不是
技术上的区别，而是用来区分围绕着安装车间运
转的制造厂和装配厂，以及那些没有围绕着安装
车间运转的制造厂和装配厂。尽管有相当大的重
叠
and a danger of over-simplification, railway
locomotive and carriage works and agricultural
engineering works fall into the first category,
motorcar and aircraft factories into the second.
The development of the ‘day-light factory’,
exemplified by the Bryant ans May Match Factory,
Garston, Liverpool, of 1919-21 by Mewes and
Davis (listed Grade II), can apply across
categories but generally applies to the latter.
而且有过于简单化的危险，铁路机车车辆工程和农
业工程工程属于第一类，汽车和飞机制造厂属于第
二类。“日光灯工厂”的发展，以 1919-1921 年
利物浦加斯顿的布莱恩特五月火柴工厂为例，由
Mewes 和 Davis (列为二级)设计，可以适用于不同
的类别，但通常适用于后者。
Railway and agricultural engineering works
铁路及农业工程
Both types of works have their own ‘pre-history’.
The first works for the manufacture and
maintenance of locomotives was built in South
Street, Newcastle (1823, for Robert Stephenson
and Co) but for much of the early nineteenth
century locomotives were ordered from
established engineering firms and carriages
from stagecoach manufacturers. From the mid
1840s the railway companies started to build
their own locomotives and rolling stock with the
consequent emergence of railway towns such
as Swindon (Wiltshire) and Crewe (Cheshire).
这两种工程都有自己的“前史”。第一批制造和
维修机车的工厂建在纽卡斯尔的南街(1823 年，
为罗伯特 · 史蒂芬逊和 Co) ，但在 19 世纪早期的
大部分时间里，机车是从知名的工程公司订购的，
车厢则是从驿站马车制造商订购的。从 19 世纪
40 年代中期开始，铁路公司开始建造自己的机车
和车辆，随后出现了斯温顿(威尔特郡)和克鲁(柴
郡)等铁路城镇。
In the agricultural sector, specialist foundries had
emerged by the 1790s for the production of
engines, wheels and castings, and workshops might
be arranged around a round house containing the
forge. By the 1840s, integrated sites were
constructing the components, assembling them on
site and erecting them in the erecting shop – an
aisled building with a central area
在农业部门，18 世纪 90 年代出现了生产发动机、车
轮和铸件的专业铸造厂，工厂可能被安排在一个容纳
铸造厂的圆屋周围。到了 19 世纪 40 年代，建筑工地
开始建造这些部件，在现场组装，然后将它们安装在
建筑车间里，这是一个带有中心区域的过道建筑
lit by a clerestorey that contained an overhead
travelling crane. This revolutionised flow line
provided comprehensive coverage for the entire
floor for lifting and moving the heaviest
components. The agricultural engineering
workshops – making traction and stationary
engines and all sorts of implements for the
domestic and world market - were concentrated in
the towns of the east of England: the Garrett
works in Leiston (Suffolk) with its 1853 ‘Long
Shop’ (listed Grade II*), remains a good example.
由一个天窗照明，其中包括一个高架起重机。这条
革命性的流水线为整个楼层提供了全面的覆盖面，
可以提升和移动最重的部件。农业工程车间——为
国内和世界市场制造牵引和固定发动机以及各种工
具——集中在英格兰东部的城镇: Garrett 工厂位于
莱斯顿(萨福克) ，其 1853 年的“ Long Shop”(列为
二级 *)仍然是一个很好的例子。
The erecting shop remained the dominant
engineering building, gaining in effectiveness with
more sophisticated crane technology. Survivals
prior to the general adoption of the erecting
workshop (pre-1850) and the earliest erecting
workshops themselves will be strong candidates
for listing if they survive reasonably intact; after
about 1850, rigorous selection should be made
on the basis of completeness of site, scale and
architectural interest. Early machinery will
strengthen the case for listing and may justify
安装车间仍然是主要的工程建筑，通过更先进的起
重机技术获得了成效。在普遍采用建造车间之前
(1850 年以前)和最早的建造车间之前，如果它们能
够相当完整地存活下来，那么它们将是列入名单的
有力候选者; 大约在 1850 年之后，应当根据场地、
规模和建筑兴趣的完整性进行严格的选择。早期的
机械设备将加强列入名单的理由，并可能证明其合
理性
a high grade. Many sites will contain forges and
pattern shops and other ancillary buildings such
as fettling shops and annealing ovens: these
are rare and strong candidates for protection.
高评级。许多遗址将包含锻造和模式商店和其他
辅助建筑，如细节商店和退火炉: 这些是罕见的
和强有力的候选保护。
Motorcar and aircraft factories
汽车和飞机制造厂
Both tended to occupy adapted premises, and often
switched production according to market demand,
for instance from cars to bicycles or cars to aircraft
in time of war. The earliest surviving purpose-built
car factory (and showroom) dates from 1900 (for
Dennis, at Guildford, Surrey; listed Grade II); the
earliest aircraft factories are dated 1909 (at
Leysdown, Kent, for Short Bros., and 1913 in
Kingston-upon-Thames, Surrey, for Sopwith
Aviation: listed Grade II). The building type of both
assumed the standard form of large, north-lit,
unobstructed sheds, which for aircraft are often
huge. The most distinguishing features are usually
the offices and showrooms where Art Deco,
stripped Classical or Moderne styles were
favoured: these are sometimes listed, as
两者都倾向于占据经过调整的场所，而且往往根据
市场需求转换生产，例如在战争时期从汽车转向自
行车或从汽车转向飞机。现存最早的专用汽车工厂
(和陈列室)可以追溯到 1900 年(为丹尼斯建造，位于
萨里郡吉尔福德; 列为二级) ; 最早的飞机工厂可以追
溯到 1909 年(位于肯特郡莱斯顿，代表短兄弟; 1913
年，位于萨里郡 Kingston-upon-Thames，代表
Sopwith 航空: 列为二级)。这两家公司的建筑类型都
采用了标准的大型、朝北的、通畅的棚屋形式，对
于飞机来说，这些棚屋通常都很大。最显著的特点
通常是办公室和陈列室的装饰艺术，剥离古典或现
代风格是最受欢迎的: 这些有时列出，如
is the de Havilland works of 1934 in Hatfield
(Hertfordshire) by Geoffrey Munro of J M Munro and
Son (listed Grade II). The large assembly plants
seldom are unless they have intrinsic architectural
or technical interest, as is the case with some inter-
war and post-war plants such as the American-
designed Cummins Engine Factory of 1964-5 in
Darlington (County Durham) by Roche and Dinkeloo
(listed Grade II*). Some factories can claim
historical importance, such as the former Hawker
factory in Kingston-upon-Thames of 1933 (Grade II)
wherein a number of important aircraft, above all the
Hurricane, were designed and produced. Often,
however, remarkable vehicles were produced in
unremarkable premises whose listing is unlikely to
be warranted.
是德哈维兰 1934 年在哈特菲尔德(赫特福德郡)的杰
弗里门罗的 j m 门罗和儿子(列为二级)。大型装配厂
很少是这样的，除非它们有内在的建筑或技术利益，
例如一些战时和战后的工厂，如美国设计的康明斯发

不起眼的厂房里生产的，而这些厂房的名单不太可能
被保证。

4.3 Storage and distribution
4.3 储存及分销
Warehouses
仓库
Merchants’ warehouses have served the wool,
cloth and other trades since the medieval period,
and were typically attached to merchants’ own
houses, with goods stored on one or more floors,
or within the basement or attic. By the eighteenth
century these might form distinct wings attached
to houses (as in Whitehaven, Cumbria). By the
mid-nineteenth century, purpose-built premises
were appearing in growing numbers. From 1839,
the palazzo-style, pioneered in Manchester,
formed a model for warehouses throughout the
country until the 1870s after which designers
drew on a rich diversity of styles. The introduction
of new facing materials such as faience and
terracotta in the late nineteenth century brought
自中世纪以来，商人的仓库一直服务于羊毛、布料
和其他贸易，通常附属于商人自己的房子，商品储
存在一个或多个楼层，或在地下室或阁楼。到了十
八世纪，它们可能会形成明显的翅膀附着在房子上
(如在怀特黑文，坎布里亚)。到了 19 世纪中期，
专门建造的房屋越来越多。从 1839 年开始，宫殿
风格在曼彻斯特首创，直到 19 世纪 70 年代，这种
风格一直是全国各地仓库的典范，之后，设计师们
利用了丰富多样的风格。19 世纪晚期，彩陶和陶
土等新面料的引入，带来了
about further change to warehouse appearance,
and the introduction of steel framing in the
Edwardian period increased the glazing area and
the size of buildings, enabling merchants to gain
maximum return from the plots. Warehouse plans
varied according to function. Bonded warehouses
are characterised by small windows and a
forbidding presence not unlike prisons. Other types
needed light as well as security. Heavier goods
tended to be stored on the lower floors whilst the
upper floors were used for inspection. Packing took
place in the basement, which, because of the
raised ground floor, could be lit by pavement-level
windows usually protected by iron grilles. Some
warehouses contained specialised equipment
according to the goods being handled: for instance,
in Manchester, where hydraulic presses
compressed cloth into airless
关于仓库外观的进一步改变，以及爱德华时期引入
的钢结构增加了玻璃面积和建筑物的大小，使商人
能够从地块中获得最大的回报。仓库计划根据功能
而变化。保税仓库的特点是小窗户和一个令人生畏
的存在不像监狱。其他类型需要光线以及安全。较
重的货物往往存放在较低的楼层，而较高的楼层则
用于检查。包装工作在地下室进行，由于地下一层
是抬高的，可以通过人行道上的窗户照明，窗户通
常由铁栅栏保护。一些仓库根据所处理的货物包含
专门的设备: 例如，在曼彻斯特，液压机将压缩的布
料压缩成不透气的

security. Most would have hoists and lifts, some

making-up, packing and dispatching goods) were
sometimes occupied by several firms: the chief
indicators of this are the numerous wagon

包，用于更安全的运输、长期储存和安全。大多
数都有起重机和升降机，有些是液压驱动的。包
装仓库(用于化妆、包装和发货)有时被几家公司占
用: 这方面的主要标志是众多的货车入口、装货区
和起重机。
Transit warehouses and depots
中转仓库和仓库
These, which provided short-term warehousing
– moving goods from long-haul to local transport
这些仓库提供短期仓储——将货物从长途运输转
移到当地运输
– are to be found lining canals and railways and
in every port. At their most ambitious they vie with
naval dockyards in scale: the London and North-
Western Railway depot at Camden (London)
opened in the early 1840s and by the 1880s
covered 14 acres; surviving elements from 1855-
70, including stabling yards, are listed Grade II.
The most sophisticated structures facilitated
interchange between road, canal and rail
transport: Camden is again a well-preserved
example; others exist in cities like Manchester
where the enormous Great Northern Railway
Company warehouse on Deansgate of 1885-96 is
listed Grade II* (Fig 14). Smaller, more modest
examples pre-dating 1914 may also be of special
interest, illustrating the former importance of
canals and railways for transporting general
goods now carried predominantly by road.
在运河、铁路和每个港口都能找到衬里。在他们最
雄心勃勃的竞争中，他们在规模上与海军造船厂竞
争: 伦敦和西北铁路站在卡姆登(伦敦)开放于 19 世
纪 40 年代初，到 19 世纪 80 年代占地 14 英亩; 从
1855 年至 70 年保存的元素，包括马厩码头，被列
为二级。最复杂的结构促进了公路、运河和铁路运
输之间的交流: 卡姆登再次是一个保存完好的例子;
其他的存在于像曼彻斯特这样的城市，1885 年至
1896 年在迪恩斯盖特的巨大的北方铁路公司仓库
被列为二级 * (图 14)。1914 年以前较小、较温和
的例子也可能具有特殊意义，说明运河和铁路以前
对于运输现在主要通过公路运输的一般货物的重要
性。
Warehouses of the later nineteenth century often
employed the latest building technology, mainly
developed for fireproofed textile mills, such as
iron and later steel and concrete construction.
Often they were also designed to impress, and
many are grand and architecturally
distinguished. Technical and architectural
interest will often combine in a single building. In
addition, groups of warehouses together can
create urban environments of enormous
character
19 世纪后期的仓库通常采用最新的建筑技术，主
要用于防火纺织厂，如钢铁和后来的钢铁和混凝
土建筑。它们往往也是为了给人留下深刻印象而
设计的，许多都是宏伟壮观，建筑风格独特的。
技术和建筑的兴趣通常会在一个建筑中结合在一
起。此外，仓库群组在一起可以创造巨大的城市
特色环境
and importance: in cities such as Manchester,
Liverpool, Leicester, Nottingham, Lancaster and
London they comprise some of the most
memorable reminders of the Industrial Revolution
(Fig 15).
重要性: 在曼彻斯特、利物浦、莱斯特、诺丁汉、
兰卡斯特和伦敦等城市，它们构成了工业革命最
令人难忘的纪念物(图 15)。
Figure 15
图 15
Towns, such as Nottingham, Leeds, and pre-eminently
Manchester, were at the cutting edge of construction
techniques to create ever more specialised
warehouses for their goods. Manchester’s Canada
House of 1909 was designed by W G Higginbottom
employing a cast-iron frame with steel trussed roof to
take great weight whilst allowing maximum daylight.
Now successfully converted to offices. Listed Grade II.
诺丁汉(Nottingham)、利兹(Leeds)和主要的曼彻斯特
(Manchester)等城镇，都处于建筑技术的前沿，为自己
的商品建造了越来越专业化的仓库。曼彻斯特 1909 年
的加拿大住宅是由 w g Higginbottom 设计的，采用了铸
铁框架和钢桁架屋顶，承受了很大的重量，同时允许最
大限度的日光。现在成功地改造成了办公室。表列二级。

5.4 Regional studies
5.4 区域研究
Between 1965 and 1980 a series of regional guides
was published by David and Charles and then
Batsford, generally with titles in the format of The
Industrial Archaeology of … These remain useful as
starting points and for context.
从 1965 年到 1980 年，大卫和查尔斯先后出版了一系
列地区指南，通常以《工业考古学... 》的形式出版，
这些作为起点和背景仍然有用。
The Association for Industrial Archaeology has
produced regional and county gazetteers in connection
with its annual conference each year for over 20 years.
20 多年来，工业考古学协会每年都会召开年度会议，
并制作地区和县级地名录。

Industrial Sites
工业用地
Scheduling Selection Guide
日程安排选择指南
Summary
摘要
Historic England’s scheduling selection guides help to define which archaeological
sites are likely to meet the relevant tests for national designation and be included on
the National Heritage List for England. For archaeological sites and monuments, they
are divided into categories ranging from Agriculture to Utilities and complement the
listing selection guides for buildings. Scheduling is applied only to sites of national
importance, and even then only if it is the best means of protection. Only deliberately
created structures, features and remains can be scheduled. The scheduling selection
guides are supplemented by the Introductions to Heritage Assets which provide more
detailed considerations of specific archaeological sites and monuments.
英格兰历史文化遗产选择指南有助于确定哪些考古遗址有可能通过国家认定的相关测试，
并被列入英格兰国家遗产名录。对于考古遗址和古迹，它们被分为从农业到公用事业和
建筑物的补充类别。日程安排只适用于具有国家重要性的网站，即便如此，也只有在它
是最佳保护手段的情况下才适用。只有故意创建的结构、特征和遗迹才能被安排。时间
安排选择指南补充了对具体考古遗址和古迹的更详细的考虑。
This selection guide offers a broad overview of the range of industrial sites which may be
deemed to have national importance, and outlines the criteria used when assessing such
for scheduling. It aims to do two things: to set these within their historical context, and to
give an introduction to the designation approaches employed.
本选择指南概述了可能被视为具有国家重要性的工业场址的范围，并概述了在评估这些场址
的时间安排时所使用的标准。它的目的是做两件事情:在历史背景下设置这些，并介绍所采
用的指定方法。
This document has been prepared by Listing Group. It is one is of a
series of 18 documents. This edition published by Historic England
July 2018. All images © Historic England unless otherwise stated.
此文档由 listinggroup 编写。它是由 18 个文件组成的系列之一。2018
年 7 月由英格兰历史出版社出版。除非另有说明，否则所有图片均为历
史上的英格兰。

Introduction
引言
This selection guide offers a broad overview of the range of industrial sites which may be
deemed to have national importance, and outlines the criteria used when assessing such
for scheduling. Only the principal industries are treated, although the approaches and
criteria outlined are generally applicable. Reference should also be made to the separate
Industrial Buildings listing selection guide. Other related selection guides include
Transport listing and scheduling, Maritime and Naval listing and scheduling, and Military
listing and scheduling Pre-1500 and Post-1500 selection guides.
本选择指南概述了可能被视为具有国家重要性的工业场址的范围，并概述了在评估这些场
址的时间安排时所使用的标准。虽然概述的方法和标准一般适用，但只处理主要产业。此
外，亦应参考。其他相关的选择指南包括和，和，以及时间安排和选择指南。
The historic industrial environment is now
recognised as being more than just the relics of
the Industrial Revolution. The impact of early,
even prehistoric, industry within the landscape
may have softened and become less starkly
obvious, but it nevertheless remains legible and
can possess great archaeological potential for
enhancing our understanding of past lives and
industrial activity. Industrialisation was a key
theme of social and economic history, above all
in the last three centuries, and archaeology has
a key role to play in its recovery. Many industrial
sites and monuments are of national importance,
and several are inscribed as World Heritage
Sites because of their international significance.
历史上的工业环境现在被认为不仅仅是工业革命
的遗迹。早期，甚至是史前时期，工业对景观的
影响可能已经软化，变得不那么明显，但它仍然
清晰可辨，并具有巨大的考古潜力，可以加强我
们对过去生活和工业活动的了解。工业化是社会
和经济历史的一个关键主题，尤其是在过去的三
个世纪，考古学在其恢复过程中扮演着关键角色。
许多工业遗址和纪念碑具有国家重要性，有几处
因其国际意义而被列为世界遗产。
Immense changes in industry and
manufacturing in the second half of the
twentieth century have had a significant impact
on the survival of our industrial heritage.
Traditional industry based on the extraction of
metal ores and coal, the production and
working of iron, steel and other metals, as well
as the manufacture of textiles, has virtually
disappeared. The landscapes that these
industries and their infrastructures created
have been subject to inevitable processes of
clearance, decontamination and reclamation,
and not always with the fullest regard to sites’
heritage values.
20 世纪下半叶工业和制造业的巨大变化对我们
工业遗产的生存产生了重大影响。以开采金属矿
石和煤、生产和加工铁、钢和其他金属以及纺织
品为基础的传统工业几乎已经消失。这些工业及
其基础设施所创造的景观不可避免地要经过清理、
净化和填海的过程，而且并非总是充分考虑到遗
址的遗产价值。
Where industries have survived, they have often
radically changed their processes, and hence their
physical form within the landscape. The industries
that came to typify the twentieth century – such as
car manufacture, the petro-chemical industry, and
power generation – have also witnessed wholesale
reorganisation, contraction or concentration. The
scale and thoroughness of industrial site-clearances
in recent years has often left less evidence behind
than is the case on older abandoned sites.
在工业存活下来的地方，它们经常从根本上改变它们
的过程，因此也改变了它们在环境中的物理形态。20
世纪的典型产业，如汽车制造业、石油化工业和发电
业，也经历了大规模的重组、收缩或集中。近年来，
工业场地清理工作的规模和彻底性，往往留下的证据
不如旧废弃场地的证据多。
Some former industrial landscapes, especially in
upland areas, have become recognised as
positive assets, not least for the tourist industry.
Many so-called ‘natural’ landscapes, as in
Derbyshire or Cornwall, are the result of centuries
of industrial exploitation, and their rugged
terrain is admired, even if its origins are
unappreciated by many visitors. The clay tips of
Cornwall are known as the ‘Cornish Alps’ and
have a significant landscape value, alongside
the Cornish Mining World Heritage Site.
Industry can contribute profoundly to the
character of an area, and the identification and
protection of its key components through
designation plays a significant role in the
safeguarding of these qualities.
一些以前的工业景观，特别是在高地地区，已经
成为公认的积极资产，尤其是对旅游业。许多所
谓的“自然”景观，如在德比郡或康沃尔，是几个
世纪的工业开发的结果，他们的崎岖地形是令人
赞叹的，即使它的起源很多游客不欣赏。康沃尔
郡的粘土尖端被称为康沃尔阿尔卑斯山，与康沃
尔矿业世界遗产一起具有重要的景观价值。工业
可以对一个地区的特征作出深刻的贡献，通过指
定来识别和保护其关键组成部分在保障这些特征
方面起着重要作用。

1 历史摘要
1.1 Prehistoric and Roman Periods
1.1 史前和罗马时期
The earliest industries that have left evidence of
substantial production for trade, rather than just for
local domestic use, are flint mines and axe factories.
Axes of special quality stone were highly-prized,
being traded far and wide; often the sites of their
origin are known. For example, stone from the
Langdale Pikes in Cumbria was roughly fashioned

往往是已知的。例如，来自坎布里亚 LangdalePikes

1.2 Anglo-Saxon and Viking
1.2 盎格鲁撒克逊人和维京人
Industrial production generally seems to have
continued on a much-diminished scale – if at all –
following the formal severance of links with the
Roman Empire in the early fifth century, and
sometimes for many centuries thereafter. In the
archaeological record this is seen most
dramatically with pottery, where industrial-scale
production only began again on a limited scale in
the mid-seventh century with Ipswich ware (made
on a slow turntable), and more widely in the ninth
century when industries, like that producing
Stamford ware, re-introduced the potter’s wheel.
在公元五世纪早期与罗马帝国正式断绝关系之后，
有时在此之后的许多世纪里，工业生产似乎继续大
幅度减少。在考古记录中，这种现象在陶器上最为
引人注目。在七世纪中叶，伊普斯维奇陶器(在一
个缓慢的转盘上制造)才开始了有限规模的工业化
生产，而在九世纪，更为广泛的工业化生产，比如
生产斯坦福陶器的工业，又重新引入了陶轮。
Most manufacturing in this period falls more
under the heading of ‘craft’ rather than ‘industry’,
although that is not to underplay, for instance,
the immense skills which some metalworkers
possessed, or the overall scale of
这一时期的大多数制造业更多地属于手工业，而
不是工业，尽管这并不是低估，例如，一些金属
工人拥有的巨大技能，或总体规模
textile production on home looms. It must also
be remembered how important wood was to
Anglo-Saxon society, and how skilled
carpenters were: six sets of carpenters’ tools
(the fullest from Flixborough, Lincolnshire)
demonstrate the woodworking tasks that could
be undertaken, whether to build houses, boats,
furniture or musical instruments.
家用织机纺织品制造。还必须记住，木材对盎格
鲁-撒克逊社会有多么重要，木匠有多么熟练:6
套木匠工具(最完整的来自林肯郡弗利克斯伯勒)
展示了可以承担的木工任务，无论是建造房屋、
船只、家具还是乐器。
Few buildings – mainly major ecclesiastical

spate of church building in the tenth century.
Roman stone buildings were widely scavenged for

some new quarries were open, and a few at least
were relatively deep as evidenced by the good
quality of stone found in some churches.

Assessment of industrial activity in a period with
only limited documentation is almost wholly reliant
on archaeological evidence. The increasing number
of finds from metal detecting is providing
在一个文献资料有限的时期，对工业活动的评估几乎

a much expanded data-set, but more important is
information from the still relatively small number of
identified sites where raw materials were won, or
goods made. In some hands, iron working was a
highly skilled and technical business, with smiths
(whom written sources indicate had close links with
kings and lords because of what appeared to be
their near-magical abilities) making steel-edged and
pattern-welded blades as well as more mundane
agricultural and domestic ironwork. Workshops
seem to have been essentially one-man operations,
typically in settlements close to patrons and
customers. Just one set of smithing tools has been
found, in a seventh-century grave at Tattershall
Thorpe (Lincolnshire).
数据集得到了很大的扩展，但更重要的是来自相对较
少的已确定的原材料或商品生产地点的信息。在一些
人看来，炼铁是一门技艺高超、技术精湛的行业，铁
匠(书面资料显示，他们与国王和领主关系密切，因
为他们似乎拥有近乎神奇的能力)制造钢刃和模板焊
接的刀片，以及更为普通的农业和家庭炼铁作品。车
间看起来基本上是一个人的业务，通常在靠近顾客和
顾客的定居点。只有一套锻造工具已经被发现，在一
个七世纪的坟墓在 TattershallThorpe(林肯郡)。
The working of non-ferrous metals, principally
bronze, seems again to have been small-scale, with
scrap being melted and recast into buckles and
brooches, just as waste glass was reworked into a
limited number of beads and vessel types.
Renowned finds of highly prestigious metalwork, as
at Sutton Hoo’s early seventh-century ship burial in
Suffolk, show the height of attainment of such
craftsmen, as well as how international the trade
was in materials and objects of high prestige.
有色金属(主要是青铜)的加工似乎也是小规模的，废
料被熔化和重铸成带扣和胸针，就像废玻璃被重新加
工成数量有限的珠子和容器类型一样。在萨顿胡
(SuttonHoo)于 7 世纪早期在萨福克郡(Suffolk)举行的
船葬上，人们发现了享有盛誉的金属制品。这些著名
的发现表明了这些工匠的技艺达到了顶峰，同时也表
明了这一贸易是如何走向国际化的，所用。
1.3 Medieval
1.3 中世纪
The traditional, and still probably broadly correct,
view is that industrial activity increased with

种观点可能仍然大体上是正确的
the arrival from the Continent of the reforming

Cistercians, for example, exploited lead ores where
these were found within their grants and were also
skilled in the iron industry (Fig 5). Monastic
bloomeries (small, low-temperature furnaces for
producing non-molten iron from ore) are known
from documentary sources to have been abundant
and spread across the country but physical remains
of such are comparatively rare,
十二世纪改革修道院秩序从欧洲大陆的到来。例如，
西斯特尔人在他们的补助金范围内开采铅矿，他们在

并且通常从他们的矿渣中鉴别出来。
Blast furnaces (higher temperature furnaces

Continent in the last years of the fifteenth century,
and after the Dissolution of the Monasteries (1536-
1541) the secular owners of former monastic
estates were to take full advantage of this leap in
technology. Monastic sites also display evidence for
some larger-scale use of water power for grinding
corn and other processes such as fulling (the
beating of woven wool to clean and thicken it), as at
Halesowen Abbey (West Midlands) (see Mills IHA).
There were also many secular mills, generally
associated with manorial sites such as the example
at Kirkby Knowle (North Yorkshire). Mills were
typically rebuilt on the same or adjacent sites many
times over the centuries, and many mills used for
industrial processes in the eighteenth and
nineteenth centuries stood on the sites of medieval
predecessors, the remains of which were thereby
often built over. Throughout history, the repeated
use of rivers and even streams for industrial
production means that many industrial landscapes
are strongly linear.
在 15 世纪的最后几年，从欧洲大陆引进了高炉(生产
铁水的高温熔炉)，在解散修道院风波之后(1536-

邻的地方重建多次，而在 18 世纪和 19 世纪，许多用

Though there is evidence for the use of coal from

1.4 1550-1700
1.41550-1700
This period can be seen as the prelude to the
Industrial Revolution, with many industries
expanding dramatically in scale. The later sixteenth
century witnessed profound changes in the
organisation of industry. The Dissolution of the
Monasteries led to a hiatus in many industrial
concerns, but also led to a release of wealth that
prompted the expansion of various secular-owned
businesses, some benefiting from monopolies and
privileges granted by the Crown. For example the
Chartered Companies – the Society of Mines Royal
and the Company of Mineral and Battery Works –
had privileges covering large areas of
这一时期可以看作是工业革命的前奏，许多行业的规
模急剧扩大。十六世纪后期，工业组织发生了深刻的
变化。解散修道院风波导致了许多工业问题的中断，
但也导致了财富的释放，促进了各种世俗所有企业的
扩张，其中一些企业受益于国王授予的垄断和特权。
例如，特许公司——皇家矿业协会和矿产和电池工厂
公司——拥有覆盖广大地区的特权
land, processing and manufacturing techniques
and trade covering a range of non-ferrous metals.
These joint-stock companies, funded by the
private investment of shareholders, imported
mining, smelting and manufacturing expertise
from central Europe and introduced larger scale
industrial enterprises based on the extensive use
of water power for dressing (that is, ore
processing) and smelting.
土地、加工和制造技术及贸易，涵盖一系列有色
金属。这些股份制公司由股东的私人投资提供资
金，从中欧引进采矿、冶炼和制造业的专门知识，
并在广泛使用水力进行选矿(即矿石加工)和冶炼的
基础上引进了规模较大的工业企业。
Underground blasting with gun powder was in
use by the late seventeenth century, as
evidenced at the copper and lead mines at Ecton
(Staffordshire). The production of copper and, at
the very end of the period, its alloy brass, also
greatly increased. Similarly, monopolies were
sold by the Crown to cover the production of
products such as alum and copperas, which were
used to process wool and were to become the
foundation of the early chemical industry.
17 世纪晚期，地下火药爆破开始使用，埃克顿(斯
塔福德郡)的铜矿和铅矿就是明证。铜的生产，以
及在这一时期的末期，其合金黄铜的生产，也大大
增加。同样，王国政府出售垄断企业，以涵盖明矾
和铜等产品的生产，这些产品被用来加工羊毛，并
成为早期化学工业的基础。
The iron industry also saw significant
development with the late medieval introduction
of charcoal-fired blast furnaces in the Weald
leading to a rapid take up of this technology
throughout the country with some 70 furnaces in
blast by 1580. A number of early blast furnaces
are scheduled, of which Rockley Old Furnace
(South Yorkshire), built about 1700, is one of the
finest surviving examples; Charlcott (Shropshire;
Fig 6) is another.
随着中世纪晚期木炭燃烧高炉在 Weald的引入，
到 1580 年，全国大约有 70 座高炉投入使用，铁
工业也得到了长足的发展。一些早期的高炉被列
入计划，其中建于 1700 年左右的洛克利老炉(南
约克郡)是现存最好的例子之一，查尔科特(什罗
普郡，图 6)是另一个。
Blast furnaces did not completely supplant the
use of bloomeries, as the former produced a
brittle cast-iron which required conversion in a
forge to become as malleable as the wrought
iron produced in bloomeries. Later bloomeries
typically employed water-powered bellows,
initially developed in the fourteenth century.
Though forges on bloomery sites had produced
limited quantities of steel for centuries, the
introduction of the cementation furnace (where
iron was reheated mixed with charcoal) from
1614 resulted in a great increase in production of
steel for the edge-tool industry.
高炉并没有完全取代灯笼的使用，因为前者生产
出一种易碎的铸铁，需要在锻造中加以转化，才
能变得像灯笼制造的锻铁一样具有可锻性。晚熟
的花卉通常采用水力风箱，最初开发于十四世纪。
虽然几个世纪以来，在炼钢厂的熔炉生产的钢数
量有限，但从 1614 年开始引进渗碳炉(将铁与木
炭重新加热)，导致刃具工业的钢产量大幅度增加。
The coal industry was very small in scale in the
medieval period, being far less significant than
other mining industries. By the sixteenth century

16 世纪 60 年代，英国大陆玻璃制造商的到来导

1.5 1700-1840
1.51700-1840
The eighteenth century witnessed the
transformation of Britain’s economy. Although the
timing and origins of the Industrial Revolution are
complex and the subject of debate – it is now seen
as a longer, less dramatic process than was
formerly thought – the effects are clear. During the
period England’s population more than doubled, and
its distribution had started to shift north.
十八世纪见证了英国经济的转型。虽然工业革命的时
间和起源是复杂的，也是辩论的主题——现在人们认
为这是一个比以前认为的更长、更不引人注目的过程
——但其影响是明显的。在此期间，英格兰的人口增
加了一倍多，其分布也开始向北移动。
The Industrial Revolution was stimulated by the
expansion of trade in the eighteenth century and
by a series of discoveries, inventions and
developments that were to transform industry and
the landscape over the next hundred years.
18 世纪贸易的扩大和一系列的发现、发明和发展
推动了工业革命，这些发现、发明和发展在今后一
百年中改变了工业和景观。
Notable amongst these are the smelting of iron by
coke, the puddling of iron (an improved method of
converting cast into wrought iron), the development
of the steam engine, and the invention of textile
machinery, initially powered by water. This was
accompanied by significant advances in ways of
working, such as the emergence of the factory
system: the systematised approach to production
bringing together multiple processes on the same
site. Coupled with this was the ongoing transport
revolution with the development of commercial
docks, an extensive turnpike road network and the
canal system. It is important to bear in mind that
traditional, craft and domestic industries prospered
alongside, and indeed were symbiotic with, the new
power-driven
其中值得注意的是焦炭冶炼铁、搅炼铁(一种改进的
将铸铁转化为锻铁的方法)、蒸汽机的发展，以及最
初由水提供动力的纺织机械的发明。与此同时，工作
方式也取得了重大进展，例如工厂制度的出现:系统
化的生产方式将同一地点的多个工序结合在一起。伴
随着商业码头的发展，广泛的收费公路网和运河系统，
正在进行的运输革命也随之而来。重要的是要记住，

industries of the Industrial Revolution: factory
scale production did not command a monopoly of
industrial output, and only started to dominate at
the end of the period.
工业革命时期的工业:工厂规模生产并没有垄断工
业产出，只是在这一时期结束时才开始占主导地位。
In 1709 Abraham Darby successfully smelted
iron without charcoal, using coke instead (coal
processed to remove impurities). This first
coke-fuelled blast furnace survives in
Coalbrookdale, a valley spur off the Ironbridge
Gorge (Shropshire) and is scheduled: the first
marker of the freeing of iron production from
the limitations of charcoal supply. Although
clusters of charcoal blast furnaces in areas like
Cumbria continued to produce high quality iron,
the use of coke allowed a great expansion, with
numbers of furnaces expanding to over 170 by
1800, with pig-iron output rising from 30,000
tons to almost 250,000 tons.
1709 年，亚伯拉罕·达比成功地在没有木炭的情
况下用焦炭(用煤去除杂质)冶炼铁。这是第一座
以焦炭为燃料的高炉，现存于 Coalbrookdale，
一座位于希罗普郡铁桥谷外的山谷支线，预计将
成为铁矿石生产摆脱木炭供应限制的第一个标志。
尽管像坎布里亚这样的地区，成群的木炭高炉继
续生产高质量的铁，但是焦炭的使用使得高炉的
数量大大增加，到 1800 年，高炉的数量已经超
过了 170 个，生铁的产量从 30,000 吨增加到将
近 250,000 吨。
By the end of the period, England had become an
exporter of iron for the first time. Ironically, the
main survivals from this period are charcoal
furnaces as most of the early generation of coke
furnaces were obliterated by later developments
on their sites, an exception being the scheduled
Bedlam furnaces in the Ironbridge Gorge itself.
The final break in the industry’s dependence on
woodlands occurred in 1783-1784: Henry Cort
discovered how to convert cast pig-iron into
wrought iron without the use of charcoal by using
a reverberatory furnace where burning coal was
kept separate from the iron. In this process,
known as puddling, melting pig-iron was stirred to
produce malleable iron that could then be rolled
into sheets.
到这一时期结束时，英国第一次成为铁出口国。具
有讽刺意味的是，这一时期的主要幸存者是木炭炉，
因为大多数早期的炼焦炉都被后来在其所在地的发
展所毁灭，唯一的例外是在铁桥谷本身预定的贝德
拉姆炼焦炉。工业对林地的依赖的最后一次突破发
生在 1783-1784 年:HenryCort 发现了如何使用反
射炉将生铁转化成熟铁，而不需要使用木炭。在这
个被称为搅炼的过程中，将熔化的生铁搅拌成可锻
铸铁，然后将其轧成薄片。
The eighteenth century also saw an expansion in
steel production with cementation furnaces (where
iron bars were reheated packed in charcoal dust)
such as the scheduled example at Derwentcote
(Tyne and Wear), and the perfection of Benjamin
Huntsman’s Process in 1740 (producing high
quality cast steel using crucible furnaces). The
latter sparked the development of Sheffield’s steel
and edge tool industries; although crucible
furnaces of this period are only thought to survive
archaeologically, scheduled standing examples
are later in date.
18 世纪，钢铁生产也随着渗碳炉(用木炭粉重新加
热铁棒)的发展而扩大，例如在
Derwentcote(TyneandWear)的预定例子，以及
1740 年本杰明·亨茨曼(BenjaminHuntsman)工艺的
完善(用坩埚炉生产高质量的铸钢)。后者促进了谢
菲尔德钢铁和刃具工业的发展;虽然这个时期的坩埚
炉只被认为是考古学上存活下来的，但计划中的现
存的样品是后来的。

The eighteenth century saw many experiments
and refinements of metallurgical processes:

Fed by the expansion of iron and steel production
was an expansion of forges and foundries
converting the raw metal into an ever-increasing
range of products for both domestic and export
markets. Although some were closely associated
with blast furnaces such as Coalbrookdale,
others, such as the forges and rolling mills at
Wortley near Sheffield, were separate concerns.
By the closing years of the eighteenth century
specialist foundries producing steam engines and
other machinery were being established. Notable
amongst these were Boulton and Watt’s Soho
Foundry at Smethwick in the West Midlands and
Mathew Murray’s Round Foundry in Leeds (West
Yorkshire). Within a few years, numerous other
foundries followed with Peel William’s Phoenix
and Soho Foundries in Manchester, while in
Cornwall the Perran and partly scheduled Hayle

wholesale clearance of most of these sites, the
archaeological investigation of surviving buildings
and surrounding of the Round Foundry in Leeds,
of Boulton and Watt’s Soho Foundry, and of the
Perran Foundry is demonstrating their
archaeological potential.
由于钢铁生产的扩大，锻造厂和铸造厂扩大了生产

The glass industry maintained its progress with the

The salt industry shifted its focus at this time.
Coastal salt-making became relatively less
important as firstly inland brine reserves were
exploited and then, somewhat later, rock salt.
Both these required fuel to raise and/or process,
favouring those reserves close to coal-fields or
good transport.
盐业在这个时候转移了它的焦点。随着内陆卤水

All this activity and the revolution in transport

In some places coal was coming to have a price

艾伦代尔地区，在相当长的时间内(1692-1896 年)
仍然在使用中，经历了许多改造(既是为了铅，现
在已成为预定的废墟)。铜冶炼更为复杂，因为它
的化学性质:只有很少的地方存活下来，所以即使
是那些只有渣堆的地方也可能值得指定。18 世纪，
相关的黄铜工业在布里斯托尔周围扩张，包括威
廉姆·钱皮恩在 Warmley 的黄铜工厂(建于 1743 年，
现在已经排定)。
The textile industry has fared somewhat better in
terms of surviving structures, the designation of
which is discussed in the Industrial Buildings
listing selection guide. The landscape settings of
the mills and especially their water management
systems are of archaeological interest, while the
buried remains of early water supply systems
纺织工业在幸存结构方面的表现要好一些，其名
称将在。考古学家对磨坊的景观环境，尤其是水
管理系统感兴趣，而早期供水系统的埋藏遗迹
< < Contents 12
目录 12
and steam-driven mills are of considerable
archaeological potential. The recent excavation,
for example, of several such sites in the Ancoats
area of Manchester has greatly added to our
understanding of the transition from water to
steam power. Sites are known in the Pennines
where steam and water power worked together
to drive machinery, or where steam was used to
pump water up to mill ponds. Haarlem Mill,
Wirksworth (Derbyshire) is the earliest mill
known in England designed from the outset to
house a steam engine, probably to pump water.
蒸汽驱动的磨坊在考古学上具有相当大的潜力。
例如，最近在曼彻斯特的 Ancoats 地区发掘的几
个这样的遗址，极大地增加了我们对从水到蒸汽
动力过渡的理解。在奔宁山脉，蒸汽和水力一起
驱动机器，或者蒸汽被用来把水泵到磨坊池塘，
这些地方都是有名的。HaarlemMill，沃克斯沃思
(德比郡)是英国已知的最早的磨坊，从一开始就设
计用来容纳蒸汽机，可能是用来抽水的。
Bristol and its environs was also a focus of an
increase in the gunpowder industry with a new
group of mills established by the 1720s including
the scheduled Littleton Works (North Somerset).
Previously the industry had served a purely
military market with mills clustered in and around
London from the mid-sixteenth century, but
布里斯托尔及其周边地区也是火药工业发展的重点，
18 世纪 20 年代建立了一批新工厂，其中包括利特
尔顿工厂(NorthSomerset)。在此之前，这个行业
曾是一个纯粹的军事市场，从十六世纪中期开始，
伦敦及其周边地区就有大量的工厂，但是
from the late seventeenth century gunpowder
found a new use in mining. The combination of
good charcoal supplies and a ready market for
explosives saw the industry spread to the Lake
District in the 1760s where a number of sites
are now scheduled.
从十七世纪晚期开始，火药在采矿业中有了新的
用途。18 世纪 60 年代，良好的木炭供应和现成
的爆炸物市场促使这一行业扩展到湖区，现在已
经安排了一些地点。
1.6 1840-1914
1.61840-1914
For much of this period Britain was the ‘workshop of
the world’. There was a spectacular increase in
production in all sectors: some in terms of scale
(such as larger blast furnaces (Fig 7) and factories
with greatly increased outputs), but also in terms of
range (with a great multiplication of small scale
specialist workshops and businesses). Cheap steel,
an ever-expanding range of machine tools

在这一时期的大部分时间里，英国都是世界工厂。所

The significant improvements in transport (for
which see the Infrastucture: Transport listing
selection guide), particularly the development of
the railways, fuelled this increase in production
by opening up new markets and reducing the
transport costs of raw materials. Improved
transport also allowed the spread of
industrialisation into new areas of the country,
completing the transformation of the nation’s
former agrarian economy into one based on
industry (Fig 8). And, as first recorded in the
1851 census, this was the period when Britain
became an urban nation.
运输方面的重大改进(见列表选择指南)，特别是
铁路的发展，通过开拓新的市场和降低原材料的
运输成本，推动了生产的增加。交通的改善也使
得工业化扩展到国家的新地区，完成了从农业经
济到工业经济的转变(图 8)。而且，根据 1851 年
人口普查的记录，这是英国成为一个城市国家的
时期。
Most of this expansion of industry was based

the result of increased capital investment in long

到 1913 年该行业达到顶峰时的 1.7 亿吨。这种扩

The pottery industry, building on the technological
achievements of the eighteenth century, now
became the largest supplier of ceramics in the
world. Much of the industry was concentrated
around Stoke-on-Trent which became famous for
its distinctive landscape of pot-works with
thousands of bottle-shaped kilns, although this
did not entirely supplant many smaller local
potteries such as the steam-powered Wetheriggs
Pottery (Cumbria), opened in 1860 and now
partially scheduled but still operating. The period
also saw the expansion of the architectural
ceramics industry pioneered in London by
Eleanor Coade from 1769, which culminated in
the Doulton works in Lambeth. There were also
major centres of glass and ceramic production in
the north-east, in Yorkshire and in Lancashire.
建立在十八世纪技术成就基础上的陶瓷工业，现在
成为世界上最大的陶瓷供应商。这个行业的大部分
都集中在特伦特河畔斯托克，这里因其独特的盆景
而闻名，有成千上万的瓶形窑，尽管这并没有完全
取代许多较小的本地陶器，例如蒸汽动力的坎布里
亚 WetheriggsPottery(1860 年开业，现已部分投
入使用，但仍在运营。这一时期也见证了埃莉
诺·科德从 1769 年开创的伦敦建筑陶瓷工业的扩
张，最终在兰贝斯的 Doulton 工厂达到顶峰。在
英国东北部，约克郡和兰开夏郡也有主要的玻璃
和陶瓷生产中心。
The shift in salt production to inland sites
was accentuated by this time and the salt
reserves around Northwich (Cheshire)
became the main focus of the industry (Fig
12). Gunpowder production became
concentrated
盐生产向内陆地区转移的趋势因此而加剧，

焦点(图 12)。火药生产变得集中起来

leading the way in technology, but towards

where isolated working and stringent safety

用途。许多这种新型爆炸物是在现有的火药
场生产的，那里已经实行了孤立的工作和严
格的安全程序。
Many industries of the period, and for that after
1914, are well represented by standing buildings
which are now generally designated via listing
rather than scheduling. Consequently the
Industrial Buildings listing selection guide
should be referred to for nineteenth-century
and later textile mills, breweries and other
structures of the food and drink industry such
as corn mills, as well as for many
manufacturing industries based in workshops
and factories. However, scheduling may remain
appropriate in some cases, particularly where
vulnerable archaeological deposits remain.
那个时期的许多行业，以及 1914 年以后的行业，
很好地代表了现在通常通过列表而不是时间表来
指定的常设建筑。因此，对于十九世纪及以后的

2 Overarching
Considerations

2.1 Scheduling and protection
2.1 计划和保护
Archaeological sites and monuments vary greatly
in character, and can be protected in many ways:
through positive management by owners, through
policy, and through designation. In terms of
考古遗址和遗迹在性质上差异很大，可以通过多种
方式加以保护:通过业主的积极管理、通过政策和
通过指定。在这方面
our designation system, this consists of several
separate approaches which operate alongside
each other, and our aim is to recommend the
most appropriate sort of protection for each asset.
Our approach towards designation will vary,
depending on the asset in question: our selection
guides aim to indicate our broad approaches, but
are subordinate to Department for Digital, Culture,
Media and Sport (DCMS) policy.
我们的指定系统，这包括几个独立的方法，并行运
作，我们的目标是建议最适当的保护，为每项资产。
根据所涉资产的不同，我们的指定方法也会有所不
同:我们的选择指南旨在指出我们的广泛方法，但
从属于政策。
Scheduling, through triggering careful control and
the involvement of Historic England, ensures that
the long-term interests of a site are placed first. It
is warranted for sites with real claims to national
importance which are the most significant
remains in terms of their key place in telling our
national story, and the need for close
management of their archaeological potential.
Scheduled monuments possess a high order of
significance: they derive this from their
archaeological and historic interest. Our
selection guides aim to indicate some of the
grounds of importance which may be relevant.
Unlike listed buildings, scheduled sites are not
generally suited to adaptive re-use.
时间安排，通过引发审慎的控制和历史英格兰的
参与，确保了一个地点的长期利益放在第一位。
对于那些真正声称具有国家重要性的遗址来说，
它们是最重要的遗迹，因为它们在讲述我们国家
的故事方面具有关键地位，而且需要对它们的考
古潜力进行密切管理。在册纪念碑具有高度的重
要性:它们源于对考古和历史的兴趣。我们的选择
指南旨在说明一些可能有关的重要理由。与列出
的建筑物不同，预定地点一般不适合活化再利用。
Scheduling is discretionary: the Secretary of State
has a choice as to whether to add a site to the
Schedule or not. Scheduling is deliberately
selective: given the ever-increasing numbers of
archaeological remains which continue to be
identified and interpreted, this is unavoidable. The
Schedule aims to capture a representative sample
of nationally important sites, rather than be an
inclusive compendium of all such assets.
时间安排是自行决定的:国务卿可以选择是否在时间
表中增加一个网站。时间安排是有选择性的:考虑到
越来越多的考古遗迹继续被鉴定和解释，这是不可
避免的。该时间表旨在收集具有代表性的国家重要
地点样本，而不是所有此类资产的包容性汇编。
Given that archaeological sensitivity is all around
us, it is important that all means of protecting
archaeological remains are recognised. Other
designations such as listing can play an important
part here. Other sites may be identified as being
of national importance, but not scheduled.
Government policy affords them protection
through the planning system, and local authorities
play a key part in managing them through their
archaeological services and Historic Environment

鉴于考古学的敏感性在我们身边随处可见，所有保
护考古遗迹的手段都得到承认是很重要的。其他名
称，如列表可以发挥重要作用。其他地点可能被确
定为具有国家重要性，但没有时间表。政府政策通

地方当局在管理他们方面发挥着关键作用。
The Schedule has evolved since it began in
1882, and some entries fall far short of modern
standards. We are striving to upgrade these
older records as part of our programme of
upgrading the National Heritage List for England.
Historic England continues to revise and
upgrade these entries, which can be consulted
on the Historic England website.
该计划自 1882 年开始以来一直在演变，有些条
目远远达不到现代标准。我们正在努力升级这些
旧的记录，作为我们升级英格兰国家遗产名录计
划的一部分。历史上的英格兰继续修改和升级这
些条目，可以参考。

2.2 Heritage assets and
national importance
2.2 遗产资产和国家重要性
Paragraph 194 and footnote 63 of the National
Planning Policy Framework (July 2018) states that
any harm to, or loss of, the significance of a
designated heritage asset should require clear and
convincing justification and for assets of the highest
significance should be wholly exceptional; ‘non-
designated heritage assets of archaeological
interest that are demonstrably of equivalent
significance to scheduled monuments, should be
considered subject to the policies for designated
heritage assets’. These assets are defined as
having National Importance (NI). This is the latest
articulation of a principle first raised in PPG16
(1990-2010) and later in PPS5 (2010-2012).
《遗产法》(2018 年 7 月)第 194 段和脚注 63 指出，
对指定遗产资产的重要性的任何损害或丧失，都应当
有明确和令人信服的理由，而且最重要的资产应当是
完全例外的;”具有考古学意义、显然与列表遗迹具有
同等重要性的非指定遗产资产，应当被视为受指定遗
产资产政策的约束”。这些资产被定义为具有国家重
要性(NI)。这是第 16 页(1990-2010 年)和第 5 页
(2010-2012 年)首次提出的原则的最新阐述。

2.3 遴选准则

3.1 Listing or scheduling
3.1 列表或日程安排
Industrial remains have historically been the
subject of complementary approaches to

buildings in use: scheduling to those monuments
where general re-use is inappropriate, or which

在历史上，工业遗迹一直是名称的补充方法的主

好了
are, however, many exceptions to this old rule of

especially when their significance can be upheld

as the creation of conservation areas by local
planning authorities.
然而，许多例外情况并不符合这个古老的经验法则:

为正在使用的纪念碑。重要的是在国家一级确定值得
指定的建筑物和场地，然后采用最适当的指定制度。
鉴于日程安排的重要性要求很高，而且由此带来的特
殊控制，列名往往可能是大多数其他资产更为适当的
做法:特别是当这些资产的重要性可以通过规划系统
得到维护的时候。其他一些指定制度也可能是适当的，
例如由地方规划当局建立保护区。
One approach, which has been used successfully

Grade II*, whereas the surrounding
一种办法是将列入清单和安排日程两者所提供的保护

所成功地使用。例如 StublickColliery(诺森伯兰)，该

建筑物

下面的土方工程和考古遗迹。在这种情况下，评级

3.2 Modern industrial sites
3.2 现代工业用地
Modern industrial sites can sometimes have strong
claims to acknowledgment and may be considered

the more extraordinary, non-standard, structures
listing will also be the more valid approach,
现代工业网站有时会强烈要求得到承认，并且可能会

上市也将是比较有效的方法,
and scheduling should only be considered in

For the most contentious modern sites, it would be
expected that a discussion on various options is

feasible, and selectivity is essential. Preservation
by record can be the most appropriate response:
securing a vivid coverage before closure is
desirable. Regeneration of ‘brown-field’ sites
covers many former industrial locations: where
只有在完全合适的特殊情况下，才应考虑时间安排。
对于最具争议的现代网站，可以预期的是，与业主
就各种选择进行讨论。应考虑文物管理协议。长期

性是必要的。通过记录进行保存可能是最适当的反
应:最好在关闭前确保生动的覆盖范围。“棕色田地”
的再生覆盖了许多以前的工业地点:

While it is legally possible to schedule industrial

the past. Considerable challenges arise over

过去。在其长期管理方面出现了相当大的挑战。

3.4 Mineral rights ownership and
outstanding mineral permissions
3.4 矿产权所有权和未获得的矿产许
可
A particular consideration for industrial
archaeological cases is that of mineral rights.
Generally minerals are held in private ownership
and often independently from the landowner, and
in some instances, mineral permissions to work or
rework mines and mine tips may be valid, but held
in abeyance, for considerable periods of time. In
addition, some sites may have other extant
planning permissions which remain valid. It is not
necessary for an owner of minerals to register his
rights if these are separate from the surface of the
land. In such instances, a decision to schedule
may incur valid claims for compensation if the
owner’s ability to exercise their valid permits are
revoked or made subject to additional costs or
conditions; a recommendation to schedule will,
therefore, be exceptional. Some information may
be available from the Land Registry but these
rights are registered on a voluntary basis.
工业考古案件的一个特别考虑因素是矿产权。一般
来说，矿物是私人所有，往往独立于土地所有者，
在某些情况下，矿物开采或重新开采的许可和采矿
技巧可能是有效的，但在相当长的一段时间内被搁
置。此外，一些网站可能有其他现存的规划许可，
仍然有效。如果矿物与土地表面分开，则矿物所有
者无须登记其权利。在这种情况下，如果所有人行
使其有效许可证的能力被撤销，或受到额外费用或
条件的限制，则安排时间的决定可能引起有效的赔
偿要求;因此，安排时间的建议属于例外情况。土
地注册处可提供一些资料，但这些权利是自愿登记
的。

3.5 句号
Sites of all periods may be considered for

可以考虑所有时段的地点进行日程安排。那些发

3.6 Rarity, representativity
and selectivity
3.6 稀有性、代表性和选择性
Being a rare survival of a site-type may strengthen
the case for scheduling. This will include sites where
technological experimentation took place (see below
under Documentation). Equally, it is important that
the schedule is broadly representative of all kinds of
sites, and not just the extraordinary or unusual ones.
A range of industrial site-types of different periods
should be considered for inclusion, although the
relative significance of the particular industry in
national terms is also a factor - not every specialised
niche industry will justify a designated example of its
own.
作为一个罕见的生存站点类型可能会加强案件的调度。
这将包括进行技术实验的网站(见下文文档)。同样重
要的是，时间表要广泛代表所有类型的网站，而不仅
仅是那些特别的或不寻常的网站。应考虑列入一系列
不同时期的工业场地类型，尽管某一行业在国家方面
的相对重要性也是一个因素--并非每一个专门的特殊
行业都有理由作为自己的特定例子。
Selection also requires that the national spread of
an industry is represented, for instance so that it is
not forgotten that coal was mined in Kent and
Somerset, not just in the great coalfields
选择还要求代表一个行业在全国的传播，例如，这

of the north. Selection of sites for designation
should also aim to capture important regional

noted that our approach is not to designate every
survival within these localised clusters. We must
be selective, and designation can only be
warranted by the survival of substantial interest,
not simply by the fact of survival.
北境。选择指定地点还应着眼于抓住重要的地区

With frequently encountered site-types or

对于经常遇到的场地类型或结构，无论是否
