General Description
一般描述
The Stone Road Bridge, or McQuillian’s Bridge, is located parallel to Stone Road, between Victoria Road South and
Watson Parkway South in the City of Guelph. It was constructed in 1916 and spans the Eramosa River on what was
then the boundary line between the Township of Guelph and the Township of Puslinch. The bridge is an early
example of reinforced concrete bowstring truss construction or tied arch span, and was built to replace an earlier
wooden span, commonly called McQuillan’s Bridge, due to the proximity of this river crossing to lots cleared and
settled by the Mc-Quillan family.
石路大桥，或称 McQuillian 大桥，位于圭尔夫市维多利亚南路和沃森南路之间，与石路平行。它建于 1916
年，横跨 Eramosa 河，当时是圭尔夫镇和 Puslinch 镇的分界线。这座桥是早期的钢筋混凝土弓弦桁架结构
或系杆拱桥的一个例子，它的建造是为了取代早期的木质桥梁，通常被称为 McQuillan 大桥，因为这座跨
河桥靠近 Mc-Quillan 家族清理和定居的地块。
The Stone Road Bridge was built under the direction of Wellington County Engineer A. W. Connor as a sturdy and
more permanent structure to meet the demand for better road conditions required by increased settlement and ag-
ricultural production in the area. The bridge was built by Charles Mattaini, a local contractor and craftsman who
developed skills in the use of concrete for many local building projects and, in particular, bridges. Mattaini, a native
of northern Italy, built over fifty bridges that were constructed in this area, and his work was well known and
admired outside of Wellington County. The Stone Road Bridge is the only example of the concrete bowstring arch
form within the City of Guelph and is one of few remaining examples of this type in the watershed.
石路桥是在威灵顿县工程师 A.w. 康纳的指导下建造的，作为一个坚固和更永久的结构，以满足该地区增加
的定居点和农业生产对更好的道路条件的需求。这座桥是由当地承包商和工匠查尔斯•马泰尼 (Charles
Mattaini)建造的，他发展了在许多当地建筑项目中使用混凝土的技能，尤其是桥梁。马太尼是意大利北部人，
他在这个地区建造了超过 50 座桥梁，他的作品在威灵顿县以外的地区广为人知并受到赞赏。石路大桥是圭
尔夫市内混凝土弓弦拱形式的唯一例子，也是该流域仅存的几个这种类型的例子之一。
The first span of this bridge type in Ontario was built in 1909 and featured a system of cross bracing between the verti-cal
hangers. While these bridges share a basic form, there is considerable variety among the structures. The Stone Road
Bridge is distinguished from the 1909 Ontario prototype in that it does not include a system of cross bracing. This form of
design was later to become typical of the standard practice of concrete bowstring arch construction in Ontario that was
most popular between 1915 and 1930. The Stone Road Bridge is also distinguished by the height of its arches, which
required them to be connected by a single cross beam, inscribed with the date of construction. The bridge’s graceful arches
and simple design are considered to be a significant element of the riverscape at this location.
在安大略省，这种桥型的第一个跨度建于 1909 年，其特点是垂直吊架之间的交叉支撑系统。虽然这些桥梁共享
一个基本的形式，有相当多的不同结构。石路大桥不同于 1909 年安大略省的原型，因为它不包括交叉支撑系统。
这种形式的设计后来成为典型的标准做法混凝土弓弦拱在安大略省是最流行的 1915 年和 1930 年之间。石路大桥
的另一个特点是其拱门的高度，这就要求它们通过一个单一的横梁连接起来，横梁上刻有施工日期。桥梁优美的
拱门和简单的设计被认为是这个位置河景的重要元素。
The introduction and success of the concrete bowstring arch bridge reflects the transition from horse-drawn vehicles to
motorized forms of transportation as this type of bridge provided a safer and more durable design than the traditional
timber bridge found commonly in rural areas in the 19th century. The concentration of this bridge type in Wellington
混凝土弓弦拱桥的引进和成功反映了从马车到机动交通形式的转变，因为这种桥提供了比 19 世纪在农村地区普
遍存在的传统木桥更安全和更耐用的设计。这种桥型集中在惠灵顿
186186
Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
Arch，Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory 拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域遗产桥清单
County is notable and reflects the availability of local aggregate and the particular skills of a local craftsman. The
Stone Road Bridge is included on the Ontario Heritage Bridge List, spans a designated Canadian Heritage River
route and is considered to be an early and rare surviving example of concrete bowstring arch construction in a local,
provincial and national context.
县是值得注意的，反映了当地集合的可用性和当地手工艺人的特殊技能。石路桥被列入安大略省遗产桥梁
名录，跨越加拿大遗产河的指定路线，被认为是当地、省和全国范围内混凝土弓弦拱施工的早期罕见的幸
存例子。
In 2000, Stone Road East underwent rehabilitation and was widened to two lanes. The City of Guelph decided to re-
route the road in order to preserve the bridge. The bridge was designated in 2004 for its cultural heritage value and
interest under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (By-law (2004)-17357A). The bridge is now used as a pedestrian
bridge and is part of the municipal trail system.
2000 年，石东路进行了修复，并扩大到两条车道。圭尔夫市政府决定重新规划道路，以保护这座桥。 2004
年，根据《安大略省遗产法》(2004 年)第四部分(第 17357a 号附则) ，该桥因其文化遗产价值和利益而被指
定。这座桥现在被用作行人桥，是市政轨道系统的一部分。

General Description
一般描述
The Norwich Street East Bridge is located on Norwich Street East, 0.05 km southwest of Arthur Street North in the
Goldie Mill neighbourhood in the City of Guelph. This steel and iron bridge was built in 1882 by the Hamilton
Bridge Company at a cost of just over $1,000 to City Council, who commissioned the work.
诺威奇街东桥位于圭尔夫市金磨坊附近的诺威奇街东，距亚瑟街北西南 0.05 公里。这座钢铁大桥建于 1882
年，由汉密尔顿桥公司花费 1000 多美元委托市议会建造。
A bridge spanned the Speed River at this location as early as 1860 and was known first as “the Wellington Foundry
Bridge” and later “the Inglis-Hunter Bridge” because of its close proximity to one of the very early industries in
Guelph, established circa 1860 on the easterly bank of the river.
早在 1860 年，这里就有一座桥横跨斯皮德河，最初被称为“惠灵顿铸造大桥”，后来又被称为“英格利斯-
亨特大桥”，因为它靠近圭尔夫最早的工业之一，大约 1860 年在河东岸建成。
The bridge became an important link in the movement of materials across the river, serving the needs of the many
foundries and mills which occupied this area in the mid-1800’s, and the choice of iron over the more traditional and
less expensive wooden bridge reflects the growing industrialization of the community. Today, this single span
bridge acts as a gateway to the residential area on the east side of the Speed River and serves as a connecting link
between the east and west sides of what is now known as the Goldie Mill Neighbourhood. The bridge is the only
surviving example of several iron and steel bridges which once existed in Guelph, and is important as a distinctive
heritage feature of the riverscape in this area. It was designated by the City of Guelph under Part IV of the Ontario
Heritage Act (By-law 1998-15786) in 1998.
桥梁成为横跨河流的材料运输的一个重要环节，满足了 19 世纪中期占据这一地区的许多铸造厂和工厂的需
要，选择铁而不是更传统和更便宜的木桥反映了社区日益增长的工业化。今天，这座单跨桥梁作为一个门
户，通往 Speed 河东侧的居民区，并作为连接东西两侧的纽带，现在被称为 Goldie Mill 居民区。这座桥是
圭尔夫仅存的几座钢铁桥梁，作为该地区河流景观的一个独特遗产，具有重要意义。1998年，圭尔夫市根
据《安大略省遗产法》(1998-15786 年法律)第四部分指定了这个城市。

General Description
一般描述
The CNR Railway Viaduct crosses the Speed River in downtown Guelph at the intersection of Macdonell Street and
Woolwich Street. Constructed of limestone and steel, it is a functional, multi-double pier structure of seven bays
straddling an earlier roadway. It exhibits rusticated stone piers and abutments, four built up steel girders, wooden
cross ties, and a modern railed catwalk. It was built circa 1857 by the Grand Trunk Railway (GTR), a company
established to build a railway line across Canada, from coast to coast. However, in 1919 the government took over
the GTR and today it is owned by the Canadian National Railway. It appears that the viaduct supported two tracks at
one time, however, only one track remains.
CNR 铁路高架桥横跨圭尔夫市中心的速度河，位于 Macdonell 街和 Woolwich 街的交叉口。它由石灰石和钢
铁建造，是一个功能性的，多双墩结构的 7 个海湾跨越早期的道路。它展示了粗糙的石头桥墩和桥台，四
个已建成的钢梁，木质十字架，和一个现代化的有轨猫道。它建于 1857 年左右，由大主干铁路(GTR) ，一
个公司成立，建设一条横跨加拿大的铁路线，从海岸到海岸。然而，1919年政府接管了 GTR，今天它归加
拿大国家铁路公司所有。看起来这座高架桥同时支撑着两条铁轨，然而，现在只剩下一条了。
The context of the site surrounding the CNR Railway Viaduct has substantial historic and cultural value. On the east
abutment, there is a tablet that marks the spot where John Galt, the General Agent of the Canada Company, cut the
first tree in founding the City of Guelph on April 23rd, 1827.
中国北车铁路高架桥周围的环境具有重要的历史和文化价值。1827年 4 月 23 日，加拿大公司的总代理人约
翰 · 高尔特(John Galt)在东边的桥墩上砍下了建立圭尔夫城市的第一棵树。
The viaduct is also sited in close to proximity to a number of other bridges. It sits above the Old Speed River Bridge,
now abandoned, and to the west of the CPR Speed River Bridge and the remnants of Allan’s Mill. All of these sites,
along with the CNR Railway Viaduct, contribute to the culture heritage value of Guelph’s historic downtown.
这座高架桥也靠近其他一些桥梁。它位于旧 Speed 河大桥(现已废弃)的上方，以及 CPR Speed 河大桥和艾伦
磨坊遗迹的西面。所有这些遗址，连同中国北车铁路高架桥，都为圭尔夫历史悠久的市中心的文化遗产价
值做出了贡献。
Sources: City of Guelph Inventory of Heritage Structures

General Description
一般描述
The Old Speed River Bridge is located near the intersection of Macdonell Street and Woolwich Street, spanning the
Speed River. This steel and concrete bridge was built circa 1930 by the Hamilton Bridge Company. Decorated
concrete balustrades support ornamental metal railings in the Art Deco style. The bridge lies cradled under two
spans of the CNR Railway Viaduct above. Now abandoned, the bridge once carried Macdonell Street.
老速河大桥位于 Macdonell 街和 Woolwich 街交叉口附近，横跨速河。这座钢筋混凝土大桥由汉密尔顿桥公
司于 1930 年左右建成。装饰混凝土栏杆支撑着装饰艺术装饰风格的金属栏杆。这座桥位于中国北车铁路高
架桥的两个跨度之下。现在这座桥已经废弃，它曾经支撑着 Macdonell 大街。
The Old Speed River Bridge, along with several nearby historic sites such as the CNR Railway Viaduct, the CPR
Speed River Bridge and Allan’s Mill remnants, actively contribute to a cultural heritage landscape surrounding
Guelph’s downtown core.
古老的速度河大桥，连同几个附近的历史遗址，如中国北车铁路高架桥，CPR 速度河大桥和艾伦磨坊遗址，
积极贡献了围绕圭尔夫市中心的文化遗产景观。
Built in 1830, the remnants of Allan’s Mill can be seen to the east of the bridge. Vestiges of this mill remain,
including a dam and a weir underneath the bridge that regulates and slows the flow of the river.
建于 1830 年的艾伦磨坊的遗迹可以在桥的东边看到。这座磨坊的遗迹依然存在，包括桥下的一座大坝和一
个堰，它们调节和减缓了河水的流速。
Sources: City of Guelph Inventory of Heritage Structures

General Description
一般描述
The Heffernan Street Footbridge, located in the downtown area of Guelph, crosses the Speed River connecting
Wool-wich Street and Arthur Street. It was built in 1914 by Galbraith and Cate and designed by Ernest E. Clawson,
the City Engineer. It replaced an earlier metal arch bridge. There has been a footbridge at this location since 1881
that connects the residential neighborhood on one side to the downtown commercial core on the other.
赫弗南街人行桥位于圭尔夫市中心，横跨连接羊毛街和亚瑟街的速度河。它由 Galbraith 和 Cate 于 1914 年
建造，由城市工程师 Ernest e。它取代了早期的金属拱桥。自 1881 年以来，这里就有一座人行天桥，将居
民区的一侧与市中心的商业中心区连接起来。
The bridge was designated under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (By-law 1990-13541) for its heritage value by
the City of Guelph in 1990. Shortly after this designation, parts of the bridge were reconstructed between 1990 and
1991. The original open-spandrel arch design was maintained as well as the open-poured concrete balustrade
railings, and the twin pier pedestal supports to the approaches with solid paneled balustrades. The bridge is a unique
feature along the Speed River and has become a landmark within Guelph’s downtown area.
1990 年，圭尔夫市根据《安大略遗产法》(1990-13541 年法律)第四部分的规定，指定这座桥具有遗产价值。
在这项指定之后不久，部分桥梁在 1990 年至 1991 年间重建。保留了原有的开拱设计，以及开浇混凝土栏杆
和双墩底座支撑的方法与实心镶板栏杆。这座桥是斯皮德河沿岸的一个独特特征，已经成为圭尔夫市中心
地区的一个地标。
Sources: City of Guelph Inventory of Heritage Structures
资料来源: 圭尔夫市遗产结构清单

General Description
一般描述
The Gordon Street Bridge is located on Gordon Street, 0.9 km north of Water Street in the City of Guelph. It was
built in 2001 to replace a 4-span steel beam bridge with masonry abutments and piers, originally built circa 1935.
Although it does not reflect the original structure, it complements Gow’s Bridge, visible downstream from this
structure, with its arches and multiple arched spans. The bridge design also includes patterned concrete balustrade
piers, ornamental steel balustrades and integrated decorative lampposts. The bridge won the Precast Concrete
Material Development & Innovation Award at the 2001 Ontario Concrete Awards.
戈登街大桥位于圭尔夫水街以北 0.9 公里的戈登街上。它建于 2001 年，用砖石桥台和桥墩取代 4 跨钢梁桥，
最初建于 1935 年左右。尽管它没有反映出原来的结构，但它补充了九大桥，从这个结构的下游可以看到它
的拱和多个拱跨。桥梁设计还包括图案化的混凝土栏杆墩，装饰钢栏杆和综合装饰灯柱。这座桥赢得了
2001 年安大略省混凝土大奖的预制混凝土材料发展与创新奖。
The Gordon Street Bridge contributes to a cultural landscape with the designated Boat House and Covered Lattice
Truss Bridge to the north, Gow’s Bridge to the south and Royal City Park adjacent to the structure. The bridge also
acts as a gateway between the University and Downtown areas of Guelph.
戈登街大桥北面是指定的船屋和有盖的格状桁架桥，南面是 Gow 大桥，毗邻皇家城市公园。桥梁还作为圭
尔夫大学和市中心之间的门户。
Sources: City of Guelph Inventory of Heritage Structures
资料来源: 圭尔夫市遗产结构清单

General Description
一般描述
Gow’s Bridge is located on McCrae Boulevard, 0.11 km north of Water Street in the City of Guelph. Built in 1897
by Daniel Keleher, a local contractor, it replaced a wooden bridge constructed at this site in 1852. Both the old
bridge and the new were referred to as Gow’s Bridge due to their proximity to Gow’s Mill, a wooden mill and
tannery owned by Guelph businessman and politician Peter Gow. Gow was the mayor of Guelph in 1866.
Gow’s Bridge 位于圭尔夫水街以北 0.11 公里的 McCrae Boulevard。这座桥建于 1897 年，由当地承包商
Daniel Keleher 建造，取代了 1852 年在这里建造的一座木桥。旧桥和新桥都被称为高桥，因为它们邻近高磨
坊，一个由圭尔夫商人和政治家彼得高拥有的木磨坊和制革厂。1866 年，高是圭尔夫的市长。
Gow’s Bridge is made of locally quarried limestone, making it the only surviving example of several stone bridges
that once crossed the rivers in Guelph. During construction, a structure called “falsework” was used to temporarily
support the arch. The bridge’s design is comprised of pilastered abutments, a centre pier and parapets with
projecting base and cap bands. The bridge contributes to the surrounding cultural landscape consisting of Royal City
Park, one of the city’s largest parks, the upstream Gordon Street Bridge and to the south The John McCrae House, a
limestone cottage circa 1858 where John McCrae (author of In Flanders Fields) was born.
高桥由当地开采的石灰石建成，是圭尔夫几座曾经横跨河流的石桥中唯一幸存的一座。在建设过程中，一
种叫做“支架”的结构被用来临时支撑拱门。大桥的设计包括壁柱桥台、中心桥墩和带有突出底座和帽带
的护墙。这座桥有助于形成周围的文化景观，包括皇家城市公园，该市最大的公园之一，上游的戈登街大
桥和南面的约翰麦克雷房子，大约 1858 年，约翰麦克雷(在法兰德斯战场的作者)出生的石灰石小屋。
Gow’s Bridge was designated under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (By-Law (1990)-13471) by the City of
Guelph in 1990. The designation covers all elements of the south and middle spans and all of the piers, each of
which is constructed of stone. The north span was reconstructed in 1997 when the entire bridge was rehabilitated.
Gow’s Bridge is also included on the Ontario Heritage Bridge List.
1990 年，圭尔夫市根据《安大略遗产法》(1990 年)-13471 第四部分指定了高桥。这个名称涵盖了南跨和中
跨的所有元素以及所有的桥墩，每个桥墩都是用石头建造的。北跨于 1997 年重建，当时整座桥已经修复。
九龙大桥也被列入安大略省文物桥梁名录。
Sources: City of Guelph Inventory of Heritage Structures
资料来源: 圭尔夫市遗产结构清单

General Description
一般描述
The CPR Speed River Bridge is located southeast of the intersection of Wellington Street East and Macdonell Street
just outside the downtown core of the City of Guelph. This deck plate girder bridge has a steel superstructure, while
the rusticated abutments are made of locally quarried limestone. Guelph Junction Railway built the bridge in 1884 to
Canadian Pacific Railway standards. Owned by the City of Guelph, the company still exists today and is the only
federally chartered railway in Canada.
CPR Speed River 大桥位于圭尔夫市中心外惠灵顿东街和 Macdonell 街交叉口的东南部。这座桥面板梁桥有
一个钢结构的上部结构，而粗糙的桥墩是由当地开采的石灰石制成的。圭尔夫枢纽铁路公司于 1884 年按照
加拿大太平洋铁路标准建造了这座桥。这家由圭尔夫市拥有的公司至今仍然存在，是加拿大唯一的联邦特
许铁路公司。
Along with the Old Speed River Bridge, the CNR Railway Viaduct and the remnants of Allan’s Mill, the CPR Speed
River Bridge contributes to a cultural heritage landscape that surrounds Guelph’s downtown core.
除了老斯比德河大桥，CNR 铁路高架桥和艾伦磨坊的遗迹，CPR 斯比德河大桥为圭尔夫市中心的文化遗产
景观做出了贡献。
In 1830, a wooden mill was erected on this site for the Canada Company. Shortly after, William Allan purchased the
mill in 1831 and built a five-storey stone structure. The Allan family ran the water power and grist mill until 1876.
In 1966, the mill was destroyed by a fire. On the site of the mill, a cairn was constructed with the intact stone that
remained after the fire. The remnants of Allan’s Mill are located to the southeast of the bridge.
1830 年，加拿大公司在这里建造了一座木磨坊。不久之后，威廉 · 艾伦在 1831 年购买了这个木材厂，并建
造了一个五层的石头结构。艾伦家族经营水力和谷物磨坊一直到 1876 年。1966 年，磨坊被一场大火烧毁。
在磨坊的原址上，用大火过后残留的完整石头建造了一个大坑。艾伦磨坊的残余部分位于桥的东南方。
Sources: City of Guelph Inventory of Heritage Structures
资料来源: 圭尔夫市遗产结构清单

General Description
一般描述
The Covered Lattice Truss Bridge is located in York Road Park, between Gordon Street and York Road in the City
of Guelph. The Timber Framers Guild of America constructed the bridge in 1992. It was built by over 400 timber
framers who were gathered in Guelph for a five-day convention. Located at the confluence of the Speed and
Eramosa Rivers, the bridge links the Eramosa River Trail and the Silvercreek Trail.
这座有盖的格状桁架桥位于圭尔夫市戈登街和约克路之间的约克路公园。美国木材制造商协会于 1992 年建
造了这座桥。它由超过 400 名木材制造者建造，他们聚集在圭尔夫参加为期五天的会议。这座桥位于 Speed
河和 Eramosa 河的交汇处，连接着 Eramosa 河小径和 Silvercreek 小径。
The lattice trusses incorporated into the design of this bridge are an evolved version of the Town Truss, patented by Ithiel
Town in 1820. The superstructure of the bridge is made completely out of timber, including wooden dowels that hold the
structure together and a wood shake roof. Some of the beams used in the bridge were cut from a willow tree that
previously grew at the site, as indicated by a plaque on the bridge interior. The bridge sits upon two masonry piers.
在这座桥的设计中采用的格子桁架是城镇桁架的进化版本，1820年由 Ithiel Town 申请专利。这座桥的上部结构
完全由木材构成，包括将结构连接在一起的木榫和木质摇晃屋顶。桥梁使用的一些横梁是从一棵柳树上砍下来的，
这棵柳树以前是在这个地方生长的，桥梁内部的一块牌匾说明了这一点。这座桥坐落在两个砖石桥墩上。
The Covered Lattice Truss Bridge actively contributes to the cultural landscape surrounding the downtown core of
Guelph. It is located just north of the Gordon Street Bridge and The Boat House, a wooden framed building that is
the last of a series of boat houses to be associated with Guelph’s river systems, and also designated under Part IV of
the Ontario Heritage Act in 1997. Popular in the summer due to its restaurant and ice cream business, The Boat
House is one of the most visited historic sites in Guelph.
覆盖式格状桁架桥为圭尔夫市中心的文化景观做出了积极贡献。它位于戈登街大桥和船屋的北面，这是一
个木制框架建筑，是圭尔夫河流系统中一系列船屋中的最后一个，也是根据 1997 年安大略遗产法第四部分
指定的。由于其餐厅和冰淇淋业务，船屋在夏季非常受欢迎，是圭尔夫最受欢迎的历史景点之一。
Sources: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory
资料来源: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory
Canadian Register of Historic Places

General Description
一般描述
The Niska Road Bridge crosses the Speed River 0.35 km west of Pioneer Trail. The one-lane Bailey bridge was built
in 1974 and is the only of its type in the City of Guelph. The Bailey bridge is a pre-fabricated, portable, truss bridge
that was developed by the British during World War II for military use. This type of bridge requires no heavy
equipment or specialized tools to construct and is typically used for temporary crossings. The Niska Road Bridge
has a steel structure with a timber deck and masonry abutments.
Niska 公路大桥横跨先锋小径以西 0.35 公里的 Speed River。这座单车道的贝利大桥建于 1974 年，是圭尔夫
市唯一一座此类桥梁。贝利大桥是一座预制的便携式桁架桥，二战期间由英国开发用于军事用途。这种类
型的桥梁不需要重型设备或专门的工具来建造，通常用于临时通道。Niska 公路大桥采用钢结构，木质桥面
和砖石桥台。
It is speculated that the bridge was chosen to be one-lane in order to discourage vehicles from using the road as a
main artery. However, the bridge still carries a large amount of traffic due to the residential area to the east.
据推测，这座桥被选为单车道是为了阻止车辆使用道路作为主干道。然而，由于大桥东侧是居民区，大桥
仍然承载着大量的交通流量。
Sources: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory
资料来源: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory

General Description
一般描述
The Wooden Trestle Railway Bridge is located between Stone Road East and Victoria Road South in the City of Guelph.
The Guelph Junction Railway likely constructed this structure circa 1900. The rail line eventually fell under ownership of
the Canadian Pacific Railway, but it has now been abandoned. The bridge is owned by the City of Guelph and is locat-ed
on a footpath, inaccessible by car, near industrial land in the south end of Guelph. Limited information is available on this
structure. The trestle is an early, and now rare, type of railway bridge in that it is constructed entirely of timber.
木栈桥(Wooden Trestle Railway Bridge)位于圭尔夫市石东路和维多利亚南路之间。圭尔夫枢纽铁路可能是在 1900
年左右建造的。这条铁路线最终归属于加拿大太平洋铁路公司，但现在已经被废弃了。这座桥归圭尔夫市所有，
位于圭尔夫南端工业用地附近的一条人行道上，汽车无法进入。关于这个结构的信息有限。栈桥是一种早期的，
现在很少见的铁路桥，因为它完全是用木材建造的。
Source: City of Guelph 2006 Structure Inventory

General Description
一般描述
The Blatchford Bridge is located on County Road 32, 0.80 km south of County Road 124. It was constructed in 1949
and is one of two remaining steel truss bridges in the Township of Puslinch, and represents the only pony truss. The
Blatchford Bridge is similar in appearance to other pony trusses in Wellington County and built during the same
time period, generally between 1949 and 1954.
Blatchford 桥位于郡道 32 号，在郡道 124 以南 0.80 公里处。它建于 1949 年，是 Puslinch 镇仅存的两座钢桁
架桥之一，是唯一的小马桁架桥。Blatchford 桥的外观与威灵顿县的其他小马桁架相似，建于同一时期，一
般建于 1949 年至 1954 年之间。
The Dominion Bridge Company Ltd. constructed this steel pony truss bridge for the County of Wellington. Established in
1886, this company was a Canadian steel bridge constructor based in Lachine, Quebec, and eventually growing to have
plants located across Canada. Contractor A.H. MacLellan and County Engineer, W.H. Keith, are credited with working on
this bridge and many other truss bridges in the County. The Blatchford Bridge underwent repairs in 1992.
自治桥有限公司为惠灵顿郡建造了这座钢制小马桁架桥。成立于 1886 年，这家公司是一家加拿大钢桥建造商，
总部设在加拿大魁北克省拉欣，并最终在加拿大各地建立了工厂。承包商 a.h。麦克莱伦和郡工程师 w.h。基思，
被认为是这座桥和该郡其他许多桁架桥的建造者。Blatchford 大桥在 1992 年进行了维修。
Located directly east of the bridge, remnant concrete abutments remain indicating the alignment of a previous bridge
parallel to the Blatchford Bridge.
位于桥的正东方，残余的混凝土桥台仍然保留着，这表明之前的桥与 Blatchford 桥平行。
Sources: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory
资料来源: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory
County of Wellington, 2007 Bridge Appraisals
威灵顿郡，2007 桥梁评估

General Description
一般描述
Little’s Bridge is located on Sideroad 25 North, 0.18 km south of Concession Road 7. It was constructed in 1910 and
is the earliest concrete solid slab bridge built in the Township of Puslinch and is the only one of this design. It is also
one of the earliest of its type in the watershed. Little’s Bridge displays an early experimentation with concrete,
which has resulted in decoratively embossed solid concrete railings. Although this is a railing design seen
throughout the watershed, the craftsmanship of Little’s bridge sets it apart. The solid railings are thinner than others
and the embossed decoration is more precise. The board finish used to set the concrete on site during construction is
still visible.
Little’s Bridge 位于 siderroad 25 North，7号特许公路以南 0.18 公里。它建于 1910 年，是 Puslinch 镇最早建
造的混凝土实心板桥，也是这种设计中唯一的一座。它也是该流域最早的类型建筑之一。Little’s Bridge 展
示了早期的混凝土实验，最终产生了装饰性的浮雕实心混凝土栏杆。尽管这是一个贯穿整个分水岭的栏杆
设计，小桥的工艺使它与众不同。实心栏杆比其他栏杆更薄，浮雕装饰更精确。在施工过程中用来固定现
场混凝土的木板表面仍然清晰可见。
Source: Ontario Structure Inspection Form, Township of Puslinch
来源: 安大略省结构检查表，Puslinch 镇

General Description
一般描述
The Cook’s Mill Bridge Abutments are located approximately 20 m east of Cooks Mill Road and the current Cook’s
Bridge, and 0.4 km west of Watson Road South. Due to the use of masonry and the mature tree that has grown
through the abutments, its date of construction is estimated to be circa 1900. After 1900, concrete was a more
commonly relied upon building material. The bridge the abutments supported likely aligned with the historic routing
of Cooks Mill Road. The current bridge on site was constructed in 1958, and is one of a series of bridges that
accommodated this crossing of the Eramosa River.
库克磨坊桥的桥墩位于库克磨坊路以东约 20 米和目前的库克桥，以及沃森路南以西 0.4 公里。由于使用了
砖石和通过桥墩生长的成熟树木，它的建造时间估计在 1900 年左右。1900 年以后，混凝土更普遍地依赖于
建筑材料。桥台支撑的桥梁很可能与 cook Mill Road 的历史路线保持一致。现在的这座桥建于 1958 年，是
一系列跨越 Eramosa 河的桥梁之一。

General Description
一般描述
Benham Bridge is located on Eramosa-Erin Townline, 1.8 km south of Wellington Road 124 near the community of
Everton. The Benham Bridge was constructed in 1910 and is classified as a single span, solid spandrel concrete arch
structure of reinforced cast-in-place concrete. The elliptical arch has a smooth soffit and the concrete wingwalls
contain the earth-filled core used to build up the structure to the road deck. For this reason, the bridge is also referred
to as an earth-filled arch structure. The Benham Bridge is the only of its type in the Township of Guelph/Eramosa,
and one of few remaining in the Grand River watershed.
Benham 桥位于 Eramosa-Erin Townline，惠灵顿路 124 以南 1.8 公里，靠近 Everton 社区。Benham 大桥建于
1910 年，是钢筋现浇混凝土单跨实腹混凝土拱结构。椭圆拱有一个光滑的底座和混凝土翼墙包含填土的核
心，用于建立结构的道路甲板。由于这个原因，这座桥也被称为填土拱结构。Benham 大桥是圭尔夫/埃拉
莫萨镇唯一的同类桥梁，也是大河流域仅存的几座桥梁之一。
The bridge was engineered by the firm of Bowman & Connor, a prolific and well-known bridge engineering
company based in Toronto and Berlin (Kitchener) in the early 20th century, along with King Cooper, a local mason.
Today, the bridge is considered a good example of functional engineering design clearly expressing the transfer of
loads through the arch to the abutments. The simple arch design is sculptural in its proportions and shape. A
Ministry of Natural Resources survey bench mark (V010 856052) is located on the southwest abutment.
这座桥是由 Bowman & Connor 公司设计的。 Bowman & Connor 公司是一家著名的桥梁工程公司，总部位于
20 世纪早期的多伦多和柏林(Kitchener)。今天，这座桥被认为是功能工程设计的一个很好的例子，它清楚
地表达了荷载通过拱桥传递到桥墩的过程。简单的拱门设计在比例和形状上是雕塑式的。一个自然资源部
的调查基准(v010856052)位于西南边的桥墩上。
Most of the early activity in concrete bridge construction in Ontario focused on the earth-filled, solid spandrel arch
form. The main construction period between 1905-1919 for solid spandrel arch bridges in Ontario was a relatively
short time span of 14 years. This bridge type gained in popularity because they were easy and inexpensive to build.
Many of these early 20th century earth-filled concrete arches have been removed from the Province’s roads because
they are too narrow to meet modern traffic needs. As a result, solid spandrel concrete arch bridges in active use are
now considered rare survivors.
在安大略省，早期的混凝土桥梁建设活动大多集中在填土、实心拱肋形式上。1905-1919 年间，安大略省实
心拱桥的主要施工阶段是相对较短的 14 年。这种桥型之所以受到欢迎，是因为它们建造起来既简单又便宜。
许多这种 20 世纪早期的混凝土拱门已经从该省的道路上拆除，因为它们太窄，不能满足现代交通的需要。
因此，现在活跃使用的实心拱肋混凝土拱桥被认为是罕见的幸存者。
Sources: Benham Bridge, Class Environmental Assessment Study, McCormick Rankin, April 2012
来源: Benham Bridge，Class Environmental Assessment Study，McCormick Rankin，April 2012
Benham Bridge, Cultural Heritage Evaluation Report, Unterman McPhail Associates, July 2010

General Description
一般描述
The Rothsay Bridge is located on County Road 7, 0.30 km west of Wellington County Road 10 in the community of
Rothsay. It was constructed in 1952 and is one of six remaining steel truss bridges in the Township of Mapleton,
five of which are pony trusses. In addition to the Rothsay Bridge, the group of pony truss bridges includes: Mallet
River, Simmon’s, Flax, Moorefield and Bosworth Bridges. All of which were constructed between 1949 and 1954,
with the exception of the Mallet River Bridge, which was constructed in 1910.
罗斯西大桥位于罗斯西社区威灵顿县 10 号路以西 0.30 公里的 7 号县道上。它建于 1952 年，是梅普尔顿镇
仅存的六座钢桁架桥之一，其中五座是小型桁架桥。除了罗斯西大桥，这组矮马桁架桥包括 : Mallet 河，西
蒙的，亚麻，摩尔菲尔德和博斯沃思桥。所有这些桥都建于 1949 年至 1954 年之间，除了建于 1910 年的
Mallet River 大桥。
The Hamilton Bridge Company Ltd. constructed this steel pony truss bridge for the County of Wellington. This
com-pany was established in 1872 and responsible for the fabrication and erection of many steel bridges in Ontario.
The steel used for most truss bridges in Ontario was sourced from the United States. However, “ALGOMA
CANADA” is pressed in the bridge’s steel girders, indicating that the material was sourced in Canada from Algoma
Steel, a company founded in 1902 and located on the St. Marys River in Sault Ste. Marie, ON. Contractor A.H.
MacLellan and County Engineer, W.H. Keith are credited with working on this bridge and many other truss bridges
in the County. The Rothsay Bridge underwent rehabilitation in 1991.
汉密尔顿桥有限公司为惠灵顿郡建造了这座钢制小马桁架桥。这家公司成立于 1872 年，负责安大略省许多
钢桥的制造和安装。安大略省大多数桁架桥使用的钢材来自美国。然而，“加拿大阿尔戈马”是压在大桥
的钢梁，表明材料来自加拿大阿尔戈马钢铁公司，成立于 1902 年，位于圣玛丽河索尔特圣玛丽，ON。承
包商 a.h。 MacLellan 和郡工程师 w.h。 Keith 被认为是这座桥和该郡其他许多桁架桥的建造者。罗斯西大桥
在 1991 年进行了修复。
Sources: County of Wellington Bridge Inventory
资料来源: 威灵顿郡大桥库存

威灵顿郡，2007 桥梁评估

General Description
一般描述
The Moorefield Bridge is located on County Road 10, 2.90 km south of Wellington County Road 8 in the
community of Moorefield. It was constructed in 1954 and is one of six remaining steel truss bridges in the Township
of Mapleton, five of which are pony trusses. In addition to the Moorefield Bridge, the group of pony truss bridges
includes: Mallet River, Simmon’s, Flax, Bosworth and Rothsay Bridges. All of which were constructed between
1949 and 1954, with the exception of the Mallet River Bridge, which was constructed in 1910. The Moorefield
Bridge and Flax Bridge are very similar in appearance and dimensions and were constructed in the same year by the
same group of County of Wellington staff.
穆尔菲尔德大桥位于威灵顿县 10 号公路，在穆尔菲尔德社区的 8 号公路以南 2.90 公里处。它建于 1954 年，
是梅普尔顿镇仅存的六座钢桁架桥之一，其中五座是小型桁架桥。除了穆尔菲尔德大桥，这组小马桁架桥
包括: Mallet 河，西蒙的，亚麻，博斯沃思和罗斯赛桥。所有这些桥都建于 1949 年至 1954 年之间，除了建
于 1910 年的 Mallet 河大桥。穆尔菲尔德大桥和亚麻大桥在外观和尺寸上非常相似，是同一年由惠灵顿县的
同一批工作人员建造的。
The Dominion Bridge Company Ltd. constructed this steel pony truss bridge for the County of Wellington.
Established in 1886, this company was a Canadian steel bridge constructor based in Lachine, Quebec, and eventu-
ally growing to have plants located across Canada. The steel used for most truss bridges in Ontario was sourced
from the United States. However, “ALGOMA CANADA” is pressed in the bridge’s steel girders, indicating that the
material was sourced in Canada from Algoma Steel, a company founded in 1902 and located on the St. Marys River
in Sault Ste. Marie, ON. Contractor A.H. MacLellan and County Engineer, W.H. Keith, are credited with working
on this bridge and many other truss bridges in the County.
自治桥有限公司为惠灵顿郡建造了这座钢制小马桁架桥。成立于 1886 年，这家公司是一家加拿大钢桥建造
商，总部设在加拿大魁北克的拉欣，并最终在加拿大各地建立了工厂。安大略省大多数桁架桥使用的钢材
来自美国。然而，“加拿大阿尔戈马”是压在大桥的钢梁，表明材料来自加拿大阿尔戈马钢铁公司，成立
于 1902 年，位于圣玛丽河索尔特圣玛丽，ON。承包商 a.h。 MacLellan 和郡工程师 w.h。 Keith，被认为是
这座桥和该郡其他许多桁架桥的建造者。
The Moorefield Bridge underwent a deck replacement and guiderail installation in 1994.
穆尔菲尔德大桥在 1994 年进行了甲板更换和导轨安装。

General Description
一般描述
The Flax Bridge is located on County Road 11, 0.01 km south of Wellington County Road 109. It was constructed in
1954 and is one of six remaining steel truss bridges in the Township of Mapleton, five of which are pony trusses. In
addition to the Flax Bridge, the group of pony truss bridges includes: Mallet River, Simmon’s, Moorefield,
Bosworth and Rothsay Bridges, all of which were constructed between 1949 and 1954, with the exception of the
Mallet River Bridge, which was constructed in 1910. The Moorefield Bridge and Flax Bridge are very similar in
appearance and dimensions and were constructed in the same year by the same group of County of Wellington staff.
亚麻桥位于威灵顿县 109 号公路以南 0.01 公里的 11 号县道上。它建于 1954 年，是梅普尔顿镇仅存的六座
钢桁架桥之一，其中五座是小型桁架桥。除了亚麻桥，这组矮小的桁架桥包括: Mallet 河，西蒙的，穆尔菲
尔德，博斯沃思和罗斯塞桥，所有这些桥都建于 1949 年和 1954 年之间，除了 Mallet 河桥，建于 1910 年。
穆尔菲尔德大桥和亚麻大桥在外观和尺寸上非常相似，是同一年由惠灵顿县的同一批工作人员建造的。
This steel pony truss bridge was constructed for the County of Wellington by contractor A.H. MacLellan and
County Engineer, W.H. Keith. Both are credited with working on many other truss bridges in the County. The Flax
Bridge is set above the floodplain and has concrete railings on the north ends of the bridge.
这座钢制小马桁架桥是由承包商 A.H.MacLellan 和郡工程师 W.H.Keith 为惠灵顿郡建造的。他们都被认为是
该县其他许多桁架桥的建造者。亚麻桥位于泛滥平原之上，桥的北端有混凝土栏杆。

General Description
一般描述
The Emerson Simmons Bridge is located on County Road 11 (Wellington Street), 0.20 km north of Wellington County
Road 8 in the community of Drayton. It was constructed in 1952 and is one of six remaining steel truss bridges in the
Township of Mapleton, five of which are pony trusses. In addition to the Emerson Simmons Bridge, the group of pony
truss bridges includes: Mallet River, Bosworth, Flax, Moorefield and Rothsay Bridges, all of which were constructed
between 1949 and 1954, with the exception of the Mallet River Bridge, which was constructed in 1910.
爱默生西蒙斯大桥位于威灵顿县 11 号公路(威灵顿街) ，威灵顿县 8 号公路以北 0.20 公里处的德雷顿社区。它建
于 1952 年，是梅普尔顿镇仅存的六座钢桁架桥之一，其中五座是小型桁架桥。除了爱默生西蒙斯大桥之外，小
马桁架桥还包括: Mallet River，Bosworth，Flax，Moorefield 和 Rothsay 大桥，所有这些桥都是在 1949 年至 1954
年间建造的，只有 Mallet River 大桥是在 1910 年建造的。
This two-span steel pony truss bridge was constructed for the County of Wellington by contractor A.H. MacLellan
and County Engineer, W.H. Keith, both of which are credited with working on many other truss bridges in the
County. The bridge is set at a 45 degree skew, and is unique for its double truss, required to span the Conestogo
River. The steel used for most truss bridges in Ontario was sourced from the United States, however, “ALGOMA
CANADA” is pressed in the bridge’s steel girders. This indicates that the material was sourced in Canada from
Algoma Steel, a company founded in 1902 and located on the St. Marys River in Sault Ste. Marie, ON.
这座两跨钢小马桁架桥是由承包商 a.h. 麦克莱伦和郡工程师 w.h. 基思为惠灵顿郡建造的，他们两人都曾在
该郡建造过许多其他桁架桥。这座桥的倾斜度为 45 度，其独特之处在于它的双桁架结构，需要跨越
Conestogo 河。安大略省大多数桁架桥使用的钢材来自美国，然而，“加拿大阿尔戈马”被压在桥梁的钢梁
上。这表明这些材料来自加拿大 Algoma 钢铁公司，该公司成立于 1902 年，位于安大略省索尔特圣玛丽的
圣玛丽河畔。
The bridge was dedicated to Emerson Simmons to “commemorate long and distinguished service as a bridge foreman.”
The Simmons Bridge underwent repairs in 1993, and included a deck replacement and installation of guide rails.
这座桥是献给爱默生 · 西蒙斯的，以“纪念作为桥梁工头长期卓越的服务”西蒙斯大桥在 1993 年进行了维修，包
括更换桥面和安装导轨。

General Description
一般描述
The Bosworth Bridge is located on County Road 7, 0.90 km east of Wellington County Road 11 in the community
of Bosworth. It was constructed in 1949 and is one of six remaining steel truss bridges in the Township of Mapleton,
five of which are pony trusses. In addition to the Bosworth Bridge, the group of pony truss bridges includes: Mallet
River, Simmon’s, Flax, Moorefield and Rothsay Bridges, all of which were constructed between 1949 and 1954,
with the exception of the Mallet River Bridge, which was constructed in 1910.
博斯沃思大桥位于威灵顿县道 11 以东 0.90 公里的 7 号县道上，位于博斯沃思社区。它建于 1949 年，是梅
普尔顿镇仅存的六座钢桁架桥之一，其中五座是小型桁架桥。除了博斯沃思大桥，小马桁架桥还包括:
Mallet River，simon’s，Flax，Moorefield 和 Rothsay 大桥，所有这些桥都是在 1949 年至 1954 年间建造的，
除了 1910 年建造的 Mallet River 大桥。
This steel Howe camelback pony truss bridge was constructed by the Hamilton Bridge Company Ltd. for the County
of Wellington. This company was established in 1872 and responsible for the fabrication and erection of many steel
bridges in Ontario. Nearly all of the steel for bridges made by this company came from producers in the United
States. Contractor A.H. MacLellan and County Engineer, W.H. Keith, are credited with working on this bridge and
many other truss bridges in the County. The Bosworth Bridge underwent repairs in 1987.
这座钢铁豪斯驼背小马桁架桥是由汉密尔顿桥有限公司为惠灵顿郡建造的。这家公司成立于 1872 年，负责
安大略省许多钢桥的制造和安装。这家公司生产的几乎所有桥梁用钢都来自美国的生产商。承包商 a.h。
MacLellan 和郡工程师 w.h。 Keith 因为在这座桥和郡里的许多其他桁架桥上工作而受到赞誉。博斯沃思大
桥在 1987 年进行了维修。

General Description
一般描述
The Mallet River Bridge is located on Sideroad 6, 0.08 km south of Wellington County Road 109. It was
constructed in 1910, making it the oldest steel truss bridge remaining in the Township of Mapleton and one of the
oldest in Wellington County. There are six remaining steel truss bridges in the Township of Mapleton, five of which
are pony trusses. In addition to the Mallet River Bridge, the group of pony truss bridges includes: Bosworth,
Simmon’s, Flax, Moorefield and Rothsay Bridges, all of which were constructed between 1949 and 1954, much
later than the Mallet River Bridge.
Mallet 河大桥位于威灵顿县 109 号公路以南 0.08 公里的 siderroad 6。它建于 1910 年，是梅普尔顿镇现存最
古老的钢桁架桥，也是威灵顿县最古老的桥梁之一。梅普尔顿镇现存的钢桁架桥有 6 座，其中 5 座是小型桁
架。除了 Mallet 河大桥之外，这组矮小的桁架桥还包括: Bosworth，simon’s，Flax，Moorefield 和 Rothsay
大桥，所有这些桥都建于 1949 年至 1954 年之间，比 Mallet 河大桥晚得多。
Aside from its early date of construction, this bridge is unique due to the decorative reinforced concrete railings with
chamfered balustrades found on each end of the trusses. The thin wooden boards used to the set concrete on site
during construction are still visible. The Mallet River Bridge is constructed of steel with a timber deck and is set at a
15 degree skew to the Mallet River.
除了它的早期建设，这座桥是独一无二的，因为装饰钢筋混凝土栏杆与倒角栏杆发现两端的桁架。在施工
过程中，现场用于固定混凝土的薄木板依然清晰可见。Mallet 河大桥是钢结构的，桥面为木质甲板，与
Mallet 河呈 15 度倾斜。
Sources: Burnside Municipal Bridge Inspections, Township of Mapleton, 2010

General Description
一般描述
The Princess Elizabeth Bridge is located on County Road 12, 0.20 km south of Wellington County Road 45 near the
community of Glen Allan. It was constructed in 1947, and is the only remaining steel through truss bridge in the
Township of Mapleton. Set above the floodplain, the bridge has a long span and is visible from all directions in the
surrounding scenic valley of rolling agricultural land. The prominent placement of the Princess Elizabeth Bridge
represents a notable landmark in the rural community.
伊丽莎白公主大桥位于威灵顿县 12 号公路以南 0.20 公里处，靠近格伦艾伦社区。它建于 1947 年，是梅普
尔顿镇仅存的钢结构桁架桥。桥位于洪泛平原之上，跨度很长，从周围起伏的农田景色山谷的各个方向都
可以看到。伊丽莎白公主大桥的显著位置代表了农村社区的一个著名的地标。
The bridge is a steel Pratt camelback through truss with a concrete deck and abutments. It was constructed by the
Hamilton Bridge Company Ltd., a company established in 1872 and responsible for the fabrication and erection of many
steel bridges in Ontario. Nearly all of the steel for bridges made by this company came from producers in the United
States. However, “ALGOMA, CANADA” is pressed in some of the bridge’s steel girders, indicating the Canadian
sourcing of steel. Algoma Steel, founded in 1902 was located on the St. Marys River in Sault Ste. Marie, ON.
“BETHLEHEM, USA” is also pressed into the steel girders of the Princess Elizabeth Bridge, indicating that the Hamil-ton
Bridge Company Ltd., more traditionally, sourced steel from the United States. The Bethlehem Steel Corporation, based in
Bethlehem, Pennsylvania, was the second largest producer of steel in the US, and also had a factory in Buffalo.
这座桥是钢制的 Pratt 驼背式桁架，桥面和桥台是混凝土结构。它由汉密尔顿桥有限公司建造，该公司成立于
1872 年，负责安大略省许多钢桥的制造和安装。这家公司生产的几乎所有桥梁用钢都来自美国的生产商。然而，
“ ALGOMA，CANADA”在一些大桥的钢梁上被压制，这表明加拿大的钢材来源。Algoma 钢铁公司成立于 1902
年，位于安大略省索尔特圣玛丽(sault ste.marie)的圣玛丽河畔。“伯利恒，美国”也被压入到伊丽莎白公主大桥
的钢梁，表明汉密尔顿大桥有限公司，更传统的来源于美国的钢铁。总部位于宾夕法尼亚州伯利恒的伯利恒钢铁
公司是美国第二大钢铁生产商，在布法罗也有一家工厂。
Sources: County of Wellington, 2007 Bridge Appraisals

General Description
一般描述
Bridge PB024 is located on Sideroad 17, 1.3 km south of 4th Line. It was constructed circa 1920 and represents one
of only two remaining concrete bowstring arch bridges in the Township of Mapleton, paired with the nearby Bridge
PB025. At one time, 36 concrete bowstring arch bridges were found in Wellington County. The bowstring design
was popular during this period as it required minimal material, was simple to install, represented newer construction
materials and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic.
Pb024 桥位于第四线以南 1.3 公里的 17 号侧道上。它建于 1920 年左右，是梅普尔顿镇仅存的两座混凝土弓
弦拱桥之一，与附近的 pb025桥配对。曾经，在威灵顿县发现了 36 座混凝土拱桥。弓弦设计在这一时期很
受欢迎，因为它只需要最少的材料，安装简单，代表了新的建筑材料，并且可以很容易地容纳车辆。
Charles Mattaini, a local bridge builder who immigrated to Canada from northern Italy, is likely responsible for the
design and/or construction of this bridge. In Italy, bowstring bridges were common and Mattaini studied their design
and how to work with cement. He is credited with bringing the bowstring design to southern Ontario where he
constructed many of these bridges in Wellington County between 1903 and 1929.
从意大利北部移民到加拿大的当地桥梁建造者 Charles Mattaini 很可能负责这座桥的设计和/或建造。在意大
利，弓弦桥很常见，Mattaini 研究了它们的设计以及如何使用水泥。他被认为是将弓弦设计带到了南安大略，
1903 年至 1929 年间，他在威灵顿县建造了许多这样的桥梁。
While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among all the bowstring truss structures in Wellington County.
Bridge PB024 is set quite high above the floodplain and because it spans across a narrow stream, it is relatively
small with shorter concrete arches. It displays decorative concrete balustrades and chamfered posts that flank each
arch. Vegetation has built up on the sides of the bridge, however it remains open to vehicular traffic.
作为一种基本类型，在威灵顿县所有的弓弦桁架结构中有着相当大的差异。Pb024桥位于洪泛平原之上，因
为它跨越一条狭窄的河流，所以它相对较小，混凝土拱门较短。它展示了装饰性的混凝土栏杆和每个拱侧
面的倒角柱子。桥的两侧已经长满了植被，但是它仍然对车辆开放。

General Description
一般描述
Bridge PB025 is located on Sideroad 18, 0.13 km north of 3rd Line. It was constructed circa 1920 and represents
one of only two remaining concrete bowstring arch bridges in the Township of Mapleton, paired with the nearby
Bridge PB024. At one time, 36 concrete bowstring arch bridges were found in Wellington County. The bowstring
design was popular during this period as it required minimal material, was simple to install, represented newer
construction materials and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic.
Pb025 大桥位于第三线以北 0.13 公里的 18 号侧道上。它建于 1920 年左右，是梅普尔顿镇仅存的两座混凝土
弓弦拱桥之一，与附近的 pb024桥配对。曾经，在威灵顿县发现了 36 座混凝土拱桥。弓弦设计在这一时期
很受欢迎，因为它只需要最少的材料，安装简单，代表了新的建筑材料，并且可以很容易地容纳车辆。
Charles Mattaini, a local bridge builder who immigrated to Canada from northern Italy, is likely responsible for the
design and/or construction of this bridge. In Italy, bowstring bridges were common and Mattaini studied their design
and how to work with cement. He is credited with bringing the bowstring design to southern Ontario where he
constructed many of these bridges in Wellington County between 1903 and 1929.
从意大利北部移民到加拿大的当地桥梁建造者 Charles Mattaini 很可能负责这座桥的设计和/或建造。在意大
利，弓弦桥很常见，Mattaini 研究了它们的设计以及如何使用水泥。他被认为是将弓弦设计带到了南安大略，
1903 年至 1929 年间，他在威灵顿县建造了许多这样的桥梁。
While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among all the bowstring truss structures in Wellington County.
Bridge PB025 is set roughly 15 feet (5m) above the floodplain on tall abutments due to the bridge’s location on a
hill. It displays decorative concrete balustrades and chamfered posts that flank each arch. The thin boards that were
used to set the cement on site left marks still visible in the cement.
作为一种基本类型，在威灵顿县所有的弓弦桁架结构中有着相当大的差异。由于桥位于山上，pb025桥位于
洪泛区上方约 15 英尺(5 米)的高桥墩上。它展示了装饰性的混凝土栏杆和每个拱门两侧的倒角柱子。用来固
定现场水泥的薄板在水泥中留下的痕迹依然清晰可见。

General Description
一般描述
The Glen Allan Bridge remnants are located on Old County Road 45, north of the current Glen Allan Bridge. The
abutments, set high above the flood plain, indicate the alignment that County Road 45 once took. Constructed in
1915, it was a Pratt camelback through truss with an usual offset and a concrete balustrade approach. It was
demolished in 2006, but both abutments and railings on the west side were retained.
格伦艾伦大桥的残骸位于 45 号老县道现在的格伦艾伦大桥以北。位于洪泛平原上方的桥墩表明了 45 号县道
曾经走过的路线。它建于 1915 年，是一个普拉特驼背式通过桁架与通常的偏移和混凝土栏杆的方法。它在
2006 年被拆除，但是西侧的桥墩和栏杆都被保留了下来。
The abutments constructed of concrete and masonry line the edges that face the Conestogo River. The names of the
municipal officials, designer and builders responsible for the bridge are impressed into the reinforced concrete
railings. The south side engravings read: Glen Allan Bridge, JNO. Tilker. Contractor, Harriston. JNO. Armstrong,
Inspector, Bowman & Connor Engineers, Toronto & Berlin, Ont. The north side engravings read: LM Young
Harriston, County Road Supt, E Box Warren, Arthur, Stickney, Reeve, Drayton, A B M Collican, Dep Reeve, Peel,
County Wellington Ontario.
用混凝土和砖石建造的桥墩沿着 Conestogo 河的边缘排列。负责大桥的市政官员、设计师和建造者的名字印
在钢筋混凝土栏杆上。南侧的铭文写着: Glen Allan Bridge，JNO。蒂尔克。承包商，哈里斯顿。乔纳森。
Armstrong，Inspector，Bowman & Connor Engineers，Toronto & Berlin，Ont 阿姆斯特朗，鲍曼 & 康纳工程
师，多伦多 & 柏林，安大略省。北面的版画上写着: LM Young Harriston 县道路监督，e Box Warren Arthur
Stickney Reeve Drayton 一个 b m Collican 副 Reeve Peel 安大略威灵顿郡。
The engineers that worked on this bridge formed the firm of Bowman & Connor between 1905 and 1909, with
offices in Toronto and Berlin (Kitchener). The firm became a prolific and well-known bridge engineering company
in Wellington County in the early 20th century.
在这座桥上工作的工程师们在 1905 年至 1909 年间成立了 Bowman & Connor 公司，在多伦多和柏林设有办
事处(Kitchener)。20 世纪早期，这家公司在威灵顿县成为了一家多产且知名的桥梁工程公司。
The Glen Allan Bridge’s elaborately designed, grand concrete balustrade approach made it unique in the Grand
River watershed. Although the bridge is no longer intact, the remaining abutments and balustrade contribute to a
cultural heritage landscape in the historic community of Glen Allan.
格伦艾伦大桥精心设计的宏伟的混凝土栏杆方式使其在格兰德河流域独树一帜。尽管这座桥不再完好无损
但其余的桥墩和栏杆为 Glen Allan 历史社区的文化遗产景观做出了贡献。
Sources: GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory

General Description
一般描述
Township of Mapleton Bridge MB009 is located on Sideroad 15, 0.22 km north of Concession 8. It was constructed
in 1958 and belongs to a grouping of early T-beam bridges built in the Township of Mapleton during the 1940s and
1950s. This group includes bridges PB001, PB016 and PB019. Like this bridge, they each display an early
experimentation with concrete. The thin board marks used to set the concrete on site are still visible. This bridge has
concrete railings and a plaque commemorating those responsible for its construction. It was built by contractor L.M.
Arnott and County Engineer, W.H. Keith, who is credited with working on many bridges in Wellington County.
梅普尔顿桥镇 mb009位于特许经营权 8 以北 0.22 公里的锡德路 15 号。它建于 1958 年，属于 1940 年代和
1950 年代在梅普尔顿建造的一组早期 t 型梁桥。这个小组包括桥梁 PB001，pb016和 PB019。和这座桥一样，
它们都展示了早期的混凝土实验。现场用来固定混凝土的薄板标记仍然清晰可见。这座桥有混凝土栏杆和
一块牌匾，用来纪念那些负责建造它的人。它是由承包商 l.m. Arnott 和郡工程师 w.h. Keith 建造的，他在威
灵顿县修建了许多桥梁。
Despite the widespread use of T-beam structures in the United States from the 1920s to the 1960s, there was a more
limited use of this bridge type within Ontario. The concrete rigid frame, introduced in Ontario in the 1930s,
continued to be the dominant form of bridge construction in the province during the 1950s when pre-stressed precast
concrete beam and post-tension cast-in-place structures were introduced in the 1960s.
尽管从 20 世纪 20 年代到 60 年代，t 型梁结构在美国得到了广泛的应用，但在安大略省，这种桥型的应用却
比较有限。20世纪 30 年代在安大略省引进的混凝土刚架，在 20 世纪 60 年代引进预应力混凝土预制梁和后
张法现浇结构后，继续成为该省桥梁建设的主要形式。
Sources: Burnside Municipal Bridge Inspections, Township of Mapleton, 2010

梅普尔顿桥镇 pb001位于西德路 17 号，威灵顿县 109 号公路以南 0.4 公里。它建于 1950 年左右，属于 1940 年代

Despite the widespread use of T-beam structures in the United States from the 1920s to the 1960s, there was a more

continued to be the dominant form of bridges in the province during the 1950s when pre-stressed precast concrete
beam and post-tension cast-in-place structures were introduced in the 1960s.

General Description
一般描述
Concession 14 Bridge is located roughly 15 m south of Concession 14, and aligned parallel to the road, just east of
Wellington Road 11. It was constructed circa 1930 and is estimated to be one of the earliest solid slab bridges in the
Township of Mapleton.
特许经营权 14 桥位于特许经营权 14 以南约 15 米处，与公路平行，就在惠灵顿公路 11 以东。它建于 1930
年左右，估计是梅普尔顿镇最早的实心板桥之一。
This bridge has been abandoned for a long period of time and is located on private property. As a result, there is
little relevant information available. The large stones in the concrete and the impression of thin board marks used to
set the concrete on site indicate that it is an early structure. Only one portion on the concrete railings remain,
depicting decorative chamfered balustrades with embossed circles. This bridge is slightly skewed and it is likely that
at one time it carried the previous alignment of Concession 14.
这座桥已经废弃了很长一段时间，位于私人财产。因此，几乎没有可用的相关信息。混凝土中巨大的石头
和用来在现场固定混凝土的薄板标记的印记表明这是一个早期的结构。混凝土栏杆上只有一部分保留下来
描绘了带有浮雕圆圈的装饰性倒角栏杆。这座桥稍微有点倾斜，很可能曾经是 14 号特许经营权的一部分。

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 2-WG is located on Third Line, 1.3 km north of Eramosa-West Garafraxa Townline. It
was constructed in 1921 and belongs to a grouping of early half-through girder bridges built in the Township during
the 1920s. This group includes Centre Wellington bridges 8-WG, 5-E, 5-P and 30-P. Like this bridge, they each
display an early experimentation with concrete, which has resulted in decorative concrete railings with a solid centre
portion and balustrades on each side. The thin boards used to set the concrete on site during construction left
imprints that are still visible. This bridge is the most decorative out of the group. Portions of the bridge are in poor
condition, however, it is better preserved than the others in its group.
中威灵顿桥 2-wg 位于 Eramosa-West Garafraxa Townline 以北 1.3 公里的第三条线路上。它建于 1921 年，属
于 1920 年代在该镇建造的一组早期中承式梁桥。这组桥包括中威灵顿乡的 8-wg，5-E，5-P 和 30-p 桥。和
这座桥一样，他们每个人都展示了早期的混凝土实验，这导致了装饰性的混凝土栏杆有一个坚实的中心部
分和两边的栏杆。在施工过程中，用来将混凝土固定在现场的薄板留下了仍然可见的印记。这座桥是整个
建筑群中最具装饰性的。桥的一部分状况很差，但是它比其他的保存得更好。

General Description
一般描述
Old Fourth Line Bridge is located on private property approximately 50 m south of Centre Wellington Bridge 3-WG on
Fourth Line, just north of Eramosa-West Garafraxa Townline. It was constructed in 1908 and is the oldest concrete bridge
in the Grand River watershed. It is one of only two remaining earth-filled concrete arch bridges in the Township, along
with Centre Wellington Bridge 12-N. The Rutherford Family has lived on this property since 1857. They housed the
builder, last name Laurie, and his team on their farm while the bridge was being constructed in 1908.
老第四线大桥位于私人财产约 50 米以南的中威灵顿乡大桥 3-wg 在第四线，刚刚北部的 Eramosa-West Garafraxa
Townline。它建于 1908 年，是格兰德河流域最古老的混凝土桥梁。它是中威灵顿乡仅存的两座填土混凝土拱桥之
一，另外还有中威灵顿桥 12-n。卢瑟福一家从 1857 年起就住在这里。在 1908 年大桥建造期间，他们把建筑商劳
里和他的团队安置在他们的农场里。
Earth filling of early concrete arches such as this was typically used for small spans. They were filled with earth,
rocks and or other types of fill, and the spandrel walls served as retaining walls. Local earth was used to fill this
bridge, and the approaches were built with hand scrapers and concrete mixed by hand. Engravings are found on top
of the railings that list the names of local councilor “Alfred Bailey” and “Jim Campbell, Reeve” along with the
construction date of “1908.”
像这样的早期混凝土拱的填土通常用于小跨度。他们填充土，岩石和或其他类型的填料，和拱肩墙作为挡
土墙。当地的泥土被用来填充这座桥，通道是用手工刮板和混凝土混合而成的。在栏杆顶部发现了雕刻，
上面写着当地议员“阿尔弗雷德 · 贝利”和“吉姆 · 坎贝尔 · 里夫”的名字，还有“1908”的建造日期
Most of the early activity in concrete bridge construction in Ontario focused on the earth-filled, solid spandrel arch
form. The main construction period between 1905-1919 for solid spandrel arch bridges in Ontario was a relatively
short time span of 14 years. This bridge type gained in popularity because they were easy and inexpensive to build.
Many of these early 20th century earth-filled concrete arches have been removed from the Province’s roads because
they are too narrow to meet modern traffic needs. This was the case for the Old Fourth Line Bridge, which was
abandoned after Fourth Line was rerouted around 1950. As a result, solid spandrel concrete arch bridges in active
use are now considered rare survivors.
在安大略省，大部分早期的混凝土桥梁建造活动都集中在填土的实心拱肋形式上。1905-1919 年间，安大略
省实心拱桥的主要施工阶段是相对较短的 14 年。这种桥型之所以受到欢迎，是因为它们建造起来既简单又
便宜。许多这种 20 世纪早期的混凝土拱门已经从该省的道路上拆除，因为它们太窄，不能满足现代交通的
需要。旧的四线大桥就是这种情况，在 1950 年左右四线改道后就被废弃了。因此，现在活跃使用的实心拱
肋混凝土拱桥被认为是罕见的幸存者。
The property owners purchased the bridge from the Township for $1 in 1978 and it remains abandoned on their
property.
1978 年，业主们以 1 美元的价格从该镇购买了这座桥，现在这座桥仍然被遗弃在他们的土地上。

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 4-WG is located on Fifth Line, 0.6 km south of Wellington Road 18. It was constructed in
1923 and is one of only seven remaining concrete bowstring arch bridges built in the Township of Centre
Wellington from roughly 1915 to 1930. At one time, 36 concrete bowstring arch bridges were found in Welling-ton
County, with a high concentration in Centre Wellington. The bowstring design was popular during this period as it
required minimal material, was simple to install, represented newer construction materials and could easily
accommodate vehicular traffic.
中威灵顿桥 4-工作组位于第五线，0.6 公里以南的威灵顿路 18 号。它建于 1923 年，是大约从 1915 年到
1930 年在中威灵顿乡仅存的七座混凝土弓弦拱桥之一。Wellington 县曾经发现过 36 座混凝土拱桥，其中
wellington 中威灵顿乡的混凝土拱桥最为集中。弓弦设计在这一时期非常流行，因为它只需要很少的材料，
安装简单，代表了较新的建筑材料，并且可以很容易地容纳车辆。
Charles Mattaini, a local bridge builder who immigrated to Canada from northern Italy, is likely responsible for the
design and/or construction of this bridge. In Italy, bowstring bridges were common and Mattaini studied their design
and how to work with cement. He is credited with bringing the bowstring design to southern Ontario where he
constructed many of these bridges in Wellington County between 1903 and 1929.
从意大利北部移民到加拿大的当地桥梁建造者 Charles Mattaini 很可能负责这座桥的设计和/或建造。在意大
利，弓弦桥很常见，Mattaini 研究了它们的设计以及如何使用水泥。他被认为是将弓弦设计带到了南安大略，
1903 年至 1929 年间，他在威灵顿县建造了许多这样的桥梁。
While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among all the bowstring truss structures in Wellington County.
虽然是一种基本类型，但在威灵顿县所有的弓弦桁架结构中存在着相当大的差异。
Centre Wellington Bridge 4-WG, because it spans across a small stream, is relatively small with shorter concrete arches.
中威灵顿乡威灵顿桥 4-wg，因为它跨越一条小溪，相对较小，混凝土拱较短。
It displays decorative concrete balustrades and chamfered posts that flank each arch.
它展示了装饰性的混凝土栏杆和每个拱门两侧的倒角柱子。
Sources: Pat Mestern, 2012
来源: Pat Mestern，2012
David Cuming, Discovering Heritage Bridges on Ontario Roads, 1983

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 8-WG is located on Seventh Line, 0.4 km south of Sideroad 25. It was constructed in
1925 and belongs to a grouping of early half-through girder bridges built in the Township of Centre Wellington
during the 1920s. This group includes Centre Wellington bridges 2-WG, 5-P, 30-P and 5-E. Like this bridge, they
each display an early experimentation with concrete, which has resulted in decorative concrete railings with a solid
centre portion and balustrades on each side. The thin boards used to set the concrete on site during construction left
imprints that are still visible. This bridge is unique to the group as it has the longest span and is skewed to the river.
Portions of the bridge are in very poor condition and some balustrades are missing.
中威灵顿乡大桥 8-wg 位于第七线，siderroad 25 以南 0.4 公里。它建于 1925 年，属于 1920 年代在中威灵顿
乡建造的一组早期中承式梁桥。这组桥包括中威灵顿乡的 2-wg，5-P，30-P 和 5-e 桥。和这座桥一样，他们
每个人都展示了早期的混凝土实验，这导致了装饰性的混凝土栏杆有一个坚实的中心部分和两边的栏杆。
在施工过程中，用来将混凝土固定在现场的薄板留下了仍然可见的印记。这座桥是这个小组的独特之处，
因为它有着最长的跨度，并且是斜向河流的。桥的一部分状况很差，一些栏杆也不见了。

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 9-WG is located on Seventh Line, 1 km north of Sideroad 20. It was constructed in 1925
and belongs to a small grouping of early concrete arch bridges built in the Township of Centre Wellington in the
first quarter of the 1900s. This group includes Centre Wellington bridges 16-WG, 12-N and Old Fourth Line Bridge.
This bridge has a concrete cast-in-place deck, and a comparatively tall arch. The thin boards used to set the concrete
on site during construction are still visible. Arthur Tedqurck (spelling unconfirmed) is believed to have been the
engineer responsible for this bridge.
中威灵顿乡大桥 9-wg 位于第七线，siderroad 20 以北 1 公里。它建于 1925 年，属于 1900 年代第一季度在中
威灵顿乡建造的一小批早期混凝土拱桥。这个群体包括中威灵顿乡的 16-wg 桥，12-N 桥和老四线桥。这座
桥有一个现浇混凝土桥面和一个相对较高的拱门。在施工过程中用来固定混凝土的薄板仍然清晰可见
Arthur Tedqurck (拼写未经证实)被认为是负责这座桥的工程师。
Many of these early 20th century concrete arches have been removed from the Province’s roads because they are too
narrow to meet modern traffic needs. As a result, solid spandrel concrete arch bridges in active use, such as Centre
Wellington Bridge 9-WG, are now considered rare survivors.
许多 20 世纪早期的混凝土拱门已经从该省的道路上拆除，因为它们太窄，不能满足现代交通的需要。因此，
实心拱肋混凝土拱桥在积极使用，如中威灵顿乡大桥 9-wg，现在被认为是罕见的幸存者。

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 16-WG is located on Fifth Line, 0.73 km north of Wellington Road 19. It was constructed
circa 1910 and belongs to a small grouping of early concrete arch bridges built in the Township of Centre
Wellington in the first quarter of the 1900s. This group includes Centre Wellington bridges 9-WG, 12-N and Old
Fourth Line Bridge. This bridge has a concrete cast-in-place deck, and the thin boards used to set the concrete on
site during construction have left very visible imprints.
中威灵顿桥 16-wg 位于威灵顿路 19 号以北 0.73 公里的第五条线上。它建于 1910 年左右，属于 1900 年代第
一季度在中威灵顿乡建造的一小批早期混凝土拱桥。这组桥包括中威灵顿乡的 9-wg 桥、12-N 桥和老四线
桥。这座桥有一个现浇混凝土的桥面，在施工过程中用来固定混凝土的薄板留下了非常明显的痕迹。
Arched bridges are one of the oldest bridge forms and are very efficient at supporting large loads over a long period of
time. Most of the early activity in concrete bridge construction in Ontario focused on the solid spandrel arch form. This
bridge type gained in popularity because they were easy and inexpensive to build. However, the popularity of solid
spandrel bridges appears to have declined after 1919. Many of these early 20th century concrete arches have been re-
moved from the Province’s roads because they are too narrow to meet modern traffic needs. As a result, solid spandrel
concrete arch bridges in active use, such as Centre Wellington Bridge 16-WG, are now considered rare survivors.
拱桥是最古老的桥梁形式之一，能够有效地承受长时间的大荷载。在安大略省，大多数早期的混凝土桥梁建设活
动都集中在实心拱肋形式上。这种桥型之所以受到欢迎，是因为它们建造起来既简单又便宜。然而，1919年以后，
实心拱桥的流行程度似乎有所下降。许多 20 世纪早期的混凝土拱门已经从该省的道路上拆除，因为它们太窄，
不能满足现代交通的需要。因此，实心拱肋混凝土拱桥在积极使用，如中威灵顿乡大桥 16-wg，现在被认为是罕
见的幸存者。

General Description

Centre Wellington Bridge 21-WG crosses Irvine Creek and allows passage

along First Line just west
沿着第一线向西
of Sideroad 15 within the former Township of West Garafraxa. Built in 1929, it represents a prominent landmark in
the area and is one of seven surviving concrete bowstring trusses in the Township of Centre Wellington. Although
this bridge type is found across Ontario, the Township of Centre Wellington has been noted for its especially large
collection. Centre Wellington Bridge 21-WG is similar to a group of prominent bowstring arch bridges that included
the Gibson Bridge, Shiloh Bridge, Hogan’s Bridge, Cox Creek Bridge, Stirton Bridge, Cheese Factory Bridge and
McDougall’s Bridge. Due to structural concerns and subsequent replacement, only the Shiloh and Gibson Bridges
remain from this group of Wellington County bowstring trusses.
Sideroad 15 号公路，位于前西 Garafraxa 镇内。它建于 1929 年，是该地区一个著名的地标性建筑，是中威
灵顿乡现存的七个混凝土弓弦桁架之一。尽管这种桥型可以在安大略省找到，但中威灵顿乡以其特别大的
收藏而闻名。中威灵顿乡大桥 21-wg 类似于一组著名的弓弦拱桥，包括吉布森大桥，夏洛大桥，霍根大桥，

The single lane and one-and-a-half lane concrete bowstring trusses of Wellington County are unique to the

The reinforced concrete bowstring arch bridge design was popular as it required minimal material,

This bridge has a length of 19.2 feet (5.8m), with one span with eight stringers. One-and-a-half lanes can cross the

characteristically tall and steep, and connected by a cross-tie beam because it arches across the Irvine Creek, a wider
watercourse. The construction date is likely pressed in the concrete on the centre of the cross tie, which is covered
by a height clearance sign.

General Description
一般描述
The Gibson Bridge was designed and engineered by Bowman and Connor, and constructed by C. Mattaini, Construction.
Replacing a wooden bridge, it was completed in 1917 at an estimated cost of $2,595. It represents the earliest tied
bowstring arch bridge in the Township of Centre Wellington and reflects the existence of relatively well-organized public
administrative bodies. The bridge’s bowstring design was popular in the 1920s and 1930s as it required minimal material,
was simple to install, represented newer construction materials and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic.
吉布森大桥由鲍曼和康纳设计和设计，由马泰尼建筑公司建造。它取代了一座木桥，于 1917 年竣工，估计耗资
2595 美元。它是中威灵顿乡最早的系杆拱桥，反映了相对组织良好的公共行政机构的存在。该桥的弓弦设计在
20 世纪 20 年代和 30 年代很流行，因为它只需要最少的材料，安装简单，代表了较新的建筑材料，可以很容易地
容纳车辆交通。
Charles Mattaini, a local bridge builder who immigrated to Canada from northern Italy, is responsible for the design and
construction of this bridge. In Italy, bowstring bridges were common and Mattaini studied their design and how to work
with cement. He is credited with bringing the bowstring design to southern Ontario where he constructed many of these
bridges in Wellington County between 1903 and 1929.
从意大利北部移民到加拿大的当地桥梁建造者 Charles Mattaini 负责这座桥的设计和建造。在意大利，弓弦桥很常
见，Mattaini 研究了它们的设计以及如何使用水泥。他被认为是将弓弦设计带到了南安大略，1903 年至 1929 年间，
他在威灵顿县建造了许多这样的桥梁。
While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among all the bowstring truss structures in Wellington County. The
Gibson Bridge, because it arches across the Irvine Creek, a wider watercourse, is characteristically tall and steep,
connected by a single prominent cross-tie inscribed with its date of construction. It has a length of 24.3 meters, with one
span. One-and-a-half lanes cross the structure, which is a unique characteristic of this group of bridges. The bridge has
chamfered balustrades with decorative circles pressed into the concrete on each side of the arch.
虽然是一种基本类型，但在威灵顿县所有的弓弦桁架结构中存在着相当大的差异。吉布森大桥，因为它横跨欧文
河，一个更广泛的水道，是典型的高和陡峭，由一个显着的十字连接铭刻着它的建设日期。桥长 24.3 米，单跨。
一个半车道横跨结构，这是这组桥梁的独特特征。这座桥有倒角栏杆，拱门两侧的混凝土上嵌有装饰性的圆圈。
The Gibson Bridge is a prominent landmark in the Township of Centre Wellington (West Garafraxa) as it is one of very
few surviving concrete bowstring trusses in Wellington County. Although this bridge type is found across Ontario, the
Township of Centre Wellington has been noted for its especially large collection, of which only seven now remain. The
Gibson Bridge was originally constructed as a group of 36 concrete bowstring trusses in the County that were erected in
the same time period and designed in a similar style. This group of bridges represented the upgrading of the transportation
networks that occurred in Ontario after World War I to accommodate an increased number and weight of newer
automobiles. The group included the Shiloh Bridge, Hogan’s Bridge, Cox Creek Bridge, Stirton Bridge, Cheese Factory
Bridge and McDougall’s Bridge. Due to structural concerns and subsequent replacement, only the Shiloh and Gibson
Bridges remain from this group of Wellington County bowstring trusses. The Gibson Bridge
吉布森大桥是威灵顿中威灵顿乡(West Garafraxa)的一个著名地标，因为它是威灵顿县仅存的几个混凝土弓弦桁架
之一。虽然这种桥型在安大略省各地都能找到，但中威灵顿乡以其特别大的收藏而闻名，现在只剩下七座。吉布
森大桥最初是由该县 36 个混凝土弓弦桁架组成的，这些桁架是在同一时期竖立起来的，设计风格类似。这组桥
梁代表了第一次世界大战后安大略省交通网络的升级，以适应新型汽车数量和重量的增加。这个小组包括夏洛大
桥、霍根大桥、考克斯溪大桥、 Stirton 大桥、奶酪工厂大桥和 McDougall 大桥。由于结构问题和随后的更换，只
有夏洛和吉布森桥留在这组威灵顿县弓弦桁架。吉布森大桥
is included on the Ontario Heritage Bridge List.
被列入安大略省文物桥梁名录。

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 27-WG is located 0.75 km west of Sixth Line on Sideroad 20, which skews to
accommodate the alignment of the bridge. It was constructed in 1918, making it one of the earliest of its type in
Wellington County. The bridge is one of only seven remaining concrete bowstring arch bridges built in the
Township of Centre Wellington from roughly 1915 to 1930. At one time, 36 concrete bowstring arch bridges were
found in Wellington County, with a high concentration in Centre Wellington. The bowstring design was popular
during this period as it required minimal material, was simple to install, represented newer construction materials
and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic.
中威灵顿乡大桥 27-wg 位于第六线以西 0.75 公里的 20 号侧道上，它倾斜以适应大桥的线路。它建于 1918
年，是威灵顿县最早的桥梁之一。这座桥是 1915 年至 1930 年间在中威灵顿乡仅存的七座混凝土弓弦拱桥之
一。曾经在威灵顿县发现了 36 座混凝土弓弦拱桥，高度集中在中威灵顿乡。弓弦设计在这一时期很受欢迎，
因为它只需要最少的材料，安装简单，代表了新的建筑材料，并且可以很容易地容纳车辆。
Charles Mattaini, a local bridge builder who immigrated to Canada from northern Italy, is likely responsible for the
design and construction of this bridge. In Italy, bowstring bridges were common and Mattaini studied their design
and how to work with cement. He is credited with bringing the bowstring design to southern Ontario where he
constructed many of these bridges in Wellington County between 1903 and 1929.
从意大利北部移民到加拿大的当地桥梁建造者 Charles Mattaini 很可能负责这座桥的设计和建造。在意大利，
弓弦桥很常见，Mattaini 研究了它们的设计以及如何使用水泥。他被认为将弓弦设计带到了南安大略，在那
里，他在 1903 年至 1929 年间在威灵顿县建造了许多这样的桥梁。
While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among all the bowstring truss structures in Wellington County.
Centre Wellington Bridge 27-WG is a relatively average size overall, with other bridges of its type being found both
larger and smaller. The imprints of wooden boards used to set the concrete on site are still visible on the bridge. It
displays concrete balustrades imprinted with decorative circles and chamfered posts that flank the north side of the
arch.
虽然是一种基本类型，但在威灵顿县所有的弓弦桁架结构中存在着相当大的差异。中威灵顿乡大桥 27-wg
是一个相对平均大小的整体，与其他类型的桥梁被发现既大又小。用于现场浇筑混凝土的木板印记仍然可
以在桥上看到。它展示了印有装饰性圆圈的混凝土栏杆和拱门北侧的倒角柱子。

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 29-WG is located on Sideroad 15, 0.7 km west of Second Line. Built in 1928, it represents a
prominent landmark in the area and is one of seven surviving concrete bowstring trusses in the Township of Centre
Wellington. Although this bridge type is found across Ontario, the Township of Centre Wellington has been noted for its
especially large collection of 36 concrete bowstring arch bridges. Centre Wellington Bridge 29-WG is similar to a group
of prominent bowstring arch bridges that included the Gibson Bridge, Shiloh Bridge, Hogan’s Bridge, Cox Creek Bridge,
Stirton Bridge, Cheese Factory Bridge and McDougall’s Bridge. Due to structural concerns and subsequent replacement,
only the Shiloh and Gibson Bridges remain from this group of Wellington County bowstring trusses.
中威灵顿乡大桥 29-wg 位于第二线以西 0.7 公里的 15 号侧道。它建于 1928 年，是该地区一个著名的地标性建筑，
是中威灵顿乡现存的七个混凝土弓弦桁架之一。尽管这种类型的桥梁在安大略省各地都能找到，但中威灵顿乡以
其特别大的 36 座混凝土弓弦拱桥而闻名。中威灵顿乡大桥 29-wg 类似于一组著名的弓弦拱桥，包括吉布森大桥，
夏洛大桥，霍根大桥，考克斯溪大桥，Stirton 大桥，奶酪工厂大桥和 McDougall 大桥。由于结构问题和随后的更
换，只有夏洛和吉布森桥留在这组威灵顿县弓弦桁架。
The single lane and one-and-a-half lane concrete bowstring trusses of Wellington County are unique to the province
because of their age, style and concentration in numbers. Built primarily in the period from 1915 to 1930, these
struc-tures reflect the transition from horse-drawn vehicles to the new motorized age. The introduction of the
bowstring truss reflects the need to provide a safe and durable structure, capable of withstanding frequent use, heavy
loads and the inevitable scrape or two. The robust concrete bowstring trusses on the rural back roads of Wellington
County illustrate the success of this particular design, which has stood the test of time.
威灵顿县的单车道和一个半车道混凝土弓弦桁架是该省独有的，因为他们的年龄，风格和数量集中。这些
结构主要建于 1915 年至 1930 年间，反映了从马车到新机动化时代的转变。弓弦桁架的引进反映了需要提供
一个安全和耐用的结构，能够经受频繁使用，重负荷和不可避免的刮伤或两个。威灵顿县乡村小路上坚固
的混凝土弓弦桁架说明了这种特殊设计的成功，它经受住了时间的考验。
The reinforced concrete bowstring arch bridge design was popular as it required minimal material, was simple to
install, represented newer construction materials and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic. This bridge has a
length of 22.6m, with one span with eight stringers. One lane can cross the structure, which is a unique characteristic
of this group of bridges. While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among all the bowstring truss structures
in Wellington County. Centre Wellington Bridge 29-WG is characteristically tall and steep, and connected by a
cross-tie beam because it arches across the Irvine Creek, a wider watercourse. The construction date is likely pressed
in the concrete on the centre of the cross tie, which is covered by a height clearance sign.
钢筋混凝土拱桥的设计很受欢迎，因为它需要最少的材料，安装简单，代表了较新的建筑材料，可以很容
易地适应车辆交通。这座桥的长度为 22.6 米，一个跨度有 8 个纵梁。一条车道可以横跨整个结构，这是这
组桥梁的独特之处。作为一种基本类型，在威灵顿县所有的弓弦桁架结构中有着相当大的差异。中威灵顿
乡大桥 29-wg 的特点是高和陡峭，并通过横梁连接，因为它跨越欧文河，一个更广泛的水道拱。施工日期
很可能被压在横梁中央的混凝土中，横梁被高度间隙标志覆盖。
Sources: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 30-WG is located on Sideroad 15, 0.7 km west of Sixth Line. It was constructed in 1942,
mak-ing it the oldest steel through truss bridge in the Township of Centre Wellington. There are five remaining steel
truss bridges in Centre Wellington, three of which are through trusses.
中威灵顿乡大桥 30-wg 位于第六线以西 0.7 公里的 15 号侧道。它建于 1942 年，是中威灵顿乡最古老的钢结
构桁架桥。在中威灵顿乡还有五座钢桁架桥，其中三座是桁架结构。
Centre Wellington Bridge 30-WG is a six-panel rivet-connected Pratt through truss. “USA” is pressed into the
bridges’ steel panels, indicating an American company supplied the steel, however the specific company is
unknown. The bridge is in poor condition and has been closed to the public.
中威灵顿乡大桥 30-wg 是一个由 6 个面板的铆钉连接的 Pratt 贯穿桁架。这座桥的钢板上印有“ USA”字样，
表明是一家美国公司提供的钢材，但具体是哪家公司还不得而知。这座桥状况不佳，已经对公众关闭。

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 1-P is located on Sideroad 5, 0.9 km east of Eighth Line West. It was constructed in 1890;
making it the oldest steel truss bridge remaining in the Township of Centre Wellington. There are five remaining
steel truss bridges in Centre Wellington, and together with the Salem Bridge, Centre Wellington Bridge 1-P is one of
only two remaining pony truss bridges.
中威灵顿乡大桥 1-p 位于第五侧道，距离第八线西部 0.9 公里。它建于 1890 年，是中威灵顿乡现存最古老
的钢桁架桥。在中威灵顿乡还有五座钢桁架桥，和塞勒姆桥一起，中威灵顿 1-p 桥是仅存的两座小型桁架桥
之一。
Aside from its early date of construction and pin jointing, now a rare feature, this bridge is unique due to its
uncharac-teristically short span. The bridge is constructed of steel with a timber deck. It is in poor condition and has
been closed to the public.
除了它的早期建设和销钉连接，现在一个罕见的特点，这座桥是独特的，因为它的非特征性短跨度。这座
桥是用钢铁建造的，桥面是木质的。它的状况很差，并且已经对公众关闭。
Sources: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data
资料来源: 中威灵顿乡 2008 年结构清单数据

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 5-P is located on Weisenberg Road, 0.45 km north of Sideroad 12. It was constructed in
1920 and is the earliest in a grouping of half-through girder bridges built in the Township of Centre Wellington
during the 1920s. This group includes Centre Wellington bridges 2-WG, 8-WG, 30-P and 5-E. Like this bridge, they
each display an early experimentation with concrete, which has resulted in decorative concrete railings with a solid
centre portion and balustrades on each side. The thin boards used to set the concrete on site during construction left
imprints that are still visible.
中威灵顿乡大桥 5-p 位于 Weisenberg 路，siderroad 12 以北 0.45 公里。它建于 1920 年，是 1920 年代在中威
灵顿乡建造的一组中承式梁桥中最早的一座。这个群包括中威灵顿乡的桥梁 2-wg，8-WG，30-P 和 5-e。和
这座桥一样，他们每个人都展示了早期的混凝土实验，这导致了装饰性的混凝土栏杆有一个坚实的中心部
分和两边的栏杆。在施工过程中，用来将混凝土固定在现场的薄板留下了仍然可见的印记。
This bridge was engineered by the firm of Bowman & Connor who had offices in Toronto and Berlin (Kitchener).
The firm became a prolific and well-known bridge engineering company in Wellington County in the early 20th
century. This bridge is closed to the public and portions of the decorative balustrades are missing.
这座桥是由 Bowman & Connor 公司设计的，该公司在多伦多和柏林设有办事处(Kitchener)。20 世纪早期，
这家公司在威灵顿县成为一家多产且知名的桥梁工程公司。这座桥不对公众开放，部分装饰栏杆也不见了。
Sources: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 26-P is located on First Line West, 0.1 km south of Sideroad 5. It was constructed in 1940
and belongs to a grouping of early T-beam bridges built in the Township of Centre Wellington during the 1920s and
1940s. This group includes Centre Wellington bridges 28-P, 32-P, 3-N, 1-E, 6-E and 33-P. Like this bridge, they
each display an early experimentation with concrete. This bridge has concrete chamfered balustrades with decorative
embossed circles and represents a prominent feature in the landscape. It is clearly visible in the valley on approach
from roads leading to the north, east and west.
中威灵顿乡大桥 26-p 位于第一线西，5号侧道以南 0.1 公里。该桥建于 1940 年，属于 20 世纪 20 年代和 40
年代在中威灵顿乡建造的一组早期 t 型梁桥。这一组包括中威灵顿乡桥梁 28-p，32-P，3-N，1-E，6-E 和
33-p。像这座桥一样，它们都展示了早期的混凝土实验。这座桥有混凝土倒角栏杆与装饰浮雕圆圈，代表
了一个突出的特点，在景观。从通往北部、东部和西部的道路上可以清楚地看到这座桥在山谷中的位置。
Both ends of the north railings and the east abutment have been recently rehabilitated.
北边栏杆的两端和东边的桥墩最近已经修复。

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 28-P is located on Sideroad 11, 0.7 km west of Eighth Line West. It was constructed in
1926 and belongs to a grouping of early T-beam bridges built in the Township of Centre Wellington during the
1920s and 1940s. This group includes Centre Wellington bridges 26-P, 32-P, 3-N, 1-E, 6-E and 33-P. Like this
bridge, they each display an early experimentation with concrete. This bridge has concrete chamfered balustrades
with decorative em-bossed circles. The thin boards used to set the concrete on site during construction left imprints
that are still visible. Engravings are found on the bottom railings that read, “Martin, Oct 26, 1926; Inspector ALMA
On; ELMIRA”. Bridge 32-P has similar engravings to this bridge.
中威灵顿乡大桥 28-p 位于 11 号侧路，距离 8 号线以西 0.7 公里。它建于 1926 年，属于一组早期的 t 型梁桥，
建于 20 世纪 20 年代和 40 年代中威灵顿乡。这一组包括中威灵顿乡桥梁 26-p，32-P，3-N，1-E，6-E 和 33-
p。像这座桥一样，它们都展示了早期的混凝土实验。这座桥有混凝土倒角栏杆和装饰浮雕圆圈。在施工过
程中用来固定混凝土的薄板留下了仍然可见的印记。在底部的栏杆上发现了雕刻，上面写着“马丁，1926
年 10 月 26 日; 检查员 ALMA On; ELMIRA”。32-P 号桥与这座桥有着相似的雕刻。
Bridge 28-P is in poor condition and has been closed to the public. A replacement bridge has been constructed
directly to the east, which allows predominantly agricultural traffic to cross Carroll Creek.
28-P 大桥状况不佳，已经关闭。一座替代桥梁已经建造完毕，直接通向东部，这使得主要的农业交通可以
通过卡罗尔河。
Source: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data
来源: 中威灵顿乡 2008 年结构清单数据

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 30-P is located on Sideroad 5, 0.2 km west of Wellington Road 7. It was constructed in
1929 and is the last in a grouping of early half-through girder bridges built in the Township of Centre Wellington
during the 1920s. This group includes Centre Wellington bridges 2-WG, 8-WG, 5-P and 5-E. Like this bridge, they
each display an early experimentation with concrete, which has resulted in decorative concrete railings with a solid
centre portion and balustrades on each side. The thin boards used to set the concrete on site during construction left
imprints that are still visible. This bridge is unique to the group as it has the shortest span. Portions of the bridge are
in poor condition but it is better preserved than others in its group.
中威灵顿乡大桥 30-p 位于威灵顿路 7 号以西 0.2 公里的 5 号侧道上。它建于 1929 年，是 20 世纪 20 年代在
中威灵顿乡建造的一组早期中承式梁桥中的最后一座。这组桥包括中威灵顿乡的 2-wg，8-WG，5-P 和 5-e
桥。和这座桥一样，他们每个人都展示了早期的混凝土实验，这导致了装饰性的混凝土栏杆有一个坚实的
中心部分和两边的栏杆。在施工过程中，用来将混凝土固定在现场的薄板留下了仍然可见的印记。这座桥
是这个小组所特有的，因为它的跨度最短。部分桥梁状况不佳，但保存得比其他同类桥梁要好。
Source: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data
来源: 中威灵顿乡 2008 年结构清单数据

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 3-N is located on Beatty Line North, 0.2 km south of Sideroad 10 North. It was
constructed in 1942 and belongs to a grouping of early T-beam bridges built in the Township during the 1920s and
1940s. This group includes Centre Wellington bridges 26-P, 28-P, 32-P, 33-P, 1-E, and 6-E. Like this bridge, they
each display an early experimentation with concrete. This bridge is unique among the group due to its Art Deco
inspired concrete balustrades and long deck length needed to span Irvine Creek. This bridge is in better condition
than others in its group.
中威灵顿乡大桥 3-n 位于比蒂线北，siderroad 北 10 以南 0.2 公里。它建于 1942 年，属于 20 世纪 20 年代和
40 年代在该镇建造的一组早期 t 型梁桥。这一组包括中威灵顿乡桥梁 26-p，28-P，32-P，33-P，1-E 和 6-
e。像这座桥一样，它们都展示了早期的混凝土实验。这座桥是独一无二的，因为它的装饰艺术启发了混凝
土栏杆和跨越 Irvine Creek 所需的长桥面长度。这座桥的状况比同组的其他桥更好。
Source: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data
来源: 中威灵顿乡 2008 年结构清单数据

General Description
一般描述
The Irvine Street Bridge is located on Irvine Street, 1.4 km south of Sideroad 10. Built in 1929, it represents a prominent
landmark in the area and is one of seven surviving concrete bowstring trusses in the Township of Centre Wellington.
Although this bridge type is found across Ontario, the Township of Centre Wellington has been noted for its especially
large collection. The Irvine Street Bridge is similar to a group of prominent bowstring arch bridges that included the
Shiloh Bridge, Hogan’s Bridge, Cox Creek Bridge, Stirton Bridge, Cheese Factory Bridge and McDougall’s Bridge. Due
to structural concerns and subsequent replacement, only the Shiloh and Gibson Bridges remain from this group of
Wellington County bowstring trusses.
Irvine 街大桥位于 Irvine 街，siderroad 10 以南 1.4 公里。它建于 1929 年，是该地区一个著名的地标性建筑，是中
威灵顿乡现存的七个混凝土弓弦桁架之一。尽管这种桥型可以在安大略省找到，但中威灵顿乡以其特别大的收藏
而闻名。欧文街大桥与一组著名的弓弦拱桥相似，包括夏洛大桥、霍根大桥、考克斯溪大桥、 Stirton 大桥、奶酪
工厂大桥和 McDougall 大桥。由于结构问题和随后的更换，只有夏洛和吉布森桥留在这组威灵顿县弓弦桁架。
The single lane and one-and-a-half lane concrete bowstring trusses of Wellington County are unique to the province
because of their age, style and concentration in numbers. Built primarily in the period from 1915 to 1930, these structures
reflect the transition from horse-drawn vehicles to the new motorized age. The introduction of the bowstring truss reflects
the need to provide a safe and durable structure, capable of withstanding frequent use, heavy loads and the inevitable
scrape or two. The robust concrete bowstring trusses on the rural back roads of Wellington County illustrate the success of
this particular design, which has stood the test of time.
威灵顿县的单车道和一个半车道混凝土弓弦桁架是该省独有的，因为他们的年龄，风格和数量集中。这些结构主
要建于 1915 年至 1930 年间，反映了从马车到新机动化时代的转变。弓弦桁架的引进反映了需要提供一个安全和
耐用的结构，能够经受频繁使用，重负荷和不可避免的刮伤或两个。威灵顿县乡村小路上坚固的混凝土弓弦桁架
说明了这种特殊设计的成功，它经受住了时间的考验。
The reinforced concrete bowstring arch bridge design was popular as it required minimal material, was simple
钢筋混凝土拱桥的设计很受欢迎，因为它只需要很少的材料，很简单
to install, represented newer construction materials and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic. This bridge has a
length of 25.9m, with one span with 10 stringers. One lane can cross the structure, which is a unique characteristic of this
group of bridges. While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among all the bowstring truss structures in
Wellington County. The Irvine Street Bridge is characteristically tall and steep, and connected by a cross-tie beam because
it arches across the Irvine Creek, a wider watercourse. The construction date, “1929”, is pressed in the concrete on the
centre of the cross-tie.
安装，代表较新的建筑材料，并可方便地容纳车辆。这座桥长 25.9 米，一个跨度有 10 个特约记者。一条车道可
以跨越整个结构，这是这组桥梁的独特之处。作为一种基本类型，在威灵顿县所有的弓弦桁架结构中有着相当大
的差异。欧文街大桥的特点是高而陡，由一个交叉横梁连接，因为它跨越了欧文溪，一个更宽的水道。施工日期，
“1929”，压在横梁中央的混凝土上。
Minutes from a 2011 meeting of Heritage Centre Wellington indicated that this bridge is the best candidate for preservation and
possible designation out of the group of seven remaining concrete bowstring arch bridges in the Township.
2011 年中威灵顿乡遗产中心会议的会议记录显示，这座桥是中威灵顿现存七座混凝土弓弦拱桥中最适合保存和指定的
一座。
Sources: Discovering Heritage Bridges on Ontario Roads, David Cuming, 1983; GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory; Historicbridges.org;
Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data
资料来源: 发现安大略省道路上的遗产桥梁，David Cuming，1983; GRCA 遗产桥梁清单; historicbridges
