General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 12-N is located on Washington Street, 0.3 km north of Wellington Road 18. It was
constructed in 1925 and is one of only two remaining earth-filled concrete arch bridges in the Township of Cen-tre
Wellington, along with Old Fourth Line Bridge. It features concrete railings with decorative embossed circles and
chamfered balustrades.
中威灵顿桥 12-n 位于华盛顿街，距威灵顿路 18 号以北 0.3 公里。它建于 1925 年，是威灵顿中心镇仅存的两
座填土混凝土拱桥之一，与老四线桥一起。它的特点是混凝土栏杆上有装饰性的浮雕圆圈和倒角栏杆。
Arched bridges are one of the oldest bridge forms and are very efficient at supporting large loads over a long period
of time. Most of the early activity in concrete bridge construction in Ontario focused on the earth-filled, solid
spandrel arch form. This bridge type gained in popularity because they were easy and inexpensive to build.
However, the popularity of solid spandrel bridges appears to have declined after 1919, although they continued to be
built in small numbers into the 1930s since it was still an economic structure in circumstances where solid ground
permitted adequate foundations. This was the case for Centre Wellington Bridge 12-N as existing limestone was
used to form an abutment base on the west side of the bridge, a unique feature. Concrete was used to form the
abutment on the east side of the bridge.
拱桥是最古老的桥梁形式之一，在长时间承受巨大荷载方面非常有效。在安大略省，大多数早期的混凝土
桥梁建设活动都集中在填土、实心拱肋形式上。这种桥型之所以受到欢迎，是因为它们建造起来既简单又
便宜。然而，1919年以后，坚固的拱肩桥的受欢迎程度似乎有所下降，尽管直到 1930 年代仍有少量的拱肩
桥建造，因为在坚固的地基允许有足够的基础的情况下，拱肩桥仍然是一种经济结构。这是中威灵顿乡 12-
n 大桥的情况，因为现有的石灰岩被用来形成桥西侧的桥台基础，这是一个独特的特征。混凝土被用来形成
桥东侧的桥台。
Many of these early 20th century earth-filled concrete arches have been removed from the Province’s roads because
they are too narrow to meet modern traffic needs. As a result, solid spandrel concrete arch bridges in active use, such
as Centre Wellington Bridge 12-N, are now considered rare survivors.
许多 20 世纪早期的混凝土拱门已经从该省的道路上拆除，因为它们太窄，不能满足现代交通的需要。因此，
实心拱肋混凝土拱桥在积极使用，如中威灵顿乡桥 12-n，现在被认为是罕见的幸存者。
Sources: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data
资料来源: 中威灵顿乡 2008 年结构清单数据

General Description
一般描述
The Victoria Street Bridge (Centre Wellington Bridge 1-EL) is located at Victoria Street, between West Mill Street
and Ross Street in the Village of Elora. Removed in 2005 due to its deteriorated condition, the Victoria Street Bridge
was one of the oldest surviving steel bridges in Ontario.
维多利亚街大桥(中威灵顿乡大桥 1-el)位于维多利亚街，在西磨坊街和罗斯街之间的埃洛拉村。维多利亚街
大桥于 2005 年因状况恶化而拆除，是安大略省现存最古老的钢桥之一。
The original bridge at this site was constructed in 1842. The cut-stone piers that remain supported the third and
fourth bridges built there in 1871 and 1899, respectively. Reid-Riddell Engineering built the pin joint truss bridge in
1899, over the falls and close to Islet Rock in Elora. For 70 years the bridge assisted in the transport of flour from
the local mill to the market in Guelph, herds of cattle to and from the cattle market in Elora and supplies and
construction materials to Elora and communities further north.
这座桥最初建于 1842 年。现存的石墩支撑着 1871 年和 1899 年分别在此建造的第三座和第四座桥梁。里德-
里德尔工程公司于 1899 年在瀑布上方，靠近埃洛拉的 Islet Rock 建造了这座大桥。70年来，这座桥协助将
面粉从当地的磨坊运往圭尔夫的市场，牛群往返于埃洛拉的牛市，并向埃洛拉和更北部的社区运送用品和
建筑材料。
With the completion of the Metcalfe Street Bridge in 1954, the Victoria Street Bridge was closed to vehicular traffic
in 1969. One sidewalk remained open and the structure began a new life as a pedestrian bridge. By the mid-1970s
the sidewalk too was closed and pedestrians had to wait until 1983 to once again have access to the bridge. That year
Metro Goldwyn Mayer (MGM) chose Elora as the setting for a Hollywood movie called, “Mrs. Soffel” and they
paid $35,000 to help restore the bridge. The project involved laying two large steel beams over the bridge
superstructure and surfacing it with a wood plank deck. Later that year the bridge was reopened to pedestrians.
随着梅特卡夫街大桥于 1954 年竣工，维多利亚街大桥于 1969 年关闭，禁止车辆通行。一条人行道仍然开放，
这个结构开始了作为人行天桥的新生活。到 20 世纪 70 年代中期，人行道也被关闭，行人不得不等到 1983
年才能再次进入桥梁。那一年，米高梅公司选择埃洛拉作为好莱坞电影《索菲尔夫人》的背景，他们支付
了 35000 美元帮助修复这座桥。这个项目包括在桥的上部结构上铺设两根大型钢梁，然后用木板甲板将其
表面覆盖。当年晚些时候，大桥向行人重新开放。
Over time, the structure was not maintained and continued to deteriorate. Although it had been designated under the
Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act in 1983, funding for the proper restoration was not forthcoming and the bridge
was de-designated by the Township in 2004 (By-law No. 2004-58). Until 2005 the bridge provided a viewpoint and
gathering place in the Village, as well as an important link between the parking area on the south bank of the Grand
River and the commercial activity on Mill Street. The stone piers still remain, contributing to a cultural heritage
landscape in scenic Elora. The piers and abutments represent a viable base for future bridges to build upon.
随着时间的推移，这个结构没有得到维护，并且继续恶化。虽然该桥是根据 1983 年《安大略遗产法》第四
部分指定的，但没有为适当的修复提供资金，2004年该镇取消了对该桥的指定(第 2004-58 号法令)。直到
2005 年，这座桥一直是格兰德河南岸的停车场和密尔街商业活动之间的重要联系点。石墩仍然保留着，为
埃洛拉风景区的文化遗产景观做出了贡献。这些桥墩和桥墩为未来的桥梁建设提供了可行的基础。
Sources: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data; GRCA Heritage Bridge Inventory

维多利亚街步行桥牌匾，2011 年 6 月; 中威灵顿乡法律第 2004-58 号

General Description
一般描述
The Shiloh Bridge spans the Speed River on Sixth Line between Side Road 30 and Wellington Road 22 in the Township
of Centre Wellington, and serves as a gateway across the watercourse in Eramosa. Constructed in 1919 by Charles
Mattaini, it replaced a previous wooden bridge. The Shiloh Bridge is among the earliest bowstring arch bridges in the
Township of Centre Wellington and reflects the existence of relatively well-organized public administrative bodies. The
bridge’s bowstring design was popular from approximately 1915 to 1930 as it required minimal material, was simple to
install, represented newer construction materials and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic.
夏洛大桥位于中威灵顿乡 30 号公路和 22 号威灵顿公路之间的第六条线路上，横跨速度河，是横跨 Eramosa 河道
的一个门户。它由 Charles Mattaini 于 1919 年建造，取代了之前的木桥。夏洛大桥是中威灵顿乡最早的弓弦拱桥
之一，反映了相对组织良好的公共行政机构的存在。大桥的弓弦设计在 1915 年到 1930 年间非常流行，因为它只
需要最少的材料，安装简单，代表了较新的建筑材料，并且可以很容易地容纳车辆。
While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among all the bowstring truss structures in Wellington County.
The Shiloh Bridge, because it arches across a narrow portion of the Speed River, is not as tall and steep as others in
its group. It has a length of 14.5 meters, with one span and five stringers. One-and-a-half lanes cross the structure,
which is a unique characteristic of this group of bridges. The bridge has chamfered balustrades with decorative
circles pressed into the concrete on each side of the arch.
虽然是一种基本类型，但在威灵顿县所有的弓弦桁架结构中存在着相当大的差异。夏洛大桥，因为它是拱
形的，横跨一个狭窄的部分的速度河，不是高和陡峭的其他组。它的长度为 14.5 米，有一个跨度和五名特
约记者。一个半车道横跨整个结构，这是这组桥梁的独特特征。这座桥有倒角栏杆，拱门两侧的混凝土上
嵌有装饰性的圆圈。
The Shiloh Bridge is a prominent landmark in the Township of Centre Wellington (former Eramosa Township) as it
is one of very few surviving concrete bowstring trusses in Wellington County. Although this bridge type is found
across Ontario, the Township of Centre Wellington has been noted for its especially large collection. The Shiloh
Bridge was originally constructed as a group of many concrete bowstring trusses in the County that were erected in
the same time period and designed in a similar style. This group of bridges represented the upgrading of the
transportation networks that occurred in Ontario after World War I to accommodate an increased number and weight
of newer automobiles. The group included the Gibson Bridge, Hogan’s Bridge, Cox Creek Bridge, Stirton Bridge,
Cheese Factory Bridge and McDougall’s Bridge. Due to structural concerns and subsequent replacement, only the
Shiloh and Gibson Bridges remain from this group of Wellington County bowstring trusses.
夏洛大桥是威灵顿中威灵顿乡(前 Eramosa 小镇)的一个著名地标，因为它是威灵顿县仅存的几个混凝土弓弦
桁架之一。尽管这种类型的桥在安大略省各地都能找到，但中威灵顿乡以其特别大的收藏而闻名。夏洛大
桥最初是由县里的许多混凝土弓弦桁架组成的，这些桁架是在同一时期竖立起来的，设计风格类似。这组
桥梁代表了第一次世界大战后安大略省交通网络的升级，以适应新型汽车数量和重量的增加。这个小组包
括吉布森桥，霍根桥，考克斯溪桥，Stirton 桥，奶酪工厂桥和 McDougall 桥。由于结构问题和随后的更换，
只有夏洛和吉布森桥留在这组威灵顿县弓弦桁架。
Source: Heritage Resources Centre, Shiloh Bridge Designation File, 2009
资料来源: 文物资源中心，2009 年志乐桥指定档案

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 5-E is located on Fourth Line, 1.5 km north of Wellington Road 22. It was constructed in
1923 and belongs to a grouping of early half-through girder bridges built in the Township of Centre Wellington
during the 1920s. This group includes Centre Wellington bridges 2-WG, 8-WG, 5-P and 30-P. Like this bridge, they
each display an early experimentation with concrete, which has resulted in decorative concrete railings with a solid
centre portion and balustrades on each side. The thin boards used to set the concrete on site during construction left
imprints that are still visible. Portions of the bridge are in very poor condition.
中威灵顿桥 5-e 位于第四线，威灵顿路 22 号以北 1.5 公里处。它建于 1923 年，属于 1920 年代在中威灵顿乡
建造的一组早期中承式梁桥。这个组包括中威灵顿乡的桥梁 2-wg，8-WG，5-P 和 30-p。和这座桥一样，他
们每个人都展示了早期的混凝土实验，这导致了装饰性的混凝土栏杆有一个坚实的中心部分和两边的栏杆
在施工过程中，用来将混凝土固定在现场的薄板留下了仍然可见的印记。部分桥梁的状况非常糟糕。
Source: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data
来源: 中威灵顿乡 2008 年结构清单数据

General Description
一般描述
Centre Wellington Bridge 6-E is located on Third Line, 0.1 km south of Eramosa-West Garafraxa Townline. It is the
oldest remaining example of a concrete T-beam bridge structure in the former township of Eramosa. If constructed
c.1921 as records indicate, earlier than its estimated date of c1940, it is the oldest example of this bridge type in the
Township of Centre Wellington. The retention of the original handrail contributes to its design character. The
detailing of the end and intermediate posts of the handrail system, i.e., decorative circle embossed and chamfered
edges, are considered to be of some artistic merit and indicative of the design elements of its time. It has lost a few
handrail posts on the north end and is in very poor condition. Bridge 6-E maintains the rural character of the area
and is physically, functionally, visually, and historically linked to its surroundings. Several bridges, starting in the
19th century, have been built at the same location.
中威灵顿桥 6-e 位于 Eramosa-West Garafraxa Townline 以南 0.1 公里的三号线上。这是 Eramosa 镇现存最古
老的混凝土 t 型梁桥结构。如果像记录显示的那样建于 1921 年，早于 1940 年的估计日期，它是中威灵顿乡
这种桥型的最古老的例子。保留原来的扶手有助于它的设计特点。扶手系统末端和中间柱子的细节，即装
饰性的圆形浮雕和倒角的边缘，被认为具有一定的艺术价值，并指示了当时的设计元素。它已经失去了北
端的一些扶手柱，状况非常糟糕。大桥 6-e 保持了该地区的乡村特色，并且在物理上、功能上、视觉上和历
史上都与周围环境相联系。从 19 世纪开始，几座桥已经在同一地点建成。
There are a number of examples of this bridge type in the Township of Centre Wellington, principally located in the
former geographic township of Pilkington. The next oldest example in the municipality is the Noah Road Bridge
(Centre Wellington Bridge 33-P) dating to 1922.
在中威灵顿乡有许多这种桥型的例子，主要位于以前的地理小镇 Pilkington。下一个最古老的例子是诺亚路
桥(中威灵顿乡桥 33-p) ，可追溯到 1922 年。
According to a Cultural Heritage Evaluation Report conducted in May 2012, demolition is pending for Centre
Wellington Bridge 6-E.
根据 2012 年 5 月进行的文化遗产评估报告，中威灵顿乡大桥 6-e 正在等待拆除。

General Description
一般描述
The David Street Bridge is located on David Street, 0.3 km east of Wellington Road 7, over the Elora Gorge in the
Vil-lage of Elora. The bridge was replaced in 2004 but represents a well-documented, long history of bridge
construction on this site.
大卫街大桥位于大卫街，位于惠灵顿路 7 号以东 0.3 公里，跨越埃洛拉村的埃洛拉峡谷。这座桥在 2004 年
被更换，但是它代表了这个地方桥梁建设的悠久历史。
Beginning in 1819, the first bridge onsite was the old Indian log bridge. To attract new settlers to North Pilkington, a
group of Elora businessmen financed the next bridge at this site in 1847. Built by David Foote, John Cattanock and Sailor
James Gairns, it was heralded as the first cantilever bridge in North America. The next bridge at this river cross-ing was
built in 1867, after the founding of Salem, just north of Elora. It was a timber truss bridge with a centre stone pier, which
remains today. The magnificent pier was constructed by Charles Lawrence, one of Elora’s early stonema-sons, and
engineered by A.W. Connor. This timber structure was condemned within eight years and in 1887 the bridge was replaced
with a steel pin connected truss bridge on the same pier. The next bridge was built in 1921 of concrete. The present bridge,
the seventh at this location, was constructed by Wellington County in 2004. Its design reflects the 1921 version, while
employing very different modern materials and techniques. Though no longer a supporting element, the 1867 pier was
restored to preserve the appearance of the 1921 bridge. The bridge is included on the Ontario Heritage Bridge List and is
an important landmark as well as a scenic element in the Elora Gorge.
从 1819 年开始，现场的第一座桥是古老的印度原木桥。为了吸引新的定居者来到北皮尔金顿，一群埃洛拉商人
于 1847 年在这里资助了下一座桥。这座桥由 David Foote，John Cattanock 和 Sailor James gainns 建造，被誉为北
美第一座悬臂桥。下一座横跨这条河的桥建于 1867 年，建于埃洛拉以北的塞勒姆之后。这是一座木桁架桥，中
间有一个石墩，至今仍然存在。宏伟的码头是由查尔斯 · 罗伦斯建造的埃洛拉早期的石像之子之一，由 a.w. 康纳
设计。这座木结构建筑在 8 年内就被废弃了。1887年，这座桥被取而代之的是同一个码头上的一座由钢钉连接的
桁架桥。下一座桥是在 1921 年用混凝土建造的。现在的这座桥是这个地方的第七座，是威灵顿县在 2004 年建造
的。它的设计反映了 1921 年的版本，同时采用了非常不同的现代材料和技术。虽然不再是一个支撑元素，1867
年的桥墩被修复以保持 1921 年桥梁的外观。这座桥被列入安大略省遗产桥梁名录，是埃洛拉峡谷的一个重要地
标和风景要素。
Sources: County of Wellington 2007 Bridge Appraisals

General Description
一般描述
The Salem Bridge (Woolwich Street Bridge) is located on Woolwich Street West, 0.1 km east of Wellington Road 7.
It was constructed in 1952, and represents a landmark in the small community of Salem. There are five remaining
steel truss bridges in Centre Wellington, and together with Centre Wellington Bridge 1-P, the Salem Bridge is one of
only two remaining pony truss bridges. This bridge is a traditionally composed mid-20th century pony truss. It could
be thought of as a companion bridge to the Metcalfe Street Bridge in Elora as they were both built within a year of
each other and share similar design details.
Salem 大桥(Woolwich Street Bridge)位于 Woolwich 西街，距离 Wellington 路 7 号以东 0.1 公里。它建于 1952
年，是塞勒姆小社区的标志性建筑。在中威灵顿乡还有五座钢桁架桥，和中威灵顿 1-p 桥一起，塞勒姆大桥
是仅存的两座小型桁架桥之一。这座桥是 20 世纪中期传统的小马桁架结构。它可以被认为是与埃洛拉的梅
特卡夫街大桥相伴的桥梁，因为它们都是在一年内相继建成的，而且具有相似的设计细节。
Contractor, Albert Reeves and the Hamilton Bridge Company with County Engineer, W.H. Keith, constructed this
rivet-connected Warren pony truss bridge for the County of Wellington. “Bethlehem, USA” is pressed in the
bridge’s steel beams as they were cast by the Bethlehem Steel Corporation, based in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania and
Buffalo, New York. This company was at one time America’s second-largest steel producer, operating from 1857 to
2003. It was not uncommon for steel used in truss bridge construction to be sourced from the United States.
承包商 Albert Reeves 和汉密尔顿桥公司与郡工程师 w.h. Keith 为惠灵顿郡建造了这座与铆钉相连的沃伦小
马桁架桥。位于宾夕法尼亚州伯利恒钢铁厂和纽约州布法罗的伯利恒钢铁厂在大桥的钢梁上铸造了“美国
伯利恒”。从 1857 年到 2003 年，这家公司一度是美国第二大钢铁生产商。用于桁架桥建设的钢材来自美国
并不罕见。
The Salem Bridge contributes to a cultural heritage landscape given its location next to the historic Wissler Mill.
Built circa 1852, Wissler’s Mill was a gristmill that ceased operation in 1965. It was subsequently converted to a
private resi-dence.
塞勒姆大桥位于历史悠久的威斯勒磨坊旁边，有助于形成文化遗产景观。威斯勒磨坊建于 1852 年左右，
1965 年停止运营。随后它被改造成了一个私人住宅。
Sources: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data
资料来源: 中威灵顿乡 2008 年结构清单数据

General Description
一般描述
Metcalfe Street Bridge (Badley Bridge) is located on Metcalfe Street (Wellington Road 21), 0.2 km south of
Wellington Road 18 in the Village of Elora. It was constructed by 1953 and is one of five remaining steel truss
bridges in Centre Wellington, three of which are through trusses.
梅特卡夫街桥(Badley 桥)位于梅特卡夫街(惠灵顿路 21 号) ，在惠灵顿路 18 号以南 0.2 公里的埃洛拉村。它
建于 1953 年，是中威灵顿乡仅存的五座钢桁架桥之一，其中三座是直立式桁架桥。
The Metcalfe Street Bridge is a nine-panel rivet-connected Parker camelback through truss. Contractor, A.H.
MacLellan and the Hamilton Bridge Company, with County Engineer, W.H. Keith, constructed the bridge and are
named in maker’s plaques located on the bridge. MacLellan and Keith were also responsible for the construction of
the Caldwell Bridge, a similar truss built two years later in the nearby Village of Fergus.
梅特卡夫街道大桥是一座由 9 个面板的铆钉连接的帕克驼背式桁架结构。承包商 a.h. 麦克莱伦和汉密尔顿
桥公司，与县工程师 w.h. 基思一起，建造了这座桥，并以桥上制造商的牌匾命名。麦克莱伦和基思还负责
建造考德威尔大桥，两年后在附近的弗格斯村建造了一个类似的桁架。
This bridge represents a landmark in the Village and provides a distinctive gateway into or out of downtown Elora.
这座桥代表了这个村庄的一个地标，并提供了一个独特的门户进出市中心 Elora。
Sidewalks on both sides of the bridge allow consistent use by both vehicles and pedestrians.
桥两边的人行道允许车辆和行人一致使用。
Sources: Township of Centre Wellington 2008 Structure Inventory Data
资料来源: 中威灵顿乡 2008 年结构清单数据

General Description
一般描述
The Caldwell Bridge is located on Wellington Road 43 (Gartshore Street), 0.7 km north of Wellington Road 18 in
the Village of Fergus. It was constructed in 1955 and is one of five remaining steel truss bridges in the Township of
Centre Wellington, three of which are through trusses.
考德威尔大桥位于费格斯村惠灵顿路 18 号以北 0.7 公里的惠灵顿路 43 号(加特肖尔街)。这座桥建于 1955 年，
是中威灵顿乡仅存的五座钢桁架桥之一，其中三座采用桁架结构。
The Metcalfe Street Bridge is a rivet-connected camelback through truss. Contractor, A.H. MacLellan and the
Domin-ion Bridge Company Limited of Toronto, with County Engineer, W.H. Keith, constructed the bridge and are
noted in plaques located on the bridge. MacLellan and Keith were also responsible for the construction of the
Metcalfe Street Bridge (Badley Bridge), a similar truss built two years earlier in the nearby Village of Elora.
梅特卡夫街大桥是一座由铆钉连接的驼背式桁架结构。承包商 A.H.MacLellan 和多伦多 Domin-ion 桥梁有限
公司，与县工程师 W.H.Keith 一起建造了这座桥，并在桥上的牌匾上注明。麦克莱伦和基思还负责建造梅
特卡夫街桥(巴德利桥) ，一个类似的桁架两年前在附近的埃洛拉村建造。
This bridge represents a landmark in the Village and a sidewalk on the west side of the bridge allows for consistent
use by both vehicles and pedestrians.
这座桥代表了这个村庄的一个地标，桥西侧的一条人行道允许车辆和行人一致使用。

General Description
一般描述
Bridge 3 is located on 1st Line, 1.6 km south of Wellington Road 124. It is one of the earliest remaining examples of
a concrete T-beam bridge structure in the Grand River watershed. It is also the oldest example of this bridge type in
Wellington County, outdating the estimated construction date of Centre Wellington Bridge 6-E by one year.
3 号桥位于威灵顿 124 路以南 1.6 公里的 1 号线上。它是格兰德河流域现存最早的混凝土 t 梁桥结构之一。
它也是威灵顿县这种桥型最古老的例子，比中威灵顿乡 6-e 大桥的预计建造日期早了一年。
The retention of the original handrail contributes to its design character. The detailing of the end and intermediate
posts of the handrail system, with a decorative circle embossed and chamfered edges, is considered to be of some
artistic merit and indicative of the design elements of its time. A portion of the railing has been lost on the east side.
Bridge 3 maintains the rural character of the area and is physically, functionally, visually, and historically linked to
its surroundings.
保留原来的扶手有助于它的设计特点。扶手系统的末端和中间柱子的细节，带有装饰性的圆形浮雕和倒角
的边缘，被认为具有一定的艺术价值，并指示了当时的设计元素。东侧的一部分栏杆已经消失。3号桥保持
了该地区的乡村特征，并且在物理上、功能上、视觉上和历史上都与周围环境相联系。
Sources: Summary Action Report, 2008

中威灵顿乡大桥 6-e，文化遗产评估报告，Unterman McPhail Associates，2012年 5 月

General Description
一般描述
Hay’s Bridge is located on East-West Luther Townline, 0.3 km north of Line 12. It was constructed in 1920 and
belongs to a grouping of three remaining reinforced concrete solid slab bridges built in the Township of Wellington
North in roughly the same year. This group also includes Boyd’s Bridge and Wellington County Bridge 36. Like this
bridge, they each display an early experimentation with concrete, which has resulted in decoratively embossed solid
concrete railings. The thin boards used to set the concrete on site during construction left imprints that are still
visible. Like Boyd’s Bridge, this structure is set quite high above the floodplain and has very large wing walls.
海伊大桥位于东西路德镇线，距离 12 号线以北 0.3 公里。它建于 1920 年，属于三组剩余的钢筋混凝土实心
板桥，建于惠灵顿北镇，大约在同一年。这一组还包括博伊德大桥和威灵顿县大桥 36 号。和这座桥一样，
他们每个人都展示了早期的混凝土实验，最终形成了装饰性的浮雕实心混凝土栏杆。在施工过程中，用来
将混凝土固定在现场的薄板留下了仍然可见的印记。就像博伊德大桥一样，这个结构设置在洪泛平原之上
并且有非常大的翼墙。

General Description
一般描述
The Gordonville Bridge is located on County Road 14, 0.4 km north of Line 6 in the community of Gordonville. It
was constructed in 1930 and is the earliest and one of very few T-beam structures remaining in the Township of
Wellington North. Its arched double-span also makes the structure unique, as few two-span T-beam bridges have
been observed in the Grand River watershed. This bridge displays an early experimentation with concrete. The thin
boards used to set the concrete on site during construction left imprints that are still visible and it appears the
concrete over the arches was molded by hand. This bridge was widened in 1955 and underwent repairs in 1994.
戈登维尔大桥位于县道 14 号，6 号线以北 0.4 公里处的戈登维尔社区。它建于 1930 年，是威灵顿北部小镇
仅存的几个 t 型梁结构中最早的一个。它的拱形双跨结构也使其独特，因为在格兰德河流域已经观察到很少
的两跨 t 型梁桥。这座桥展示了早期的混凝土试验。在施工过程中，用来将混凝土固定在现场的薄板留下了
仍然可见的痕迹，拱门上的混凝土似乎是手工制作的。这座桥在 1955 年加宽，1994 年进行了维修。
According to information contained in Charles Mattaini’s journal, it is likely that the Gordonville Bridge replaced a
1919 concrete bowstring arch bridge that he designed and constructed. Mattaini was a prominent builder of concrete
bowstring arch bridges in Wellington County between 1903 and 1929.
根据查尔斯 · 马泰尼日记中的信息，戈登维尔大桥很可能取代了他设计和建造的 1919 年的混凝土弓弦拱桥。
1903 年至 1929 年间，马泰尼是威灵顿县著名的混凝土弓弦拱桥建造者。
Sources: County of Wellington, 2007 Bridge Appraisals
资料来源: 惠灵顿郡，2007 年桥梁评估
Charles Mattaini’s Journal
Charles Mattaini’s Journal 查尔斯 · 马泰尼的日记
Pat Mestern, 2012
Pat Mestern，2012

General Description
一般描述
Conestogo River Bridge #4 is located on Wellington Road 109, 1.7 km east of Highway 6 near the community of
Arthur. It was constructed in 1931 and belongs to a group of four concrete rigid frame bridges built in close
proximity heading east along Wellington Road 109. These bridges were built for the County of Wellington in 1931
and 1934 and include Conestogo River Bridge #5, #6 and #10.
Conestogo 河大桥 4 号位于威灵顿路 109 号，6 号公路以东 1.7 公里，靠近 Arthur 社区。它建于 1931 年，属
于一个由四个混凝土刚架桥组成的桥组，它们紧挨着惠灵顿 109 号公路向东移动。这些桥梁是在 1931 年和
1934 年为惠灵顿郡建造的，包括 Conestogo 河大桥 # 5，# 6 和 # 10。
Conestogo River Bridge #4 is an early example of the concrete rigid frame. This bridge type was introduced in
Ontario in the 1930s and continued to be the dominant form of highway bridges in the province during the 1950s
until the in-troduction of pre-stressed precast concrete beam and post-tension cast-in-place structures in the 1960s.
This structure has decorative concrete railings and underwent repairs in 1989. “The Kings Highway 1931” is
engraved on the base of the south railing.
Conesstogo 河大桥 # 4 是混凝土刚性框架的早期例子。这种桥型于 1930 年代引入安大略省，并在 1950 年代
继续成为该省公路桥梁的主要形式，直到 1960 年代引入预应力混凝土预制梁和后张法现浇结构。这种结构
有装饰性的混凝土栏杆，并在 1989 年进行了维修。1931 年的国王高速公路雕刻在南边栏杆的底部。
Sources: County of Wellington, 2007 Bridge Appraisals
资料来源: 惠灵顿郡，2007 年桥梁评估
David Cuming, Discovering Heritage Bridges on Ontario Roads, 1983
大卫 · 卡明，《发现安大略省道路上的传统桥梁》 ，1983 年

General Description
一般描述
Conestogo River Bridge #5 is located on Wellington Road 109, 0.7 km east of Highway 6 near the community of
Arthur. It was constructed in 1931 and belongs to a group of four concrete rigid frame bridges built in close
proximity heading east along Wellington Road 109. These bridges were built for the County of Wellington in 1931
and 1934 and include Conestogo River Bridge #4, #6 and #10. Conestogo River Bridge #5 is the only in the group to
exhibit a steep, pronounced arch. The structure has decorative concrete railings, and a much more extended east
abutment than west. The thin board marks used to set the concrete on site are still visible.
Conestogo 河大桥 5 号位于威灵顿路 109 号，6 号公路以东 0.7 公里，靠近 Arthur 社区。它建于 1931 年，属
于一个由四个混凝土刚构桥组成的桥组，它们紧挨着惠灵顿 109 号公路向东移动。这些桥梁是在 1931 年和
1934 年为惠灵顿郡建造的，包括 Conestogo 河桥 # 4，# 6 和 # 10。Conesstogo 河大桥 5 号是这个群体中唯一
一座展示出陡峭、明显的拱门的桥。这个建筑有装饰性的混凝土栏杆，东边的桥台比西边延伸得多。现场
用来固定混凝土的薄板标记仍然清晰可见。
Conestogo River Bridge #5 is an early example of the concrete rigid frame. This bridge type was introduced in
Ontario in the 1930s and continued to be the dominant form of highway bridges in the province during the 1950s
until the introduction of pre-stressed precast concrete beam and post-tension cast-in-place structures in the 1960s.
Conestogo 河大桥 # 5 是混凝土刚性框架的早期例子。这种桥型于 1930 年代引入安大略省，并在 1950 年代
继续成为该省公路桥梁的主要形式，直到 1960 年代引入预应力混凝土预制梁和后张法现浇结构。
Sources: David Cuming, Discovering Heritage Bridges on Ontario Roads, 1983

General Description
一般描述
The Dirksen Farm Bridge is located on private property on Highway 109, 0.5 km west of Sideroad 7 outside the
community of Arthur. It was constructed circa 1900 and is the only steel truss bridge in the Township of Wellington
North, and one of the oldest in Wellington County.
德克森农场大桥位于 109 号高速公路上的私人财产上，在 siderroad 7 以西 0.5 公里处，在 Arthur 社区外。它
建于 1900 年左右，是威灵顿北镇唯一的钢桁架桥，也是威灵顿县最古老的桥之一。
Aside from its early date of construction, this bridge is unique due to its use of Carnegie Steel. Although it is not
uncommon for steel used in Ontario’s bridges to be sourced from the United States, it is less common to find Carnegie
steel in the Grand River watershed. The Carnegie Steel Company, headed by Andrew Carnegie, was located in Pittsburg,
Pennsylvania and was in operation from 1892 to 1901 before it was purchased by The United States Steel Company.
除了它的早期建造日期，这座桥是独一无二的，因为它使用了卡内基钢铁。尽管安大略省桥梁使用的钢材来自美
国并不罕见，但在大河流域发现卡内基钢材的情况并不常见。卡内基钢铁公司由安德鲁 · 卡内基领导，位于宾夕
法尼亚州匹次堡，1892 年至 1901 年运营，后被美国钢铁公司收购。
Due to the early construction date of this bridge, it is likely that it was once located at another nearby water crossing
and later moved to its current location on the Dirksen Family Farm.
由于这座桥的早期建造日期，它很可能曾经位于附近的另一个水上交叉口，后来搬到了 Dirksen 家庭农场目
前的位置。
Sources: Paul Karuse, The Battle For Homestead, 1880-1892
来源: Paul Karuse，The Battle For Homestead，1880-1892
Politics, Culture, and Steel, 1992
政治，文化，钢铁，1992

General Description
一般描述
The MacPherson Bridge spans the Grand River on 12th Line, 0.6 km south of 15th Sideroad. Constructed in 1921
and engineered by U.W. Christie, the bridge is a two-span tied double concrete bowstring arch bridge. It is the only
remain-ing bowstring arch bridge in the Township of East Garafraxa and is one of very few double bowstring arch
bridges built in the Grand River watershed. It underwent repairs in 1985 and 2007.
MacPherson 大桥横跨 12 号线上的格兰德河，在 15 号侧道以南 0.6 公里。该桥建于 1921 年，由威斯康星大
学克里斯蒂分校设计，是一座双跨系杆双混凝土拱桥。它是东 Garafraxa 镇仅存的弓弦拱桥，也是大河流域
建造的极少数双弓弦拱桥之一。它在 1985 年和 2007 年进行了维修。
The MacPherson Bridge was part of the Ontario governments upgrading of transportation networks after World War I to
accommodate the increasing number of automobiles in the area. The bridge’s bowstring design was popular in the 1920s
and 1930s as it required minimal material, was simple to install and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic.
MacPherson 大桥是安大略省政府在第一次世界大战后为了适应该地区日益增长的汽车数量而对交通网络进行升级
的一部分。这座桥的弓弦设计在 20 世纪 20 年代和 30 年代很流行，因为它只需要很少的材料，安装简单，容易容
纳车辆。
The MacPherson Bridge is located on a rise of 12th Line and is set approximately 30 feet (9m) above the floodplain.
It is noteworthy for the length of its spans as well as its multi-span configuration. It exhibits decorative concrete
rails, balustrades and tied arches along with very pronounced ice breaks on the east side of the pier. The thin board
finish is still visible in the concrete. Perhaps the most striking feature of the bridge is its heavy skew. Aside from the
arches being offset from each other to accommodate this skew, the single overhead tie rod for each span does not
follow the skew angle. As a result, the tie rods do not meet at the same location on each arch. Interestingly, It does
not appear that the contractor placed an emphasis on maintaining a perfect curve to the concrete arches, as slight
variances are discernable. This is a contrast to other concrete bowstring arch bridges in the watershed where every
curve and detail was constructed as close to perfection as possible.
MacPherson 大桥坐落在 12 号线上，距离泛滥平原约 30 英尺(9 米)。值得注意的是它的跨度长度以及它的多
跨结构。它展示了装饰性的混凝土轨道，栏杆和系在一起的拱门，以及码头东侧非常明显的破冰。薄板装
饰仍然可以在混凝土中看到。也许这座桥最显著的特点就是它的倾斜度。除了拱之间相互偏移以适应这种
倾斜外，每个跨度的单个架空拉杆并不遵循倾斜角度。因此，拉杆不会在每个拱的相同位置相遇。有趣的
是，承包商似乎并没有把重点放在保持混凝土拱的完美曲线上，因为细微的差异是可以识别的。这与分水
岭地区的其他混凝土弓弦拱桥形成鲜明对比，在那里，每一条曲线和每一个细节都尽可能接近完美。
Remains of a stone pier from a previous bridge located near this crossing are still visible 18m downstream from the
MacPherson Bridge.
在 MacPherson 大桥下游 18 米处仍然可以看到位于这座桥附近的旧桥的石墩残骸。
Sources: Ministry of Culture Bridge Inspection Report, 1985
资料来源: 文化部桥梁检查报告，1985

General Description
一般描述
East Garafraxa Bridge 8 is located on 13th Line, 0.7 km south of 15th Sideroad. It was constructed in 1913 and is the only
remaining steel truss bridge in the Township of East Garafraxa and is one of the oldest through truss bridges in the Grand
River watershed. A long-time resident of the Township indicated that at the time of construction teams of horses were
hired to build up the approaches to the bridge and workers were paid $2.50 per day for their efforts.
东 Garafraxa 8 号大桥位于 13 号线上，在 15 号侧道以南 0.7 公里。它建于 1913 年，是东 Garafraxa 镇仅存的钢桁
架桥，也是大河流域最古老的下承式桁架桥之一。该镇的一位长期居民表示，在建造桥梁的过程中，雇佣了一些
马队，工人每天的工资为 2.50 美元。
East Garafraxa Bridge 8 is a steel Pratt through truss with six panels and riveted connections. It has a timber deck
and large concrete abutments. It was constructed by The Hamilton Bridge Works Company Ltd., indicated by a
makers plaque located above the southern entrance. 13th Line dramatically skews around the Grand River to allow
the bridge the shortest span possible. This was done in an effort to reduce construction costs, as it was more
affordable to build a straight bridge, rather than a skewed bridge.
East Garafraxa 桥 8 是一个钢制普拉特通过桁架与六个面板和铆接连接。它有一个木质甲板和大型混凝土桥
台。它是由汉密尔顿桥工程有限公司建造的，位于南入口上方的制造商牌匾表明了这一点。13号线大幅度
地弯曲了格兰德河，使大桥的跨度尽可能缩短。这样做是为了降低建设成本，因为建造一座直桥比建造一
座倾斜的桥更经济实惠。
East Garafraxa Bridge 8 remains largely unaltered, undergoing minor repairs in 1972 and 2001. This bridge is
consid-ered a rare survivor due to the increasing occurrence of steel truss bridges being demolished but not replaced
in the watershed and province-wide.
East Garafraxa 8 号大桥基本上保持不变，在 1972 年和 2001 年进行了小规模的维修。这座桥梁被认为是一个
罕见的幸存者，因为越来越多的钢桁架桥梁被拆除，但没有更换在流域和全省范围内。
Sources: Township of East Garafraxa Bridge and Large Culverts Capital Forecast 2011
资料来源: East Garafraxa 大桥和大涵洞镇 2011 年首都预测

General Description
一般描述
East Garafraxa Bridge 14 is located on 10th Sideroad, 0.3 km west of 13 Line. It was constructed circa the 1940s and is
the only bridge of its type remaining in the Township of East Garafraxa. This structure was constructed on site and the
concrete support beams were poured in place. It exhibits uniquely tapered concrete balustrades with triangular pointed top
caps. The thin board finish is still visible in the concrete abutments, which support a relatively short span.
东 Garafraxa 大桥 14 号位于 13 号线以西 0.3 公里的第 10 侧道上。它大约建于 20 世纪 40 年代，是东 Garafraxa 镇
仅存的同类型桥梁。这个结构是在现场建造的，混凝土支撑梁已经浇筑到位。它展示了独特的锥形混凝土栏杆与
三角形尖顶帽。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土桥台上看到，它支撑着相对较短的跨度。
Source: Township of East Garafraxa Bridge and Large Culverts Capital Forecast 2011
资料来源: East Garafraxa 大桥和大涵洞 2011 年首都预测

General Description
一般描述
The Grand River Bridge is located on Highway 109, 0.2 km west of East Junction 25 near the community of
Waldemar in the Township of East Garafraxa. It was constructed in 1953 and is the earliest of this bridge type found
in the Township. The concrete rigid frame was introduced in Ontario in the 1930s and continued to be the dominant
form of highway bridges in the province during the 1950s until the introduction of pre-stressed precast concrete
beam and post-tension cast in place structures became more popular in the 1960s. This structure is representative of
the larger, stronger concrete rigid frame bridges built after World War II to accommodate an increase in personal
motorized vehicles.
格兰德河大桥位于 109 号高速公路上，在 25 号东路口以西 0.2 公里，靠近东 Garafraxa 镇的 Waldemar 社区。
它建于 1953 年，是该镇发现的最早的这种桥型。混凝土刚架于 1930 年代引入安大略省，并在 1950 年代继
续成为该省公路桥梁的主要形式，直到 1960 年代引入预应力混凝土预制梁和后张法现浇结构变得更加普遍。
这种结构是二战后为了适应个人机动车辆的增加而建造的更大、更强的混凝土刚架桥的代表。
The three-span, elliptically arched Grand River Bridge is set quite high above the floodplain on two piers. The piers
exhibit pronounced triangular shaped ice breaks. A benchmark from the Department of Highways is located on the
southwest side of the bridge.
这座三跨椭圆拱形的大河大桥位于漫滩上空的两个桥墩上，相当高。桥墩呈现出明显的三角形冰裂。来自
高速公路部门的标杆位于桥的西南侧。
Sources: Dufferin County Grand River Bridge List
来源: Dufferin County 大河桥列表

General Description
一般描述
Keldon Bridge is located on Sideroad 27-28, 0.3 km south of Highway 89 in the community of Keldon. It was
engineered by Christie & Beattie and constructed in 1929. Keldon Bridge represents the only remaining concrete
bowstring arch bridge in the Town of Grand Valley. This bridge is paired with the very similar Jonston Bridge in the
neighbouring Township of Amaranth, which was also engineered by Christie & Beattie, designed in the same style
and constructed in the same year.
Keldon 大桥位于 Keldon 社区 89 号公路以南 0.3 公里的 27-28 号侧道上。它由 Christie & Beattie 设计，建于
1929 年。Keldon 大桥是 Grand Valley 镇仅存的混凝土弓弦拱桥。这座桥与邻近的 Amaranth 镇的 Jonston 桥
非常相似，这座桥也是由 Christie & Beattie 设计的，设计风格相同，同年建成。
The bowstring design was popular in the early 1900s as it required minimal material, was simple to install,
represented newer construction materials and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic. Many of these structures
were built in the Grand River watershed, however they are quickly disappearing due to demolition and replacement
with wider, more load-bearing structures.
弓弦设计在 20 世纪早期很流行，因为它需要最少的材料，安装简单，代表了新的建筑材料，可以很容易地
适应车辆交通。许多这样的建筑都是在大河流域建造的，但是它们由于被拆除而迅速消失，取而代之的是
更广阔的、承重更大的建筑。
While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among bowstring truss structures. The concrete trusses on the
Keldon Bridge are shallow and thick. Solid railing walls merge into the arch and display decorative embossed
squares and a slightly protruding capped end post. Due to damage, only the southwest end post remains. The railings
located in the centre of the arch are open balustrades that span between each stringer. The thin board finish is still
visible in the concrete.
作为一种基本类型，弓弦桁架结构有着相当大的多样性。Keldon 大桥上的混凝土桁架是浅而厚的。坚固的
栏杆墙融入拱门，显示装饰浮雕方块和一个稍微突出的端部立柱。由于损坏，只剩下西南端的柱子。拱门
中央的栏杆是开放的栏杆，横跨在每个纵梁之间。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土中看到。
Keldon Bridge is clearly visible to motorists on Highway 89 as it is set amongst a picturesque agricultural landscape.
Keldon 桥位于风景如画的农业景观之中，对 89 号高速公路上的驾车者来说清晰可见。
It thus represents a landmark within the community of Keldon.
因此，它代表了 Keldon 社区的一个里程碑。
Sources: ELGV Bridge Inspections Summary, 2011
资料来源: ELGV 桥梁检查摘要，2011

是一个里程碑
General Description
一般描述
ELGV Bridge #7 is located on Sideroad 24-25, 0.2 km south of Concession Road 8-9. It was constructed circa 1920
and is the only bridge of its kind remaining in the Town of Grand Valley, however it is similar to structures found in
the Townships of Amaranth and Wellington North.
ELGV 桥 7 号位于特许路 8-9 以南 0.2 公里的 24-25 号侧道上。它建于 1920 年左右，是格兰德山谷镇仅存的
同类桥梁，但它与阿马兰特和惠灵顿北镇的建筑结构相似。
This bridge displays an early experimentation with concrete, which has resulted in decoratively embossed solid
concrete railings, which are comparatively taller and thicker than other similar structures. The thin board finish is
still visible in the concrete.
这座桥展示了早期的混凝土试验，这导致了装饰浮雕实心混凝土栏杆，这是相对较高和较厚的其他类似结
构。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土中看到。
Source: ELGV Bridge Inspections Summary, 2011

General Description
一般描述
ELGV Bridge #10 is located on Sideroad 27-28, 1 km south of Concession Road 12-13. It was constructed circa
1930 and is one of the earlier rigid frame bridges remaining in the Town of Grand Valley. It is representative of the
bridge type built in this era throughout the watershed. However, ELGV Bridge #10 is more decorative than other
rigid frames, depicting art deco inspired concrete balustrades embossed with varying line lengths.
ELGV 桥 10 号位于特许公路 12-13 以南 1 公里的 27-28 号侧道上。它建于 1930 年左右，是格兰德山谷镇保
留下来的较早的刚构桥之一。它是这个时代在整个流域建造的桥梁类型的代表。然而，ELGV 桥 # 10 比其
他刚性框架更具装饰性，描绘了艺术装饰灵感的混凝土栏杆浮雕不同线长。
Source: ELGV Bridge Inspections Summary, 2011

General Description
一般描述
The Concession 6 Abutments are located just south of County Road 25 and align with Concession 6 in the Town of
Grand Valley. They are located perpendicular to Grand River Structure No. 2, which now carries County Road 25
across the Grand River. The abutments are estimated to have been constructed circa 1910 and appear to have
originally carried Concession 6, which has now been realigned around County Road 25 and the newer Grand River
Structure No. 2.
特许 6 号桥墩位于 25 号县道以南，与格兰德山谷镇的特许 6 号桥对齐。它们垂直于格兰德河 2 号建筑物，
现在该建筑物将 25 号县道穿过格兰德河。据估计，这些桥墩大约建于 1910 年左右，最初似乎带有特许权
6，现在已经重新排列在县道 25 号和较新的大河 2 号建筑物周围。
The large concrete abutments would have carried the previous structure high above the floodplain. Given the shape
of the abutments, they likely supported a steel truss bridge.
这些巨大的混凝土桥墩将原来的结构搬到了洪泛区的高处。考虑到桥墩的形状，它们很可能支撑着一座钢
桁架桥。

General Description
一般描述
Jonston Bridge is located on 6th Line, 0.2 km south of 15th Sideroad. It was constructed circa 1929 and represents
one of only two remaining concrete bowstring arch bridges in the Township of Amaranth, along with Sproules
Bridge. It was engineered by Christie & Beattie. Jonston Bridge is paired with the very similar Keldon Bridge in the
neighbouring Town of Grand Valley, which was also engineered by Christie & Beattie, designed in the same style
and constructed in the same year.
Jonston 大桥位于第 6 线，在第 15 侧道以南 0.2 公里处。它建于 1929 年左右，是 Amaranth 镇仅存的两座混
凝土弓弦拱桥之一，与 Sproules 桥一起。它由 Christie & Beattie 设计。Jonston 大桥与附近城镇 Grand Valley
的 Keldon 大桥非常相似，该桥也由 Christie & Beattie 设计，设计风格相同，同年建成。
The bowstring design was popular in the early 1900s as it required minimal material, was simple to install,
represented newer construction materials and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic. Many of these structures
were built in the Grand River watershed, however they are quickly disappearing due to demolition and replacement
with wider, more load-bearing structures.
弓弦设计在 20 世纪早期很流行，因为它需要最少的材料，安装简单，代表了新的建筑材料，可以很容易地
适应车辆交通。许多这样的建筑都是在大河流域建造的，但是它们由于被拆除而迅速消失，取而代之的是
更广阔的、承重更大的建筑。
While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among bowstring truss structures. The concrete trusses on
Jonston Bridge are shallow and thick. Solid railing walls merge into the arch and display decorative embossed
squares and a slightly protruding capped end post. The railings located in the centre of the arch are open balustrades
that span between each stringer. The thin board finish is still visible in the concrete.
作为一种基本类型，弓弦桁架结构有着相当大的多样性。Jonston 桥上的混凝土桁架是浅而厚的。坚固的栏
杆墙融入拱门，显示装饰浮雕方块和一个稍微突出的端部立柱。位于拱门中央的栏杆是开放的栏杆，横跨
在每个纵梁之间。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土中看到。
Sources: Township of Amaranth 2008 Structure Inventory
来源: Amaranth 镇 2008 结构清单

General Description
一般描述
Sproules Bridge is located on 6th Line, 0.4 km north of 15th Sideroad. It was constructed in 1912 and represents the
oldest concrete bowstring arch bridge remaining in the Grand River watershed. It is also one of only two remaining
concrete bowstring arch bridges in the Township, along with Jonston Bridge.
Sproules 大桥位于第 6 线，距第 15 侧道以北 0.4 公里。它建于 1912 年，是大河流域现存最古老的混凝土弓
弦拱桥。它也是该镇仅存的两座混凝土弓弦拱桥之一，另外还有 Jonston 大桥。
The bowstring design was popular in the early 1900s as it required minimal material, was simple to install,
represented newer construction materials and could easily accommodate vehicular traffic. Many of these structures
were built in the Grand River watershed, however they are quickly disappearing due to demolition and replacement
with wider, more load-bearing structures.
弓弦设计在 20 世纪早期很流行，因为它需要最少的材料，安装简单，代表了新的建筑材料，可以很容易地
适应车辆交通。许多这样的建筑都是在大河流域建造的，但是它们由于被拆除而迅速消失，取而代之的是
更广阔的、承重更大的建筑。
While of a basic type, there is considerable variety among bowstring truss structures. Sproules Bridge has relatively
small arches and its concrete trusses and railings are uniquely thin. Concrete railings flank each arch of the bridge
and end with a decoratively topped post. The thin board finish is still visible in the concrete and a plaque appears to
be missing from the bridge.
作为一种基本类型，弓弦桁架结构有着相当大的多样性。Sproules 桥有相对较小的拱，它的混凝土桁架和栏
杆是独一无二的薄。混凝土栏杆侧面的每个拱桥和结束与装饰性的顶部立柱。在混凝土中仍然可以看到薄
薄的木板表面，一块牌匾似乎从桥上消失了。
Sources: Township of Amaranth 2008 Structure Inventory

General Description
一般描述
Amaranth Structure No. 2 is located on 7th Line, 1.5 km north of Wellington Road 109. It was constructed circa
1920 and belongs to a group of five remaining reinforced concrete solid slab bridges built in the Township of
Amaranth during the same time period. This group includes Amaranth Structure No. 10, 11, 15 and 17. Like this
bridge, they each display an early experimentation with concrete, which has resulted in decoratively embossed solid
concrete railings. This bridge is less decorative and has a slightly shorter span than the other bridges in its group.
The thin board finish is still visible in the concrete. Amaranth Structure No. 2 is set quite low to the watercourse and
does not have wing walls.
阿马兰特 2 号建筑位于威灵顿 109 号公路以北 1.5 公里的 7 号线上。它建于 1920 年左右，属于同一时期建于
Amaranth 镇的五座剩余钢筋混凝土实心板桥。这一组包括 Amaranth 结构 10 号，11 号，15 号和 17 号。和
这座桥一样，他们每个人都展示了早期的混凝土实验，最终形成了装饰性的浮雕实心混凝土栏杆。这座桥
的装饰性较差，跨度比同类桥梁略短。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土中看到。Amaranth 的 2 号结构设置在离
河道很低的地方，没有翼墙。

General Description
一般描述
Amaranth Structure No. 10 is located on 7th Line, 1.5 km south of 15th Sideroad. It was constructed circa 1920 and be-
longs to a group of five remaining reinforced concrete solid slab bridges built in the Township of Amaranth during the
same time period. This group includes Amaranth Structure No. 2, 11, 15 and 17. Like this bridge, they each display an
early experimentation with concrete, which has resulted in decoratively embossed solid concrete railings. This bridge
exhibits the finest decorative detailing and is the best preserved of the group. The thin board finish is still visible in the
concrete. Amaranth Structure No. 10 is set quite high above Willow Brook on large abutments.
Amaranth 10 号建筑位于第 7 线，第 15 侧道以南 1.5 公里。它建于 1920 年左右，属于同一时期在 Amaranth 镇建
造的一组剩余的五座钢筋混凝土实心板桥。这一组包括 Amaranth 结构 2 号，11 号，15 号和 17 号。和这座桥一样，
他们每个人都展示了早期的混凝土实验，最终形成了装饰性的浮雕实心混凝土栏杆。这座桥展示了最好的装饰细
节，也是保存最完好的一座。薄板装饰仍然可以在混凝土中看到。Amaranth 第 10 号建筑位于柳溪上方，高高耸
立在大型桥墩上。

General Description

be-longs to a group of five remaining reinforced concrete solid slab bridges built in the Township of Amaranth

General Description
一般描述
Dufferin Bridge No. 10 is located on Melancthon-Proton Townline, 1.04 km north of Highway 89 on the border of
the Township of Melancthon in Dufferin County and the Township of Southgate in Grey County. It was constructed
in 1920 and is the only remaining steel truss bridge in the Township of Melancthon.
Dufferin 10 号大桥位于 Melancthon-Proton Townline，89号公路以北 1.04 公里，位于 Dufferin 县 Melancthon
镇和 Grey 县 Southgate 镇的交界处。它建于 1920 年，是 Melancthon 镇仅存的钢桁架桥。
Dufferin Bridge No. 10 is a truss frame structure with a timber deck and curb. It is supported by seven longitudinal
and four transverse riveted steel I-beams. Remnant abutments from a previous structure remained on either side of
the current bridge and they were incorporated into the newer abutments, although they bear no weight.
杜弗林 10 号大桥是一座桁架结构，桥面和路缘为木结构。它由 7 根纵向和 4 根横向铆接钢 i 梁支撑。以前
结构的残余桥台仍然保留在现有桥梁的两侧，它们被并入新的桥台，尽管它们没有承受重量。
Melancthon-Proton Townline dramatically skews around the Grand River to the northwest to allow the bridge the
shortest span possible. This was done in an effort to reduce construction costs, as it was more affordable to build a
straight bridge, rather than a skewed bridge.
Melancthon-Proton Townline 沿着大河向西北方向急剧倾斜，使桥梁的跨度尽可能缩短。这样做是为了降低
建设成本，因为建造一座直桥比建造一座倾斜的桥更实惠。
East Garafraxa Bridge 8 remains largely unaltered, undergoing railing improvements in 1994 and restoration work
in 1997. This bridge is considered a rare survivor due to the increasing occurrence of steel truss bridges being
demolished but not replaced in the watershed and province-wide.
东 Garafraxa 8 号大桥基本上保持不变，1994 年进行了铁路改造，1997 年进行了修复工程。这座桥被认为是
一个罕见的幸存者，因为越来越多的钢桁架桥梁被拆除，但没有更换在流域和全省范围内。

General Description
一般描述
G. Anderson Bridge is located on 8th Line SW, 3.4 km north of Highway 89. It was constructed circa 1960 and is
representative of the concrete rigid frame bridges built in the 1960s and found in the Township of Melancthon and
throughout the watershed. This bridge is unique due to its prominent and picturesque siting over the Grand River at
the intersection of 8th Line SW and Side Road 270. It represents a landmark in the agricultural landscape.
安德森大桥位于 89 号公路以北 3.4 公里的第 8 线西南部。它建于 1960 年左右，是 1960 年代在 Melancthon
镇和整个流域建造的混凝土刚架桥的代表。这座桥是独一无二的，因为它的突出和风景如画的坐落在格兰
德河上，位于第 8 线西南和 270 路的交叉口。它代表了农业景观中的一个里程碑。
G. Anderson Bridge is skewed by 35 degrees, has simple concrete railings and displays a pleasing elliptical arch.
安德森桥倾斜 35 度，有简单的混凝土栏杆和显示一个令人愉快的椭圆形拱。
Source: Township of Melancthon Municipal Structure Appraisals, 2010
资料来源: 2010 年 Melancthon 镇市政结构评估

General Description
一般描述
The Pedestrian Railway Bridge spans the Grand River perpendicular to 250 Sideroad, 0.38 km west of Highway 10
in the Township of Melancthon. The structure is a single-span steel half through beam bridge with a timber deck and
concrete abutments. The Toronto Grey & Bruce Railway likely constructed the first bridge on this site circa 1874,
the year the railway was constructed. Due to impressions left in the abutments it appears that a previous structure,
likely a truss bridge, has been removed and replaced with the current half through beam bridge. It is also likely that
the cur-rent structure was brought to this site from another location. The rail line, which was absorbed by the
Canadian Pacific Railway in the late nineteenth century, was abandoned circa 1988.
这座人行铁路桥横跨大河，与 Melancthon 镇 10 号公路以西 0.38 公里的 siderroad 250 号公路垂直。这座桥的
结构是一座单跨钢中穿梁桥，桥面为木质甲板和混凝土桥台。多伦多格雷和布鲁斯铁路公司可能在 1874 年
左右在这个地点建造了第一座桥梁，也就是铁路建成的那一年。由于桥台留下的痕迹，似乎之前的一个结
构，可能是一个桁架桥，已经被拆除，取而代之的是目前的中间梁桥。现在的结构很可能是从另一个地方
搬到这个地方的。这条铁路线在 19 世纪末被加拿大太平洋铁路吸收，大约在 1988 年被废弃。
The bridge has been converted from a railway crossing to a pedestrian and snowmobile trail and is sited in a very
pic-turesque agricultural landscape.
这座桥已经从一个铁路道口改造成了一个步行和雪地摩托车小径，坐落在一个风景如画的农业景观。
Source: Andreae, C. (1997). Lines of Country: An atlas of railway and waterway history in Canada
资料来源: Andreae，c. (1997)。国家线: 加拿大铁路和水路历史地图集

isolate trends. The following charts and graphs look at specific aspects of the 167 heritage bridges inventoried, such

的特定方面，例如桥梁类型、年龄范围、所有权类别、拆卸数字和设计趋势。

heritage bridges, demolitions and designations. Municipalities with no bridges recorded were only partially located

entirely located in the watershed, no bridges were included in the inventory as information was unavailable.
下面，表 1 代表了按市划分的分水岭，显示了所有桥梁的清单，所有遗产桥梁，拆除和指定。没有桥梁记

岭，但由于信息不可用，没有桥梁被包括在清单中。

Figure 2 graphically represents the distribution of heritage bridges across the watershed’s municipalities. It is
apparent that some municipalities house more heritage bridges than others. This can be due to the size of the
municipality, occurrence of rivers and streams, as well as local bridge building techniques. Wellington County,
specifically the Townships of Centre Wellington and Mapleton, contain the highest number of heritage bridges (16%
and 9%, respectively) in the watershed. The high proportion of concrete bowstring arch and steel truss bridges in the
County may explain this finding.
图 2 以图形方式表示了流域各城市的遗产桥梁的分布情况。很明显，一些城市比其他城市拥有更多的遗产
桥梁。这可能是由于城市的规模，河流和溪流的出现，以及当地的桥梁建设技术。威灵顿县，特别是中威
灵顿乡和梅普尔顿镇，拥有最高数量的遗产桥梁(分别为 16% 和 9%)在分水岭。该郡混凝土弓弦拱和钢桁架
桥的高比例可以解释这一发现。

图 2。流域城市中确定的遗产桥梁数量。

A number of different bridge types were found in the watershed, however some were more commonly identified.
Figure 3 breaks down the percentage of each bridge type found in the inventory. Through trusses, concrete
bowstring arch, rigid frame, pony truss and concrete arch bridges, respectively, were the most plentiful. The
predominance of these structures speaks to the regional historic trends in bridge construction observed in the
watershed and more fully discussed in Section 1.3 of this report.
在流域中发现了许多不同的桥梁类型，但其中一些更为常见。图 3 分解了清单中发现的每种桥梁类型的百
分比。通过桁架，混凝土弓弦拱，刚性框架，小马桁架和混凝土拱桥，分别是最丰富的。这些结构的优势
说明了在流域观察到的桥梁建设的区域历史趋势，本报告第 1.3 节对此进行了更充分的讨论。
Figure 3. Heritage bridges identified by type.
图 3。按类型确定的遗产桥梁。
Periods of construction were analyzed and revealed that a majority of the watershed’s heritage bridges (115 or 69%)
were constructed between 1900-1949 (Figure 4). The commonly found truss and concrete bowstring arch bridges
typically constructed during this period support the finding. Twenty (12%) bridges were constructed during the
period from 1850-1899. This small number is accounted for by the loss of very old structures over time. Conversely,
the limited number of bridges (19%) constructed from 1950-1999 is due to the newness of the structures and their
inability to meet the criteria for inclusion set in the projects scope (sec. 2.1). Most notably, many did not meet the
35-year age cut off.
分析了施工周期，发现大多数流域的遗产桥梁(115 或 69%)是在 1900-1949 年间建造的(图 4)。常见的桁架和
混凝土弓弦拱桥通常在这一时期建造支持这一发现。在 1850-1899 年间建造了 20 座(12%)桥梁。这一小部分
是由于随着时间的推移，非常古老的结构的损失。相反，1950-1999 年间建造的桥梁数量有限(19%) ，是由
于这些桥梁结构新颖，无法满足项目范围所规定的列入标准(第 2.1 节)。最值得注意的是，许多没有达到 35
岁的年龄截止。

图 4。按年龄分列的遗产桥梁。
Ownership categories were analyzed in an effort to determine which levels of government, organizations or
individuals would be best suited to actively conserve heritage structures in the watershed (Figure 5)1. The results
indicate that lower-tier municipalities own 52% of the bridges with significant cultural heritage value. However, that
number combined with the figures for upper-tier (20%) and single-tier (19%), accounts for 91% of bridge
ownership. As a result, incentives and support should be provided to assist these regions, counties, cities and
townships in maintaining and rehabilitating, designating and celebrating their heritage bridges.
对所有权类别进行了分析，以确定哪些级别的政府、组织或个人最适合积极保护流域遗产结构(图 5)1。结
果表明，下层自治区拥有 52% 具有重要文化遗产价值的桥梁。然而，这个数字加上上层桥梁(20%)和单层桥
梁(19%)的数字，占桥梁所有权的 91% 。因此，应当提供激励和支持，协助这些地区、县、市和乡维护和修
复、指定和庆祝其遗产桥梁。
Figure 5. Ownership of heritage bridges by category.
图 5。按类别划分的遗产桥梁的所有权。
Thirteen bridges in the Grand River watershed have been designated under the Ontario Heritage Act (see Appen-dix
D). Figure 6 graphically represents the municipalities in which these designated structures are located.
根据《安大略遗产法》 ，大河流域的 13 座桥梁已被指定(见附录 d)。图 6 以图形方式表示这些指定结构所
在的城市。
1 Single-tier municipalities are represented by one level of governance responsible for providing a municipality with all services. In the case of
two levels of governance, a county or region shares responsibilities with their constituent cities, towns, townships or villages and are often referred to as upper and
lower-tier municipalities, respectively (MMAH, 2013).
单层市政府由一个级别的治理机构代表，负责为市政府提供所有服务。在两级治理的情况下，一个县或地区与其组成城市、城镇、乡镇或村庄分担责
任，通常分别称为上层和下层自治区(MMAH，2013 年)。

It also draws a comparison between the total number of heritage bridges identified in this inventory by the total

their best practices.
它还将本清单中确定的遗产桥梁总数与人道协调厅正式指定的建筑物总数进行比较。被指定的城市数量很
多，例如有 5 个城市的圭尔夫，这是其他城市可以借鉴的一种保护模式，采用了它们的最佳做法。

图 6。按市政府划分的指定遗产桥梁的位置。
Although conservation is the goal of this report, it is also necessary to comment on trends threatening heritage
bridge retention. Figure 7, below, indicates the number of heritage bridges demolished to date in each watershed
municipality. The most alarming rates of demolition are occurring in Wellington County, home to a number of
concrete bowstring arch, truss and concrete arch bridges. Figure 8 indicates that these bridge types are the most
threatened. It is also necessary to note, however, that the municipalities with the highest number of bridges naturally
have correspondingly high numbers of heritage bridges and demolitions.
虽然保护是本报告的目标，但也有必要对威胁文物桥梁保留的趋势发表评论。下面的图 7 显示了迄今为止
在每个流域城市拆除的遗产桥梁的数量。最令人震惊的拆除率发生在威灵顿县，许多混凝土弓弦拱，桁架
和混凝土拱桥的所在地。图 8 显示这些类型的桥梁受到的威胁最大。然而，有必要指出的是，桥梁数量最
多的城市自然也有相应数量的遗产桥梁和拆除。

图 7。按市镇划分的拆除桥梁数量。

6.0 Future Opportunities
6.0 未来的机遇
Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory provides opportunities for heritage
conservation and planning. Consistency across the province in this endeavour leads to the identification of similar
future opportunities as those discussed in the TRCA’s inventory, Crossing the Humber. They include:
拱，桁架和梁: 大河流域文物桥清单提供了文物保护和规划的机会。在这项努力中，全省范围内的一致性导
致了类似的未来机会的确定，就像 TRCA 的目录中所讨论的那样，跨越亨伯河。它们包括:
• listing of all identified heritage bridges on the GRCA’s GIS GRIN mapping system for use in cultural
planning efforts, community education and heritage tourism undertaking further research on the watershed’s bridges, building on
and growing this inventory as more information becomes available review of the inventory that will assist in determining if a
Heritage Impact Assessment will be required as part of the Environmental Assessment planning review process for applications
that may impact heritage bridges conserving bridges through adaptive reuse in an effort to give the structure new life while
meeting community needs, such as the creation of pedestrian bridges incorporating heritage bridges into municipal official
planning documents, such as pedestrian and recreational master plans providing a model that is easily adaptable, and could be
used to undertake further inventory work in other municipalities in Ontario additional municipal inventories could be merged into
a province-wide inventory, allowing for the comparative analysis of bridges and trends across Ontario
将所有已确定的文物桥梁列入 GRCA 的地理信息系统 GRIN 绘图系统，用于文化规划工作、社区教育
和文物旅游进一步研究流域的桥梁，随着更多信息的获得，在这一清单的基础上进一步增加这一清
单，审查清单将有助于确定是否需要进行文物影响评估，作为环境评估规划审查进程的一部分，审
查可能通过适应性再利用影响文物桥梁保护工作的申请，努力在满足社区需求的同时赋予这一结构
新的生命,例如建造人行桥梁，将遗产桥梁纳入市政府官方规划文件，例如提供易于调整的模式的
步行和娱乐总体规划，并可用于在安大略省其他城市开展进一步的盘存工作，额外的市政盘存可合
并为全省盘存，以便对安大略省的桥梁和趋势进行比较分析
7.0 Next Steps
7.0 下一步
Following the completion of this inventory, the next steps include:
完成这份清单后，下一步包括:
1. Distribution of the inventory results to watershed municipalities, stakeholders and interested individuals.
向流域城市、利益攸关方和感兴趣的个人分发清单结果。
2. Updating the GRCA’s GIS GRIN mapping system with the identified heritage bridge locations.
更新 GRCA 的地理信息系统 GRIN 映射系统与确定的遗产桥梁位置。
3. Updating the GRCA’s Heritage River Inventory in support of the 20-year Heritage River Monitoring Report for
the Grand River, due in 2014. Corresponding heritage summaries, evaluation criteria and photographs will be made available to
encourage public education and heritage awareness throughout the watershed.
更新 GRCA 的文物河流清单，以支持 2014 年到期的大河 20 年文物河流监测报告。政府将提供相应的文物摘
要、评估准则和照片，以鼓励公众教育和提高对整个流域的文物意识。
361
361
全面
这种规模的工作
有助提高市民对区内文化遗产基础设施的认识。
Heritage Resources Centre
文物资源中心
4. Adding the identified heritage bridges to Building Stories, an online interactive inventory of historic
将已确定的文物桥梁添加到“建筑故事”中，这是一个在线互动的历史清单
places in Canada. The site is a widely applicable tool well suited to crowd sourcing information. It is a
perfect venue for the public to enter additional details on each structure, thus enriching its significance and
usefulness as a planning tool. Inclusion on the site will assist in drawing tourists to the watershed as bridges
of interest can be visited individually or as a group by customizing driving tours.
加拿大的地方。这个网站是一个广泛应用的工具，非常适合于众包信息。它是公众输入每个结构的
额外细节的完美场所，从而丰富了它作为一个规划工具的重要性和有用性。包含在网站上将有助于
吸引游客到分水岭，因为有兴趣的桥梁可以单独访问或作为一个团体通过定制驾驶旅游。
5. Encouraging municipalities to further evaluate bridges with identified heritage significance under their jurisdiction in an
effort to pursue official recognition and protection under Section 27 and/or Section 29, Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act (see
Appendix H).
鼓励各市政当局进一步评估其管辖范围内具有确定遗产重要性的桥梁，努力根据《安大略遗产法》第
27 节和/或第 29 节第四部分寻求官方承认和保护(见附录 h)。
Note: It should be noted that designation applications must originate from the
municipality in which the bridge is located. Municipal designation would not
apply to federal or provincial crown properties or to active railway bridges
regulated under the Canada Transportation Act. These bridges should still be
listed as cultural heritage properties of interest on their respective municipal
heritage registers (TRCA, 2011).
注意: 应该指出的是，指定申请必须来自桥梁所在的市政当局。市政指定
不适用于联邦或省政府财产，也不适用于根据加拿大运输法管理的现役
铁路桥梁。这些桥梁仍然应该被列为各自市政遗产登记册上感兴趣的文
化遗产财产(TRCA，2011)。
8.0 Conclusion
8.0 结论
Following a year of detailed investigation, 167 heritage and 38 demolished bridges have been inventoried in the
Grand River watershed, culminating in the publication of Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand
经过一年的详细调查，大河流域的 167 处遗产和 38 座被拆毁的桥梁已经被清点，最终出版了《拱，桁架和
梁: 大河》
River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory. It will also contribute to the maintenance
of the Grand River’s Canadian Heritage River status and recognition of the
collaborative efforts of each watershed municipality in the promotion, protection and
conservation of our limited stock of heritage bridges.
河溪流域文物桥梁目录。它还将有助于维持大河的加拿大遗产河地位，并承认每
个流域城市在促进、保护和保护我们有限的遗产桥梁方面的合作努力。
This inventory has taken strides to:
这个清单已经在以下方面取得了长足进步:
• Recognize bridges of cultural heritage value and significance to water-
shed communities to the extent possible noting the limitations outlined in
Section 2.2
注意到第 2.2 节概述的局限性，尽可能认识到文化遗产对流域社区的价
值和意义的桥梁
Comprehensive
work of this scale has
not been undertaken in the
watershed, and will serve to
broaden awareness of the
area’s cultural heritage
infrastructure.
• Identify groups with jurisdiction over most heritage bridges, notably regional and local municipalities
确定对大多数遗产桥梁具有管辖权的群体，特别是地区和当地市政当局
• Foster civic identity and pride by drawing attention to the heritage and development of a community
通过关注社区的传统和发展，培养公民的认同感和自豪感
• Provide easily accessible information about cultural heritage value for land-use planners, architects, consultants, property
owners, developers, the tourism industry, educators and interested members of the general public
为土地用途规划师、建筑师、顾问、业主、发展商、旅游业界、教育工作者和有兴趣的市民提供有关文
化遗产价值的资料
• Represent a central element of municipal cultural planning that begins with mapping local cultural resources and then
leverages these resources for economic development and community building
是市政文化规划的一个核心要素，首先绘制当地文化资源地图，然后利用这些资源促进经济发展和社区
建设
It is hoped that the example set in this inventory, along with the ground-breaking work pioneered by the Toronto and
Region Conservation Authority, will inspire other watershed communities located along Canadian rivers to
recognize, conserve and celebrate their unique cultural heritage resources.
希望这份清单所树立的榜样，以及多伦多和地区保护局开创的突破性工作，将激励加拿大河流沿岸的其他
流域社区承认、保护和庆祝其独特的文化遗产资源。

APPENDIX G: General overview of Ontario bridge types
附录 g: 安大略省桥梁类型的一般概述
Type
类型
Comments
评论
Timber
木材
Typically used for agricultural areas in the 1800s with log beams and rock filled timber
cribs.
在 19 世纪通常用于农业地区的原木梁和填满岩石的木材摇篮。
Material was readily available. King and Queen timber posts were used until the 1900s
for longer
材料很容易获得，直到 1900 年代，国王和王后的木桩使用时间更长
spans. Timber trestles were constructed for rail after 1850. Timber is suitable in tension
and
木栈桥是 1850 年后为铁路建造的。木材适用于张力和
compression.
压缩。
Masonry
圬工
Used principally in Ontario for structure foundations. Little skilled labour for bridges
available so
主要用于安大略省的结构基础
only a few constructed. When it was used they were frequently built in rough stone and
mortar.
只有少数已建成的桥梁。在使用桥梁时，桥梁通常是用粗糙的石头和砂浆建造的。
Cast Iron
铸铁
Though used in the United Kingdom from the early 1800s for arches and beams there was
little
尽管从 19 世纪早期开始在英国用于制造拱门和横梁，但这种材料很少
iron industry in Canada until later and so it was infrequently used. Cast iron is good in
compres-
在加拿大，直到后来的铁工业，所以它很少被使用。铸铁是好的压缩
sion but not tension and there were many beam failures.
但不会产生张力，而且有许多梁失效。
Wrought Iron
锻铁
Wrought iron had improved strength and was not brittle. It also had good tension and
compres-
锻铁提高了强度，不易脆，也具有良好的拉伸和压缩性能
sion. It replaced the cast iron bridges when the railway arrived (1830s in Britain and
1850s in
铁路建成后(19 世纪 30 年代的英国和 19 世纪 50 年代的英国) ，它取代了铸铁桥梁
Canada). Wrought iron was used for plate girders and many different truss types that
were largely
锻铁被用于板梁和许多不同的桁架类型，这些类型在很大程度上
developed in the United States. They were no longer used after 1900. The era of
“catalogue”
它们在 1900 年以后就不再使用了
bridges started at this time.
桥梁开始于这个时候。
Steel
钢铁
Steel had higher strength in compression and tension and better quality control but rusted
more
钢具有较高的抗压强度和抗拉强度，质量控制较好，但锈蚀较多
than wrought iron. Developed in the 1860s, Ead’s Arches in St. Louis, US was the first
major user
在 19 世纪 60 年代发展起来的，位于美国圣路易斯的 Ead 的拱门是第一个主要的使
用者
of steel in 1873. The period coincided with better analytical capability; creation of the
first engi-
这一时期恰逢分析能力提高的时期; 第一台发动机的诞生
neering school in Canada at the University of New Brunswick; and the emergence of the
Cana-
加拿大新不伦瑞克大学的 neering 学校，以及 Cana 的出现
dian Society of Civil Engineers in 1886 (principal founders Keefers, Gzowski, Fleming).
Railways
1886 年，印度土木工程师学会(主要创始人 Keefers，Gzowski，Fleming)
produced the first bridge specifications after 1870. Steel became the major material for
bridge
1870 年以后，钢成为桥梁的主要材料
construction after 1870 replacing wrought iron.
1870 年后，建筑工程取代了锻铁。
Concrete
混凝土
Although used in various formats in Europe since Roman times, the emergence of
Portland Ce-
尽管自罗马时代以来，欧洲已经使用了不同的格式，但是波特兰 Ce 的出现
ment in 1855 produced concrete of higher quality, strength and durability. Used then for
mass
1855 年生产的混凝土质量更高，强度更高，耐久性更好
concrete walls, abutments and footings. Good in compression but cracked in tension.
混凝土墙、桥墩和基础。抗压性能好，但抗拉时会出现裂缝。
Reinforced Concrete
钢筋混凝土
Steel reinforcing of concrete in tension areas resulted in much wider use. Then it was
used for
钢筋混凝土在受拉区域得到了更广泛的应用
beams as well as arches. Developed first in France in the 1880s, the first super structure
use in
横梁以及拱门。19 世纪 80 年代在法国首次发展，第一个超级结构用于
Ontario was for the arch bridge in Massey in 1906. The first rigid frames were introduced
on the
1906 年，安大略省在梅西建造了拱桥。第一个刚性框架被引入到建筑中
Queen Elizabeth Highway in 1938 and then widely used on Highways 400 and 401 in the
1940s
伊丽莎白女王高速公路在 1938 年，然后广泛使用的 400 和 401 高速公路在 1940 年
代
and 1950s. Reinforced concrete replaced mass concrete for wall, abutments, piers and
footings in
20 世纪 50 年代，钢筋混凝土取代了大体积混凝土，用于墙壁、桥台、桥墩和基础
the 1930s.
1930 年代。
Pre-stressed Concrete
预应力混凝土
Developed by Freyssinet in France in the 1930s to eliminate cracking of concrete in
tension areas,
由法国 Freyssinet 公司于 20 世纪 30 年代开发，用于消除混凝土在受压区域的裂缝,
the first of these beams occurred in Ontario in 1954. Can be used pre-cast; cast in place
either pre
1954 年，安大略省首次出现了这种梁。可用于预制; 可用于预制
or post tensioned. Presently the most widely used bridge construction material.
目前使用最广泛的桥梁建筑材料。

APPENDIX H: Excerpt from the Ontario Heritage Act,
附录 h: 《安大略省遗产法》节选,
Sections 27 and 29, Part IV
第 27 及 29 条，第 IV 部分
Ontario Heritage Act
安大略省遗产法
PART IV
第四部分
CONSERVATION OF PROPERTY OF CULTURAL HERITAGE VALUE OR INTEREST
文化遗产价值或利益财产的保护
Register
登记册
27. (1) The clerk of a municipality shall keep a register of property situated in the municipality that is of cultural heritage value or
interest. 2005, c. 6, s. 15.
(1)市政府办事员应当对本市具有文化遗产价值或者利益的财产进行登记。2005 年第 6 节第 15 条。
Contents of register
登记册内容
(1.1) The register kept by the clerk shall list all property situated in the municipality that has been designated by
the municipality or by the Minister under this Part and shall contain, with respect to each property,
(1.1)办事员保存的登记册应列出市政当局或部长根据本部分指定的位于该市的所有财产，并应载有关于每
一财产的内容,
(a) a legal description of the property;
财产的法律描述;
(b) the name and address of the owner; and
业主的姓名和地址; 以及
(c) a statement explaining the cultural heritage value or interest of the property and a description of the heritage
解释物业的文化遗产价值或利益的说明，以及文物的描述
attributes of the property. 2005, c. 6, s. 15.
物业的属性。2005，c. 6，第 15 条。
Designation of Properties by Municipalities
市政当局指定财产
Designation by municipal by-law
由市政法规指定
29. (1) The council of a municipality may, by by-law, designate a property within the municipality to be of cultural heritage value
or interest if,
(1)市议会可依法指定市内具有文化遗产价值或利益的财产，如果:
(a) where criteria for determining whether property is of cultural heritage value or interest have been prescribed by
如何界定财产是否具有文化遗产价值或利益的标准已由
regulation, the property meets the prescribed criteria; and
规例下，该物业符合订明的准则; 及
(b) the designation is made in accordance with the process set out in this section. 2005, c. 6, s. 17 (1).
指定是按照本条第 6 条第 17(1)条所列明的程序进行。
Source: Province of Ontario. (2005). Ontario Heritage Act. Retrieved from: http://www.e-laws.gov.on.ca/html/statutes/english/elaws_
statutes_90o18_e.htm#BK39.
资料来源: 安大略省(2005) . 《安大略遗产法》检索自: http://www.e-laws. gov. on.ca/html/statutes/english/laws _ statutes _ 90o18 _ e.
htm # bk39。

APPENDIX I: Ontario Regulation 9/06
附录一: 安大略省法规 9/06
Ontario Heritage Act
安大略省遗产法
ONTARIO REGULATION 9/06
安大略省第 9/06 条
CRITERIA FOR DETERMINING CULTURAL HERITAGE VALUE OR INTEREST
确定文化遗产价值或利益的标准
Consolidation Period: From January 25, 2006 to the e-Laws currency date.
巩固期: 从 2006 年 1 月 25 日至电子法律通用日期。
No amendments.
没有修改。
Criteria
准则
1. (1) The criteria set out in subsection (2) are prescribed for the purposes of clause 29 (1) (a) of the Act. O. Reg.
9/06, s. 1 (1).
(1)第(2)款规定的准则是为了《法案》第 29(1)(a)条的目的而订立的。O. 规例。9/06，第 1(1)条。
(2) A property may be designated under section 29 of the Act if it meets one or more of the following criteria for
determining whether it is of cultural heritage value or interest:
如果某一财产符合下列一项或多项标准以确定其是否具有文化遗产价值或利益，则可根据该法第 29 条
指定该财产:
1. The property has design value or physical value because it,
该属性具有设计值或物理值,
i. is a rare, unique, representative or early example of a style, type, expression, material or
construc-tion method,
是一个罕见的，独特的，代表性的或早期的样式，类型，表达，材料或建筑方法的例子,
ii. displays a high degree of craftsmanship or artistic merit, or

Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
PReface
Bridges – primarily road but also railway– are important cultural features within the Grand River watershed and
support the national status of the Grand River and its major tributaries as Canadian Heritage Rivers. Some, such as the
timber covered bridge of West Montrose, are unique survivors of once common designs. A few, such as the massive,
nine-span concrete bowstring bridge across the Grand River at Caledonia, are visually arresting in their scale and form.
Yet most of the structures in the watershed are “ordinary” steel or concrete bridges. However, close examination can
reveal that they are anything but ordinary in what they can tell us about the past and present. And many, with steel
trusses or concrete arches rising above the land have an aesthetic quality.
Bridges, like people, have finite lives. Increased traffic loads, salt damage, and freeze/thaw cycles are some of the
common factors affecting bridge life. These events are predictable and the loss of key bridges can be planned for.
This is why an inventory, like this one of the Grand River watershed, is so important. The inventory can highlight
structures before they become a crisis. With pro-active planning it may be possible to reuse the bridge in less strenuous
locations, sympathetically repair rather than replace the bridge, or encourage the design of a new structure to be
of equal visual quality to the one it replaced.
But the inventory is not only for management. For those that have a hankering for old bridges, Arch, Truss & Beam:
The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory is a gazetteer for anyone that wants to explore the area. You can
discover parts of Ontario and the adjoining resources you never knew existed.
Christopher Andreae, PhD
Heritage Resources Centre

Arch, Truss & Beam: The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory
1
execuTIve summaRy
Bridges are an important component of our human heritage, representing an evolution in building materials
and techniques as well as reflecting the aesthetics of the time. Early bridges help to demonstrate the role of rivers
in the industrial and cultural development of Canada. Bridges in the Grand River watershed act as passageways
through time, providing clues as to how and why local communities and economies developed and evolved.
These remaining heritage bridges should be interpreted, conserved and celebrated as vestiges linking our collective
present to our past.
Heritage bridges represent an endangered species in the 21st century, with many contemporary issues challenging
conservation efforts. Rural bridges are experiencing capacity issues due to the intensification of agricultural
practices and large new machinery. And with urbanization spreading throughout the watershed in the form of new
residential growth and increasing road networks and capacities, heritage bridges are often ill-equipped to compete
with newer construction techniques in terms of ease of approvals, affordability and load capacity. Newer structures are
not built with an emphasis on design, materials and aesthetics as they once were. Restrictive municipal and
provincial budgets have led to an increasing number of utilitarian bridges crossing the watershed’s rivers, resulting
in an ever-increasing loss of the area’s unique cultural heritage identity.
The Grand River Conservation Authority (GRCA), on behalf of watershed municipalities, is the steward of the
Canadian Heritage River designation for the Grand River and its major tributaries and has advocated the need
for a comprehensive inventory of heritage bridges in the watershed for many years. In 2012, the GRCA and the
Heritage Resources Centre at the University of Waterloo formed a partnership to carry out Arch, Truss, Beam:
The Grand River Watershed Heritage Bridge Inventory. The goal of this study was to support the designation of the
Grand River and its four tributaries, identify and encourage the listing or designation of bridges with significant cultural
heritage value under the Ontario Heritage Act, as well as promote the unique character and tourism potential of
structures located in each watershed municipality.
To undertake this inventory, the 39 watershed municipalities (seven upper-tier, 26 lower-tier and six single-tier)
and two First Nations were contacted to obtain information on bridges under their jurisdiction. This resulted
in full municipal cooperation in the study. Various provincial, private and community organizations, as well as
local residents were consulted to gather further background research. Maps were reviewed and site visits carried
out to functional and abandoned bridges, as well as abutments. Each bridge that exhibited potential cultural
heritage value was evaluated using the Ontario Heritage Act’s (OHA), Ontario Regulation 9/06: Criteria for determining
cultural heritage value or interest. Of the 678 bridges inventoried, 167 (25%) were found to have heritage value.
As well, 38 demolished structures were identified that were most likely heritage bridges. Additionally, 13 bridges
formally designated under the OHA were identified. Figure 1 illustrates the inventory’s main findings.
This inventory hopes to contribute to the growing
discourse surrounding heritage conservation in
Ontario, while building on the seminal work
undertaken by the Toronto and Region Conserva-
tion Authority, Crossing the Humber: The Humber
River Heritage Bridge Inventory. This project
represents the adaptation of the bridge inventory
process as a conservation planning tool to meet the
unique context of the Grand River watershed: the
largest inland watershed in southwestern Ontario,
comprised of 6,800 km2. This tool could be further
adapted by other watersheds to elaborate on the
base of knowledge surrounding the conservation
of Ontario’s heritage bridges.
